TL;DR: 提出VisualErase，通过重定向视觉生成轨迹实现更鲁棒的概念擦除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法主要重定向文本到图像的映射，但模型仍保留目标概念的视觉生成轨迹，易受对抗恢复攻击。

Method: 利用结构保持图像编辑构建内容对齐、概念移除的配对图像，导出每个源图到配对图的去噪目标，用双分支重定向损失对齐文本条件和无条件预测，并联合优化配对保留损失以维持非目标生成。

Result: 在风格、名人、裸露擦除任务中，七种攻击下最大攻击成功率分别限制为0%、8%、0.1%，同时保持通用生成质量。

Conclusion: 视觉轨迹重定向对超越文本到图像映射的鲁棒概念擦除至关重要。

Abstract: Concept erasure is essential for the safe deployment of text-to-image diffusion models, as they may reproduce harmful, copyrighted, or privacy-sensitive content learned from unconstrained large-scale data. Existing methods typically erase unwanted concepts while preserving general generation capability by redirecting target-related text-to-image mappings. However, recent studies show that erased models may still retain visual generative trajectories of target concepts, leaving them vulnerable to adversarial recovery attacks and revealing a fundamental gap between redirecting text-to-image mappings and truly removing visual knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose VisualErase, a new paradigm that redirects concept-bearing visual generative trajectories toward explicitly defined concept-removed outcomes. To enable this redirection, we use structure-preserving image editing to construct content-aligned, concept-removed counterparts for source images, providing explicit visual endpoints that retain non-target content. We then derive a denoising target from each source-to-counterpart pair and use a dual-branch redirection loss to align both text-conditioned and unconditional predictions with this target, since conditional supervision alone does not explicitly constrain generation without textual guidance. To mitigate the adverse effects of concept erasure on non-target generation, we jointly optimize the redirection loss with a counterpart retention loss that matches denoising predictions from the frozen pretrained model. Across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure, VisualErase limits the maximum attack success rate over seven attacks to 0%, 8%, and 0.1%, respectively, while retaining general generation quality. These results highlight the importance of visual trajectory redirection for robust concept erasure beyond text-to-image mappings alone.

</details>


### [93] [PortraitAes: Intent-Conditioned Structured Portrait Aesthetics Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05010)
*Junzhou Xie,Haozhong Xiong,Xunyun Tian,Kaile Du,Tianchen Yu,Qiang Li,Wei Liu,Jiaming Liu,Ruihua Huang,Yang Shi,Guangcan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出人像美学评估基准PortraitAes-Bench及模型PortraitAes，通过意图条件化的多任务监督与分数校准，显著提升人像美学评分与排序的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人像美学评估方法通常只预测单一美学分数，或使用未针对摄影意图进行条件化的通用多模态大模型。由于相同的模糊、姿态、光照或构图在不同摄影意图下可能有益也可能有害，这些模型只能学到与上下文无关的美学先验，对具有不同摄影目标的人像给出不一致、不准确甚至误导性的判断。

Method: 构建11K规模的PortraitAes-Bench基准，将任务分解为意图条件化的子判断。由专家撰写的评分准则定义了9种摄影意图、6个一级维度和22个二级标准，并据此构建意图路由、专家评估、验证与分数融合的结构化流程。在此结构下训练PortraitAes并施加多任务监督，再通过高斯分数校准与维度内跨图像排序提升分数可比性。

Result: 在标准基准上，PortraitAes取得Pearson相关0.924、Spearman秩相关0.934；在困难样本集上，Pearson相关0.829、Spearman秩相关0.795。在两个集合上均优于所评估的通用多模态大模型和专用美学基线。

Conclusion: 将人像美学评估显式分解为意图条件化的多维度子判断，并结合结构化流程与分数校准，可有效克服上下文无关美学先验的缺陷，在人像美学评分与排序上达到领先性能。

Abstract: Portrait aesthetic assessment assigns comparable scores according to how effectively human-centered images fulfill their photographic intent. These scores support data filtering, candidate selection, and preference modeling in image-generation pipelines. Existing methods typically predict a single aesthetic score or use general-purpose MLLMs without conditioning on photographic intent. This omission matters because the same blur, pose, lighting, or framing choice may serve one photographic intent but undermine another. These models thus learn context-agnostic aesthetic priors and yield inconsistent, inaccurate, misleading judgments for portraits with distinct photographic objectives. We introduce PortraitAes-Bench, an 11K-scale benchmark that decomposes this task into intent-conditioned subjudgments. Expert-authored rubrics define nine photographic intents, six first-level dimensions, and 22 secondary criteria. They support a structured pipeline for intent routing, specialist assessment, verification, and score fusion. Following this structure, we train PortraitAes with multi-task supervision. We then improve score comparability through Gaussian score calibration and within-dimension cross-image ranking. On the standard benchmark, PortraitAes achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.924 and a Spearman rank correlation of 0.934. On the hard-case set, its Pearson correlation is 0.829 and its Spearman rank correlation is 0.795. Across both sets, PortraitAes outperforms the evaluated general-purpose MLLMs and specialized aesthetic baselines.

</details>


### [94] [EMBER-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Event Causal Memory in Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05013)
*Aoyang Cai,Boning Zhao,Shaoxuan Xie,Dahui Gao,Huan Yang,Zhongyuan Wang,Zhiwei Yu,Guocai Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出EMBER-Bench，一个用于长时程具身任务中跨事件因果推理的自我中心基准，包含189个家务任务和699个QA对，揭示现有模型在从历史事件提取因果信息并转化为当前行动约束方面存在显著困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终身物理智能体需在长时间交互中推理，过去事件消失后仍持续影响世界。智能体不仅要回忆发生了什么，还要推断历史如何改变当前状态并约束未来行动。然而现有具身与视频记忆基准主要关注历史检索与总结，对这种依赖历史的因果推理探索不足。

Method: 新构建EMBER-Bench：设计任务、录制视频、标注数据。包含189个家务任务、699个QA对，覆盖任务进展、失败恢复、外部干预及具有远距离依赖与前提条件的复合长时程任务，并附细粒度事件与因果链标注。评估双向推理：下一步动作预测（从历史中选择动作）与因果回溯（给定动作识别使其必要的历史事件）。输入消融实验加入动作日志或特权因果-结果标注。

Result: 16个模型中最高的总体准确率为61.2%，而两位人类评估者平均为98.3%。在配对决策点上，正确的回溯与正确的下一步动作预测并不相关。加入动作日志带来1.6个百分点的提升，而因果-结果标注在此基础上再带来13.0个百分点的额外提升。

Conclusion: 从过去事件中提取因果信息并转化为对当前行动约束，仍是长时程具身智能体的关键难题。

Abstract: Lifelong physical agents must reason over extended interactions where past events continue to shape the world long after they disappear from view. Beyond recalling what happened, agents must infer how history changes the current state and constrains future actions. Yet existing embodied and video-memory benchmarks largely focus on historical retrieval and summary, leaving such history-dependent causal reasoning underexplored. We introduce EMBER-Bench, an egocentric benchmark for cross-event causal reasoning in long-horizon embodied tasks, for which we newly created the task design, video recording, and data annotation. It contains 189 household tasks and 699 QA pairs, spanning task progress, failure recovery, external interventions, and compound long-horizon tasks with distant dependencies and prerequisites, with fine-grained event and causal-chain annotations. EMBER-Bench evaluates reasoning in both directions: next-action prediction selects the next action from history, and causal traceback, given that action, identifies the historical event that makes it necessary. Input ablations that add action logs or privileged cause-and-consequence annotations to the video indicate which kind of historical information models fail to use. Among the 16 evaluated models, the highest overall accuracy is 61.2%, compared with a mean of 98.3% across two human evaluators. At paired decision points, correct traceback is not associated with correct next-action prediction. Adding action logs yields a gain of 1.6 points, whereas cause-and-consequence annotations yield an additional gain of 13.0 points on top of that. These results suggest that extracting causal information from past events and converting it into constraints on current actions remains a key difficulty for long-horizon embodied agents. Project Page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/

</details>


### [95] [Look Where You Say You're Looking: Self-Grounded Attention for Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05023)
*Uri Berger,Gal Chechik,Gal Dalal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Saliency，通过将模型推理步骤中提到的图像区域作为监督信号，训练视觉语言模型提升视觉注意力与推理所指区域的对齐程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有引导视觉注意力的方法仅依据图像和问题确定目标区域，忽略了模型自身生成的推理内容；作者希望证明以推理为条件来定位目标区域能提升下游性能。

Method: 使用 grounding 模型定位每一步推理中提到的物体，将这些区域作为视觉注意力的监督信号，训练 VLM 使注意力对齐推理所指区域。

Result: 构建了包含 25 个视觉推理基准的统一评测套件并复现了先前方法；Self-Saliency 在平均排名和平均得分上均显著优于先前的注意力引导方法和图像级文本 grounding 基线。事后分析显示模型主要调整推理文本以适应已有注意力模式，产生更短、指向更大区域的步骤；在控制生成文本后，相关层中指向被 grounding 区域的注意力显著增加。还发现 VLM 视觉注意力存在朝向图像边缘的几何偏置，但消融表明增益并非仅由对齐图像中心导致。

Conclusion: 以模型自身推理为条件确定目标区域能有效提升视觉注意力对齐与下游性能，说明将视觉注意力对齐到推理中提到的区域至关重要，而这一增益不能由简单的中心对齐解释。

Abstract: We introduce Self-Saliency, a method for training Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to increase the alignment between their visual attention and the image regions mentioned in their reasoning. Self-Saliency uses a grounding model to localize the objects mentioned in each reasoning step and treats the resulting areas as supervision for the model's visual attention. Previous work on steering visual attention determines target image regions based solely on the image and question. In contrast, we show that conditioning the target regions on the model's generated reasoning improves downstream performance. For proper evaluation, we build a unified, broad suite of 25 visual reasoning benchmarks, where we reproduce the results of previous methods. We find that Self-Saliency significantly outperforms both prior attention-steering methods and baselines that ground image-level text, achieving both a better average rank and a better mean score. Post-training analysis shows that the model primarily adapts its reasoning text to existing attention patterns, producing shorter steps that refer to larger regions. Nevertheless, when controlling for generated text, attention to grounded regions increases significantly across the relevant layer. Finally, we identify a consistent geometric bias in VLM visual attention toward the image border. However, our ablations show that Self-Saliency's gains cannot be explained by simply aligning attention with the center of the image, highlighting the importance of aligning visual attention with the regions mentioned in the model's reasoning.

</details>


### [96] [LightVLN: Efficient Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation with Compact Memory and History-Guided Local Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05024)
*Yiming Zhao,Tianshun Li,Jingle He,Ruonan Chai,Xinhu Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级历史感知空中视觉-语言导航框架LightVLN，在降低算力与内存开销的同时实现优越性能，并完成机载闭环部署验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中视觉-语言导航（VLN）使无人机能依据自然语言指令在复杂三维环境中执行长时序任务，但现有模型依赖大规模视觉-语言骨干网络和密集视觉历史，计算与内存开销大，难以机载部署。

Method: 采用0.5B紧凑语言骨干，结合历史与当前观测的紧凑表征：将每帧历史压缩为单个token（复用策略已计算的视觉特征），并引入历史与指令条件化的局部聚合，将当前观测从256个视觉token缩减至32个；最多16帧历史时，观测相关token总数不超过48。

Result: 在OpenFly数据集上取得50.93% Test-Seen与36.14% Test-Unseen成功率，在多数指标上优于所评估的7B语言骨干基线；AerialVLN-S Val-Seen上SR为25.83%。在重建的未见校园环境中，部署于DJI M350 RTK配Jetson Orin NX 16GB，机载实时-仿真硬件在环评估实现14.61 Hz模型推理与11.13 Hz端到端决策更新。

Conclusion: LightVLN在效率与效果上均表现优异，验证了轻量历史感知框架用于空中导航的可行性与实用价值。

Abstract: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables unmanned aerial vehicles to execute long-horizon natural-language instructions from visual observations in complex three-dimensional environments. However, recent aerial VLN models often rely on large-scale vision-language backbones and dense visual histories, imposing substantial computation and memory costs that hinder onboard deployment. We propose LightVLN, a lightweight history-aware aerial VLN framework that combines a compact 0.5B language backbone with compact representations of both historical and current observations. LightVLN compresses each historical frame into a single token using visual features already computed by the policy. It further introduces history- and instruction-conditioned local aggregation to reduce the current observation from 256 to 32 visual tokens while preserving navigation-relevant spatial information. With up to 16 historical frames, the policy uses at most 48 observation-derived tokens. On the public OpenFly dataset, LightVLN achieves 50.93% Test-Seen and 36.14% Test-Unseen success rates (SR), outperforming the evaluated 7B language-backbone baselines on most reported metrics. It also achieves 25.83% SR on AerialVLN-S Val-Seen. In a reconstructed unseen campus, we deploy LightVLN on a DJI M350 RTK with an external Jetson Orin NX 16 GB for closed-loop onboard-compute real-to-sim hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluation, achieving 14.61 Hz model inference and 11.13 Hz end-to-end decision updates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LightVLN for aerial navigation.

</details>


### [97] [Triggering Generalist Reasoning via Predictive Uncertainty for Dual-System VLA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05025)
*Hyemin Yang,Wooseong Jeong,Giwon Lee,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TUD，一种自适应推理框架，通过预测性不确定性信号来决定何时调用通用推理器，从而在双系统VLA模型中实现更高效的机器人控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双系统VLA模型以固定频率调用慢速通用推理器，忽略了决策复杂度在滚动过程中的动态变化。这种静态策略在简单阶段浪费算力，且在场景突变时无法及时重启推理。

Method: TUD测量在缓存的通用推理上下文下，下一个chunk槽位处动作重预测的跨步离散度，作为预测性不确定性信号。该信号刻画未来动作计划随新观测变化的程度，且可直接从架构已有的前向传播中计算，无需人工阶段标签或额外的不确定性模型。

Result: 在VLA-Arena上，TUD在相同调用预算下成功率高于其他不确定性基线，墙钟开销低，且能更一致地区分成功与失败轨迹。相比非自适应基线，TUD找到更优的成本-成功率权衡，并可通过调整单一阈值描绘完整操作曲线，在相同成功率下大幅减少VLM调用。真机实验中，相比最强的固定间隔基线，TUD将通用推理器调用减少75%，同时获得更高成功率。

Conclusion: 预测性不确定性为高效VLA控制中的自适应推理提供了一个实用的判据。

Abstract: Dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models improve real-time robotic control by pairing a slow, reasoning-capable generalist with a fast specialist action expert. However, existing methods invoke the generalist at a fixed frequency, ignoring the fact that decision-making complexity varies throughout a rollout. This static strategy wastes computation in easy phases and can delay renewed reasoning when the scene changes unexpectedly. We propose TUD (Triggering generalist reasoning via predictive Uncertainty for Dual-system VLA), an adaptive inference framework that selectively skips unnecessary generalist calls. TUD measures the cross-step dispersion of action re-predictions at the upcoming chunk slot under the cached generalist context, as a predictive uncertainty signal. This signal captures how much the future action plan shifts as new observations arrive and is computed from forwards the architecture already runs, requiring neither manual phase labels nor an auxiliary uncertainty model. On VLA-Arena, it achieves a higher success rate at matched call budgets than alternative uncertainty baselines while maintaining low wall-clock overhead, and more consistently separates successful from failed rollouts. Also, TUD finds a more favorable cost-success trade-off than non-adaptive baselines, tracing an entire operating curve as a single threshold is varied, and substantially reduces VLM calls at matched success rate. The same trade-off appears in our real-robot experiments, where TUD cuts generalist calls by 75% relative to the strongest fixed-interval baseline while achieving an even higher success rate. Our results suggest that predictive uncertainty provides a practical criterion for adaptive reasoning in efficient VLA control.

</details>


### [98] [GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05026)
*Hyun Song,Kangmin Kim,Loren Jinsoo Um,Minhui Han,Jaehyeok Park,Taewan Cho,Andrew Jaeyong Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoBridge-VLA 通过两阶段方法从预训练 VLA 的冻结视觉编码器中学习几何特征，用于提升操作任务的动作预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型虽从视觉-语言预训练中获取语义信息，但操作任务还需要精确的空间推理能力，现有模型在这方面存在不足。

Method: 两阶段方法：Stage I 用深度监督训练特征桥与几何解码器；Stage II 冻结这些模块，训练门控残差接口及动作侧投影和动作专家。残差增强现有视觉 token，不增加第二个图像编码器或 token 数量。部署仅需 RGB、机器人状态和语言，无需深度观测。

Result: LIBERO 上成功率达 70.9%，优于 SmolVLA 的 60.0%；同一检查点中禁用残差成功率从 70.90% 降至 69.85%，各套件效果不一。物理 ROBOTIS OMY 机器人四任务中成功 148/200（74.0%），对比 SmolVLA 的 108/200（54.0%）。

Conclusion: GeoBridge-VLA 有效提升了 VLA 模型的空间推理与操作成功率，且部署时无需深度输入，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.

</details>


### [99] [SPACE-CLIPv2: Decoding Local Geometry from Frozen CLIP for Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05029)
*Hyun Song,Taewan Cho,Kangmin Kim,Andrew Jaeyong Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPACE-CLIPv2 提出一种冻结 CLIP 主干的深度解码器，通过在 token 空间做固定邻域聚合与门控残差注入，结合高通分支保留局部对比，在 NYU Depth V2 和零样本 iBims-1 上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 等视觉-语言基础模型语义表征强，但其 patch token 并未针对稠密度量几何优化。SPACE-CLIP 已表明冻结 CLIP 特征可经层级分组融合支持单目深度估计，但未明确相邻 CLIP token 应如何组合以恢复精细局部结构。

Method: 构建冻结主干深度解码器 SPACE-CLIPv2，在 CLIP token 空间聚合固定局部邻域：在选定解码阶段采样固定 token 模板，预测聚合权重，并通过门控残差更新注入响应；另设 token 空间高通分支以保留浅层局部对比。

Result: 在 NYU Depth V2 上优于匹配的 SPACE-CLIP 基线；五种子实验稳定显示固定采样优于学习偏移采样；零样本 iBims-1 评估在边界与平面几何指标上进一步提升。

Conclusion: 受约束的局部 token 聚合是从冻结 CLIP 表征解码几何的一种实用机制。

Abstract: Vision-language foundation models such as CLIP provide strong semantic representations, but their patch tokens are not directly optimized for dense metric geometry. SPACE-CLIP showed that frozen CLIP features can support monocular depth estimation through layer-group feature fusion, yet it leaves open how neighboring CLIP tokens should be combined to recover fine local structure. We present SPACE-CLIPv2, a frozen-backbone depth decoder that aggregates fixed local neighborhoods in CLIP token space. At selected decoder stages, the model samples a fixed token stencil, predicts aggregation weights, and injects the resulting response through a gated residual update. A token-space high-pass branch further preserves shallow local contrast. On NYU Depth V2, SPACE-CLIPv2 improves over a matched SPACE-CLIP baseline, while five-seed experiments consistently favor fixed over learned-offset sampling. Zero-shot iBims-1 evaluation further improves boundary and planar-geometry measures. These results support constrained local token aggregation as a practical mechanism for decoding geometry from frozen CLIP representations.

</details>


### [100] [Code2Games: Enabling Coding Agents for Gaming World Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05033)
*Wei Wu,Ziyang Xu,Zeyu Zhang,Yang Zhao,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Code2Games是一个智能体框架，可从自然语言游戏意图出发构建结构化游戏世界，并适配到Unreal Engine 5，配套GameCode4D基准进行多维评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自然语言游戏意图生成高质量游戏世界需要联合推理场景结构、空间布局、玩法目标、交互实体与可执行玩法逻辑。现有编码智能体虽能生成单独资产、场景或脚本，但难以保持各组件间的一致性。

Method: Code2Games基于同一游戏意图生成的Blender基础世界构建结构化游戏世界，通过共享的场景-玩法表示与持久元素对应关系，协调场景分析、玩法规划、受约束的游戏世界生成及游戏引擎定制；随后适配到Unreal Engine 5，并采用执行引导的重构流程，利用编译诊断、运行时反馈与玩法测试结果解决引擎适配中的不一致。

Result: 提出GameCode4D基准，包含十个固定游戏提示，覆盖不同场景与玩法复杂度；从视觉质量、交互保真度、多模态产物质量、可玩游戏质量四个维度评估。实验表明，相比编码智能体直接生成及现有基线方法，Code2Games持续提升了生成游戏世界的视觉质量与交互保真度，以及引擎适配后游戏的质量。

Conclusion: Code2Games通过共享表示与执行引导重构有效提升了游戏世界生成的一致性与质量，为自然语言驱动的游戏世界生成提供了可行框架与系统化评估基准。

Abstract: Generating a high-quality gaming world from a natural-language game intent requires joint reasoning about scene structure, spatial layout, gameplay objectives, interactive entities, and executable gameplay logic. Existing coding agents can generate individual assets, scenes, or scripts, but often struggle to maintain consistency across these components. We propose Code2Games, an agentic framework that builds a structured gaming world upon a base Blender world generated from the same game intent. Code2Games coordinates scene analysis, gameplay planning, constrained gaming-world generation, and gaming-engine customization through a shared scene-gameplay representation with persistent element correspondence. After world generation, Code2Games adapts the generated world to Unreal Engine 5 and employs an execution-guided reconstruction process that uses compilation diagnostics, runtime feedback, and gameplay test results to resolve inconsistencies arising during engine adaptation. To systematically evaluate gaming-world generation, we introduce the GameCode4D benchmark, which comprises ten fixed game prompts spanning different levels of scene and gameplay complexity. We evaluate the generated results across four dimensions: visual quality, interactive fidelity, multimodal artifact quality, and playable-game quality. Experiments demonstrate that, compared with direct gaming-world generation by coding agents and existing baseline methods, Code2Games consistently improves the visual quality and interactive fidelity of generated gaming worlds, as well as the quality of the resulting games after engine adaptation.

</details>


### [101] [CoDG-Net: Structure-Guided Style Diffusion and Collaborative Learning to Mitigate Catastrophic Forgetting in Medical Image Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05053)
*Yucheng Song,Jincan Wang,Haokang Ding,Zhiqiang Tian,Kangxu Fan,Zhifang Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结构引导风格扩散增强与双分支协同学习网络CoDG-Net，在提升医学图像域泛化分割性能的同时降低灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割的域泛化（DG）极具挑战且重要，但现有方法大多忽视了灾难性遗忘（CF）问题：模型在追求跨域鲁棒性时会牺牲对源域知识的保留能力，这直接威胁已部署临床场景中的诊断安全。

Method: 一是提出结构引导的风格扩散增强方法，在频域上以解剖结构一致性为约束，对幅度谱进行跨域扩散，生成风格覆盖更广更多样的样本；二是设计双分支交互式架构的协同学习网络CoDG-Net，并提出学习偏置引导策略，在层级与任务级自适应调节知识迁移。

Result: 在单源与多源医学DG基准数据集上的实验和消融研究表明，CoDG-Net在目标域分割性能上优于现有最先进方法，同时在源域数据上取得更低的遗忘率。

Conclusion: 通过数据增强与协同学习相结合，可在增强跨域泛化的同时有效缓解源域灾难性遗忘，兼顾临床诊断安全。

Abstract: Domain Generalization (DG) for medical image segmentation is both highly challenging and critically important. However, existing medical DG methods largely overlook the issue of Catastrophic Forgetting (CF): \textbf{Models often sacrifice their ability to retain source-domain knowledge while pursuing cross-domain robustness.} This can directly threaten diagnostic safety in already-deployed clinical scenarios. To address this, we investigate data augmentation strategies and catastrophic forgetting for medical image DG segmentation. First, we propose a structure-guided style diffusion augmentation method. Constrained by anatomical structure consistency in the frequency domain, this method performs cross-domain diffusion on the amplitude spectrum, generating samples with more diverse and broader style coverage to better support domain generalization. Then, we design a collaborative learning network with a dual-branch interactive architecture (CoDG-Net), together with a novel learning bias-guided strategy that adaptively regulates knowledge transfer at both the layer level and the task level, thereby effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting on the source domain. Experiments and ablation studies on single-source and multi-source medical DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that CoDG-Net not only outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in target-domain segmentation performance, but also achieves a lower forgetting rate on the source-domain data. The code is available at: https://github.com/wangprocess/CoDG-Net.

</details>


### [102] [Salvation Lies Within: Eliciting Inherent Style Transfer in Step-Distilled Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05066)
*Shengyin Sun,Yiming Li,Yingzhao Lian,Xing Li,Xingzhi Zhou,Anxin Tian,Zhili Wang,Haoyang Li,Ziqiang Cui,Chen Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 StyleForge，一个全自动、免训练框架，将参考风格表达为可复用的渲染指令，从而让冻结的步数蒸馏 T2I 模型在保持原生少步生成能力的同时实现风格化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过后训练适配步数蒸馏 T2I 模型会带来额外计算成本，并破坏其原生的少步生成行为，因此需要一条不同于特定风格适配的互补路径：利用模型已编码的视觉知识，通过语言来激发风格能力。

Method: StyleForge 无需训练且全自动。它把参考图像中的视觉证据组织为连贯的风格规范：整合整体渲染特征与局部颜色、光照行为；随后将该规范编译为可跨内容提示复用的文本引导，用于冻结的步数蒸馏 T2I 模型。

Result: 在生成质量分数上相比最强基线获得最高 29.47% 的相对提升；Pareto 分析表明，风格化提升的同时仍能较好地遵循所请求的内容。

Conclusion: 通过语言引导激发步数蒸馏 T2I 模型的风格能力是一条有效且互补的路线，可在不额外训练、不损害少步生成的前提下实现内容可变的风格化。

Abstract: Adapting step-distilled text-to-image (T2I) models through post-training incurs additional computational costs and affects native few-step generation behavior. This motivates a complementary route beyond style-specific adaptation: drawing on the visual knowledge already encoded in step-distilled T2I models to elicit stylistic capabilities through language. Pursuing this direction requires textual guidance that captures how visual attributes jointly define a style and remain applicable as the depicted content changes. To explore this approach, we introduce StyleForge, a fully automatic, training-free framework that expresses reference styles as reusable rendering instructions. By integrating overall rendering characteristics with local color and lighting behavior, StyleForge organizes visual evidence from reference images into a coherent specification of how the target style should be expressed. The specification is then compiled into textual guidance that can be reused across content prompts, enabling frozen step-distilled T2I models to render different subjects and scenes in the reference style while retaining native few-step generation. Extensive experiments show relative gains of up to 29.47\% in generation quality scores over the strongest baseline, while Pareto analysis indicates that improved stylization is accompanied by strong adherence to the requested content.

</details>


### [103] [CGDD-Net: Context-Guided Dynamic Detail Modeling for Retinal Vessel Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05078)
*Xincheng Li,Xiaoqi Sheng,Xinyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CGDD-Net视网膜血管分割网络，通过上下文引导的动态细节建模和共享解码器路径提升分割性能，参数仅1.96M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜血管分割需要兼顾血管几何特征与细尺度重建信息。现有方法通常将每个中间阶段特征通过独立直接跳跃连接传递到解码器，导致信息冗余且参数效率低。

Method: CGDD-Net包含三个核心模块：CSDE（上下文引导尺度自适应可变形编码）结合固定网格卷积与可变形局部注意力，捕获多空间尺度的血管模式；SAMG（空间自适应多核门控）在每个位置选择感受野响应；DCDF（动态跨尺度细节融合）对齐门控中间特征并压缩为8通道表示，在三个解码器分辨率上复用，并配合选定的编码器跳跃连接。

Result: 在DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE、HRF上AUC分别为0.9824、0.9938、0.9895、0.9874，F1分别为0.8323、0.8102、0.8510、0.8157。模型含196万可训练参数。累积消融中，完整模型在DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE上F1分别较内部基线提升2.48、0.61、3.49个百分点。另有12组跨数据集迁移实验验证无目标域自适应的迁移能力。

Conclusion: 共享中间细节传递是一种有效且参数紧凑的视网膜血管分割架构方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: Accurate retinal vessel segmentation requires features that capture vascular geometry while preserving information for fine-scale reconstruction. We propose CGDD-Net, a context-guided dynamic detail modeling network that connects adaptive feature extraction to a shared decoder pathway. Context-Guided Scale-Adaptive Deformable Encoding (CSDE) combines fixed-grid convolution with deformable local attention to capture vascular patterns at multiple spatial extents. Spatially Adaptive Multi-Kernel Gating (SAMG) selects receptive-field responses at each location. Dynamic Cross-Scale Detail Fusion (DCDF) aligns the gated intermediate features and compresses them into an eight-channel representation, which is reused at three decoder resolutions together with selected encoder skips. This design consolidates intermediate information before decoding instead of transferring each middle-stage feature through a separate direct skip. On DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, STARE, and HRF, CGDD-Net achieves AUC values of 0.9824, 0.9938, 0.9895, and 0.9874, with F1 scores of 0.8323, 0.8102, 0.8510, and 0.8157, respectively. The complete model contains 1.96 million trainable parameters. In cumulative ablations, the full model improves F1 over the internal baseline by 2.48, 0.61, and 3.49 percentage points on DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, and STARE. Twelve directed cross-dataset experiments further characterize transfer without target-domain adaptation. The results support shared intermediate detail delivery as an effective, parameter-compact architecture for retinal vessel segmentation. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/lixincheng-xcl/CGDD-Net}.

</details>


### [104] [ReMAP: Restoring the Perceptual Cycle with Reasoning-Time Latent Visual Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05097)
*Hao Jiang,Zhanyu Guo,Chenwei Wu,Yichen Guo,Qizhe Zhang,Junchi Yao,Jixian Wu,Jinhao You,Kai Tang,Jiajun Cao,Tinghao Wang,Mengyu Wang,Leo Anthony Celi,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ReMAP，一种推理时的记忆增强感知方法，通过全局与局部两种潜在记忆在推理过程中重新引入视觉证据，在多个多图像基准上超越先前方法并大幅减少视觉token。m


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型推理越长，对初始视觉输入的注意力越弱，导致视觉定位能力下降，需要视觉记忆在推理中重新引入视觉证据。

Method: 沿整理、组织、访问三轴对视觉记忆进行受控分析；提出ReMAP，结合静态的、问题条件化的全局记忆与动态局部记忆（以全局上下文为锚，按当前推理状态选择并重编码区域级证据），两者以紧凑潜在token插入推理序列；并用基于分支展开的强化学习访问策略决定何时继续推理或调用全局/局部记忆。

Result: 在十个基准族上，ReMAP在四个多图像基准上均优于先前视觉记忆方法，在MuirBench和MIMIC上分别超过最强先前结果8.38和14.84个百分点；在四种骨干上，启用记忆访问均优于同款禁用记忆的模型；在共享的V*Bench、CV-Bench-2D和MuirBench问题上，视觉token减少51.0-76.8%。

Conclusion: 全局与局部记忆形成互补的潜在表示，让推理状态触发有针对性的视觉检索，检索到的证据再引导后续推理，从而恢复感知循环。

Abstract: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reason for longer, attention to the initial visual input diminishes, weakening visual grounding. Visual memory reintroduces visual evidence during reasoning. We conduct a controlled analysis of visual memory along three axes: curation, organization, and access. We find that local evidence benefits from global context, compact latent representations balance accuracy and visual-context cost, and the utility of memory access depends on the reasoning state. Guided by these findings, we propose ReMAP (Reasoning-Time Memory-Augmented Perception), which couples two complementary latent memories: a static, question-conditioned Global memory that preserves scene and cross-image context, and a dynamic Local memory that uses this context as an anchor while selecting and re-encoding region-level evidence according to the current reasoning state. Both memories return compact latent tokens inserted into the reasoning sequence, and a reinforcement-learning access policy trained with branched rollouts decides when to continue reasoning or invoke Global or Local memory. On ten benchmark families, ReMAP outperforms prior visual-memory methods on all four multi-image benchmarks, exceeding the strongest prior results on MuirBench and MIMIC by 8.38 and 14.84 percentage points. Across four backbone families, enabling memory access improves over the same trained model with memory disabled, and on shared V*Bench, CV-Bench-2D, and MuirBench questions ReMAP reduces the visual tokens entering the reasoning sequence by 51.0-76.8% relative to the native-resolution backbone. Further analyses show that Global and Local memory form distinct yet complementary latent representations. Together, these components restore the perceptual cycle by letting the reasoning state trigger targeted visual retrieval, with the retrieved evidence guiding subsequent reasoning.

</details>


### [105] [LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05109)
*Yucheng Xin,Runci Bai,Yongcong Wang,Guangwei Gao,Jiao Liu,Dianjie Lu,Linwei Fan,Zhuoran Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LoopMoEVR，将循环学习范式引入统一高清图像/视频修复任务，通过降解条件低秩循环嵌入、IterAda3DN归一化、专家分支及自适应深度预测器，仅用约0.884M可训练参数在UHD去雾、去雨、去噪和低光增强任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一高清图像修复模型为追求泛化能力不断加深网络深度，但收益有限；而循环学习范式（如GPT-6、looped Transformers）以低参数量和强回归能力受到关注。作者希望将循环学习引入需要跨域学习的修复任务中。

Method: 提出LoopMoEVR——基于循环的混合专家模型，可处理退化的超高清(UHD)输入。包含三部分：(1) 降解条件低秩循环嵌入，构建依赖输入的阶段条件；(2) 时空迭代自适应归一化模块IterAda3DN，融合局部特征与全局循环上下文进行位置级仿射调制；(3) 专家分支将注意力更新的局部与全局视频状态同循环条件结合，生成专用调制参数，并由输入条件深度预测器自适应配置循环迭代次数。

Result: 模型仅约0.884M可训练参数，统一处理UHD视频去雾、去雨、去噪和低光增强任务，在公开基准和真实场景中均取得SOTA修复性能。

Conclusion: 循环学习范式能有效用于跨域高清视频修复，以极低参数量实现多任务统一处理并超越现有方法，为高效高清修复提供新思路。

Abstract: Recently, unified high-definition image restoration has attracted considerable attention; however, existing models tend to excessively increase their depth in pursuit of improved generalization, which often yields only limited gains. Meanwhile, loop-based learning paradigms have drawn widespread attention due to their low parameter counts and strong regression capability, as exemplified by GPT-6 and looped Transformers. In this paper, we introduce the loop learning paradigm to address restoration tasks that require cross-domain learning. Specifically, we propose LoopMoEVR, a loop-based mixture-of-experts model capable of handling degraded ultra-high-definition (UHD) inputs. First, a degradation-conditioned low-rank loop embedding is designed to construct input-dependent stage conditions. Second, a spatio-temporal iterative adaptive normalization module, termed IterAda3DN, is developed to fuse local features with global loop context, thereby performing position-wise affine modulation. Finally, the expert branches further integrate the attention-updated local and global video states with the loop conditions to generate dedicated modulation parameters, while an input-conditioned depth predictor adaptively configures the number of loop iterations. With only approximately 0.884M trainable parameters, the proposed model uniformly handles UHD video dehazing, deraining, denoising, and low-light enhancement tasks, achieving state-of-the-art restoration performance on both public benchmarks and real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [106] [PCLM: Small-target localization with frozen CLIP via prototype contrast and local magnification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05115)
*Zhipeng Ye,Feng Jiang,Qiufeng Wang,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PCLM方法，利用冻结CLIP编码器，通过原型对比与局部放大实现小目标定位，在多个数据集上超越文本条件基线5.63–13.23个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小目标在视觉-语言编码器中占据的图块极少，导致空间特征把物体外观与周围内容混在一起，难以准确定位。

Method: 每类用五张掩码支持图像，以等权区域特征构建前景和背景原型，其差值给出共享的查询图块评分方向；将九个重叠查询窗口放大并独立编码以更密集采样小目标，再通过重投影与覆盖率平均合成连续定位图。类别方向仅占2 KiB且不随支持数量变化。

Result: 在VOC、COCO、ADE20K和Oxford-IIIT Pets的5047个小目标查询上，平均像素AP均高于所有评估的文本条件定位基线，较最强场景数据集基线提升5.63至13.23个百分点；在相近实测延迟下，局部放大比整幅画布放大提升场景小目标AP 4.51至5.68点。

Conclusion: 原型对比能增强局部观测的收益，支持样本增多可细化类别估计而不增加表示大小或查询时评分成本，方法可跨数据集迁移。

Abstract: Small targets occupy few patches in a vision-language encoder, so spatial features often mix object appearance with surrounding content. We propose Prototype Contrast and Local Magnification (PCLM), a support-conditioned localization method that uses a frozen CLIP encoder. Five masked support images per class define foreground and background prototypes through equally weighted regional features. Their difference provides a shared scoring direction for query patches, explicitly comparing target evidence with the demonstrated background. Nine overlapping query windows are enlarged and encoded independently to sample small targets more densely. Reprojection and coverage averaging combine their scores into a continuous localization map. The class direction occupies 2 KiB regardless of support count and transfers unchanged across datasets with mapped categories. On 5,047 small-target queries from VOC, COCO, ADE20K and Oxford-IIIT Pets, PCLM achieves higher mean pixel AP than every evaluated text-conditioned localization baseline on each dataset under our evaluation protocol. Gains over the strongest scene-dataset baselines range from 5.63 to 13.23 percentage points. At comparable measured latency, local magnification improves scene small-target AP by 4.51 to 5.68 points over whole-canvas enlargement. Factorial experiments show that prototype contrast increases the benefit of local observation, including under matched image-coordinate filtering. Support-budget experiments show that additional examples refine category estimation without increasing representation size or query-time scoring cost.

</details>


### [107] [Representation--Behavior Alignment for Explainable Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05129)
*Chao Huang,Pengfei Wei,Kaige Li,Chengliang Liu,Wei Wang,Wenqi Ren,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"表征—行为错位"概念并将其分解为容量与方向两个分量，发现方向分量主导该问题，据此提出参数高效的RBA方法实现视频异常检测的决策与解释统一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）为视频异常检测提供了更可解释的途径，但其最终决策并不总能充分利用隐藏状态中的判别性信息，即"表征—行为错位"，该问题此前未被系统刻画与解决。

Method: 作者将错位分解为两部分：容量分量（从未聚合到读出位置的判别信息）与方向分量（读出位置上最优法向—异常轴与原生轴之间的角度失配）。通过残差流追踪定位到若干中后段注意力层，并发现两个分量主要受注意力而非MLP更新支配，据此提出RBA（Representation–Behavior Alignment），仅使用视频级标签、更新约0.012%的骨干参数进行高效适配。

Result: 在多个视频异常检测基准和多种MLLM骨干上，方向分量均占主导地位；残差流追踪显示原生轴可分性在若干中后段注意力层显著上升。三个基准实验表明RBA提升了原生读出的性能，并使模型决策方向与判别性表征更好对齐，同时通过单一生成过程产出异常判定与解释。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了MLLM视频异常检测中决策方向与表征错位的关键瓶颈，证明通过极少量参数的注意力层适配即可有效缓解，并实现异常检测判定与解释的一体化生成。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural way to make video anomaly detection more explainable. However, their final decisions do not always fully use the discriminative information contained in their hidden states, an issue we refer to as representation--behavior misalignment. We decompose this gap into a capacity component that measures discriminative information never aggregated into the readout position, and a directional component that measures the angular mismatch between the optimal and the native normal--abnormal axis at that position. Across multiple video anomaly detection benchmarks and MLLM backbones the directional component dominates, and residual-stream tracing shows that native-axis separability rises sharply in several mid-to-late attention layers. Because both components are governed by attention rather than MLP updates, we propose Representation--Behavior Alignment (RBA), a parameter-efficient method that adapts those layers using video-level labels alone while updating about 0.012\% of the backbone parameters. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RBA improves native-readout performance and better aligns the model's decision direction with discriminative representations, and it produces anomaly decisions and explanations through a single generative process.

</details>


### [108] [RoMod: Temporal Routing Modulation via Mixture-of-Experts for Video Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05131)
*Chao Huang,Pengfei Wei,Benfeng Wang,Chengliang Liu,Wei Wang,Li Shen,Wenqi Ren,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究了多模态大模型中间层特征在视频异常检测中判别力的来源，发现稀疏MoE模型中异常证据集中于少数专家并形成动态路由子网络，据此提出RoMod高效VAD框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型的中间层特征在视频异常检测（VAD）中展现出强大潜力，但其判别力的来源尚不清晰。作者希望借助稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型显式的专家结构和稀疏激活特性，深入探究这一内部计算机制。

Method: 在完全冻结骨干网络且不额外训练的条件下，分析MoE模型内部专家激活情况；发现异常相关证据集中于少数专家，这些专家跨层重复出现、自发专精于不同异常类型，共同构成动态路由子网络。进一步验证受这些专家影响最强的输出通道也包含最多异常相关信息，因此路由统计可作为内部异常线索。基于此提出RoMod框架，仅用5%弱标注视频训练，包含路由调制融合模块RoMF（利用路由信号自适应重校准隐藏语义通道，并防止路由分支绕过语义特征自行预测）和路由感知时序网络RoTN（捕捉异常从发生到持续再到终止的时序演变）。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上实验表明，RoMod达到最先进的性能，同时相比同等规模的稠密骨干网络运行速度显著更快。

Conclusion: MoE模型的专家路由机制可为VAD提供可解释且有效的内部异常线索，路由统计与语义特征互补，RoMod以极低弱标注成本实现了高效且领先的检测性能。

Abstract: Intermediate-layer features from multimodal large language models have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection (VAD), yet the origin of their discriminative power remains unclear. We study this question using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, whose explicit expert structure and sparse activation make their internal computation easier to inspect. With a fully frozen backbone and no additional training, we find that anomaly-related evidence is concentrated in a small set of experts. These experts recur across layers, spontaneously specialize in different anomaly types, and together form a dynamic routing subnetwork. We further show that the output channels most strongly influenced by these experts are also the hidden dimensions that contain the most anomaly-relevant information. Routing statistics can therefore serve as an internal anomaly cue that complements semantic features.Based on these findings, we propose RoMod, an efficient VAD framework trained with only \(5\%\) of weakly labeled videos. RoMod includes a Routing-Modulated Fusion module, RoMF, and a Routing-aware Temporal Network, RoTN. RoMF uses routing signals to adaptively recalibrate hidden semantic channels. Its design also prevents the routing branch from bypassing semantic features and making predictions on its own. RoTN captures the temporal evolution of anomalies from onset to persistence and termination. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RoMod achieves state-of-the-art performance while running substantially faster than dense backbones of comparable size.

</details>


### [109] [How Does Geometry Enter Generated Motion?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05135)
*Weihan Li,Junhao Wu,Yuhan Song,Xiaofeng Lin,Xinlei Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文考察视频生成模型是否真正遵循固定物理定律：通过控制首帧几何、保持初始状态不变，并与模拟器预测对比，发现九个图像到视频模型能保留几何并让运动受几何调制，但运动状态的演变系统性地偏离物理定律，表现为几何条件下的运动合成而非物理模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在固定物理定律下，场景的可见几何决定了运动必须如何改变。作者希望探究视频生成器是否以及如何实现这一"几何—运动"关系，即模型输出的是真实的物理演化，还是仅基于几何的表面运动合成。

Method: 作者固定物理定律与初始状态，仅在首帧改变所绘制的几何，采用匹配的轨迹与偏转器族进行配对干预：每次只改变一个变量（局部凸起、屏障高度、提示词文本、片段长度）。随后将每个生成轨迹与该几何对应的模拟器预测进行对比，横跨九个图像到视频模型，并进一步使用实拍首帧进行验证。

Result: 几何被保留并影响运动：球速跟随轨道所绘制的起伏变化。但物理状态本应将这种响应延续下去，生成的运动却在此偏离定律：平均坡度几乎不使球加速，连续接触无法通过一致的状态进行复合，球前方的编辑会在球到达前就改变其运动，球还能越过高于其释放点的屏障。两种全局条件主导轨迹：文本强烈控制目的地，片段长度强烈控制开放权重模型的时序。该模式在实拍首帧下依然存在。

Conclusion: 当前视频生成的行为表现为"几何条件下的运动合成"，其状态演化与固定物理定律的演化存在系统性差异，说明模型并未真正内化物理定律，而是以几何为条件生成运动。

Abstract: Under a fixed physical law, the visible geometry of a scene determines how motion must change. We ask how video generators realize this relationship. We fix the law and the initial state and change only the geometry drawn in the first frame, within matched families of tracks and deflectors, and compare each generated trajectory with the simulator prediction for that geometry. Paired interventions change one thing at a time: a local bump, the height of a barrier, the words of the prompt, the length of the clip. Across nine image-to-video models, geometry is preserved and shapes the motion: the speed of the ball follows the drawn undulation of a track. A physical state would carry this response forward, and here the generated motion parts from the law. The mean slope barely accelerates the ball, successive contacts fail to compose through a consistent state, an edit ahead of the ball alters its motion before it arrives, and the ball climbs over barriers higher than its release point. Two global conditions organize the global trajectory: text strongly controls the destination, while clip length strongly controls timing in the open-weight models tested. The pattern persists with photographed first frames. Current video generation thus behaves as geometry-conditioned motion synthesis whose evolution of state differs systematically from that of a fixed physical law.

</details>


### [110] [SemCam: Semantic Camera Motion Control for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05141)
*Janna Bruner,Omer Talmi,Ianir Ideses,Lior Fritz,Lior Wolf,Sagie Benaim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出语义相机运动控制新任务SemCam，用参考视频和运动标签控制主体相对相机行为，成功率68.6%超过基线45.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现有视频中控制相机相对于运动主体的行为很困难：维持正面视角等行为要求相机适应主体位置和朝向的变化，目标轨迹难以预先指定。现有相机控制视频到视频方法依赖显式轨迹或参考运动，无法直接表达这种动态的相机-主体关系。

Method: SemCam结合共享基低秩适配（shared-basis low-rank adaptation）与运动条件调制（motion-conditioned modulation），并引入背景一致性损失以提升参考视频和目标视频共同可见区域的保真度。

Result: 构建661个配对视频覆盖8种语义相机行为，并在独立109场景基准上用主体相对运动指标、外观指标和用户研究评估。SemCam语义运动成功率达68.6%，最强基线Vista4D为45.3%，同时保持相当的主体身份保持度。

Conclusion: SemCam通过语义相机运动控制实现了无需显式轨迹的主体相对相机行为控制，显著优于现有基线，同时保持内容保真。

Abstract: Controlling the camera relative to a moving subject in an existing video is challenging: behaviors such as maintaining a frontal view require the camera to adapt to the subject's changing position and orientation, making the desired trajectory difficult to specify in advance. Existing camera-controlled video-to-video methods typically rely on explicit trajectories or reference motions, which do not directly express these dynamic camera--subject relationships. We introduce semantic camera motion control, a novel video-to-video task in which a reference video and a target motion label specify the desired subject-relative camera behavior without an explicit target trajectory. Our method, SemCam, learns to realize this behavior while preserving source content. It combines shared-basis low-rank adaptation with motion-conditioned modulation, while a background-consistency loss encourages fidelity in regions visible in both reference and target videos. We construct 661 paired videos covering eight semantic camera behaviors and evaluate on a separate 109-scene benchmark using subject-relative motion metrics, appearance measures, and a user study. SemCam achieves a semantic-motion success rate of 68.6%, compared with 45.3% for Vista4D, the strongest evaluated baseline, while maintaining comparable subject identity preservation.

</details>


### [111] [Construction and Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Near-Real-Time Fire Detection from MTG FCI Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05154)
*Asaf Vanunu,Boaz Nadler,Arnon Karnieli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了用于MTG FCI近实时火灾探测的机器学习模型，发现1公里配置模型在性能上显著优于2公里模型和阈值算法，并能更早、更小地探测火灾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球静止卫星观测对野火探测与监测至关重要，而当前MTG FCI近实时火灾探测中机器学习模型与阈值算法的比较尚需评估。

Method: 使用VIIRS火灾参考数据，在1公里和2公里空间配置下训练并评估机器学习模型，覆盖欧洲、非洲和中东的不同生态区域，并与阈值类算法进行比较。

Result: 1公里模型显著优于2公里变体和业务阈值产品，F1分数最高提升0.36；1公里模型对小火灾的探测概率更高，且能比基线产品提前最多260分钟探测到火灾。

Conclusion: 1公里机器学习模型在MTG FCI近实时火灾探测中表现优越，且训练模型已公开可用，可支持开源应用。

Abstract: Geostationary satellite observations are important for wildfire detection and monitoring. The current study evaluates machine learning models for MTG FCI near-real-time fire detection in 1- and 2-km spatial configurations and compares them with threshold-based algorithms. The models were trained and evaluated using VIIRS fire reference data across diverse ecological regions in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. The key results are that 1-km models significantly outperform both their 2-km variants and operational threshold products. The constructed 1-km models achieved F1 scores higher by up to 0.36 compared to baseline products. Importantly, the 1-km models detected small fires with higher probability compared to competing models. Finally, the models robustly detected fires up to 260 min earlier than baseline products. To support opensource applications, our trained models are publicly available.

</details>


### [112] [Recurrent Latent Visual Search for GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05185)
*Kaiyu Wu,Beichen Zheng,Weiyao Huang,Keze Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReLaViS方法，通过循环潜在视觉搜索实现GUI元素定位的显式空间多步搜索，在单轮交互内完成，显著提升准确性且计算开销低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI grounding（定位用户指令对应的界面元素）是视觉语言模型驱动的GUI agent的关键能力。单步定位难以处理小元素和密集布局，因此需要多步视觉搜索。但现有方法依赖与视觉空间不对齐的文本推理，或需要与外部视觉工具进行昂贵多轮交互。

Method: ReLaViS在单轮交互内进行循环潜在视觉搜索。每步中，空间搜索头用隐藏状态查询截图的视觉token，生成显式表示搜索焦点的空间搜索分布；该分布将视觉token聚合为潜在视觉证据，并循环反馈为下一步输入嵌入以调节后续搜索。此外，引入GUI感知的由粗到细归纳偏置，通过由扁平元素标注构建的轨迹，监督从全局界面经中间元素组到目标的搜索。基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B构建。

Result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro上准确率提升3.1个百分点至56.3%，推理FLOPs仅增加3.5%，并在全部五个基准上优于匹配的单步基线。

Conclusion: ReLaViS将多步视觉搜索内化为模型内的显式空间过程，在单轮交互内实现，兼顾精度与效率，优于单步基线。

Abstract: GUI grounding is a critical capability for GUI agents powered by vision-language models, helping them execute user instructions by locating the corresponding elements in screenshots. Single-step grounding struggles with small elements and dense layouts, motivating multi-step visual search. However, existing approaches commonly rely on textual reasoning misaligned with visual space or costly multi-round interactions with external visual tools. To make multi-step visual search an explicit spatial process within the model, we propose ReLaViS, which performs Recurrent Latent Visual Search in a single interaction round. At each step, a spatial search head uses the hidden state to query the screenshot's visual tokens, producing a spatial search distribution that explicitly represents the search focus. This distribution then aggregates the visual tokens into latent visual evidence, which is recurrently fed back as the next input embedding to condition subsequent search. We further introduce a GUI-aware coarse-to-fine inductive bias through trajectories constructed from flat element annotations, supervising search from the global interface through intermediate element groups to the target. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, ReLaViS improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy by 3.1 percentage points to 56.3% with only a 3.5% increase in inference FLOPs and outperforms the matched single-step baseline on all five benchmarks.

</details>


### [113] [Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05191)
*Shengjian Wu,Li Sun,Yu Shangguan,Qingli Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DETRNN是一个即插即用模块，将无序的物体查询（object queries）按置信度和相似度排序成竞争感知序列，并用RNN按此顺序迭代精炼，从而减少冗余预测、稳定训练并提升检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DETR类检测器训练时采用一对一二分匹配，实现了无需NMS的端到端集合预测。但缺乏显式的去重机制，多个查询可能对同一目标产生高度相似的假设，导致训练不稳定、预测不够果断。作者受NMS顺序执行特性的启发，希望在解码器内部建模查询之间的竞争关系。

Method: 提出DETRNN即插即用模块：首先基于先验预测构建显式的置信度与相似度排序，将无序的物体查询转化为竞争感知序列；然后沿该顺序用RNN精炼查询，在解码器内部建模竞争关系，实现有序的递归精炼。

Result: 在多个DETR类检测器上进行实验，均取得一致的性能提升，且效率相当（comparable efficiency）。

Conclusion: 有序递归精炼能有效减少冗余预测、稳定优化过程并提升最终检测精度，DETRNN可作为一种通用增强模块应用于各类DETR风格检测器。

Abstract: DETR-style detectors use one-to-one bipartite matching during training to assign object queries to ground-truth objects, enabling end-to-end set prediction without non-maximum suppression (NMS). However, without an explicit de-duplication procedure, multiple queries can still produce highly similar hypotheses for the same object, making training unstable and predictions less decisive. Inspired by the sequential ordering of NMS, we propose DETRNN, a plug-and-play module that turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement. DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder. This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy. Experiments on multiple DETR-style detectors show consistent gains with comparable efficiency.

</details>


### [114] [Long-MDR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Deep-Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05195)
*On Tai Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出Long-MDR，一个面向多模态深度研究智能体的长时程在线强化学习训练配方，将上下文扩展到128k、工具交互轮次扩展到75+，并通过三项技术提升学习效率与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一代多模态研究智能体需在长时程研究历史中推理，单任务中会反复搜索网页、检查视觉证据、回溯假设，积累上万token的多模态上下文。然而现有在线RL训练大多局限于较短上下文与交互视野，扩展到此规模时暴露出弱策略浪费交互预算、策略熵过早崩溃等实际限制。

Method: Long-MDR包含三个组件：On-Policy Distillation Warmup（在线策略蒸馏预热）、Progressive Horizon Expansion（渐进式视野扩展）和Entropy-Triggered Rescue（熵触发救援），用于应对长时程RL中的低效与不稳定问题。

Result: 在50轮评估预算下，经RL训练的Long-MDR-9B在对比的7B-9B智能体中，于六个基准中的五个排名第一。

Conclusion: 这是首个在128k上下文下训练的在线多模态深度研究RL研究，也是首个采用75工具轮次视野的研究；所提配方在直接训练缓慢且昂贵的区间中，同时提升了长时程RL的学习效率与稳定性，并带来持续收益。

Abstract: The next generation of multimodal research agents must reason over long-lived research histories rather than short model completions. During a single task, an agent may repeatedly search the web, inspect visual evidence, revisit earlier hypotheses, and accumulate tens of thousands of tokens of multimodal context. Despite this trend, online RL for multimodal research agents remains largely confined to shorter contexts and interaction horizons. We push online RL training to 128k context and 75+ tool-interaction turns. To our knowledge, this is the first online multimodal deep-research RL study trained at 128k context, and the first trained with a 75 tool-turn horizon. Scaling to this regime exposes several practical limitations of conventional RL training. Early in training, weak policies make poor use of large interaction budgets, causing expensive rollouts with little reward improvement. Later, policy entropy can collapse before performance has saturated, prematurely ending useful learning. We introduce Long-MDR, a three-component training recipe designed specifically for this setting: On-Policy Distillation Warmup, Progressive Horizon Expansion, and Entropy-Triggered Rescue. Together, these techniques improve both the learning efficiency and stability of long-horizon RL, enabling continued gains in a regime where direct training is slow and costly. At a 50-turn evaluation budget, our RL-trained Long-MDR-9B ranks first on five of six benchmarks among the compared 7B-9B agents.

</details>


### [115] [F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05207)
*Zhisong Xu,Fan Zhu,Jiawei Qian,Ziyu Chen,Zhenjun Zhao,Javier Civera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: F2SLAM将前馈3D几何直接转化为优化原生的目标权重测量，并挂载到持久稠密因子图上，通过高低频双流统一稠密BA，提升轨迹估计与重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D模型提供强多视角几何先验，而在线SLAM主要依赖局部测量，长序列易累积漂移。现有结合方法多将前馈预测当作外部几何状态，事后与在线估计对齐或融合，使更广的多视角证据游离于优化器之外，无法真正参与SLAM状态优化。

Method: 提出F2SLAM，将前馈几何直接转换为优化原生的目标权重测量，附着在持续维护的稠密因子图上。高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性；低频流利用更广的多视角上下文，在状态一致性检查后选择性刷新已有测量。两流通过单次稠密光束法平差共同约束同一组位姿、逆深度及可选相机内参。

Result: 在多个基准上取得稳定优异的轨迹估计与更佳的稠密重建，标定与非标定设置均有效。非标定配置下，Replica数据集平均ATE RMSE从最强前馈基线的0.030 m降至0.002 m。

Conclusion: 将前馈几何内化为优化原生的测量，而非事后融合，可让多视角证据真正参与SLAM优化，兼顾在线跟踪与全局一致性，在标定与非标定场景下均显著提升精度。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.

</details>


### [116] [PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05233)
*Gavriel Habib,Dvir Samuel,Or Shimshi,Rami Ben-Ari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出像素条件化的流式头像重演框架PixReenact，基于因果视频扩散，无需专用身份/运动表征，实现鲁棒的跨身份长时流式重演与低延迟输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式头像重演依赖专用身份或运动表征，会丢失有用视觉信息并继承外部提取器的失效模式；同时许多基于扩散的重演方法采用离线、片段式生成，需对整个视频片段联合处理与去噪，难以实现连续低延迟流式生成。

Method: PixReenact直接以VAE编码的参考帧和驱动帧作为条件，不使用专用身份或运动表征。为分离参考身份与驱动运动，采用跨身份伪监督训练，并结合锚定原始参考与驱动输入的校正目标。通过长时间自回归展开减少自回归漂移，并采用状态感知的双教师蒸馏分别处理冷启动与稳态生成。滚动学生模型以4-NFE每次更新连续输出四帧。

Result: 在三个跨身份基准和一个长时程流式基准上，PixReenact展现出鲁棒的跨身份重演能力，在极端视角、遮挡和明显面部表情等挑战条件下表现良好，并在长流中保持参考身份。4-NFE滚动学生模型每次更新连续输出四帧，平均发射延迟为239 ms。

Conclusion: PixReenact通过像素条件化的因果视频扩散框架，在不依赖专用表征的前提下实现了鲁棒跨身份、长时稳定的流式头像重演，并达到较低延迟，验证了该框架的有效性。

Abstract: Streaming head-avatar reenactment aims to animate a reference image according to a live driving video, requiring robust motion transfer, long-term identity stability, and low latency. Existing methods often rely on specialized identity or motion representations, which can discard useful visual information and inherit failure modes from external extractors. In addition, many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising an entire video clip before producing its output, making continuous low-latency streaming difficult. We introduce PixReenact, a pixel-conditioned streaming reenactment framework built on causal video diffusion. PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations. To separate reference identity from driver motion, we train with cross-identity pseudo supervision together with corrective objectives anchored to the original reference and driving inputs. Long self-rollouts reduce autoregressive drift, while state-aware dual-teacher distillation separately addresses cold-start and steady-state generation. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment, particularly under challenging conditions such as extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining the reference identity over long streams. A 4-NFE rolling student continuously emits four frames per update with a mean emission latency of 239 ms.

</details>


### [117] [ArticuTable: Generating Instance-Level Interactive Rigid-Articulated 3D Tabletop Scenes from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05249)
*Kai Lv,Yibo Yin,Lijun Guo,Heng Fan,Kaihao Zhang,Xingping Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ArticuTable，一个单图像桌面场景3D重建框架，能够同时恢复可执行的部件级铰接结构与输入视角一致的场景布局。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需要兼具视觉保真度与物理交互性的3D环境。现有单图桌面重建方法虽能恢复合理的场景几何，但通常将物体表示为整体刚性体，交互仅限于整体刚体运动，无法实现部件级铰接动作；同时，单一观测可能对应多种姿态-尺度配置，导致难以恢复与输入视角一致的场景布局。

Method: 提出两项核心方法：1）生成鲁棒的铰接建模（GRAM）——结合由多模态大语言模型引导的关节拟合与语义状态推理，从不完美的整体代理网格中恢复可靠的关节参数与有效运动范围，将其转化为可执行的铰接资产；2）渐进式语义-几何场景配准（PSGSR）——在度量、平面和输入视角约束下逐步缩小姿态-尺度搜索空间，并通过结构感知的语义对应解决朝向歧义。

Result: 在视觉保真度、输入视角一致性、铰接质量、物理合理性和仿真就绪度等多方面均表现优异；构建了 ArticuTable-100 数据集（100个仿真就绪的桌面场景），并通过包含用户研究在内的广泛评估验证了性能。

Conclusion: ArticuTable 实现了从单张图像重建兼具可执行部件级铰接与输入视角一致布局的桌面场景，并贡献了标准化数据集，推动了具身智能体所需3D环境的生成。

Abstract: Embodied agents benefit from 3D environments that combine visual fidelity to real-world observations with physical interactivity. Existing single-image tabletop reconstruction methods recover plausible scene geometry but typically represent objects as monolithic rigid bodies, limiting interaction to whole-object rigid motion and precluding executable part-level articulation. Meanwhile, recovering a scene layout consistent with the input view remains challenging because a single observation may admit multiple plausible pose-scale configurations. We present ArticuTable, a single-image 3D tabletop reconstruction framework that recovers both executable part-level articulation and an input-view-consistent scene layout. For object modeling, we introduce generation-robust articulation modeling (GRAM), which combines joint fitting guided by a multimodal large language model with semantic state reasoning to recover reliable joint parameters and valid motion ranges from imperfect monolithic proxy meshes, thereby converting them into executable articulated assets. For scene layout, we introduce progressive semantic-geometric scene registration (PSGSR), which progressively narrows the pose-scale search space under complementary metric, planar, and input-view constraints and resolves orientation ambiguity through structure-aware semantic correspondences, yielding a scene layout consistent with the input view. We further contribute ArticuTable-100, a curated collection of 100 simulation-ready tabletop scenes. Extensive evaluation, including a user study, demonstrates strong performance across visual fidelity, input-view consistency, articulation quality, physical plausibility, and simulation readiness.

</details>


### [118] [MGPO: Manifold-Guided Diffusion Alignment for Task-Aware Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05252)
*Yunyi Chen,Chenru Wang,Xinyi Ye,Zexin Zheng,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO)，将基于扩散的数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，通过像素空间判别奖励与基于类别MST的隐空间几何奖励实现双空间对齐，在分割等任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散的数据集蒸馏存在目标不匹配：扩散模型由似然驱动，偏好密度近似，而下游任务需要判别性决策边界。此外，仅依赖密度会导致几何覆盖丢失，生成样本坍缩到少数高密度模态，无法覆盖流形的结构多样性。

Method: 将数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，实现双空间对齐：一是像素空间的判别性奖励，用于增强类别可分性；二是隐空间的几何奖励，由类别级最小生成树（MST）引导，促使生成隐变量覆盖每类的稀疏几何骨架。奖励模块化设计可通过替换冻结的任务奖励模型扩展到目标检测、分割等结构化任务。

Result: 提供理想化理论分析支撑MST奖励，包括Hausdorff近似界和与数据集规模无关的子采样界。大量实验表明MGPO持续优于现有方法，在低预算设置下分割任务mIoU提升+8.0%。

Conclusion: MGPO通过双空间对齐的奖励设计同时缓解语义不匹配与几何覆盖丢失，具有良好的模块化可扩展性，在多个任务上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion-based dataset distillation (DD) suffers from a fundamental objective mismatch: likelihood-driven diffusion models prioritize density approximation over the discriminative decision boundaries required for downstream tasks. Beyond semantic mismatch, relying solely on density also leads to geometric coverage loss, where generated samples collapse into a few high-density modes and fail to cover the manifold's structural diversity. We propose Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO), which reformulates DD as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and achieves Dual-Space Alignment via a pixel-space discriminative reward and a latent-space geometric reward guided by a class-wise Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). The discriminative reward enforces class separability, while the MST-based geometric reward encourages generated latents to cover a sparse geometric skeleton of each class, jointly addressing both failure modes. We further provide an idealized analysis that motivates the MST-based reward, including a Hausdorff approximation bound and a subsampling bound independent of the dataset size. The reward-modular design extends to structured tasks such as object detection and segmentation by substituting the frozen task reward model. Extensive experiments show MGPO consistently outperforms existing methods, including a +8.0% mIoU gain on segmentation under low-budget settings.

</details>


### [119] [Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting for Diffusion Sampling Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05254)
*Kai-Liang Cheng,Yuan-Yuan Cheng,Yu-fan Jin,Xiao-Ming Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HybridFF是一个免训练、即插即用的扩散采样加速框架，通过多基函数预测器融合来建模特征演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散采样加速中，特征演化既包含局部平滑也包含长程趋势和非单调变化，单一基函数预测器难以兼顾，因此需要多基融合方案。

Method: 先用移动最小二乘（MLS）为多个互补基函数族分别估计系数，再通过融合权重组合各预测器。提出两种策略：HybridFF (Fixed) 用小集校准模型专属权重并固定；HybridFF (Adaptive) 用全步预测误差的指数移动平均计算分支可靠性分数，在线更新权重。

Result: 在DiT-XL/2、FLUX.1-dev、SD3.5-Large和HunyuanVideo上，相比代表性单基预测器和缓存基线，实现了更优的加速-质量权衡。

Conclusion: 多基函数融合与可控融合权重策略能有效提升扩散采样加速中的预测保真度与生成质量，兼顾效率与质量。

Abstract: We propose Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting (HybridFF), a training-free, plug-and-play framework for accelerating diffusion sampling. To capture local smoothness, long-range trends, and complex non-monotonic variations when modeling feature evolution, HybridFF first estimates coefficients using moving least squares (MLS) for each of multiple complementary basis families and then combines the corresponding predictors using fusion weights. In addition to the choice of basis functions, the fusion weights also play a critical role. We introduce two strategies to balance quality and speedup. HybridFF (Fixed) prioritizes efficiency with model-specific fusion weights calibrated on a small set and held constant during inference. HybridFF (Adaptive) updates the fusion weights online using branch reliability scores computed from an exponential moving average of full-step prediction errors, improving prediction fidelity and generation quality under aggressive caching while retaining substantial acceleration. Experiments across DiT-XL/2, FLUX.1-dev, SD3.5-Large, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate a favorable speedup--quality trade-off over representative single-basis forecasters and caching baselines.

</details>


### [120] [When and What to Prune? Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05273)
*Tianjun Shi,Haotian Xiong,Ziyu Gong,Qi Lu,Li Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAPrune是一种免训练的视觉token剪枝框架，用于加速VLA推理，通过校准集观察动作-视觉注意力随层的变化，在注意力模式可靠后再剪枝，并采用双路径剪枝规则，可剪除87.5%的视觉token，最高获得1.718倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法多采用固定剪枝调度（如预设层剪枝或均匀层剪枝），但VLA模型中早期层模型可能不知道哪些视觉区域对动作重要，看似不重要的token在结合语言指令后可能变得有用，因此固定调度存在风险。

Method: 提出SAPrune，一种免训练的VLA推理视觉token剪枝框架。它使用小规模校准集观察动作到视觉注意力随层的变化，仅在注意力模式变得可靠后才选择剪枝层。在每个选定的层上，应用双路径剪枝规则：一条路径保护强注意力的视觉token，另一条路径防止有用的周围上下文被丢弃。

Result: 在LIBERO、SIMPLER及真实世界机器人任务上的实验表明，SAPrune剪除87.5%的视觉token，实现最高1.718倍推理加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。

Conclusion: SAPrune通过自适应选择剪枝层和双路径剪枝规则，有效加速VLA推理，在显著减少视觉token的同时维持任务性能。

Abstract: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.

</details>


### [121] [Answer with Evidence: Consistency-Aware Grounded Visual Question Answering for Roadside Traffic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05274)
*Runwei Guan,Rongsheng Hu,Shangshu Chen,Ningwei Ouyang,Shaofeng Liang,Heyi Lin,Jinjing Zhu,Yang Shi,Dongming Wu,Daizong Liu,Henghui Ding,Hui Xiong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文针对“说点不一致”问题，提出先枚举后回答框架，并提出一致性评测与强化学习优化，显著提升一致性与定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路边交通推理要求文本主张有视觉证据支撑，但现有 grounded MLLMs 常出现“说点不一致”（答案与定位框矛盾），而分开打分答案和框的指标无法惩罚该失败。作者将其归因于传统“先答后定位”分解：在枚举对象前就锁定数值主张。

Method: 构建 RoadSceneVQA-G 基准（34.7K 问答对，每个自由文本答案关联见证框），提出 Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) 评测套件；方法上提出 Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA)，反转生成顺序使答案-证据一致成为输出结构属性；并提出 Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO) 强化学习阶段，用多 rollout 的并集作 recall teacher，无需真值框。

Result: EtA 将说点一致性从 26.6% 提升到 93.7%，grounding F1 从 52.2% 提升到 73.0%；ECPO 进一步将 F1 提升到 75.6%（无逐框监督）。在 gRefCOCO 上，该框架优于最强对比方法，表明可迁移到交通场景之外。

Conclusion: 通过反转生成顺序与一致性强化学习，可在无真值框监督下显著提升 grounded MLLMs 的答案-定位一致性，并具备跨场景迁移能力。

Abstract: Roadside traffic reasoning requires every free-form textual claim to be backed by visual evidence. Existing grounded multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit say-point mismatch, in which the textual answer contradicts the bounding boxes the model localizes. Evaluation metrics that score answers and boxes separately leave this failure unpenalized. We trace the mismatch to the conventional answer-then-ground factorization, which commits to a numerical claim before any object is enumerated. To measure it, we build RoadSceneVQA-G, a benchmark of 34.7K question-answer pairs in which every free-form answer is linked to the set of boxes that witnesses it, and we propose the Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) evaluation suite. To address it, we introduce Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA), which reverses the generation order so that answer-evidence agreement becomes a property of the output structure, and Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO), a reinforcement learning stage that uses the union of multiple rollouts as a recall teacher without ground-truth boxes. EtA raises say-point consistency from 26.6\% to 93.7\% and grounding F1 from 52.2\% to 73.0\%, and ECPO further increases F1 to 75.6\% without per-box supervision. On gRefCOCO, the same framework outperforms the strongest compared method, indicating that it transfers beyond traffic scenes. The project is available at \url{https://github.com/GuanRunwei/RoadSceneVQA-G}.

</details>


### [122] [Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05289)
*Xiaobiao Du,Beixi Hao,Zhen Fang,Tianqing Zhu,Richard Hartley,Xin Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Mobile-4DGS，一个统一的轻量级框架，可在移动设备上实现高保真、实时的静态与动态 3D 高斯渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 在新视角合成上表现优异，但要在资源受限的移动设备上部署静态与动态高斯表示仍面临存储量大、图元冗余、逐帧计算开销高等挑战。

Method: 1) 提出蒙特卡洛高光能量聚合器，将高阶辐射残差压缩进一阶球谐（SH），并结合属性条件化 SH 增强模块，其预测偏移在推理前预烘焙；2) 提出基于多视角 Alpha 的稠密化与剪枝策略，抑制冗余图元并保持多视角一致性；3) 针对动态场景构建紧凑显式 4D 表示，包括二阶高斯运动、可学习时间支撑和二进制静态-动态划分，实现连续时间建模且无需运行时形变网络；4) 基于该划分设计深度顺序证书，选择性复用已提交的深度顺序，减少播放期间的重复投影、排序、合并与索引缓冲更新。

Result: 在静态与动态场景上的大量实验表明，Mobile-4DGS 在保持有竞争力视觉质量的同时，显著降低了存储与渲染开销，实现了移动设备上的实时 3D 与 4D 高斯 Splatting。

Conclusion: Mobile-4DGS 通过外观压缩、图元剪枝和紧凑 4D 表示等设计，为移动平台上的实时静态与动态高斯渲染提供了统一的高效解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.

</details>


### [123] [BossouChimpanzee: Long-term Chimpanzee Video Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05293)
*Daniel Schofield,Susana Carvalho,Vladimir Iashin,Andrew Zisserman,Max Bain,Arsha Nagrani,David Ng,Claudia Sousa,Boniface Zogbila,Jules Doré,Dora Biro,Misato Hayashi,Tetsuro Matsuzawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了BossouChimpanzee视频数据集，记录了1988-2018年几内亚Bossou野生黑猩猩的长达1200多小时连续视频，并先行发布约74小时快照用于个体与行为识别研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为行为学与认知研究提供长期野生黑猩猩视觉记录，并为野外视听数据的机器学习模型训练与评估提供基准资源。

Method: 通过合作实地考察与研究，采集并整理跨越三十年（1988-2018）的连续视频，梳理实验范式的历史与科学贡献，统计并描述主视频数据集结构，同时先行发布约74小时快照BossouChimpanzee70h，覆盖23个已识别个体。

Result: 构建了超过1200小时的黑猩猩视频档案，并发布了约74小时的初始快照，专注于黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别任务。

Conclusion: 该数据集是行为学与认知研究的重要资源，也为野外视听数据的机器学习研究提供了丰富基准。

Abstract: We describe the BossouChimpanzee video dataset, a unique long-term visual record of wild chimpanzees at an outdoor laboratory for field experiments in Bossou, Guinea, spanning three decades (1988-2018) and comprising over 1,200 hours of continuous video recordings collected through collaborative fieldwork and research. In this paper, we outline the history and scientific contributions of the experimental paradigm and video archive, provide key statistics and details on the structure of the main video dataset, and release an initial ~74h snapshot, BossouChimpanzee70h, covering 23 identified individuals focused on chimpanzee individual and action recognition, ahead of the full video resource. This dataset represents a valuable resource for cognitive and behavioural research in ethology and a rich benchmark for training and evaluating machine learning models on audiovisual data from the wild.

</details>


### [124] [Revisiting Ground-Truth Synthesis from High-Speed Video: Exact Validity Conditions and an Audited Consumer Capture Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05298)
*Abdullah Al Shafi,Sumaiya Rahim Suma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 合成运动去模糊数据集常用N帧平均并以中心帧为标签。本文证明该标签仅在窗口为奇数且各帧曝光时长相同时才无偏；偶数窗口造成固定比例偏移，不等时长的误差均值虽为零却会卷积到监督信号中。作者审计51段标称240fps的手机视频，发现19段实际约176fps，并指出奇偶选择对滤波器拟合的影响大于时序不规则性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动去模糊数据集广泛采用"多帧平均+中心帧标签"的合成方式，但该标签是否存在系统性偏差从未被严格检验。作者希望揭示该标签在窗口奇偶性与帧曝光时长一致性上的隐含假设，并说明违反假设时误差的性质与后果。

Method: 理论分析N帧平均标签的偏差：推导奇数/偶数窗口及等/不等采样时长下的对齐误差。随后审计51段标称240fps的智能手机视频，通过容器时序表（timing tables）核实实际帧率，并设计受控实验比较窗口奇偶选择与帧时序不规则性对线性去模糊滤波器拟合的影响。

Result: 偶数窗口即使在理想时序下也会使标签产生固定比例的模糊长度偏移；不等时长的平均错位为零，故无法从数据集统计中察觉，但偏移不可从模糊中读出时会卷积进监督信号而非作为噪声。51段视频中19段实际约176fps，仅记录于容器时序表。受控实验显示奇偶选择带来的代价远大于时序不规则性，且插值标签可借助真实帧时间修复。

Conclusion: 运动去模糊数据集合成中的中心帧标签并非普遍无偏，其有效性依赖窗口为奇数且曝光时长相等。作者提供一个无需解码即可检验这两个条件的工具，并承诺公开视频片段及其时序表，以推动数据集合成的规范化。

Abstract: Motion-deblurring datasets are commonly synthesised by averaging $N$ consecutive high-frame-rate frames and labelling the result with the central frame. We show that this label is unbiased for every capture timing only when the window is odd and the frames' sample durations are equal. An even window shifts every label by a fixed fraction of the blur length, even under perfect timing. Unequal durations are subtler: their mean misalignment is zero, so dataset statistics cannot reveal them, yet when the offset cannot be read from the blur they convolve the supervision rather than adding noise to it. Auditing 51 smartphone clips recorded at a nominal 240 fps, we find 19 captured near 176 fps, a behaviour recorded only in the container's timing tables. In a controlled test the parity choice costs a fitted linear deblurring filter far more than these timing irregularities do, and interpolation labels, unlike blur labels, can be repaired with the true frame times. We provide a tool that checks both conditions without decoding, and will release the clips and their timing tables.

</details>


### [125] [Kinematics-Centric Continuous Sign Language Retrieval with Gloss-Guided Boundary-Aware Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05306)
*Chang Liu,Ke Han,Davide Talon,Elisa Ricci,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将手语-文本对齐从RGB外观空间重构到结构化的运动学空间，以3D SMPL-X运动为主要表示，并引入词条引导的局部对齐与视觉蒸馏策略，在CSL-Daily和PHOENIX-2014T上取得优异检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手语-文本对齐方法主要依赖外观密集的RGB表示，将运动语义与视觉变化纠缠在一起，导致运动-语言接地模糊。论文旨在减少对外观信号的依赖，获得语义更一致的表示。

Method: 1）以3D SMPL-X运动作为主要表示，在统一运动空间中显式建模手语的运动学动态；2）提出词条（gloss）引导的局部对齐机制，利用词条时间跨度作为弱监督，将连续运动分解为连贯片段，建立细粒度的运动-文本对应；3）设计视觉蒸馏策略，训练时以RGB信号作为特权监督提供补充上下文，推理时完全移除。

Result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在CSL-Daily上取得最先进的双向检索性能，在PHOENIX-2014T上取得有竞争力的结果。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了运动学表示与显式局部接地在手语-文本对齐中的有效性，验证了以运动学为中心的框架的优越性。

Abstract: Sign language-text alignment remains a fundamental challenge for text-driven sign language understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on appearance-heavy RGB representations, which entangle motion semantics with visual variations and lead to ambiguous motion-language grounding. In this paper, we reformulate sign language-text alignment in a structured kinematic space and propose a kinematics-centric framework that adopts 3D SMPL-X motion as the primary representation. By explicitly modeling the kinematic dynamics of signing in a unified motion space, our approach reduces reliance on appearance signals and yields more semantically consistent representations. To capture the compositional nature of sign language, we introduce a gloss-guided local alignment mechanism that leverages gloss temporal spans as weak supervision to decompose continuous motion into coherent segments and establish fine-grained motion-text correspondences, thereby reducing ambiguity in localizing word-level semantics in continuous signing. Furthermore, we develop a visual distillation strategy, where RGB signals serve as privileged supervision during training to provide complementary contextual cues, while being completely removed at inference time. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art bidirectional retrieval performance on CSL-Daily and competitive results on PHOENIX-2014T. These results highlight the effectiveness of kinematic representations and explicit local grounding for sign language-text alignment.

</details>


### [126] [Shadow Feature Refinement Network: Progressive Feature Refinement based on Knowledge Distillation for Effective Shadow Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05325)
*Donghyun Han,Byoung-Dai Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SFR-Net，通过监督学习、特征细化损失与知识蒸馏来提升阴影去除性能，并引入后处理算法恢复自然色彩一致性，在ISTD+和SRD数据集上取得竞争性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习虽进展显著，但阴影去除仍是难题，因为阴影的大小和颜色会随光照条件变化而改变。

Method: 提出阴影特征细化网络（SFR-Net），结合监督学习、特征细化损失和知识蒸馏；并设计专门的后处理算法，用于恢复生成的无阴影图像的自然色彩一致性。

Result: 在ISTD+上全图RMSE为3.4627、SSIM为0.9382；在SRD上RMSE为4.3781、SSIM为0.9341，在阴影与非阴影区域均表现竞争性，并具备较强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该方法在多样条件下表现稳健，为鲁棒且感知自然的阴影去除提供了有前景的方向。代码已开源。

Abstract: In the field of deep learning, has seen significant advancements; however, shadow removal remains a persistent challenge owing to the variable sizes and colors of shadows influenced by lighting conditions. This study proposes a novel shadow feature refinement network (SFR-Net), which leverages supervised learning, feature refinement loss, and knowledge distillation to enhance shadow removal performance. A dedicated post-processing algorithm is further introduced to restore natural color consistency in the generated shadow-free images. We evaluated our method on two public datasets: the adjusted image shadow triplet dataset (ISTD+) and the shadow removal dataset (SRD), which demonstrate strong generalization capabilities under diverse conditions. On ISTD+, our model achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.4627 and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.9382 across the entire image. On SRD, it recorded an RMSE of 4.3781 and an SSIM of 0.9341. These comprehensive results show that our approach performs competitively across both shadow and non-shadow regions while setting a promising direction for robust and perceptually natural shadow removal. Code is available at https://github.com/DongHyun99/SFRNet.

</details>


### [127] [Riemannian Shape Analysis of the Corpus Callosum in Kendall Space: Aging and Alzheimer's Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05326)
*Olakunle S. Abawonse,Fatou Fall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出黎曼形状空间框架分析胼胝体随龄形态变化，发现后部区域主导且阿尔茨海默病破坏正常老化轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数研究用标量摘要量化胼胝体，丢弃其边界几何信息，无法精细刻画随龄形态变化。
