However, routing labels do not align with the specialists' intended mechanisms: COSMOS supports compositional accuracy, not mechanism identity.

</details>


### [302] [LocusRL: Diagnosing LLM Reward and Policy Interventions in Competitive Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04441)
*Chengyu Luan,Bo Xin,Songyan Guo,Yuxiang Zuo,Ahmed Yazdan,Jiahang Li,Yicheng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LocusRL诊断框架，通过将受控的奖励-策略对比与对奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标和实际动作的审计相结合，揭示大语言模型干预强化学习时的真实机制。研究发现干预效果存在种子依赖性反转，奖励可强烈影响学习却不提升性能，并能定位与验证动作层面的修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型既可通过奖励设计也可通过动作选择干预强化学习，但仅凭总体性能无法说明这些干预到底做了什么：相似回报可能掩盖不同的学习机制，而看似合理的奖励可能诱发不良行为。因此需要一种能追溯干预机制、将总体结果转化为可检验解释的诊断方法。

Method: 提出LocusRL诊断框架，将受控的奖励-策略对比与四类审计（奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标、执行动作）相连接，把性能差异追溯到可检验的解释，并通过可执行规则与反事实回放检验针对性修正。实验涵盖两个评估批次、十个Connect Four训练种子，以及匹配的三种子奖励方向实验；并在Leduc与Goofspiel中扩展至不完全信息与奖励验证场景。

Result: 发现干预效果存在种子依赖性反转；追踪实际更新后，历史Qwen训练被解释为通过奖励加权的教师动作似然起作用。匹配的奖励方向实验中，在终端奖励固定时，符号反转的稠密预言奖励仅得2.8%胜率，仅终端训练为57.2%，正向稠密预言为46.7%，说明奖励能强烈影响学习但不提升性能。决策层面，反事实回放验证了对已诊断动作错误的有效修正。

Conclusion: 评估大语言模型干预必须追踪其输出如何转化为学习信号与动作；LocusRL将总体结果转化为可操作的诊断与可验证的修正。

Abstract: Large language models can intervene in reinforcement learning through both reward design and action selection, yet aggregate performance offers an incomplete account of what these interventions actually do. Similar returns can conceal different learning mechanisms, while plausible rewards can induce undesirable behavior. We introduce LocusRL, a diagnostic framework that connects controlled reward-policy comparisons with audits of reward judgments, signal delivery, optimization objectives, and executed actions. The framework traces performance differences to testable explanations and checks targeted corrections through executable rules and counterfactual replay.
  Across two evaluation batches covering ten Connect Four training seeds, we uncover seed-dependent reversals in intervention effects and show how tracing actual updates changes their interpretation: historical Qwen training operates through reward-weighted teacher-action likelihood. A separate matched three-seed reward-direction experiment distinguishes sensitivity to a learning signal from its usefulness. With terminal rewards held fixed, a sign-reversed dense oracle yields a 2.8% aggregate win rate, compared with 57.2% for terminal-only training and 46.7% for the positive dense oracle. Thus, a reward can strongly influence learning without improving performance. At the decision level, counterfactual replay verifies a winning correction to a diagnosed action error. Complementary experiments in Leduc and reward-validation studies in Goofspiel extend the analysis to imperfect-information settings, revealing how reference-label definitions and validation-data exposure affect intervention assessment.
  Together, these findings show why evaluating LLM interventions requires tracing how their outputs become learning signals and actions. LocusRL turns aggregate outcomes into actionable diagnoses and verifiable corrections.

</details>


### [303] [One-Step Generation via Riemannian Wasserstein Gradient Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04454)
*David Li,Chanhyuk Lee,Jaehoon Yoo,Nikita Gushchin,Floor Eijkelboom,Eric Moulines,Maxim Panov,Alexander Korotin,Seunghoon Hong,Jinwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将漂移模型与Wasserstein梯度流从连续欧氏域推广到受约束空间，提出并比较多种几何感知场，在统一框架下训练一步生成器，各任务取得有竞争力结果，且最优场因任务而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有漂移模型与Wasserstein梯度流主要针对连续欧氏域（如图像空间），粒子更新为无约束加性更新；在受约束空间上，这类更新可能越出有效域或忽略几何结构，不适合作为训练目标。已有适应工作仅针对特定场或缺乏充分实证比较。

Method: 在统一的一步生成器训练框架下，推导并比较多种几何感知的场（geometry-aware fields），将迭代分布精炼过程移至训练阶段并摊销到生成器中。

Result: 在具有不同结构的数据上进行测试，各设定下均取得有竞争力的一步生成结果；表现最佳的场随任务不同而变化。

Conclusion: 目标函数的几何选择在实际中至关重要，不同任务需选择不同的几何感知场。

Abstract: Recently, Drifting Models and Wasserstein Gradient Flows have attracted substantial attention because they move iterative distributional refinement to training and amortize it into a generator, enabling fast inference. However, existing formulations have been developed largely for continuous Euclidean domains, such as image spaces, where particles admit unconstrained additive updates. On constrained spaces, these updates can leave the valid domain or ignore its geometry, making them unsuitable targets for training. Recent work has adapted updates to these spaces, but has focused on particular fields or offered limited empirical comparison. We derive and compare several geometry-aware fields within a common training framework for one-step generators. We test the method on data with different structures and obtain competitive one-step results in each setting. The best-performing field varies by task, showing why the choice of objective matters in practice.

</details>


### [304] [Target-free Latent Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04467)
*Luoyu Chen,Weiqi Wang,Chenhan Zhang,Zhiyi Tian,Yuxian Huang,Shui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需目标（target-free）的对抗训练框架，通过无监督方式在模型潜空间中放大并多样化行为级偏移，生成语义多样的对抗样本，从而覆盖更广泛的有害行为模式，提升对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型仍易受越狱攻击，会诱发有害行为并绕过安全对齐。现有的对抗训练方法在构建对抗样本时存在行为级狭隘性：要么鼓励固定的有害目标完成，要么基于固定良性-有害数据对进行目标激活消融，导致生成的对抗样本诱发的有害行为高度同质化，无法反映真实越狱攻击的行为多样性，从根本上限制了鲁棒性。

Method: 提出无目标的对抗训练框架，以无监督方式生成对抗样本：通过在模型潜空间中放大并多样化行为级偏移，产生语义多样的对抗样本，诱发多种有害行为；并以语义熵作为输出层面的对抗行为多样性度量。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在目标模型中诱发出多样的有害行为，显著缓解了行为级狭隘性，并提升了对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过无监督、无目标的对抗样本生成扩增行为覆盖，能够暴露更多样的失败模式，进而改善安全对齐并增强对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that induce harmful behaviors and circumvent safety alignment. To defend against such attacks, adversarial training paradigms have been proposed to first simulate failure modes and then train the model to correct them, yielding promising improvements in safety alignment. However, these methods typically construct adversarial samples either by encouraging fixed harmful target completions or by performing targeted activation ablation derived from fixed benign--harmful data pairs. As a result, the generated adversarial samples tend to induce homogeneous harmful behaviors that poorly reflect the diversity of behaviors elicited by real-world jailbreak attacks. This behavior-level narrowness fundamentally limits their robustness. To address this issue, we propose a target-free adversarial training framework that generates adversarial samples in an unsupervised manner. By amplifying and diversifying behavior-level shifts in the model's latent space, our approach produces semantically diverse adversarial samples that induce a wide range of harmful behaviors. This expanded behavioral coverage exposes more diverse failure modes and thereby improves safety alignment. To quantify this effect, we use semantic entropy as an output-level measure of adversarial behavioral diversity. Empirically, our method elicits diverse harmful behaviors in the target model, substantially mitigating behavioral narrowness and improving robustness to jailbreak attacks.

</details>


### [305] [BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04490)
*Chenhang Cui,Xu Xie,Linrui Xu,Xiaohao Liu,Xingyu Zhu,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BARQ，通过熵正则化最优传输实现均衡的码字分配，并结合加权重心更新精炼码本，从而提升基于码本的权重量化质量，在多个 LLM 上取得更低困惑度与更高零样本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 参数量增长，模型存储与参数内存带宽成为高效部署的主要瓶颈。基于码本的权重量化可缓解该问题，但拟合过程中最近码字分配不均衡，导致部分码字更新不足，码本利用率受限，量化质量受损。

Method: 提出 BARQ（Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization）：1）通过带均匀边际约束的熵正则化最优传输，结合曲率加权重构代价，计算权重块与码字之间的联合软分配，确保精确解中每个码字获得相等的正向拟合质量；2）采用分配加权的重心更新精炼码字，并证明其最小化固定分配下的拟合目标，对有限 Sinkhorn 迭代在码字质量超过分母下限时仍保持最优性；3）丢弃软分配，用精炼后的码本执行标准硬最近码字编码。

Result: 分析给出了降低硬量化失真与评估损失的充分条件。在多个 LLM 上，BARQ 在相同比特预算下相比所评估基线取得更低困惑度与更高平均零样本准确率。

Conclusion: 通过均衡码字分配与最优重心更新的码本精炼方法，可有效提升码本利用率与量化质量，为 LLM 高效部署提供实用方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) grow in parameter count, model storage and parameter memory traffic have become major bottlenecks to efficient deployment. Codebook-based weight quantization reduces these costs, but imbalanced nearest-codeword assignments during fitting can leave some codewords insufficiently updated, limiting effective codebook utilization. To address this limitation, we propose Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization (BARQ), which improves quantization quality through balanced fitting of existing codebooks. Specifically, we first compute joint soft assignments between weight blocks and codewords through entropically regularized optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted reconstruction costs, ensuring equal positive fitting mass for every codeword in the exact solution. We then refine the codewords through an assignment-weighted barycentric update, which we prove minimizes the fitting objective for fixed assignments. For finite Sinkhorn iterations, the implemented update retains this optimality provided all codeword masses exceed the denominator floor. Finally, we discard the soft assignments and use the refined codebook for standard hard nearest-codeword encoding, with our analysis establishing sufficient conditions for reducing hard-quantization distortion and evaluation loss. Across multiple LLMs, BARQ achieves lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy than the evaluated baselines at comparable bit budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/chenhangcuisg-code/BARQ.

</details>


### [306] [Understanding Clustering in Slot Attention via Particle Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04493)
*Vasudev Joy,Rajat Rasal,Avinash Kori,Anthea Monod,Ben Glocker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出简化版槽注意力（SSA），一种无参数变体，其动力学与软k-means聚类相关，能对面向对象表示的出现提供机制解释。在Pascal VOC上，SSA达到与槽注意力相当的性能，表明无需学习神经网络组件也能实现有竞争力的面向对象分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 槽注意力虽用于面向对象图像分割和表示学习，但其学习组件掩盖了聚类行为在多大程度上源于注意力动力学本身，因此需要一种更简化的方法来揭示内在机制。

Method: 从交互粒子动力学的视角研究注意力，提出简化版槽注意力（SSA），一种无参数变体，其动力学与软k-means聚类相关联。

Result: 在Pascal VOC数据集上，SSA取得了与槽注意力相当的性能。

Conclusion: 竞争性的面向对象分割无需依赖学习得到的神经网络组件即可实现，SSA为面向对象表示的出现提供了直接的机制解释。

Abstract: Studying attention through the lens of interacting particle dynamics has shown how token clustering can emerge from the underlying dynamics. We extend this perspective to slot attention, a method for object-centric image segmentation and representation learning in which learned components obscure how much of the clustering behaviour is intrinsic to the attention dynamics. We therefore introduce simplified slot attention (SSA), a parameter-free variant whose dynamics are connected to soft $k$-means clustering and which provides a straightforward mechanistic explanation for the emergence of object-centric representations. On the Pascal VOC dataset, SSA achieves performance comparable to that of slot attention, demonstrating that competitive object-centric segmentation can be achieved without learned neural-network components.

</details>


### [307] [LoRA's Second Descent Extends Beyond Parameter Parity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04507)
*Yueran Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了LoRA适配器秩与双下降现象的关系，发现在标签噪声下LoRA呈现第二次下降，但只有在失去参数优势后才追平全量微调的风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双下降现象已受到广泛关注，已有工作将其与数据、模型和学习配置相关联。实际微调中常用在冻结预训练权重上训练小型适配器（如LoRA），适配器秩是决定其容量的超参数，但秩与双下降的关系尚不明确。

Method: 提出模块匹配秩扫描（MMRS），在四个视觉骨干网络和一个70亿参数语言模型上，于标签噪声条件下量化秩与风险的关系。该方法将秩扫描扩展到超过满秩的范围，并将每个秩与相同模块的全量微调进行配对比较（按随机种子配对）。

Result: 在DeiT-Tiny上，风险在秩为1时最低，随着适配器能够拟合噪声标签而急剧上升，形成插值悬崖；越过峰值后风险再次下降，但所有仍能节省参数的后峰值秩都高于全量微调的风险。秩为1的LoRA在四个视觉骨干中的三个上优于全量微调，符合小秩强正则化的特点。LoRA要到首次在DeiT-Tiny上使用四倍于全量微调投影权重的秩时，才追平全量微调的风险。

Conclusion: LoRA确实表现出第二次下降，但只有在失去其参数优势后才追平全量微调的风险，说明其参数效率优势与匹配全量性能之间存在权衡。

Abstract: Double descent has sparked considerable interest, with recent work relating it to the data, the model and the learning configuration. Practical fine-tuning commonly involves training a small adapter on top of frozen pretrained weights, as in low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The adapter's rank is the hyperparameter that sets its capacity, yet how this rank relates to double descent has not been well explored. We quantify this relation under label noise on four vision backbones and a 7B language model with a module-matched rank sweep (MMRS), which extends past full rank and compares every rank with dense fine-tuning of the same modules, paired by seed. On DeiT-Tiny, risk is lowest at rank one and rises sharply as the adapter becomes able to fit the noisy labels, forming an interpolation cliff. Past the peak, risk falls again, but every tested post-peak rank that still saves parameters remains above dense risk. Rank-one LoRA outperforms dense fine-tuning on three of the four vision backbones, consistent with strong regularization at small rank. LoRA thus exhibits a second descent, but matches dense risk only after losing its parameter advantage, first on DeiT-Tiny at four times dense's projection weights. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lora-second-descent-C7B5.

</details>


### [308] [Length Generalization Needs Proper Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04518)
*Pavlo Vasylenko,Matthias Lindemann,André F. T. Martins,Marcos Treviso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现长度泛化不仅取决于位置编码和注意力机制等架构选择，也与训练过程本身密切相关。实验表明权重衰减会阻碍外推，而重新设计 dropout 的放置位置则能显著提升外推能力，并提出新的 VPAD 策略进一步改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多将长度泛化问题归因于架构选择（如位置编码、注意力机制），但作者认为训练过程本身同样关键，希望探究正则化方法（权重衰减与 dropout）对长度泛化的影响及其机理。

Method: 作者系统研究正则化对长度泛化的影响，发现权重衰减会阻碍外推；通过重新考虑 dropout 在架构中的放置位置来提升外推能力。他们指出 dropout 置于层归一化之前会引入系统性的分布不匹配，而将 dropout 放在线性投影之前可解决该问题。此外提出保方差仿射 Dropout（VPAD）这一新策略，以减少预激活方差失配。

Result: 改进后的 SmolLM3（结合滑动窗口注意力）在采用 dropout 的持续预训练后，在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上可完美外推至 64 倍，在 RULER 和 HELMET 上远超预训练上下文长度。Mamba2 同样受益于 dropout，表明该问题是架构无关的。VPAD 进一步降低预激活方差失配，在 transformer 中带来额外外推提升。

Conclusion: 长度泛化受训练过程影响，合理的 dropout 放置（尤其是置于线性投影前）比标准放置更有效，权重衰减则有负面影响。该效应具有架构无关性，而 VPAD 能进一步缓解方差失配并改善外推性能。

Abstract: Length generalization is the ability of sequential models to perform well on context lengths unseen during training. In this work, we show that the challenge of achieving length generalization is related not only to architectural choices such as positional encoding and the attention mechanism but also to the training procedure itself. We study how regularization affects length generalization and find that weight decay can hinder extrapolation. In contrast, dropout improves extrapolation when its placement within the architecture is reconsidered. In that regard, we show that the standard placement of dropout before layer normalization introduces a systematic distributional mismatch, and that applying dropout just before the linear projection resolves this issue. For example, a modified SmolLM3 with sliding window attention, continually pre-trained with dropout, can extrapolate perfectly to 64$\times$ on Needle-in-a-Haystack and far beyond the pre-training context size on RULER and HELMET. Mamba2 also benefits from dropout, suggesting an architecture-agnostic nature of the problem. We further propose Variance-Preserving Affine Dropout (VPAD), a new dropout strategy that substantially reduces the resulting pre-activation variance mismatch, leading to further extrapolation improvements in transformers.

</details>


### [309] [Proximal Causal Learning under Unmeasured Confounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04519)
*Ying Tang,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PCL-U 框架，直接从观测协变量中学习代理变量，通过神经编码器分解出治疗诱导、结果诱导和共享代理，并借助极小极大互信息目标与矩风险函数实现因果效应估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从观测数据估计处理效应通常依赖"无未测混杂假设"（NUCA），但该假设在现实中很少成立。近端因果学习（PCL）虽能通过代理变量处理未测混杂，但现有方法要求代理变量必须预先指定，限制了实际应用。

Method: 提出 PCL-U，利用神经编码器将观测协变量分解为治疗诱导代理、结果诱导代理和共享代理，并以极小极大互信息目标作为指导，再通过一个实用的基于矩的风险函数获得因果估计。

Result: 在基准数据集上，PCL-U 达到或超过现有基线方法。此外，在两类不同维度和混杂强度的合成数据集上，该方法保持了稳定的估计精度。

Conclusion: PCL-U 无需预先指定代理变量，可直接从观测协变量中学习代理变量，在保证估计稳定性的同时达到或优于现有基线，扩展了近端因果学习的适用范围。

Abstract: Estimating treatment effects from observational data typically relies on the No Unmeasured Confounding Assumption (NUCA), which rarely holds in practice. Proximal causal learning (PCL) addresses unmeasured confounding via proxy variables, yet existing methods require the proxy variables to be pre-specified. Thus, we propose PCL-U, a framework that learns proxy variables directly from observed covariates. PCL-U uses neural encoders to decompose covariates into treatment-inducing, outcome-inducing, and shared proxies, guided by minimax mutual information objectives, and obtains causal estimates through a practical moment-based risk function. Experiments on benchmarks show that PCL-U matches or outperforms existing baselines. Besides, there are two types of synthetic datasets with varying dimensions and confounding strengths that illustrate that our method maintains stable estimation accuracy.

</details>


### [310] [Weight Decay and Neuron Condensation: A Three-Stage Analysis of Two-Layer ReLU Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04533)
*Cheng Xu,Pengxiao Lin,Zhangchen Zhou,Zhi-Qin John Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从NTK初始化出发，将权重衰减下的训练动力学分为快速拟合、幅度压缩、神经元凝聚三阶段，用两层ReLU网络分析残差相关场，揭示权重衰减如何促进凝聚表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 权重衰减作为常用正则化手段，其在神经元凝聚（参数方向对齐）中的作用尚不清楚，本文旨在揭示其动力学机制。

Method: 在NTK区域初始化下，用两层ReLU网络刻画训练动力学，分析控制神经元幅度与方向的残差相关场，分三阶段研究快速拟合、幅度压缩与神经元凝聚。

Result: 快速拟合阶段残差趋于准静态平衡且切核几乎不变；幅度压缩早期核衰减放大残差相关场，其孤立吸引极值为凝聚方向候选；幅度稳定后约束极值漂移并证明神经元方向向其收缩。

Conclusion: 该阶段化分析从动力学角度解释了权重衰减如何促进凝聚表征，而不仅是减小参数范数。

Abstract: Weight decay is widely used as a regularization technique in neural network training, yet its role in neuron condensation (parameter direction alignment) remains unclear. Starting from a parameter initialization in the neural tangent kernel regime, we characterize training dynamics under weight decay through three stages: rapid fitting, amplitude compression, and neuron condensation. Using a two-layer ReLU network, we analyze a residual correlation field that governs both neuron amplitudes and directions. During rapid fitting, the residual approaches a quasi-static equilibrium maintained by weight decay while the tangent kernel remains nearly unchanged. In the early stage of amplitude compression, kernel decay amplifies the residual correlation field, whose isolated attracting extrema provide candidates for condensation directions. As neuron amplitudes stabilize, we bound the drift of attracting extrema and demonstrate contraction of neuron directions around them, leading to neuron condensation. This staged analysis provides a dynamical understanding of how weight decay promotes a condensed representation, beyond reducing parameter norms.

</details>


### [311] [PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04537)
*Seoyoon Yum,Sehoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PHASEGATE，将 LLM 推理阶段（prefill/decode）作为 CPU 检索的准入信号，为两阶段分别标定并发上限，在保证 LLM 延迟的前提下最大化检索吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在统一内存系统上，设备端助手需同时运行 GPU 上的 LLM 推理与 CPU 检索。饱和的本地检索负载会显著抬升解码延迟（p95 增加 60-61%），而预填充延迟仅上升 5.7-6.9%，说明两阶段对资源竞争敏感度差异很大，但现有策略未加以区分。

Method: PHASEGATE 将 LLM 阶段作为独立 CPU 检索的准入信号，分别为 prefill 与 decode 标定不同的并发上限（在 base-M4 上取 4 与 1）。同时设置阶段盲控制组 TimeGate，使用相同两个上限并按标定得到的调度执行，但不观察 LLM 阶段。

Result: 在积压队列下，PHASEGATE 的聚合检索吞吐为最佳可行固定策略的 2.0 倍，且在全部七次留出运行中两项 LLM 延迟 p95 均在无检索基线的 1.25 倍以内。TimeGate 吞吐相近，但每次都违反输出 token 延迟上限。M2 与 M2 Pro Mac mini 复现了该策略排序；输出长度扫描显示，随着解码占比增大，优势逐渐缩小。

Conclusion: 以 LLM 推理阶段为准入信号可在保护 LLM 延迟的同时大幅提升检索吞吐，且该策略优势在多种硬件上可复现；但其收益随解码在请求中占比上升而减弱。

Abstract: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

</details>


### [312] [TMAML: Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04547)
*Wannes Janssens,Matthias Bogaert,Dirk Van den Poel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将冷启动预测形式化为少窗口学习问题，提出时间模型无关元学习（TMAML），在TFT上实例化并验证其冷启动预测表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冷启动预测（历史数据极少甚至没有）是常见难题，需要模型能从少量数据快速学习并借助相关序列信息泛化到未见序列。现有全局预测模型虽能利用跨序列共享信息生成冷启动预测，但并未针对训练集外泛化或短历史适应进行优化。

Method: 将冷启动预测建模为少窗口学习问题，改造原本用于神经网络少样本适应的模型无关元学习算法，提出TMAML：以时间上一致的支持-查询窗口构建元任务，并配合时间元训练与元测试流程，使预测模型显式针对冷启动预测优化。作者在Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）上实例化TMAML。

Result: 在三种冷启动场景下的初步实证分析表明：TMAML一致地优于或持平于标准ERM训练的TFT；在三个场景中的两个上比naive方法给出更好的校准预测；但在概率预测精度上并未一致优于naive方法。

Conclusion: TMAML为冷启动预测提供了显式优化的元学习框架，在点预测与部分场景的校准上具优势，但概率预测精度仍有提升空间，未来需进一步改进。

Abstract: Cold-start forecasting, the task of forecasting a time series with little to no historical data, is a common challenge. Addressing it requires approaches that learn quickly from few datapoints and leverage information from related series, typically through static covariates, to generalize well to unseen series. While some global forecasting models can generate cold-start predictions by leveraging information shared across multiple series, they are not optimized for out-of-train-set generalization or adaptation from short histories. In this work, we formulate cold-start forecasting as a few-window learning problem and introduce Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (TMAML), which tailors the model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm, originally developed for few-shot adaptation of neural networks, to deep time series forecasting. TMAML constructs meta-tasks as temporally consistent support-query windows and pairs them with a temporal meta-training and meta-testing procedure, yielding forecasting models that are explicitly optimized for cold-start forecasting. We instantiate TMAML on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and present an initial empirical analysis of forecast accuracy and calibration across three cold-start scenarios: TMAML consistently outperforms or matches a standard ERM-trained TFT, yields better-calibrated forecasts than naive on two of the three scenarios, but does not consistently outperform naive on probabilistic forecast accuracy.

</details>


### [313] [Coupling Noisy Pairwise Knowledge to the DAG Posterior for Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04559)
*Guoliang Xu,James E Corter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HB-NoisyKG贝叶斯框架，将观测数据与多来源重复因果报告结合，通过特征条件Beta先验和共享误差矩阵建模报告可靠性，并用交替推断迭代精化，提升有限观测下的结构学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部因果报告可改善有限观测下的结构学习，但不同来源和变量对的可靠性差异较大，需要一种能同时建模数据与噪声报告的可靠框架。

Method: 将每条报告视为某DAG隐含的直接对状态的噪声观测；采用特征条件Beta先验刻画变量对的可靠性，共享误差矩阵捕捉系统性错误；用交替推断以图后验精化可靠性估计，再据此影响图更新。报告似然仅依赖图的成对状态边际，从而支持离散与连续似然（图内与联合推断）。

Result: 在五个离散基准上，相对80次重启的无KG基线，HB总重启不超过80次，将平均SHD从22.39降至16.06；在物理光通道（随机变量ID但保留描述）上，SHD从39.00降至27.30；连续Sachs上，graph-only BGe较无KG Top-K将AUROC提升0.121；受控合成实验中，持续更新相比一次性估计降低了平均可靠性估计误差与留出报告对数损失。

Conclusion: HB-NoisyKG能有效整合噪声外部因果报告，提升结构学习效果，并通过持续更新改善可靠性估计质量，适用于离散与连续场景。

Abstract: External causal reports can improve structure learning from limited observations, but their reliability varies across sources and variable pairs. We introduce HB-NoisyKG, a Bayesian framework that combines observational data with repeated causal reports from sources such as large language models. Each report is a noisy observation of a direct pair state implied by one DAG. A feature-conditioned Beta prior pools information about pair reliability, and a shared error matrix captures systematic mistakes. Alternating inference uses the graph posterior to refine reliability estimates, which determine how reports influence subsequent graph updates. The report likelihood uses only graph pair-state marginals, so the same observation layer supports discrete and continuous likelihoods in graph-only and joint inference. Against an 80-restart no-KG baseline, HB uses at most 80 total restarts and lowers mean SHD from 22.39 to 16.06 on five discrete benchmarks. On a physical light tunnel with random variable IDs and retained descriptions, HB lowers SHD from 39.00 for no-KG to 27.30. On continuous Sachs, graph-only BGe raises AUROC by 0.121 over no-KG Top-K. In a controlled synthetic study, continued updating also reduces mean reliability estimation error and held-out report log loss compared with one-time estimation.

</details>


### [314] [Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04572)
*Tim Aebersold,Soheyl Massoudi,Mark Fuge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss（PAL），仅需单步分离投影即可在训练中实现精确约束满足，兼具效率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将学习模型部署到许多领域需要精确满足约束，现有方法在训练中展开多步修复并对残留违反进行软惩罚，导致计算与内存开销大、修复不收敛时缺乏鲁棒性，且把大部分约束满足工作交给修复过程。

Method: 核心发现是训练中仅需一个分离的投影步骤即可，据此提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss（PAL）：利用该单步投影后的约束残差自适应地为原始预测的约束惩罚加权。

Result: 在实验中，PAL 是唯一在极非线性约束上仍保持几乎完美可行性的方法，并在合成与工程基准上匹配或超越现有方法；在其 ACOPF 基准上训练速度比经典修复方法 DC3 快 2.5 倍；在约束评估昂贵（如使用神经代理）时仍可训练，而现有展开方法在该设定下内存不可行。

Conclusion: 单个分离投影步骤足以替代多步展开修复，PAL 以更低计算与内存成本实现更强的约束满足与可行性，适用于昂贵约束评估场景。

Abstract: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.

</details>


### [315] [DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04596)
*Karn Tiwari,Varnith Chordia,Prathosh A P*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DiffGate：一种结果门控的蒸馏目标，选择性地对失败轨迹施加有界的教师引导，结合GRPO，在代码与数学任务上提升pass@8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy distillation (OPD)目标主要是token-local且outcome-agnostic，只优化每个前缀处的师生一致性，但推理质量是轨迹级决定的；RLVR（如GRPO）提供结果级监督，却存在奖励稀疏、信用分配粗糙的问题。OPD与RLVR存在互补盲点，需要一种能结合二者优势的方法。

Method: 提出DiffGate，将GRPO与选择性、有界的教师引导结合。教师监督仅施加于失败轨迹，并按组难度缩放，同时平滑有界以�止极端师生差异主导优化。验证器决定哪些轨迹获得教师引导，教师在轨迹内提供稠密的token级更新方向。

Result: 在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B学生模型上，代码任务avg@8分别比匹配的GRPO提升+1.7和+1.8分，pass@8分别提升+1.6和+5.7分；数学任务avg@8与GRPO相差在0.5分以内，pass@8分别提升+1.1和+3.9分。整体上DiffGate在四个模型-领域设置中均提升pass@8。

Conclusion: DiffGate通过结果门控的选择性教师引导，有效弥补OPD与RLVR的盲点，在所有四个模型-领域设置中均提升pass@8，在所评估协议下改善了解决方案覆盖率。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm for post-training large language models, reducing the train--test mismatch of conventional distillation by supervising the student on its own generated trajectories. However, existing OPD objectives remain largely token-local and outcome-agnostic, optimizing teacher--student agreement at each prefix despite reasoning quality being determined at the trajectory level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), provides complementary outcome-level supervision but suffers from sparse rewards and coarse credit assignment. We show that OPD and RLVR exhibit complementary blind spots: teacher signals provide dense local guidance but are weakly aligned with rollout correctness, whereas group-relative rewards capture task success but provide coarse token-level credit and vanish on all-failure groups. We introduce DiffGate, an outcome-gated objective that combines GRPO with selective, bounded teacher guidance. Teacher supervision is applied only to failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, and smoothly bounded to prevent extreme teacher--student discrepancies from dominating optimization. The verifier therefore determines \emph{which trajectories} receive teacher guidance, while the teacher provides dense token-level update directions within those trajectories. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B students, DiffGate improves code avg@8 over matched GRPO by $+1.7$ and $+1.8$ points and pass@8 by $+1.6$ and $+5.7$ points, respectively. On mathematics, avg@8 remains within $0.5$ points of GRPO while pass@8 improves by $+1.1$ and $+3.9$ points. Overall, DiffGate improves pass@8 across all four model--domain settings, demonstrating improved solution coverage under our evaluation protocol.

</details>


### [316] [Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04600)
*Keqin Chen,Jie Bian,Yulian Wu,Vincent Y. F. Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究纯ε-差分隐私下的固定预算最佳臂识别问题，提出了隐私感知的迁移指数上界，并设计了AO-Pri-BAI算法，其失败概率指数达到该隐私感知基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最佳臂识别需要在同时保证统计效率与隐私保护，固定预算下纯ε-差分隐私的分析尚不完善，需要一个能刻画隐私约束下最优错误指数的新基准。

Method: 作者证明最优指数衰减率被一个实例相关的隐私感知迁移指数上界约束（不同于Jourdan和Azize[2025]固定置信度分析中的量）；据此提出AO-Pri-BAI自适应算法，通过拉普拉斯树机制维护私有运行估计，并在困难备择与臂分配之间进行min-max交互学习采样设计。

Result: AO-Pri-BAI满足纯ε-差分隐私；其失败概率指数与隐私感知基准相匹配；数值实验表明即使在非渐近设定下，该算法在多种实例上优于基准算法。

Conclusion: 该工作为差分隐私下固定预算最佳臂识别建立了隐私感知的理论基准，并给出了达到该基准的自适应算法，理论与实验相互印证。

Abstract: Best arm identification under differential privacy is a pure-exploration problem in which both statistical efficiency and privacy protection must be achieved simultaneously. We study fixed-budget best arm identification for bandits under pure $ε$-differential privacy, where the learner must recommend an arm after a prescribed sampling budget while protecting the full transcript. We prove that the optimal exponential decay rate of the error probability is upper bounded by an instance-dependent privacy-aware transportation exponent that differs from the analogous quantity used to characterize the stopping time in fixed-confidence analysis by Jourdan and Azize [2025]. Guided by this exponent, we propose AO-Pri-BAI, an adaptive algorithm that maintains private running estimates through Laplace-tree mechanisms and learns a sampling design through a min--max interaction between hard alternatives and arm allocations. We prove that AO-Pri-BAI satisfies pure $ε$-differential privacy. We also establish that the exponent of the failure probability of AO-Pri-BAI matches the privacy-aware benchmark. Numerical studies show that even in the non-asymptotic setting, AO-Pri-BAI outperforms benchmark algorithms on various instances, complementing the theoretical analyses.

</details>


### [317] [Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04604)
*Octavio Pappalardo,Nathan Herr,Tim Rocktäschel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将自动课程学习建模为序列决策问题，指出现有局部学习信号不足以评估课程决策价值，并利用大语言模型（LLM）结合在线学习进度估计来预测任务的长期收益与即时可学性，在Craftax的256个文本目标基准上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动课程学习可提升强化学习效果，但预测课程决策的后果较为困难。作者指出，决定课程决策价值的量（如任务的长期下游收益）与常用于指导课程的局部学习信号之间存在信息鸿沟，因此需要引入更丰富的信息来更好地预判课程决策的后果。

Method: 将自动课程学习形式化为序列决策问题；提出一种方法，将在线学习进度估计与LLM提供的两类估计相结合：(i) 在每个任务上学习的潜在下游收益；(ii) 当前直接在该任务上训练是否可能产生进步。并在Craftax中构建包含256个文本目标的自定义基准，在不同课程目标下进行评估。

Result: 在针对单个目标任务进行优化时取得最大收益；在面向全部任务集优化时，收益因学习者跨任务迁移机制的不同而存在差异，从学习速度的适度提升到持续至训练结束的更大收益不等。

Conclusion: LLM能够利用关于学习问题的更丰富信息来更好地预判课程决策的后果，弥补局部学习信号的不足；该方法在个体目标任务上效果最佳，而在全任务集优化中效果依赖于学习者的跨任务迁移机制。

Abstract: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.

</details>


### [318] [Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04624)
*Yida Pan,Muhammad H. Ashiq,Chanyong Jung,Yixuan Jia,Jonah M. Miller,Qing Qu,Ismail Alkhouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FunBCS（函数空间反向一致采样），将扩散先验用于PDE系数反演的优化从输出空间转到输入空间，并理论证明其能正确最小化未观测误差，实验误差降低27-64%且加速1.4-2.1倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从极稀疏观测中恢复PDE系数场是严重病态逆问题，依赖扩散模型等生成方法编码先验。现有先进扩散求解器在去噪器输出空间中寻找物理一致重建，但在不连续PDE情形下，输出空间方法可能无法正确最小化与真实系数场相关的未观测误差，导致重建失败。

Method: 作者首先证明在不连续PDE设定下输出空间方法不能恰当最小化未观测误差；进而提出FunBCS（函数空间反向一致采样），一种输入空间优化方法，通过寻找最佳输入使去噪器重建满足物理一致性；并证明FunBCS能恰当最小化未观测误差。基于理论分析，还给出采样过程中输入空间优化步数动态分配的指导。

Result: 在四个PDE逆问题（含不连续Darcy流）上的评估表明，与当前最优方法相比，FunBCS将重建误差降低27%–64%，同时运行速度提升1.4–2.1倍。

Conclusion: 输入空间优化（FunBCS）相较输出空间优化在理论上更适合处理不连续PDE反问题，并能正确最小化未观测误差；实验验证其在精度与效率上均优于现有最先进方法，为扩散先验求解PDE逆问题提供了新范式。

Abstract: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.

</details>


### [319] [The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04631)
*Abdelkader Baggag,Yousef Saad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，旨在向数值线性代数专家普及大语言模型的核心概念，并梳理LLM技术中所依赖的关键数值线性代数方法，同时介绍NLA在该领域的最新贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值线性代数（NLA）长期推动科学发展，从空气动力学中的特征值问题催生LR和QR算法，到稀疏线性系统求解。当前机器学习（尤其是大语言模型）浪潮再次使NLA处于核心位置，许多LLM技术建立在矩阵与张量方法之上，而NLA研究者难以快速适应这一变化，因此需要一篇连接两个领域的综述。

Method: 采用综述方式，围绕机器学习技术，重点聚焦大语言模型。通过阐释LLM背后的核心概念，使其对数值方法领域的专家易于理解；同时系统梳理LLM技术所采用的NLA概念，并介绍NLA在LLM方向上的若干重要新近成果。

Result: 澄清了面向数值方法专家的大语言模型核心概念，并明确了LLM技术中使用的关键数值线性代数概念，同时汇总了NLA在LLM领域的重要近期贡献。

Conclusion: 随着迈向通用人工智能（AGI），矩阵方法将发挥更加重要的作用；该综述为数值线性代数研究者理解并参与LLM研究提供了桥梁。

Abstract: Numerical Linear Algebra (NLA) has consistently played a vital role in advancing science by providing tools to solve fundamental problems encountered in scientific and engineering applications. Over the decades, it has continually evolved to meet the demands driven by successive waves of scientific discovery. For instance, during the 1950s and 1960s, substantial efforts were devoted to developing methods for solving eigenvalue problems that emerged from the rapidly growing field of aerodynamics. This led to the discovery of the LR and QR algorithms. Later the attention turned to the solution of sparse linear systems that were common in applications like computational aerodynamics. Today we are experiencing yet another wave of major scientific advancement and NLA is once more at the heart of its development. This Machine Learning (ML) wave is proving to be utterly disruptive in science and engineering. Many tools in ML particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) are grounded in matrix and tensor methods. As we are approaching Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), it is clear that matrix methods will be called to play an even more significant role. For the numerical linear practitioner the speed of the current change makes it particularly challenging to adapt.
  This is a survey article that centers on machine learning techniques, with a particular focus on large language models. It has two main objectives. The first is to clarify the core concepts behind Large Language Models in a manner accessible to specialists in numerical methods. The second is to examine the key Numerical Linear Algebra concepts employed by LLM techniques, while also highlighting several significant recent contributions of NLA to the field.

</details>


### [320] [Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04638)
*Nianli Peng,Geoffrey J. Gordon,Kianté Brantley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RDA2C，将回放数据视为正则化对偶平均（RDA）中的累积反馈，而非仅作为离策略样本，通过拟合对偶评分模型并由熵镜像映射导出策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Actor-critic 方法通过复用历史经验提高样本效率，但历史数据通常被当作当前策略改进更新的离策略样本。作者希望赋予回放数据一个不同的角色，使历史优势估计直接参与演员目标，而不仅服务于最近一次更新。

Method: RDA2C 存储带评论家估计优势标签的状态-动作样本，在聚合数据集上拟合对偶评分模型 $Z_\theta$，并利用熵镜像映射从累积评分模型中导出当前策略，使回放定义了一个经验对偶目标。理论分析上建立了有限时间值差分解，将正则化对偶平均项与陈旧回放监督拟合、评论家偏差、有限缓冲方差和回放覆盖等误差分离，并给出各自有界的假设条件。

Result: RDA2C 可接受任意评论家的优势标签。使用 GAE 标签时，RDA2C 在八个 MuJoCo 任务中的六个以及十二个 Atari 游戏中的八个上优于 PPO；在 MuJoCo 上六个任务优于最接近的对偶平均基线 AAPDA。使用 twin-$Q$ 标签时，RDA2C 在匹配批量与更新频率下与 SAC 相当。

Conclusion: 将回放视为定义对偶目标的累积反馈，可使历史优势估计直接作用于演员目标，RDA2C 在多种标签来源下均取得有竞争力的表现，并获得有限时间值差分解的理论支持。

Abstract: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

</details>


### [321] [Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04644)
*Zhouyang Liu,Ning Liu,Yixin Chen,Jiezhong He,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了神经图编辑距离（GED）模型在跨图集合迁移时的表现，发现集内性能与跨集合迁移之间存在显著差距，多源训练可显著改善零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经GED方法在标准集内评估下表现优异，但其跨图集合的迁移能力尚不清楚，传统评估无法揭示模型的泛化行为。

Method: 利用精确GED监督，在多种图数据集上对一系列代表性学习方法进行系统性跨集合迁移研究，并分析源-目标方向及集合结构特征的影响。

Result: 集内表现好的模型在结构差异大的数据上常失去优势；多源集合训练能大幅提升零样本迁移，并为新目标集合的少监督学习提供更好起点；迁移行为随源-目标方向和集合结构特征而变化。

Conclusion: 传统集内评估只能部分反映神经GED模型的泛化能力，需推动在异构图集合上进行更广泛的评估。

Abstract: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.

</details>


### [322] [Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04649)
*Abdel Mfougouon Njupoun,Colin Bredenberg,Blake Aaron Richards,Guillaume Lajoie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GaTaP，一种持续学习算法，通过闭式内循环学习任务特定门控变量来选择性地抑制或增强网络模块，从而兼顾减少灾难性遗忘与实现少样本组合泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习通常聚焦于在学习新知识时避免灾难性遗忘，但灵活的持续学习器还应能复用并重组已有知识，以快速解决新的任务组合。现有方法在这一组合泛化能力上仍显不足。

Method: GaTaP 引入任务特定的门控变量（gating variables），通过闭式解的内循环更新，选择性地抑制或增强网络模块；网络参数则在较慢时间尺度的外循环中学习，且门控变量与网络参数均使用相同的局部差分目标传播（difference target propagation）误差信号进行更新。

Result: 在多层感知机与卷积网络的类增量学习场景中，GaTaP 在旧任务上保持较强性能，同时通过推理时的少样本增益适配实现对未见任务组合的组合泛化；对学习到的门控模式分析显示，相关任务呈现相似的门控模式，表明推断出的门控捕捉到了可复用的任务结构。

Conclusion: GaTaP 为同时缓解灾难性遗忘并实现少样本组合泛化提供了一个有效框架。

Abstract: Continual learning is typically framed as acquiring new knowledge without catastrophically forgetting previous tasks. However, a flexible continual learner should also be able to reuse and recombine previously acquired knowledge to rapidly solve novel task compositions. We introduce Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP), a continual learning algorithm in which task-specific gating variables---learned through a closed-form inner loop update---selectively suppress or enhance network modules. Network parameters are learned in a slower timescale outer loop, using the same local difference target propagation error signal as is used for adapting gating variables. We provide tractable experiments on class-incremental learning scenarios for both multilayer perceptron and convolutional network architectures. We show strong performance retention on previously learned tasks, as well as compositional generalization to unseen tasks, achieved through few-shot gain adaptation at inference. We analyze learned gating patterns and find that related tasks exhibit similar gating patterns, suggesting that inferred gates capture meaningful, reusable task structure. Overall, GaTaP provides a powerful framework for jointly ameliorating catastrophic forgetting and enabling few-shot compositional generalization in neural network models.

</details>


### [323] [Pareto-Improving Adversarial Attacks with Primal-Dual Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04652)
*Yang Dai,Longfei Zhang,Wei Tao,Li Shen,Jincai Huang,Qing Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出迁移攻击中"迁移性与不可感知性"的冲突源于固定扰动预算的评估方式，而非本质矛盾；并提出即插即用的原对偶优化包装器ST，在保持或提升攻击成功率的同时显著提升不可感知性，扩展了Pareto前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在相同扰动预算下，迁移性更强的对抗攻击通常攻击成功率更高，但其不可感知性往往下降，二者看似存在固定预算下的权衡。作者认为这一冲突是固定预算评估造成的假象：若在扫描ε得到的ASR-不可感知性Pareto前沿上比较，强迁移攻击在匹配ASR时其实已具备更好的不可感知性。因此，本文希望挖掘并释放这一潜在优势，在不牺牲迁移性的前提下提升隐蔽性。

Method: 提出ST（stealthy transfer attack），一个即插即用的原对偶包装器。它在标准约束目标上加入L∞饱和正则项，并通过两步原对偶更新求解：对扰动进行投影原变量更新，同时对对偶变量做L1球投影，利用Fenchel对偶吸收正则项。该方法无需辅助模型或手工感知先验。

Result: ST在不同基础攻击与额外代理架构上均扩展了Pareto前沿。在ε=16/255时，相较于各基础攻击，LPIPS平均不可感知性提升17%、NIQEE提升14%，同时ASR保持不变或有所提升。在匹配的高ASR水平上，最强的ST变体进一步在Pareto意义上优于专门的隐蔽迁移攻击。

Conclusion: 强迁移攻击潜在具备不可感知性优势，该优势可通过原对偶优化包装器加以释放，而无需牺牲迁移性。这证明迁移性与不可感知性之间的冲突并非本质权衡，而是固定预算评估带来的结果。

Abstract: Transferable adversarial attacks are arguably the most practical black-box threat model. Under the same perturbation budget, stronger transfer attacks attain higher attack success rate (ASR), yet their imperceptibility also tends to degrade. Under such a fixed-budget protocol, transferability and imperceptibility therefore appear to trade off against each other. We argue that this conflict is an artifact of fixed-budget evaluation, not an intrinsic trade-off. When attacks are compared on the ASR--imperceptibility Pareto frontier obtained by sweeping $ε$, stronger transfer attacks already attain better imperceptibility at matched ASR than weaker ones. To exploit this latent advantage, we introduce the stealthy transfer attack ST, a plug-in primal-dual wrapper that adds an $L_\infty$ saturation regularizer to the standard constrained objective and resolves it through a two-step primal-dual update: a projected primal step on the perturbation coupled with an $L_1$-ball projection on a dual variable that absorbs the regularizer through Fenchel duality, requiring no auxiliary models or handcrafted perceptual priors. Empirically, ST extends the Pareto frontier across different base attacks and additional surrogate architectures. At $ε{=}16/255$, average imperceptibility gains over each base attack are $17\%$ on LPIPS and $14\%$ on NIQE while ASR is preserved or improved. At matched high-ASR levels, the strongest ST variants further Pareto-dominate dedicated stealth-oriented transfer attacks, confirming that the latent imperceptibility advantage of strong transfer attacks can be unlocked by a primal-dual optimization wrapper without sacrificing transferability. Code will be made available at \url{https://github.com/AndssY/ST}.

</details>


### [324] [Path Laplacian Encodings for Directed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04657)
*Lydia Mezrag,Semih Cantürk,Michael Perlmutter,Bastian Rieck,Guy Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PathLapPE——一种基于有向图上路径拉普拉斯算子的谱位置编码，能编码方向性高阶结构，可嵌入标准图学习架构，在多个基准任务上取得一致提升且无需方向性超参数调优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有向图广泛存在（引文网络、网页图、信息流网络等），但现有图学习方法多依赖对称化图表示的消息传递或仅部分利用边方向性的位置编码，未能充分刻画方向信息。

Method: 提出 PathLapPE，从有向图上的路径拉普拉斯算子导出谱位置编码，同时提供节点级与边级特征，用以编码方向性高阶结构，并可接入标准图学习架构（尤其与方向感知消息传递结合）。

Result: 在节点级与图级基准任务上，PathLapPE 在多种架构中均带来一致提升，与方向感知消息传递结合时效果尤为明显；与磁拉普拉斯位置编码相比，无需额外调优方向性超参数，运行时间与性能均具竞争力。

Conclusion: PathLapPE 为有向图提供了一种更充分地利用边方向性的谱位置编码方案，兼顾性能、易用性（免超参调优）与效率，是可推广到多种图学习架构的通用组件。

Abstract: Directed graphs naturally model many real-world systems in which interactions are asymmetric, such as citation networks, web graphs, and information-flow networks. However, graph learning methods commonly rely on message passing with symmetrized graph representations or positional encodings that only partially exploit edge directionality. We introduce PathLapPE, a novel spectral positional encoding (PE) derived from the path Laplacian on directed graphs. PathLapPE provides node- and edge-level features that encode directional higher-order structure and can be incorporated into standard graph learning architectures. Empirical results on node- and graph-level benchmark tasks show that PathLapPE yields consistent improvements across several architectures, especially when combined with direction-aware message passing. Compared with magnetic Laplacian positional encodings, a widely studied spectral positional encoding for directed graphs, PathLapPE does not require additional fine-tuning of directionality hyperparameters while offering competitive runtime and performance.

</details>


### [325] [Low-Fidelity FDM Spectral Guidance for Neural Eigenvalue Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04695)
*Aryan Chaudhary,Manikandan Padmanaban,Jagabondhu Hazra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将粗略有限差分法（FDM）与神经网络特征值求解器结合：用FDM得到的近似特征值作为固定位移（shift），并引入更稳定的SIPMNN训练流程，在10维基准问题上以更少迭代获得更高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子特征值问题在科学中广泛存在。经典方法将算子离散成矩阵求解，但高维时细网格在内存和计算上代价急剧上升；而现有神经网络求解器虽避免存储大网格，却需数十万次训练迭代且难以找到目标特征值。作者希望结合两者优势以兼顾效率与精度。

Method: 用粗略的有限差分法计算作为算子谱的廉价数值模型，将其近似特征值作为神经网络训练中的固定位移，使网络只需定位谱的相关部分；同时提出Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network（SIPMNN），一种面向高维问题更稳定的训练流程。

Result: 在d=10的五个测试问题上，该组合方法总体精度优于所对比的纯神经网络方法，并且迭代次数减少8到10倍。

Conclusion: 经典数值方法与神经网络求解器可相互促进：廉价粗网格FDM提供谱结构先验，结合稳定的SIPMNN训练，可在高维算子特征值问题上实现更高精度和显著更少的迭代。

Abstract: Operator eigenvalue problems appear throughout science. Classical methods usually discretize the operator into a matrix and then solve the resulting matrix eigenvalue problem. This works well in low dimensions, but fine grids quickly become expensive in both memory and computation as the dimension grows. Neural network based solvers avoid storing these large grids, but recent state of the art neural methods can require hundreds of thousands of training steps and may struggle to find the desired eigenvalues. We show that the two approaches can help each other. A coarse finite difference method (FDM) calculation acts as a cheap numerical model of the operator spectrum. We use the approximate eigenvalues as fixed shifts during the training of the neural solver, as they only need to locate the relevant part of the spectrum. We also introduce Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN), a more stable training procedure for higher-dimensional problems. Across five test problems at $d=10$, the combined approach is more accurate overall than the tested fully neural alternatives while using eight to ten times fewer iterations.

</details>


### [326] [Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04696)
*Zeyang Li,Yunan Wang,Risheek Garrepalli,Mohammad Ghavamzadeh,Navid Azizan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF)，一种无需重要性采样或对采样轨迹反向传播的生成模型训练算法，用于从非归一化密度中采样；在在线 RL 中利用 critic 梯度作为目标 score，实验显示性能匹配或优于现有生成式策略基线且大幅降低训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型为在线 RL 提供了表达力强的策略类，能实现多模态行为并提升性能。但训练困难：critic 将目标策略指定为非归一化 Boltzmann 密度，却不直接提供该密度的样本。现有方法多依赖重要性采样构造训练信号，方差大、计算成本高、训练不稳定。

Method: 学习目标流时强制自一致性，绕过目标后验均值估计。联合利用给定的目标 score 与流匹配结构，将自一致性要求建立为 score-calibrated 最优性条件：先针对终端密度，再针对可训练速度场。证明其唯一解分别是目标密度，以及若有目标样本时 CFM 可恢复的理想流模型。将速度条件表述为不动点方程，利用其条件期望结构构造 stop-gradient 目标。整个训练保持 CFM 的“采样-插值-回归”可扩展结构，即使无目标样本，也使用当前流生成的端点。在线 RL 中，critic 梯度在生成动作处提供目标 score，从而直接训练 actor。

Result: 在 RL 基准实验中，SCF 匹配或优于当前最先进的生成式策略基线，同时显著减少训练时间。

Conclusion: SCF 提供了一种简单高效、无需重要性采样与轨迹反向传播的生成模型训练方法，通过 score-calibrated 自一致性条件将非归一化密度采样与流匹配统一起来，并为在线 RL 的 actor 训练提供了直接途径。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.

</details>


### [327] [Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04703)
*Doudou Zhang,Wenwen Hou,Yilin Chen,Qi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示 Drifting Models 性能依赖表征的判别几何，提出持续表征学习，从像素直接学习判别表征，将 FID 降低约 82–95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Drifting Models 将迭代分布精炼从推理转移到训练，实现高效单步生成，但其在复杂图像数据集上的性能强烈依赖构建漂移场的表征：像素空间漂移效果差，而预训练特征空间显著提升质量，原因尚不明确。作者旨在解释这一差距并加以改进。

Method: 作者将该差距归因于表征的判别几何，其决定核密度估计（KDE）中的样本加权，进而影响漂移。为此提出持久表征学习（persistent representation learning），在生成器跨批次演化过程中持续学习更具判别性的表征几何。同时在匹配条件下建立 KDE 比率损失与漂移回归损失的当前步梯度等价性，把基于密度比的生成器优化与经验漂移联系起来，从而支持对漂移速度的直接控制。

Result: 在多个数据集上，该方法无需预训练编码器即可直接从像素学习有效的判别表征，相比原始像素空间 Drifting Models 将 FID 降低约 82–95%。此外，适配预训练表征并应用速度裁剪（velocity clipping）可带来进一步增益。

Conclusion: 表征的判别几何是 Drifting Models 性能的关键，持续表征学习可在无预训练编码器条件下显著提升单步生成质量，且与预训练表征和速度裁剪互补，为进一步改进提供方向。

Abstract: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

</details>


### [328] [Localized Operator Learning with Adaptive Partition-of-Unity Mixture-of-Expert Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04708)
*Madison Cooley,Ramansh Sharma,Shandian Zhe,Robert M. Kirby,Varun Shankar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于单位分解(POU)的专家混合框架用于局部化算子学习，并提出HiRefPOU残差式分层POU架构，在异构Darcy与反应扩散问题上显著降低误差，且分区具有可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepONet、FNO等算子学习方法在处理具有锐利界面、异构系数和局部多尺度结构的PDE族时表现不佳，缺乏显式的几何局部化能力。

Method: 提出POU专家混合框架：几何感知门控网络生成平滑空间分区并混合局部专家网络；核心贡献HiRefPOU为DeepONet的残差式分层POU架构，用嵌套父子分区组织局部表示并保持全局连续性；同一POU原理也可引入FNO以增加空间自适应性而不改动谱层。

Result: 在异构Darcy与反应扩散基准上，HiRefPOU误差显著低于全局DeepONet与静态POU-MoE基线；更广泛的实验表明局部化的收益取决于PDE结构与所选算子骨干网络；学习到的分区可解释，且与界面及解快速变化区域一致。

Conclusion: 显式几何局部化能同时提升神经算子学习的精度与可解释性。

Abstract: Operator learning methods such as DeepONets and FNOs often struggle with PDE families featuring sharp interfaces, heterogeneous coefficients, and localized multiscale structures. We introduce a partition-of-unity (POU) mixture-of-experts framework for localized operator learning, in which geometry-aware gating networks produce smooth spatial partitions which blend the contributions of local expert networks. Our main contribution is HiRefPOU, a residual-style hierarchical POU architecture for DeepONets that organizes localized representations through nested parent-child partitions while preserving global continuity. We also show that the same POU principle can be incorporated into Fourier Neural Operators to introduce spatial adaptivity without modifying the underlying spectral layers. On heterogeneous Darcy and reaction-diffusion benchmarks, HiRefPOU achieves substantially lower error than global DeepONet and static POU-MoE baselines, while the broader operator-learning experiments show that the benefits of localization depend on the PDE structure and the chosen neural-operator backbone. The learned partitions are interpretable and align with interfaces and regions of rapid solution variation. These results show that explicit geometric localization can improve both accuracy and interpretability in neural operator learning.

</details>


### [329] [FoSeRL: Formal Sequential Robustness Certification for Reinforcement Learning Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04754)
*Sara Taheri,Deep Kumar Ganguly,Jan Křetínský,Majid Zamani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FoSeRL框架，用于在随机环境中认证已部署RL策略对预先确定的稀疏动作攻击的鲁棒性，无需修改策略即可给出回报损失的概率保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在随机环境中，回报本身具有波动性，即使没有攻击也可能变化，因此在存在动作扰动时认证回报损失非常困难。现有方法往往需要平滑或重训练策略，难以在保持部署策略不变的情况下给出可靠的鲁棒性保证。

Method: FoSeRL将攻击损失认证转化为终端安全问题。它要求一个支持共享随机性和独立单步后继查询的可重置模拟器，但不需要解析动力学模型。通过让攻击与未攻击两条轨迹共享初始状态和随机性，将运行回报差作为增广状态坐标，使轨迹级认证化为终端安全认证。随后使用时变障碍条件约束终端失败概率：条件精确满足时可认证所有可接受的预承诺攻击；从采样轨迹学习并在留出数据上验证时，可在指定攻击设定下给出相同保证。

Result: 在六个随机连续控制环境和三类RL策略族（TD3、SAC、PPO）上，FoSeRL能够认证非平凡的基数—幅度鲁棒性前沿，认证预算显著大于策略平滑方法，并揭示出名义性能相近的策略之间存在明显鲁棒性差异。

Conclusion: FoSeRL为已部署RL策略提供了一种无需修改策略的回报损失认证方法，适用于随机环境下的稀疏动作攻击，并能有效区分策略鲁棒性。

Abstract: Even a few action perturbations can substantially degrade the performance of a deployed decision policy. Certifying the resulting return loss is challenging in stochastic environments, where returns vary even without an attack. We introduce FoSeRL, a framework for certifying deployed RL policies against precommitted, temporally sparse action attacks. The deployed policy is unchanged, with no smoothing or retraining. Certification requires a resettable simulator supporting shared randomness and independent one-step successor queries, but no analytical dynamics model. FoSeRL certifies that an attacked episode loses no more than a prescribed amount of return relative to the same episode unattacked, with at least a target probability and at a user-specified confidence level. Both runs share the initial state and randomness, so the measured loss reflects the attack, not the episode; carrying the running return gap as a state coordinate makes it the terminal value, reducing trajectory-level certification to terminal safety. Time-dependent barrier conditions on the augmented state bound the terminal failure probability: satisfied exactly, they certify every admissible precommitted attack; learned from sampled trajectories and verified on held-out data, they certify the same guarantee under a specified attack-episode setting. Across six stochastic continuous-control environments and three RL policy families (TD3, SAC, and PPO), FoSeRL certifies non-trivial cardinality--magnitude robustness frontiers, achieves substantially larger certified budgets than policy smoothing, and reveals marked robustness differences among policies with comparable nominal performance.

</details>


### [330] [EasyClassifier: Honest, Reproducible Machine-Learning Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04758)
*Ahmad B. A. Hassanat,Ghada A. Altarawneh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EasyClassifier是一个无需代码的开源Python工具，通过默认执行正确的交叉验证流程（折叠内预处理、嵌套交叉验证等），避免数据泄漏和选择偏差带来的乐观评分，并将偏差从2.9个百分点降至+0.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习分类在医学、社会科学、经济学等领域被广泛使用，但许多研究者并不编程。此类工作中反复出现两类错误：在所有行上学习预处理后再做交叉验证（数据泄漏），以及报告在比较中获胜的分类器的交叉验证分数（选择偏差）。两者都会使已发表分数过于乐观，因此需要一个让正确流程成为默认而非选项的工具。

Method: 提出EasyClassifier：一个开源Python包，用户通过一系列通俗语言的多选题从CSV或Excel文件走到完成分析，全程无需代码。它让正确流程成为默认：每个预处理步骤在训练折内学习；所选分类器通过嵌套交叉验证（最多2000行）或未触碰的20%测试集获得单独最终评分；分类器使用固定默认参数和固定随机种子；每次运行输出报告，含可直接改编的方法段落、应引用的参考文献和可直接发表的图。评估在来自7个领域的10个公开数据集及随机标签对照上进行，数据对半划分，一半作未触碰的外部测试（30次运行）。

Result: 常见做法平均高估平衡准确率2.9个百分点（小数据上高达9.9）；EasyClassifier报告的分数平均符号偏差为+0.7个百分点，平均绝对误差2.3个百分点（单侧Wilcoxon p = 3.2×10^{-4}，30次运行）。在随机标签上，报告48.8%平衡准确率，而随机水平为50%。

Conclusion: EasyClassifier通过将正确的评估流程设为默认，显著减少了数据泄漏和选择偏差导致的乐观评分，为不编程的研究者提供了可靠、可复现且报告就绪的机器学习分析工具。该工具以MIT许可证发布于PyPI（pip install easyclassifier）、GitHub和Zenodo。

Abstract: Machine-learning classification is now used across medicine, the social sciences, economics, education and engineering, very often by researchers who do not program. Two errors recur in such work: preprocessing learned on all rows before cross-validation (data leakage), and reporting the cross-validation score of the classifier that won a comparison (selection bias). Both make published scores optimistic. We present EasyClassifier, an open-source Python package that guides a user from a CSV or Excel file to a finished analysis through a sequence of plain-language, multiple-choice questions, with no code. It makes the correct procedure the default rather than an option: every preprocessing step is learned inside each training fold; the selected classifier receives a separate final score from nested cross-validation (up to 2,000 rows), or an untouched 20% test set; classifiers run with fixed default parameters and fixed random seeds; and every run writes a report with a ready-to-adapt Methods paragraph, the references to cite, and figures prepared for publication. On ten public datasets from seven fields and a random-label control, split in half so that one half served as an untouched external test, the common practice overstated balanced accuracy by 2.9 percentage points on average (up to 9.9 on small data), whereas the score EasyClassifier reports had a mean signed bias of +0.7 points and a mean absolute error of 2.3 points (one-sided Wilcoxon p = 3.2 x 10^{-4}, 30 runs). On random labels it reported 48.8% balanced accuracy against a chance level of 50%. EasyClassifier is available under the MIT license from PyPI (pip install easyclassifier), GitHub, and Zenodo.

</details>


### [331] [Variance-Optimal Control Variates for Learning with Black-box Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04766)
*Zihao Zhao,Shuhan Zhang,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出即使精确的动作价值函数也未必是方差最优的控制变量，并提出一种无需额外oracle成本的无偏修正，可将方差大幅降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代模型常通过黑盒oracle（人类、优化求解器、外部工具）学习，这类oracle只给反馈不暴露内部机制。常见做法是学习（动作）价值函数作为控制变量来降方差，但作者发现精确价值函数仍可能远离方差最优。

Method: 首先分析价值函数最小化每个动作自身梯度项噪声，却因参数共享仍影响估计器其余部分，从而产生差距；提出简单无偏修正且不增加oracle成本；进而证明残差方差可按动作精确分解且无交叉项，据此得到神经网络参数的闭式方差最小修正，通过简单投影计算。

Result: 理论上证明简单无偏修正可将方差降低任意大倍数，并给出闭式方差最小修正；实验上该修正在所有任务中持续降低价值函数残留方差并改善学习。

Conclusion: 价值函数并非方差最优控制变量，所提无偏修正与闭式投影方法能有效降低残差方差、提升黑盒oracle场景下的学习效果，代码已开源。

Abstract: Modern models increasingly learn through black-box oracles such as humans, optimization solvers, and external tools that provide feedback without exposing their internal mechanisms. A common remedy is to learn an (action-)value function as a control variate. In this paper, we first observe that even an exact action-value function can be arbitrarily far from variance-optimal. We show that this gap arises because the value function minimizes the noise in each action's own gradient term, while an action can still affect the rest of the gradient estimator through shared parameters. A simple unbiased correction, at no extra oracle cost, can still reduce its variance by an arbitrarily large factor. Motivated by this, we then prove that the residual variance can be decomposed exactly by actions with no cross terms. This decomposition yields a closed-form variance-minimizing correction for neural-network parameters, which can be computed by a simple projection. Empirically, our correction consistently reduces the variance left by the value function and improves learning across all tasks. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/Zihao-Kevin/black_box_opt.

</details>


### [332] [Repeated-Measure Leakage, Distribution Shift, and Reliability under Partial Observation in Patient World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04778)
*Arjun Subramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过评估阶梯验证患者世界模型的预测前提：在PhysioNet GaitPDB步态数字生物标志物短时预测任务上，患者分离导致GRU的NMSE从0.1227升至0.1961，且在50%时间掩蔽下Transformer的NMSE升至0.611而MC-dropout预测方差下降，说明预测状态缺乏可靠的可靠性与缺失鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者世界模型被越来越多用于纵向预测、干预感知推理和临床试验模拟，但因果或临床干预有效性不同于预测泛化与可靠性。在做出更强主张之前，底层的预测状态应能跨患者泛化、在真实偏移和缺失观测下存活，并通过有意义的可靠性信号暴露失败。作者因此在一个刻意收窄的设定中检验这些前提。

Method: 使用PhysioNet GaitPDB数据集（165名参与者、306条记录、51129个context-future对）进行短时数字生物标志物预测。采用persistence、ridge、MLP、GRU、Transformer及紧凑JEPA风格预测器，构建逐步移除原始时间重叠、同记录熟悉性和同患者熟悉性的评估阶梯，最后测试未见患者泛化；并考察重复测量、研究偏移、更长预测间隔、部分观测与50%时间掩蔽下的不确定性校准。

Result: GRU的NMSE在随机窗口划分下为0.1227，消除训练测试原始重叠后升至0.1393，患者留出下升至0.1961。在54名有重复记录的参与者中，接触同患者另一条记录使GRU NMSE从0.2177改善至0.1556，但不支持参与者层面的记录排除身份假设。患者留出评估下MLP与Transformer统计上不可区分。研究偏移、四倍长的预测间隔和部分观测进一步降低性能；在50%时间掩蔽下Transformer NMSE升至0.611，而MC-dropout预测方差反而下降。

Conclusion: 作者不主张这是纵向或干预感知模拟器，而是提出一个前提性评估栈：患者分离、重复测量控制、偏移、缺失性与不确定性验证，应在信任更强的患者世界模型主张之前完成。

Abstract: Patient world models are increasingly proposed for longitudinal prediction, intervention-aware reasoning, and clinical-trial simulation. Causal or clinical intervention validity is distinct from predictive generalization and reliability; before making stronger claims, the underlying predictive state should generalize across patients, survive realistic shifts and missing observations, and expose failure through meaningful reliability signals. We evaluate these prerequisites in a deliberately narrow setting: short-horizon digital-biomarker forecasting from PhysioNet GaitPDB, comprising 165 participants, 306 recordings, and 51,129 context-future pairs. Using persistence, ridge, MLP, GRU, Transformer, and a compact JEPA-style predictor, we build an evaluation ladder that progressively removes raw temporal overlap, same-recording familiarity, and same-patient familiarity before testing unseen-patient generalization. For GRU, NMSE rises from 0.1227 under random-window splitting to 0.1393 after eliminating raw train-test overlap and to 0.1961 under patient holdout. Among 54 participants with repeated recordings, exposure to a different recording from the same patient improves GRU NMSE from 0.2177 to 0.1556, while a recording-excluded identity hypothesis is not supported at the participant level. Under participant-held-out evaluation, MLP and Transformer are statistically indistinguishable. Study shift, a four-times-longer prediction gap, and partial observation further degrade performance; under 50% temporal masking, Transformer NMSE rises to 0.611 while MC-dropout predictive variance falls. We do not claim a longitudinal or intervention-aware simulator. Instead, the results support a prerequisite evaluation stack of patient separation, repeated-measure controls, shift, missingness, and uncertainty validation before stronger patient-world-model claims are trusted.

</details>


### [333] [DASH: Fast, Valid Counterfactuals for Deep Networks via Batched Directional Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04783)
*Shraman Pal,Gabriel Medeiros,Clayton Escouper das Chagas,Can Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DASH：一种用于深度神经网络反事实解释的批量启发式搜索方法，可快速生成接近、有效且可执行的反事实，在多种范数目标下兼顾精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实解释的理想特性包括低延迟、接近原输入、满足输入域/类别/可执行性约束，但深度网络中同时实现这些目标很困难：启发式方法快但可能返回无效反事实，精确方法能保证全局接近性却耗时过长。

Method: 提出 DASH，一种批量启发式搜索方法，用于在 ℓ1、ℓ2、ℓ∞ 目标下寻找接近、有效且可执行的反事实。DASH 利用方向性 Lipschitz 界与局部仿射模型生成锚点，再通过批量网络评估对潜在区域进行排序与扩展。

Result: 在四个表格数据集、网络深度 2 至 32 上，与九种启发式方法和限时精确混合整数基线比较，并在 PBMC3k 上评估可扩展性。在 9,000 个表格查询-范数案例中，DASH 在 94.6% 情况下返回位于最佳启发式有效距离 5% 内的有效反事实，搜索中位 CPU 运行时间 0.061 秒；表现最好的基线 PGD-bisect 仅 41.1%，中位运行时间 0.298 秒。

Conclusion: 所提搜索方法在多种范数下保持高有效接近性，同时搜索运行时间实用，优于现有启发式与限时精确基线。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations are most useful when they can be generated with low latency, remain close to the factual input, and satisfy input-domain, categorical, and actionability constraints. Achieving these objectives simultaneously is challenging for deep neural networks. Heuristic methods are often fast but may return invalid counterfactuals, whereas exact methods can certify global proximity but may not finish within practical time limits. We introduce DASH, a batched heuristic search method for finding close, valid, and actionable counterfactuals for deep neural networks under $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$, and $\ell_\infty$ objectives. DASH uses directional Lipschitz bounds and local affine models to generate anchors, then ranks and expands promising regions with batched network evaluations. We compare DASH against nine prior heuristic methods and time-limited exact mixed-integer baselines on four tabular datasets, with network depths from 2 to 32, and evaluate scalability on PBMC3k. Across 9,000 tabular query-norm cases, DASH returns a valid counterfactual within $5\%$ of the best heuristic-observed valid distance in $94.6\%$ of cases, with a median CPU search runtime of $0.061$ s. PGD-bisect, the baseline with the highest pooled within-$5\%$ coverage, meets this criterion in $41.1\%$ of cases, with a median runtime of $0.298$ s. These results show that the proposed search maintains high valid proximity across norms while keeping its search runtime practical.

</details>


### [334] [KALEIDO: Input-Space Adaptation of a Vision Model for Time-Series Forecasting Through Gated Fold Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04786)
*Xiangyu Shi,Qinghua Liu,Sam Heshmati,Zubin Abraham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Kaleido利用可控制的渲染折叠几何作为时序自适应轴，仅训练0.05%的LayerNorm参数，将掩码自编码器的图像修复能力适配到时间序列预测，在多个基准上显著超越零样本基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型依赖大规模时序语料实现零样本预测，而视觉模型无需此类语料，因为自然图像隐含了预测器所需的模式，ImageNet预训练的掩码自编码器可通过修复序列渲染图来预测。但渲染后的序列并非自然图像，弥合这一差距需要面向时序的自适应，而渲染几何（序列如何被折叠和绘制）是其中一个可控制、可混合的自适应维度。

Method: Kaleido先检测主导周期，生成规则化的折叠几何集合来渲染序列，对各修复结果用仅基于验证集拟合的凸式逐位置门控进行组合，再以固定比例与零样本输出融合；除基线已发布的设置外，不使用任何逐数据集超参数，且仅训练LayerNorm（占0.05%参数）。

Result: 仅训练LayerNorm（0.05%）的Kaleido在LTSF上相对已发布零样本基线将MSE降低13%，冻结版本降低6.6%；在GIFT-Eval上将基线MASE提升7.4%、CRPS提升19.3%。

Conclusion: 渲染几何是弥合渲染序列与自然图像差距的有效、可控且可混合的自适应轴，Kaleido以极小的可训练参数代价实现了对视觉基础模型预测能力的时序适配，并在多个基准上取得一致提升。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models buy zero-shot forecasting with large temporal corpora; a vision model needs none, since a natural image implicitly embeds the patterns a forecaster must model, and an ImageNet-pretrained masked autoencoder forecasts a series by inpainting a rendering of it. A rendered series is not a natural image, however, and closing that gap takes temporal-aware adaptation. We show that the rendering geometry - how the series is folded and drawn - is a controllable, mixable axis for it. Kaleido detects the dominant periods, renders a rule-generated set of fold geometries, combines the inpaintings with a convex per-position gate fit on validation only, and fuses the result with the zero-shot output at one fixed share, with no per-dataset hyperparameter beyond the baseline's published settings. Training only LayerNorm (0.05%), Kaleido lowers MSE by 13% against the published zero-shot baseline on LTSF and, frozen, by 6.6%; on GIFT-Eval it improves the baseline by 7.4% in MASE and 19.3% in CRPS.

</details>


### [335] [TIMBRE: Teaching Time Series Forecasters to Read, Remember, and Reconcile](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04795)
*Xinyu Guan,Zhirong Zhang,Hongyuan Liu,Pengcheng Xu,Yu Sun,Chen Song,Qianyang Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIMBRE结合来源感知表示、状态条件响应迁移与可靠性引导融合，在不改变冻结预测头中位数的前提下调整区间宽度；在13个任务的单种子一epoch开发研究中，它仅在两个任务上优于原生Chronos-2，且去除响应迁移后部分任务误差大幅下降，说明增益来自对响应迁移的敏感性而非通用预测优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件驱动的预测需要将报告与历史响应转化为对数值预测的改动，因此需要一种能整合外部证据并作用于既有预测模型的机制。作者希望验证在冻结预测头之上引入来源感知、响应迁移与可靠性融合是否能带来稳定的预测改进。

Method: 提出TIMBRE（Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence），包含三部分：来源感知表示（source-aware representation）、状态条件响应迁移（state-conditioned response transfer）、可靠性引导融合（reliability-guided fusion），并在冻结的预测头（frozen forecast head）之前进行整合；另设独立读出层（readout）在保持中位数不变的情况下调整区间宽度。实验为单种子、一epoch的开发性研究，覆盖13个任务，并做了去除响应迁移的消融。

Result: TIMBRE在8个任务上相对普通融合（ordinary fusion）改善了MAE，但仅2个任务优于原生Chronos-2。在训练模型中关闭响应迁移后，BTC与AULF的MAE分别下降47.04%和6.81%。缺少部分开发集分数、且未进行重训练消融，限制了对各证据机制的归因。

Conclusion: 结果表明所观察到的效果更多反映模型对"学习到的响应迁移"的敏感性，而非TIMBRE具备通用预测优势。作者将当前工作定位为开发性研究，并指出缺失分数与缺乏重训练消融是归因证据机制的主要局限。

Abstract: Event-informed forecasting requires translating reports and historical responses into changes to a numerical forecast. We propose TIMBRE (Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence), which combines source-aware representation, state-conditioned response transfer, and reliability-guided fusion before a frozen forecast head. A separate readout adjusts interval widths while preserving the median. In a single-seed, one-epoch development study of 13 tasks, TIMBRE improves MAE over ordinary fusion on eight tasks but over native Chronos-2 on only two. Disabling response transfer in the trained model reduces BTC and AULF MAE by 47.04% and 6.81%, respectively. These findings identify sensitivity to learned response transfer rather than a general forecasting advantage. Missing development-set scores and the absence of retrained ablations limit attribution to individual evidence mechanisms.

</details>


### [336] [Multi-Agent Spectrum Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04802)
*Job Elliott,Graduate Student Member,IEEE,Justin G. Metcalf,Golnaz Habibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多认知雷达在100 MHz频段内与其他无线电用户共享频谱的问题，采用元学习让各设备自主决策发射位置和带宽，实验证明其优于传统强化学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来无线通信系统需要灵活、可扩展的频谱共享方案。多个认知雷达需在有限频谱中相互协作且不干扰其他用户，传统强化学习在多智能体竞争目标下难以兼顾性能与稳定性，因此需要更优的学习方法。

Method: 利用机器学习，每个设备在固定100 MHz频带内独立决定发射位置与带宽；系统分析真实或仿真信号活动，识别频谱占用与空闲部分；设备据此调整传输策略，避开拥挤频率。提出基于元学习（meta-learning）的方法，并与传统强化学习方法对比。

Result: 在五个多智能体基准环境中，所提元学习方法在主要基线算法中取得最高平均奖励，同时保持低碰撞率和稳定的传输行为。基于软件定义无线电（SDR）实测记录与仿真环境的实验均验证了该优势。

Conclusion: 元学习方法在多智能体频谱共享场景中能持续更好地平衡相互竞争的目标，优于传统强化学习方法，为未来无线通信系统的频谱共享提供了灵活、可扩展的方案。

Abstract: This project explores how multiple cognitive radars can learn to share limited wireless spectrum with other radio users without interfering with one another. Using machine learning (ML), each device independently decides where and how widely to transmit within a fixed 100 MHz band. The system analyzes real or simulated signal activity to detect which parts of the spectrum are currently in use and which are open. Based on this information, the devices adapt their transmission choices to avoid crowded frequencies while making efficient use of available space. The goal is to develop a flexible, scalable approach to spectrum sharing that could support future wireless communication systems. Experimental results using both over-the-air software-defined radio (SDR) recordings and simulated environments demonstrate that the proposed meta-learning approach consistently balances competing objectives better than conventional reinforcement learning (RL) methods in multi-agent spectrum-sharing scenarios. Across five multi-agent benchmark environments, our proposed method achieved the highest average reward among the primary baseline algorithms while simultaneously maintaining low collision rates and stable transmission behavior.

</details>


### [337] [Separating Decision Time from Decision Quality in the Real-Time Gap of Distilled Deciders: Evidence from a Game and a Conveyor Simulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04810)
*Chihoon Shin,Junyeong Lee,Kihyeok Jeong,Wonok Kwon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将实时决策器的性能差距分解为"时间分量"和"质量分量"，在ViZDoom中进行了三项预注册研究，发现tick转换会严重低估异步延迟带来的性能损失，且时间与质量分量在不同宿主系统上表现各异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时智能体常在世界暂停或决策时间取整到整tick的条件下评估，这种"tick转换"方法预测几乎无损失，但实际异步游戏中学习决策器的命中准确率下降了14.8个百分点，说明现有评估方法严重低估了实时延迟的影响。

Method: 在ViZDoom中训练一个小型决策器模仿脚本教师，以墙钟时间运行游戏，并加入教师等待决策器服务器调用的对照。通过将决策器与零延迟教师之间的差距分解为时间分量和质量分量，在Windows和Linux两种宿主上进行三项预注册研究；使用DAgger从决策器自身游戏中用教师标注状态进行重训练；在传送带模拟器（400 ms截止时间）中验证。

Result: Windows宿主上时间分量为6.5-8.7 pp，质量分量为6.3-8.6 pp。Linux宿主（跳过0.08-0.09%的tick）上时间分量消失（-0.1 pp，95%配对bootstrap区间[-0.4, 0.0]），质量分量仍存在（5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]）。DAgger重训练在新游戏上提升2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9]和3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]。实时游戏中统一延迟留下5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5]的质量分量，重训练使决策器与教师在自身状态上的分歧从22.7%降至14.9%。传送带模拟器中超过400 ms截止时间的延误会消除质量分量。

Conclusion: tick转换会掩盖异步延迟的真实代价。将延迟差距分解为时间与质量分量有助于诊断问题来源：延迟匹配对照可指示应尝试哪种补救措施（如DAgger重训练），而不同宿主系统上时间分量的差异表明tick跳过机制是关键因素。

Abstract: Real-time agents are often evaluated with the world paused, or with decision time rounded to whole ticks (tick conversion). Tick conversion predicts almost no loss for a learned decider whose hit accuracy falls by 14.8 percentage points (pp) on the same games in asynchronous play. We instead split the decider's gap to a zero-latency teacher into time and quality components. In ViZDoom, we train a small decider by imitating a scripted teacher, run the game on wall-clock time, and add a control in which the teacher waits for a call to the decider's server before deciding. On a Windows host, three preregistered studies put the time component at 6.5-8.7 pp and the quality component at 6.3-8.6 pp. On a Linux host that skips 0.08-0.09% of ticks, the time component disappeared (-0.1 pp; paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.4, 0.0]) while the quality component remained (5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]). Retraining on teacher-labelled states from the decider's own play (DAgger) improved it on new games on both hosts (2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] and 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]), a preregistered partial success. Imposing one delay schedule on every arm in live play left a quality component of 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5] on 100 new games, and retraining cut the decider's disagreement with the teacher on its own states from 22.7% to 14.9%. In a conveyor simulator with a 400 ms deadline, delay past it erased the quality component. A latency-matched control whose delays match the decider's shows which remedy to try.

</details>
