### [338] [GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04827)
*Xiaoyun Yu,Xiangfei Qiu,Yonggui Huang,Shixiang Tang,Nanqing Dong,Wanli Ouyang,Geguang Pu,Honggang Qi,Jilin Hu,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GRAM框架，通过记忆并检索TSFM预测误差中的系统性偏差原型来校正冻结时序基础模型的零样本预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强方法用相似历史窗口的真实未来值校正TSFM预测，但真实未来包含模型已捕获的预测成分和难以迁移的样本随机波动。相比之下，预测误差中反复出现的系统性模型偏差更能刻画冻结TSFM的失败模式，提供更有价值的校正信号。但利用这种偏差面临两个挑战：不同数值水平的预测误差因尺度差异难以比较；需从被随机波动污染的误差中提取反复出现的偏差。

Method: GRAM包含两个模块：（1）幅度记忆模块（AMM），按幅度对预测误差进行缩放，并将其聚合成可检索的原型；（2）原型图模块（PGM），建模原型之间的关系，聚合一致的偏差信息并抑制随机波动。在线预测时，GRAM检索并扩展与当前查询相关的原型，生成逐预测步长的校正量以修正原始TSFM预测。

Result: 在多个数据集和多种基础模型上的实验表明，GRAM能够一致地提升预测性能。

Conclusion: GRAM作为一种通用的检索增强框架，可有效提取并利用冻结TSFM的系统性偏差，实现零样本预测的持续改进。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.

</details>


### [339] [Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04845)
*Minjae Lee,Kyunghyun Cho,Sangdon Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MAESTRO方法，将多目标对齐（MOA）建模为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，用对抗式Dirichlet偏好分布通过在线镜像下降更新，端到端RL训练单一prompt条件策略，单次训练即可覆盖Pareto前沿，尤其在难区域表现最佳且训练成本最低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类价值观是多面的（有用性、无害性、幽默性之间存在权衡），且不同用户想要不同的权衡。多目标对齐（MOA）需要训练能提供Pareto前沿任意点的策略。但现有方法存在缺陷：或为每个偏好训练一个模型，或事后插值几个分别对齐的专家，或训练单一条件模型却不考虑应在哪些偏好上训练。由于偏好单纯形的难区域取决于具体目标，现有方法使这些难区域训练不足，无法充分利用单一模型。

Method: MAESTRO将MOA形式化为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，端到端训练一个prompt条件策略，并用RL针对对抗性偏好分布进行优化：该分布为Dirichlet分布，通过在线镜像下降（online mirror descent）朝向当前策略服务最差的偏好更新，而非固定分布。

Result: 在HH-RLHF、BeaverTails及一个摘要任务上，最多三个目标的情况下，MAESTRO在大多数任务上单次训练即取得最佳Pareto前沿，且在所比较方法中训练成本最低。最大优势出现在固定偏好分布导致训练不足的难区域，证实单一prompt条件模型能够自行覆盖目标之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 单一prompt条件模型配合对抗式偏好分布优化，能够有效覆盖多目标间的权衡，尤其在难区域显著优于现有方法，同时降低训练成本，为多目标对齐提供了高效且全面的解决方案。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.

</details>


### [340] [PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04850)
*Jae Won Choi,Ryoonki Hong,Alan Liang,Manjula Adiveppa Wader,Bingsong Zeng,Peiyang Tang,Longwei Liu,Ruishan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PIT-GCL是一个双塔结构感知框架，独立编码每个蛋白的序列、Cα点云和持续同调拓扑描述符，通过跨注意力实现软对接，用于蛋白质结合预测，在多个基准上表现优异且适合大规模筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质结合预测对靶点识别、治疗性结合剂设计和规模化筛选至关重要，但结合依赖序列、三维几何和全局结构组织，难度较大。AlphaFold3和Boltz-2等折叠模型虽提升了结构预测，但其置信度输出（pLDDT、pTM、ipTM）并非专为二分类结合预测设计，而专门的结构感知预测器通常需要结合复合物结构，在筛选规模下无法获取。

Method: 提出PIT-GCL双塔结构感知框架。每个蛋白塔独立编码，输入包括氨基酸序列、Cα点云和全局持续同调描述符。各塔将残基ESM-2嵌入与由Vietoris-Rips过滤的H0、H1持续景观计算得到的拓扑摘要结合，并用结构感知Transformer处理，其中成对Cα距离作为学习到的注意力偏置。随后双向跨注意力模块在两个单蛋白表示间进行潜在空间软对接。模型以二元交叉熵和NT-Xent对比损失联合训练。

Result: 在三个二分类相互作用预测基准（PPIRef上的通用PPI、STAG上的TCRpMHC结合、PPB-Affinity上的全链对）上，PIT-GCL在通用PPI上优于代表性的基于序列、结构感知和任务专用基线；在PPB-Affinity上是唯一高于随机水平的方法；在TCR-pMHC上于固定决策阈值下领先，但被任务专用的序列模型超越。

Conclusion: 由于第一阶段每个蛋白独立编码，其表示可预计算并在候选对间复用，便于大规模筛选。该方法在通用PPI上具竞争力，并在困难基准上展现优势，但特定任务中仍需与专用模型比较。

Abstract: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

</details>


### [341] [CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04851)
*Tao Feng,Fangxu Yu,Zijie Lei,Jiaru Zou,Changjiang Jiang,Yi Yan,Jiaxuan You,Pan Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CURIO，一种好奇心驱动的测试时学习框架，通过内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）补充任务反馈，在开放-ended发现任务中提升LLM的探索与学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放-ended发现需要从反复尝试中学习，同时继续探索价值尚不明确的方向。冻结的LLM只能复用上下文中的先前解，无法从成败中更新模型；而强化学习虽能适应，却可能因过度偏好高奖励轨迹而过早压制低奖励但有潜力的方向。

Method: CURIO在测试时结合任务反馈与内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）。ICWM学习策略隐藏状态表示中的转移，并在策略top-k选择之外的采样token上提供预测误差奖励。通过epoch归一化和退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。

Result: 在六个数学发现任务和单细胞去噪任务上，使用8B至235B的Qwen3骨干模型，三次运行均值在五个数学目标上优于仅任务RL对照，在Circle Packing上匹配最佳已报告性能，并在所有测试规模的两个留出语料上提升去噪Score和MSE。相对增益在Hadamard上达18.3%，去噪Score达10.8%。代码多样性测量显示生成程序具有更大的结构变化。

Conclusion: 好奇心可作为开放-ended发现中学习的补充探索信号，帮助LLM在测试时持续探索并提升性能。

Abstract: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.

</details>


### [342] [Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04867)
*Jihwan Moon,Sheir A. Zaheer,Jinmyoung Lee,Gunhee Kim,Chan Y. Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在125M和400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}分块的Chinchilla最优预算下，系统研究了贪心分块局部学习在自回归语言模型预训练中的损失差距，并分解辅助设计为架构与目标两方面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部学习在图像分类上可与端到端反向传播竞争，在小Transformer上已知以更差的最优损失换取并行加速，但在更大规模自回归语言模型预训练中该损失差距如何变化、哪些辅助设计能缩小差距尚未被测量。

Method: 在125M和400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}分块、token预算匹配且Chinchilla最优的设置下进行实证研究，将辅助设计分解为网络架构（MLP辅助 vs Transformer辅助）与训练目标（多token预测MTP辅助），并测量部署式逐块执行的激活内存开销。

Result: (i) 与端到端的差距从K=2到K=4翻倍以上，但K=4时从125M到400M缩小；(ii) 用Transformer辅助替换MLP辅助可恢复22-41%的差距；(iii) MTP目标在首个块边界有效、在更深边界有害，仅限首块时K=4配置最佳（400M时+0.062 vs +0.075 nats）；(iv) 逐块执行将激活内存降低至多2.2倍。

Conclusion: 作者将这些结果定位为经验支持的方法方向而非最终方法：局部目标应在各边界选择性地施加未来预测压力，同时抵抗绕过预测内容的捷径。

Abstract: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

</details>


### [343] [Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04869)
*Ji Zhang,Zixin Liu,Yiran Ding,Jiayi Wang,Yilu Du,Weijia Xuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出时序链接预测忽视了"谁发起行为"这一源节点活跃度信号，并提出SNAM模型以极低成本弥补该盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互包含两部分：谁决定行动，以及选择对谁行动。现有时序链接预测研究集中于后者，作者证明标准负采样机制会从最优打分中精确抵消源节点活跃度，使模型永远不会因学到该信号而获得奖励，从而系统性忽视源活跃度这一关键信号。

Method: 提出源节点活跃度建模（SNAM），一种自激励事件强度模型，通过精确的点过程似然拟合历史中已包含的衰减交互计数，参数少于20个。该模型可独立使用，也可作为增量项加到冻结的TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD打分上，无需重新训练主干模型。

Result: 仅凭SNAM参数（不看目标节点）在历史负采样下于五个数据集中四个击败DyGFormer与TPNet；作为增量项加入四个冻结模型的打分后，在两种设定下几乎每一组主干-数据集组合的AP均有提升，最高提升25个百分点。完整模型在13个数据集、3种协议下对11个基线排名第一，且在百万级事件流上每轮训练速度比TPNet和DyGFormer快9-100倍。

Conclusion: 源节点活跃度是时序链接预测的一个盲点，而SNAM提供了一种廉价且可迁移的方式来弥补这一盲点。

Abstract: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.

</details>


### [344] [ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04882)
*Penghui Yang,Long Xing,Xuanlang Dai,Ziyu Liu,Kai Chen,Yuhang Zang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ResOPD方法，在稀疏教师接口下实现无偏的全词表反向KL梯度估计，并显著降低梯度方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏中跨长推理轨迹传输稠密教师分布会造成严重的通信与内存瓶颈，实际系统只能使用稀疏教师接口（采样token分数或Top-k分布）。但稀疏设定存在两难：采样token估计无偏但梯度方差极大，直接优化Top-k目标又引入系统性偏差。

Method: ResOPD将未观测词表聚合为一个可观测的粗粒度尾部事件，计算其精确的聚合梯度，仅对尾部内部的细粒度残差进行采样，且无需额外的教师查询或前向传播。

Result: 实验表明ResOPD大幅降低梯度方差，稳定在线训练动态，并在所评估的设定中提升下游性能。

Conclusion: ResOPD可作为高效、即插即用的稀疏在线策略蒸馏方差缩减原语。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

</details>


### [345] [SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04893)
*Amr M. Zaki,Farhoud Jafari,Honggeun Ji,Komal Sarda,Marin Litoiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SFlexRCA，一种面向资源受限工业物联网环境的免拓扑根因分析框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业物联网系统产生高维传感器遥测数据，故障会在互联组件间传播，给根因分析带来挑战；同时边缘设备资源有限，需要轻量、可扩展的方案。

Method: SFlexRCA 将多元遥测转化为紧凑的正交表示，并采用共享的轻量线性建模，避免显式图构建、消息传递以及按变量或滞后增长的参数。

Result: 在 BATADAL、SWaT、WADI 三个公开数据集上与 10 个统计、因果及非因果基线比较，评估根因分析准确率、训练效率、推理延迟和内存消耗；并在 Raspberry Pi 3/5 上评估推理效率与内存，在 Pi 5 上测能耗。SFlexRCA 在 BATADAL 训练数据有限情况下仍保持较强定位性能，且紧凑共享架构避免了因果与图方法的参数增长。

Conclusion: SFlexRCA 是一种免拓扑、轻量且可扩展的根因分析框架，适合部署在资源受限的工业物联网边缘设备上，代码已开源。

Abstract: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

</details>


### [346] [ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04905)
*Qingwen Zeng,Zehao Fu,Shuyu Meng,Linghan Huang,Jiayi Zhang,Chenglin Wu,Ling Chen,Huaming Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ScopeSAE 通过归一化梯度归因，为每个 token 选择与预测最相关的 token-layer 子空间来训练稀疏自编码器，首次实现"重建优于原始"效果，并在特征利用率、可解释性和字典冗余等方面超越逐层基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）主要以逐层方式训练，其建模子空间由层身份固定，与实际驱动每个预测的 token-layer 状态无关。这种约束导致特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏直接行为依据等问题。

Method: 提出 ScopeSAE：通过归一化梯度归因，将每个预测归因到最具影响力的 token-layer 状态，从而按 token 选择建模子空间，并在该预测相关子空间上学习特征。同时采用干预分析与 KL 微调对照实验来验证效果来源。

Result: ScopeSAE 产生"重建优于原始（reconstruction-better-than-original）"效应：SAE 回写重建的下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活。干预分析和 KL 微调对照实验表明该效应源于预测相关子空间本身，而非架构改动。此外，在有效特征数、可解释性、利用率和字典冗余上均优于逐层基线。

Conclusion: 按预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间，能得到更有用且具行为意义的特征，说明建模子空间的选择是提升 SAE 质量的关键因素。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

</details>


### [347] [Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04907)
*Luoyu Chen,Xiaoyu Ding,Weiqi Wang,Chenhan Zhang,Zhiyi Tian,Jianhuan Huang,Shui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究"潜意识学习"中数据需求来源，通过"潜意识引导"测试床发现软监督（KL）只需几百个载体样例即可恢复教师特质向量，而硬监督（NLL）即使数万样例也远达不到。作者用噪声线性逆问题框架解释：梯度指向FΔ_T，梯度下降作为F的渐进逆，软标签恢复低曲率方向，硬标签则同时放大采样噪声，导致最优逆深度随独立载体数增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已发表的潜意识学习演示通常需要数万个载体样例，作者想探究这一数据需求究竟从何而来，并区分其是揭示特质的必要还是抑制噪声的必要。

Method: 以"潜意识引导"为测试床，教师特质为已知残差流向量Δ_T，用参数恢复直接测量迁移。在相同载体前缀下对比token级（硬）NLL监督与全分布（软）KL监督，并通过将引导向量蒸馏建模为含噪线性逆问题（涉及Fisher矩阵F）来解释梯度偏离Δ_T、梯度下降作为F渐进逆的机制。在Qwen2.5-7B和Gemma-2-9B上验证四个预测。

Result: 四种预测均得到验证：初始梯度的Fisher畸变、从陡峭到平坦方向的恢复顺序、最优逆深度随数据规模移动、以及从固定提示池重采样补全与新增提示效果相当。软监督从几百个载体即可近乎精确恢复Δ_T，硬监督即使数万载体仍远低于此。

Conclusion: 在此设定下，大规模载体数据集的作用与其说是揭示特质，不如说是抑制被Fisher逆放大的标签噪声；软监督能以极少数据实现特质继承。

Abstract: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

</details>


### [348] [Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04918)
*Lin Qiu,Yao Liu,Diyi Hu,Hanqing Zeng,Onur Gungor,Chujie Chen,Jiayi Liu,Jianyu Wang,XueLin Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RVCO将token级信用分配建模为守恒路由问题，用视觉干预响应、去尺度坐标与预算化熵路由分配序列效用，在四个模型家族和七个推理基准上超过RLVR基线且保持稳定与鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态推理中，可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽能扩展能力，但结果奖励只给出整条轨迹的价值大小，无法说明该价值应如何分配到产生它的各个决策上，即缺少合理的token级信用分配机制。

Method: 提出Residual Visual Credit Optimization（RVCO），把token信用视为守恒的路由问题：通过受控视觉干预得到逐token的证据响应；用轨迹内稳健坐标去除偶然的尺度影响；用预算化熵路由按感知依赖程度分配固定的序列效用；引入残差支撑路径保证每个有效位置都有正信用，并用解析校正精确恢复规定的信用质量。

Result: 所得信用场具有选择性、有界、全支撑且对响应局部分数平移不变，并在极限情况下退化为硬token选择。在四个模型家族、七个推理基准上，RVCO比强RLVR基线提升准确率，同时保持后期优化稳定性、损坏鲁棒性和有竞争力的训练成本。

Conclusion: RVCO在不改变奖励、rollout和组相对优势估计器的前提下，仅改变token级信用的几何结构，即可改善多模态推理的信用分配与整体性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.

</details>


### [349] [TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04925)
*Baoxi Liu,Yi Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出TSAE，一种用于时间序列预测表示的结构化稀疏自编码器，将隐藏状态分解为可检查特征，并配套TSEVAL评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列预测在能源调度、工业运营和环境监测等关键决策中至关重要，理解模型依赖的模式对评估可靠性和识别失败至关重要。输入归因可识别重要变量和时间片段，但对内部特征洞察有限；标准稀疏自编码器目标未直接约束跨变量结构或时间连续性。

Method: TSAE通过共享字典与变量路由的私有字典组织跨变量结构；采用门控编码将特征检测与幅度估计分离；依据原始片段相似性约束相邻稀疏编码变化。并通过预测一致性微调提升对冻结预测器输出的保留。配套TSEVAL协议分别审计保真度、特征一致性和物理校准。

Result: 在冻结PatchTST上针对ETTh1、ETTh2和ETTm1的三种子实验中，TSAE在五种SAE中取得最低的隐藏状态重构误差、归一化预测-重构误差（NFRE）和特征转移率，且在相当的每token活跃度下。NFRE较次优均值下降4.3-26.4%。

Conclusion: 选择性、物理相关性和校准方面存在数据集相关权衡，表明保真度和时间稳定性收益需要独立的语义验证来支撑特征解释。

Abstract: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

</details>


### [350] [Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04928)
*Yi Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在1B规模上从估计器选择与奖励信号退化两个方向研究GRPO，通过从零实现训练OLMo-2-0425-1B并测量两侧影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解GRPO在1B规模下，估计器选择如何影响学习信号，以及退化的奖励信号如何影响所学内容。

Method: 从零实现GRPO，在GSM8K上训练OLMo-2-0425-1B，进行受控扫描，包括同时退化训练奖励和测试时选择器的验证器质量实验。

Result: 零样本提示使基座模型仅0.08%，几乎无梯度；3-shot提示达18.3%训练成功。估计器变体在种子噪声内，Dr. GRPO在两种子上领先。离策略中裁剪是关键，无裁剪比率损失4-6点。10%翻转验证器下RL保留91%和106%增益，选择仅57%；格式验证器下RL保留16-30%，选择几乎为零。

Conclusion: 翻转噪声是期望奖励的仿射变换，组归一化优势配合Adam重缩放可精确消除；残差为二阶方差效应。弱验证器在RL中比测试时选择便宜得多。

Abstract: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

</details>


### [351] [Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04931)
*Ying Han,Ling Liu,Fabio Soldo,Vu Nguyen,Danio Wang,Liz Kidd,Yongle Cao,Theodore Rose,Su-Lin Wu,Romer Rosales*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个在大型短视频平台上以十亿级规模部署的实时缩略图优化系统，首次公开证明了在线多臂老虎机框架能在无人工筛选的短视频场景下以O(B)规模成功落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与长视频不同，短视频中大量内容没有创作者精心挑选的封面图，默认静态帧效果差。因此需要一个全自动、端到端、可大规模部署的方案来替代静态默认帧。

Method: 采用多臂老虎机（MAB）在线探索框架，结合多阶段候选生成流水线与低延迟服务基础设施；并利用深度视觉质量模型得到图像先验来初始化探索，从而降低探索成本，在服务时动态选择最优缩略图。

Result: 在全球范围部署后，核心用户发现与互动指标取得了统计显著的提升。

Conclusion: 这是首个公开报道的、在十亿级无筛选短视频发现场景中成功上线在线多臂老虎机框架的工作，验证了该自动化缩略图优化系统在真实大规模生产环境中的有效性。

Abstract: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published work demonstrating an online Multi-Armed Bandit framework successfully deployed at an $O(B)$ scale for uncurated short-form video discovery. Our solution pairs a multi-stage candidate generation pipeline with a low-latency serving infrastructure. By initializing the exploration framework with image-specific priors derived from a deep visual quality model, the system minimizes exploration costs and dynamically serves optimal thumbnails at serving time. Global deployment demonstrates statistically significant improvements in core user discovery and engagement metrics.

</details>


### [352] [Learning under Localized Minority Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04936)
*Amin Hosseininasab,Steven M. Shugan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出传统类别不平衡方法忽视了“局部少数类不平衡（LMI）”问题，即少数类在特征空间某些区域被过度低估，进而提出基于树的分层集成方法，并给出无偏评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法默认少数类相对多数类是均匀欠采样的，但现实中少数样本在某些特征区域可能被不成比例地少观测（如小企业破产记录消失），导致模型拟合观测偏差、在真实少数分布的低观测区域泛化差。作者强调不平衡的“成因”与“修正方法”同样重要。

Method: 提出基于树的分层方法：递归划分特征空间，以降低每个分层内部的LMI扭曲；对每个分层，将其多数类实例与完整观测到的少数类集合配对，训练基分类器形成集成。

Result: 在模拟LMI的基准表格数据上，分层集成方法优于流行及最先进的类别不平衡处理方法；同时提出使用无偏测试集的黄金标准评估协议，显示基于同一LMI偏差数据的传统留出评估会严重误导性能判断。

Conclusion: LMI是常被忽视且超出一般类别数量不平衡的挑战；纠正方法需考虑不平衡的成因，并采用无偏评估，否则性能评估可能被观测偏差误导。

Abstract: Class-imbalance methods implicitly assume that the minority class is uniformly undersampled relative to the majority class. However, in many real-world settings, minority instances may be disproportionately under-observed in certain regions of the feature space. For example, small businesses that go bankrupt may disappear from records, while those that survive remain visible, making bankruptcy appear less common among small firms than it actually is. This gives rise to localized minority imbalance (LMI), a challenge that is often overlooked and extends beyond general class-count imbalance. We show that under LMI, existing imbalance mitigation techniques can fit observation-induced biases in the training data and generalize poorly to under-observed regions of the true minority distribution. To address this, we propose a tree-based stratified approach that recursively partitions the feature space with the goal of reducing within-stratum LMI distortion. For each resulting stratum, we pair its majority instances with the full observed minority set and train a base classifier to create an ensemble. Extensive experiments over benchmark tabular datasets simulated with LMI show that our stratified ensembling approach outperforms popular and state-of-the-art imbalance mitigation techniques. We also introduce a gold-standard evaluation protocol that uses unbiased test sets, and demonstrate that conventional hold-out evaluation from the same LMI-biased data can substantially mislead performance. Overall, our results highlight that the cause of imbalance is as important as the correction method.

</details>


### [353] [D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04938)
*Jieke Wu,Qijie Zhu,Weimin Wu,Zeqi Ye,Minshuo Chen,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: D-DOIT 是一种无需训练的离散扩散模型适配方法，通过离散 Doob h-变换，仅用奖励值（无需梯度）重加权逆向转移概率来引导采样，并在 DNA 设计与蛋白质逆折叠任务上超越现有免训练引导基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型的奖励引导适配存在困难：连续扩散的梯度引导方法不适用，因为掩码离散扩散基于分类 token 揭示的离散跳转而非连续状态更新，且未来 rollout 代价高昂。作者希望提出一种免训练、高效、支持通用奖励的适配方法。

Method: 将适配形式化为从奖励倾斜的目标分布中采样，通过离散扩散逆向核的 Doob h-变换实现该传输，仅使用奖励值而非奖励梯度。由于掩码离散扩散采样的是分类式的 token 揭示转移，D-DOIT 推导出相应的离散 Doob h-变换，通过重加权逆向转移概率（而非添加漂移修正）来引导采样。为规避昂贵的未来 rollout，每个引导步骤采样候选下一状态，用模型预测头将每个候选补全为干净序列，用奖励预言机评估，再以正比于奖励的概率重采样下一状态。此外提供可选的后期 best-of-K 精修，仅在去噪末段分支轨迹，避免全轨迹 K 倍开销。

Result: 在调控 DNA 设计和蛋白质逆折叠基准上，D-DOIT 优于免训练引导基线：在提升增强子活性和细胞类型特异性的同时保持序列自然性，并在蛋白质逆折叠中取得最高成功率。

Conclusion: D-DOIT 为离散扩散模型提供了一种无需训练、高效且通用的奖励引导方法，理论上基于离散 Doob h-变换，实践上避免未来 rollout 与梯度计算，在多个科学设计任务中验证了有效性。

Abstract: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

</details>


### [354] [A Graph-Based Inspection and Intervention Tool for Assessing Mechanistic Learning in PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04939)
*Adwait Patkhedkar,Alifaraz Lakhani,Prathmesh Mohite,Abhijeet Salunke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GIIT工具，用计算物理依赖图检查科学模型内部物理对应关系，发现在时间外推OOD下物理映射发生漂移并减弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在训练条件下发现的物理有意义对应关系，在训练条件之外是否仍然成立。

Method: GIIT（基于图的检查与干预工具）：将支配物理表示为计算物理依赖图，通过敏感性和趋势发现把图节点映射到网络内部组件，并用靶向干预检验该映射。

Result: 模型分布内物理残差很低（全ID为1.915×10⁻⁴，ID子窗口t∈[0.5,0.8]为1.01×10⁻⁴），但在离开训练域前功能映射已改变，并随窗口外推持续偏移：残差从边界跨越窗口（t∈[0.5,1.5]）的2.81×10⁻²升至严重OOD（t∈[1,2]）的3.30×10⁻¹；内部层映射系统性左移，平均获胜层索引从5.71（ID）、3.00（ID子窗口）降至2.29（严重OOD）。7个物理节点中仅2个在边界跨越窗口保持稳定层归属，严重外推下仅1个。

Conclusion: 时间外推伴随逐层对应漂移与功能对应减弱，内部功能对应变化可在常规输出指标严重退化之前被检测到；线性振荡系统结果见附录。

Abstract: We ask whether physically meaningful correspondences discovered inside a trained scientific model remain meaningful outside the conditions under which they were discovered. We introduce GIIT (Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool), which represents governing physics as a computational physics dependency graph, maps graph nodes to internal network components via sensitivity- and trend-based discovery, and tests the resulting mapping under targeted intervention. Evaluating on temporal extrapolation out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes of increasing severity, we find that temporal extrapolation is associated with layer-wise correspondence drift and reduced functional correspondence. Specifically, while the model achieves low physics residual in-distribution (1.915 x 10-4 on full ID and 1.01 x 10-4 on an ID sub-window t in [0.5, 0.8]), the functional mapping changes even before leaving the training domain, and the shift continues as the evaluation window extends beyond the training domain: residual error increases from 2.81 x 10-2 on the boundary-crossing window (t in [0.5, 1.5]) to 3.30 x 10-1 on severe OOD (t in [1, 2]), accompanied by a systematic leftward shift of internal layer mappings, where the average winner layer index drops from 5.71 (ID) to 3.00 (ID sub-window) down to 2.29 (severe OOD). Only 2 of 7 physical nodes maintain stable layer assignments across the boundary-crossing window, and only 1 of 7 under severe extrapolation, revealing potential internal functional correspondence changes before severe degradation in conventional output metrics. Additional results for linear oscillatory systems are further detailed in the appendix.

</details>


### [355] [Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04940)
*Tongli Su,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao,Bowen Zhu,JayaSai Somasundaram,Hasibul Haque*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出软件世界模型（SWM），通过探索-学习-行动三阶段预测代码变更将破坏的下游组件（blast set），效果优于静态可达性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体修改一个仓库时可能悄然破坏依赖它的下游服务、库或数据存储，但每次操作后都跑完整集成测试不现实，因此智能体需要提前预测这些失败。

Method: SWM分三阶段：Explore从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更并优先探索与依赖图矛盾的失败区域；Learn基于执行结果微调语言模型预测下游破坏；Act将采样预测转为每个消费者的破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移和决定是否值得再次执行。与仅预测自身观测的软件世界模型和只给出传播位置的静态变更影响分析不同。

Result: 在留出合成系统上，blast-set F1从静态可达性的0.431提升到0.571±0.037，排序遗憾减少一半以上，并在全部九个评估检查点上改善迁移收益。可达性在图中已表示的依赖上更强，SWM能恢复被图遗漏的耦合导致的失败；在真实库上实验表明预测结构化失败结果（而非仅标量风险）对下游决策质量更重要。

Conclusion: SWM能作为静态影响分析的补充，通过预测结构化下游破坏结果支撑变更排序、迁移与执行成本决策，提升智能体修改代码的安全性。

Abstract: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

</details>


### [356] [TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04945)
*Bowen Han,Lingbei Meng,Shihuan Luo,Yupeng Zang,Wenlin LI,Peize He,Yaodi Luo,Lian Zhang,Jianqing Zhu,Jinchao Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TempoBridge：一种源条件化的共同传输框架，用于时序、遗传和化学扰动下的单细胞群体转变预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 破坏性单细胞测量只能提供未配对的群体快照，无法追踪同一细胞在不同条件下的变化；仅依赖局部细胞状态和转变需求难以区分不同源群体的响应。

Method: 提出统一的、以源细胞为条件的传输（transport）公式。源细胞初始化潜在传输并提供固定的经验群体摘要，速度场同时接收该摘要、演化中的细胞状态、流时间及结构化转变描述符。小批量最优传输（OT）仅用于条件流匹配的训练路径构造，推理阶段无需目标表达或OT计算。

Result: 在留出供体上，Energy distance 为0.129，优于 scGen 的0.144；遗传平均表达 L2 误差为2.261，优于 scGPT-scratch 的3.156（Seen 2/2）。在留出化合物上，条件平均药物效应相关性为0.598，优于 CellFlow 适配器的0.561。时序消融显示，移除源上下文、用随机配对替代最优传输、或用静态残差回归替代流匹配，均会导致更高的平均分布误差。

Conclusion: 结果证明，源条件化的共同传输框架在留出供体、基因组合和化合物上均具有预测实用性。

Abstract: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

</details>


### [357] [Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04946)
*Qingyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出非对称监督对比学习（Asymmetric SupCon）预训练目标，实现跨国纵向EHR表示迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨机构与跨国EHR表示迁移困难，源于临床编码、患者人群和医疗流程差异大；同时负性临床结局存在异质性，负样本不应被强行拉近。

Method: 设计任务特定的Asymmetric SupCon目标：只聚类共享阳性结局的患者，不显式吸引阴性轨迹相互靠近；在台湾NHIRD（398万患者）上预训练时间Transformer编码器，并迁移至MIMIC-IV与EHRSHOT；采用结合直接映射与嵌入检索的混合语义映射流程实现异构临床词表迁移。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV上，NHIRD预训练稳定优于随机初始化，并大幅缩小与任务特定域内预训练的差距；在EHRSHOT上，迁移模型在突发疾病预测的少样本场景表现突出；消融显示Asymmetric SupCon在四个任务中三个取得最佳AUPRC，第四个仅低于Standard SupCon 0.003。

Conclusion: 非对称对比预训练是任务特定、跨国EHR表示迁移的有效方法。

Abstract: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.

</details>


### [358] [How Should Teachers Be Prepared? RL on Student-Induced States for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04950)
*Xiaoyu Ma,Haoyue Liu,Zhichao Wang,Jionghao Zhu,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Prep-OPD，通过强化学习预先训练教师模型以适应学生推理状态并纠错，再进行在线策略蒸馏，显著提升小模型数学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏依赖教师对学生生成轨迹的监督，但擅长独立解题的教师在学生错误或偏离其推理路径的前缀下，续写准确率会下降，因此需要让教师适应学生的推理状态。

Method: 先用强化学习训练教师，从固定的学生前缀出发续写，以最终答案正确性为奖励，使教师学会适应学生状态并纠错；随后用该教师通过轨迹引导和token级监督蒸馏学生。

Result: 在八个数学推理基准上，以Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507为教师、Qwen3-1.7B与0.6B为学生，4B教师+1.7B学生时，平均准确率较标准OPD和最强基线Relay-OPD分别提升8.28和2.30个百分点；基于学生前缀的教师RL优于从问题起始训练的方式，且同一教师可复用于0.6B学生。

Conclusion: 让教师先适应学生推理状态再蒸馏，比直接使用独立解题能力强的教师更有效，能稳定提升不同规模学生的推理表现。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves the reasoning capabilities of small language models through token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. Yet can teachers that excel at solving problems independently also guide student reasoning effectively? Prior work shows that when student prefixes follow reasoning paths that differ from the teacher's own or contain errors, teachers can be less accurate when continuing from these prefixes than when solving problems independently. To this end, we propose Prep-OPD, which uses reinforcement learning (RL) before distillation to train the teacher to adapt to the student's existing reasoning state and correct course when errors arise. Training optimizes teacher continuations from fixed student prefixes using final-answer correctness as the reward. The prepared teacher then trains the student through trajectory guidance and token-level supervision. We evaluate Prep-OPD on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the teacher and Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B as students. With the 4B teacher and 1.7B student, Prep-OPD improves average accuracy over standard OPD and the strongest baseline, Relay-OPD, by 8.28 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments further show that teacher RL conditioned on student-generated prefixes yields higher student accuracy than problem-start teacher RL with and without handoff on Qwen3-1.7B. Reusing the same prepared teacher also improves Qwen3-0.6B.

</details>


### [359] [EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04953)
*Ruogu Chen,Jie Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EDISCO 是首个针对欧氏组合优化问题、具有精确 E(2)-不变生成分布的离散扩散模型，在 TSP 与 CVRP 上以更少训练数据超越现有学习类最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧氏组合优化问题（如 TSP、CVRP）在二维欧氏群 E(2)（旋转、反射、平移）下具有内在对称性，但现有学习方法（含扩散模型）仅通过数据增强或正则化近似 E(2)-等变性，学习效率与鲁棒性受限。

Method: 提出 EDISCO：在节点索引解上构建具有精确 E(2)-不变生成分布的离散扩散模型。核心是 E(2)-等变边分数网络，配合离散边变量上的类别型连续时间马尔可夫链，并通过精确后验采样实现高效多步推理，从而获得局部几何归纳偏置。

Result: 在 100–10000 节点的合成 TSP 与 50–2000 客户的 CVRP 上，EDISCO 优于此前学习类最先进求解器，且仅使用 33–50% 的训练实例；仅在均匀合成数据上训练，在空间分布偏移和 CVRP 约束紧度偏移下仍优于竞争基线。

Conclusion: 精确 E(2) 不变性为欧氏组合优化带来显著效率与泛化优势，EDISCO 可作为更易训练、更鲁棒的学习式求解框架，代码已开源。

Abstract: Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems (ECOPs), such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), possess inherent symmetries under the two-dimensional Euclidean group E(2), including rotations, reflections, and translations. Existing learning-based methods, including recent diffusion-based methods, rely on data augmentation or regularization to approximate E(2)-equivariance. This paper presents EDISCO, the first discrete diffusion model for ECOPs with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions over node-index solutions. EDISCO introduces an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network coupled with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling provides efficient multi-step inference. This design gives EDISCO a local geometric inductive bias: edge neighborhoods with the same relative geometry and combinatorial context are represented consistently regardless of absolute position or orientation, making learning more efficient and inference more robust than non-equivariant methods. EDISCO outperforms previous learning-based state-of-the-art solvers on synthetic TSP from 100 to 10000 nodes and CVRP from 50 to 2000 customers, while using only 33-50% of the training instances. Trained only on uniform synthetic data, EDISCO also outperforms competing learning-based baselines under spatial distribution shift and CVRP constraint-tightness shift. Code is available at https://github.com/ValleyC/EDISCO.

</details>


### [360] [Trinity: One Differentiable Physics for Training, Refining and Scoring Generative Floorplanners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04957)
*Shih-Ying Yeh,Tzu-Sian Wang,Xuehai Wang,Jia-Hua Lee,Daniel Z. Kaplan,Ming-Qi Xu,Wuqian Tang,Chun-Yao Wang,Shang-Hong Lai,Chun-Yi Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文重新实现四种扩散布局器并在统一标准下评估各阶段贡献，提出基于流匹配的布局器 Trinity，将六个可微约束/目标函数用作训练损失、采样后闭式精炼器的能量及各阶段软代价基础，在 FloorSet 上取得更优的硬代价与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散布局器仅基于参考布局训练，将耦合的布局系统交由引导、事后循环和合法化处理，只报告最终端点结果，掩盖了生成器本身的贡献，难以公平评估各部分作用。

Method: 在 FloorSet 上以统一配方重新实现四种扩散布局器，对原始、精炼和合法化布局采用同一尺度评分；提出 Trinity 流匹配布局器，其六个可微的约束与目标函数同时作为训练损失项、采样后闭式精炼器的能量以及各阶段软代价的基础，使网络学习校正先验且采样无需引导。

Result: 训练项使普通 transformer 的原始软代价降低 26%，在短预算下尤为关键；共享精炼器对最终代价的贡献大于生成器，并以少 16 至 660 倍的步数匹配移植布局器的循环；Trinity 精炼后软代价比最佳移植流程低 36%；软代价的排序与竞赛硬代价一致；在 FloorSet 验证集上平均硬代价为 1.014，每例耗时 1.63 秒。

Conclusion: 将约束与目标统一为可微函数并贯穿训练、精炼与评估，可让模型直接学习校正先验、免去采样引导，在精度与效率上均优于现有扩散布局流程，同时提供更透明的阶段化评估。

Abstract: Floorplanning arranges the blocks of a chip and decides their shapes under objectives that press blocks together, short wirelength and a small outline, and constraints that hold them apart, non-overlap, clusters, MIB shapes and boundary blocks. Recent diffusion placers train on reference layouts alone and leave this coupled system to guidance, post-hoc loops and a legalizer, reporting only the endpoint, which hides what the generator contributes. We re-implement four of them under one recipe on FloorSet, score raw, refined and legalized layouts on one scale, and propose Trinity, a flow-matching floorplanner whose six differentiable functions for the constraints and objectives are its training loss term, the energy of a closed-form refiner after sampling and the base of a soft cost for every stage. The network thus learns the correction prior placers apply in their samplers, and sampling needs no guidance. Stage by stage, the training term lowers a plain transformer's raw soft cost by 26% and matters most at short budgets, the shared refiner decides more of the final cost than the generator and matches a ported placer's loop in 16 to 660 times fewer steps, Trinity's refined soft cost is 36% below the best ported pipeline, the soft cost ranks settings as the contest's hard cost does, and on the FloorSet val set the pipeline reaches a mean hard cost of 1.014 in 1.63 s per case.

</details>


### [361] [MAGIC: Topology-Aware Analytic Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04963)
*Junlin Chen,Yuhan Wang,Xuefei Wang,Xiao Wang,Ruijie Wang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAGIC提出一种免回放的图小样本类增量学习框架，用冻结图表示骨干+闭式解析持续学习，通过拓扑先验缓解过拟合、漂移感知解析蒸馏缓解表示漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFSCIL除继承传统图持续学习的灾难性遗忘外，还有两大特有挑战：新类监督极少导致严重过拟合；跨会话边连接新节点与历史节点，改变历史传播邻域并引发表示漂移。

Method: MAGIC为免回放框架：结合冻结图表示骨干（如SGC或预训练图基础模型）与闭式解析持续学习。从基图学习可刻画同质与异质关系的拓扑先验，经Potts马尔可夫随机场推断注入以精炼新类监督；并通过漂移感知解析蒸馏，将受影响历史节点旧表示上的预测迁移到更新表示上。

Result: 在五个数据集、八个基线对比中，5-shot设置下Mean Accuracy与Final Accuracy平均提升5.48和9.33个百分点，Performance Drop平均降低10.78个百分点；1-shot与3-shot下同样占优，支持样本增多时增益更大，且训练时间显著更少。

Conclusion: MAGIC有效缓解GFSCIL的过拟合与表示漂移，在多个设置和数据集上超越基线，且计算开销更低。

Abstract: Graph few-shot class-incremental learning (GFSCIL) requires a model to continually recognize emerging classes from only a few labeled nodes while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Beyond the catastrophic forgetting inherited from conventional graph continual learning, GFSCIL presents two distinctive challenges: extremely limited novel-class supervision causes severe overfitting, while cross-session edges---edges connecting newly arriving nodes with historical nodes---alter historical propagation neighborhoods and thereby induce representation drift. We propose MAGIC, a replay-free GFSCIL framework that combines a frozen graph representation backbone (e.g., an intrinsically parameter-free backbone such as SGC or a pretrained graph foundation model) with closed-form analytic continual learning. To alleviate novel-session overfitting, MAGIC learns a topological prior from the base graph that can characterize both homophilous and heterophilous relations, and injects this prior through Potts Markov random field inference to refine supervision for novel classes. To mitigate representation drift, MAGIC transfers previous predictions from the old representations of affected historical nodes to their updated representations through drift-aware analytic distillation. Experiments across five datasets and eight baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of MAGIC. Under the 5-shot setting, MAGIC improves Mean Accuracy and Final Accuracy by 5.48 percentage points and 9.33 percentage points on average, and reduces Performance Drop by 10.78 percentage points on average compared with the best baselines. MAGIC also shows clear advantages under the 1- and 3-shot settings, with larger gains as the number of supports increases. Moreover, MAGIC requires substantially less training time.

</details>


### [362] [One Token Can Be Enough: Bridging Prompting and Activation Steering with Prefix Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04967)
*Xudong Zhu,Zhihui Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出 Prefix Steering：仅在提示末尾的短跨度（甚至单 token）施加激活引导，即可实现接近全程引导的行为控制，同时更好保留通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示通过初始上下文影响模型，而激活引导通常在生成全程干预。作者想探究：引导能否像提示一样，仅通过一次短暂初始干预来影响后续生成，从而挑战"对每个生成 token 都进行引导"的常见做法。

Method: 在固定状态注意力假设下，建立单/多 token 引导与提示诱导注意力头输出相匹配的充分条件，并刻画输入表示变化对匹配及近似误差的影响；进而提出 Prefix Steering，在提示末尾 token 起始的短跨度上应用已有引导方向与算子，之后不再干预，并研究干预时长与强度的联合作用。

Result: 在四个模型、五个任务上，短跨度（甚至单 token）干预常能保留全程引导的大部分行为控制力，同时更好地保持通用能力，其权衡优于或媲美提示与替代引导强度策略；在推理后的最终答案格式化任务上也依然有效。

Conclusion: 短暂初始干预能改变后续生成轨迹而无需持续干预，表明引导结束很久后表达的行为仍可被影响，支持对激活引导采取更动态的视角。

Abstract: Prompting guides language model behavior through the initial context, whereas activation steering often intervenes throughout generation. A natural question is whether steering can produce effects on subsequent computation similar to those of prompting. Under fixed-state attention assumptions, we establish sufficient conditions for single- and multi-token steering to match prompt-induced attention-head outputs, and characterize how changes in input representations affect this match and its approximation error. This attention-level connection leads us to ask whether, at the behavioral level, steering can also guide subsequent generation through a brief initial intervention. We study Prefix Steering, which applies existing steering directions and operators over a short span starting at the final prompt token, with no further direct intervention afterward. We examine how intervention duration and strength jointly shape the control-capability trade-off. Across four models and five tasks, intervention over a short span, even a single token, often retains much of full steering's behavioral control while better preserving general capabilities, offering a trade-off competitive with, and in some settings better than, prompting and alternative steering-strength policies. Prefix Steering also remains effective on final-answer formatting tasks after reasoning, suggesting that a brief initial intervention can influence behavior expressed well after steering ends. These findings challenge the common practice of steering every generated token and motivate a more dynamical view of activation steering, in which a brief intervention can alter the trajectory of subsequent generation without continued intervention.

</details>


### [363] [Hamiltonian Metric Learning and Energy-Based Training: A Dissipative Geometric Framework for Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04969)
*Sparsho Chakraborty,Mohammad Alamgir,Nishanth M,Akshit Nanda,Ram Prasad Padhy,Sayan Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将参数优化视为耗散动力系统的演化，提出HAMLET几何能量框架，并在图像重建与MNIST基准上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统优化通过迭代规则利用损失景观信息更新参数，本文希望从耗散动力系统的视角重新审视参数优化问题。

Method: 将参数视为广义坐标、损失视为势能、正定度量定义参数空间的局部动能几何；从变分形式推导哈密顿动力学、位置依赖度量产生的几何力以及与度量兼容的瑞利耗散律；用CIFAR-10图像重建（以图像Hessian为度量，再将图像重参数化为矩阵乘积态）以及Poincaré返回映射进行说明。

Result: 连续系统满足单调能量耗散关系；以图像Hessian为度量可消除二次模态动力学的曲率依赖；矩阵乘积态重参数化产生真正的位置依赖度量和非零几何力；在五种子MNIST MLP基准上，HAMLET取得最高平均测试准确率97.95%和最低平均测试负对数似然0.0696。

Conclusion: 这些例子确立了HAMLET作为研究参数空间中耗散运动的几何、能量型框架。

Abstract: Optimization in machine learning is usually expressed through iterative rules that update model parameters using information from the loss landscape. In this work, we study an alternative viewpoint in which parameter optimization is treated as the evolution of a dissipative dynamical system. The model parameters are regarded as generalized coordinates, the loss acts as a potential energy, and a positive-definite metric defines the local kinetic geometry of parameter space. Starting from a variational formulation, we derive the corresponding Hamiltonian dynamics, the geometric force generated by a position-dependent metric, and a metric-compatible Rayleigh dissipation law. The resulting continuous system satisfies a monotonic energy-dissipation relation, while its discrete form allows the influence of curvature on the optimization trajectory to be studied directly. We illustrate the framework using a controlled CIFAR-10 image-reconstruction problem for which the optimum is known analytically. With the image Hessian used as the metric, the curvature dependence of the quadratic modal dynamics is removed. We then reparameterize the same image as a matrix product state, producing a genuinely position-dependent metric and a nonzero geometric force. Poincaré return maps provide a complementary phase-space view of the resulting contraction dynamics. These examples establish HAMLET as a geometric, energy-based framework for studying optimization as dissipative motion in parameter space. On a five-seed MNIST MLP benchmark, HAMLET attains the highest mean test accuracy (97.95\%) and the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (0.0696) among the three evaluated optimizers.

</details>


### [364] [Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04976)
*Kaiyue Wen,Tengyu Ma,Percy Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Priced Guidance 框架，通过“压缩成本”来评估语言模型产生原创研究想法的能力，并证明引导成本 K 比特与无提示生成概率 2^{-K} 之间存在下界关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接通过重复采样估计语言模型“无提示地产生未来研究想法”的概率代价极高，因为这一概率可能极其微小，因此需要一种更高效的方法来给出该概率的下界。

Method: 提出 Priced Guidance 框架：生成器 LM 连续提出多选题并给出答案概率分布，掌握目标想法的引导 LM 选择答案；若答案先验概率为 p，生成器需支付 -log2 p 比特。累计成本近似等于引导所传递的信息比特数。若期望引导成本不超过 K 比特，则无引导生成概率至少为 2^{-K}。在 87 篇近期高质量深度学习论文的核心想法上评测五个生成器模型，并用 LLM 作为评判者判断生成想法是否在核心研究对象与定义机制上匹配目标。

Result: Fable 5.1 取得最低中位压缩成本 69.9 比特，远低于 gzip 无损压缩目标想法摘要的中位数 5,712 比特；由 Fable 5.1、Opus 5 和 Astra 组成的均匀集成进一步将中位压缩成本降至 55.8 比特，并将生成概率下界提升约 18,000 倍。

Conclusion: 压缩成本可作为评估语言模型生成新颖研究想法能力的有效代理指标，且多模型集成能显著降低压缩成本、提高无提示生成目标想法的概率下界。

Abstract: We evaluate language models' capability to generate novel research ideas through the lens of compression. We aim to lower-bound the potentially tiny probability that a language model generates the essence of a future research idea without any hints. Rather than estimate this probability through expensive repeated sampling, our Priced Guidance framework measures the compression cost: how many additional bits of information are needed to guide the model to recover the target idea. We prove that if the model can recover the target idea with at most K bits of guidance in expectation, then it can generate the idea without any guidance with probability at least $2^{-K}$. In our framework, the language model, called the generator, can pose a sequence of multiple-choice questions and specify a probability distribution over possible answers. A guide, which is a language model with access to the target idea, selects answers. If a selected answer has prior probability p, the generator pays $-\log_2 p$ bits. The generator aims to produce an idea that matches the essence of the target idea with minimal cumulative cost. This cumulative cost equals, up to an additive constant, the number of bits of information sent by the guide. Using this methodology, we evaluate five generator LLMs (Opus 5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM 5.3) on the core ideas in 87 recent high-quality deep learning papers and we use LLM as judge to determine whether the generated idea matches the target in terms of the central research object and defining mechanism. Fable 5.1 achieves the lowest median compression cost at 69.9 bits, substantially lower than gzip's median of 5,712 bits for losslessly compressing the summary of the target idea. A uniform ensemble of Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Astra further reduces the median compression cost to 55.8 bits and improves the generation probability lower bound by 18,000 times.

</details>


### [365] [What Will Post-Training Fix? Per-Problem Gains Are Shared Across Independent RL Runs, and Existing Checkpoints Predict Them Better Than A Priori Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04978)
*Xiaoxian Duan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验了"训练前即可预测模型将在哪些问题上提升"这一假设，发现增益中可预测的共享成分主要归属于基座模型而非问题本身，且现有检查点的逐题增益比各类先验信号更能预测新训练运行的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据选择、课程设计和后训练方案评估都以"训练前能判断模型会在哪些问题上提升"为前提，作者直接对这一假设进行实证检验。

Method: 基于 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 与 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 两个基座模型，在最多 1532 道竞赛数学题上进行十八次后训练运行、每题多采样，并用不相交运行子集之间的一致性导出噪声上限，再将训练前可得信号与噪声上限对比。

Result: 两基座模型上结论一致：独立运行对"哪些罕见被解出的问题会提升"高度一致（噪声上限约 0.9），但两基座之间仅 rho=0.25，说明共享成分属于基座模型而非问题；先验信号（基座通过率、正确解似然、更大模型通过率及其组合）仅解释 0.30 与 0.24 的可解释增益方差；来自另一家族单个检查点的逐题增益预测新运行效果优于所有先验信号（0.52 对 0.33，0.34 对 0.17），结论在 2025–2026 竞赛题目及基线独立估计下依然成立。

Conclusion: 训练前难以预判具体问题上的提升，逐题增益的共享结构来自基座模型；论文建议将噪声上限作为逐题信号的标准伴随指标。

Abstract: Data selection, curricula and the evaluation of post-training recipes all assume that we can tell, before training, which problems a model will improve on. We test this assumption directly. For two base models, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, we evaluate eighteen post-training runs on up to 1532 competition math problems with many samples per problem, and compare signals available before training against a noise ceiling derived from the agreement between disjoint subsets of runs. Three findings hold on both base models. What post-training fixes is shared: independent runs agree on which rarely solved problems improve, with a noise ceiling of about 0.9, yet the two base models agree with each other only at rho=0.25 - the shared component belongs to the base model, not to the problem. A priori signals capture a minority of it: base pass rate, the likelihood of a correct solution, a larger model's pass rate and their combinations explain only 0.30 and 0.24 of the explainable variance in gains. Existing checkpoints are the better predictor: the per-problem gains of a single checkpoint from another family predict a new run better than every a priori signal, alone or combined (0.52 vs. 0.33 and 0.34 vs. 0.17 against the combined signals). The conclusions hold on problems from 2025-2026 competitions and when the baselines on the two sides of every comparison are estimated independently. We propose the noise ceiling as a standard companion to per-problem signals.

</details>


### [366] [How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04988)
*Lama Moukheiber,Haotian Xue,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TEMPO，一种基于时间距离的规划目标，仅需训练一个小型MLP映射，即可显著提升冻结世界模型的规划能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜空间世界模型通过比较想象终点与目标的潜距离来排序候选动作，但当目标需多步规划才能到达时，该距离衡量的是"像不像目标"而非"离目标还有多远"，导致排序失效。

Method: TEMPO不修改世界模型，仅利用已用于训练模型的演示数据，学习冻结潜空间的一个小型映射，使两个状态之间的距离反映二者之间的环境步数，并将该时间距离融入规划器的代价函数。无需奖励、策略或成功标签，计算开销极小。

Result: 在11个仿真环境（迷宫导航、桌面推动、机械臂控制、三维操作等）上以LeWM和PLDM规划器评估。仅增加最多0.3%算力的小MLP，即在所有目标距离上提升两个规划器，将LeWM在TwoRoom距目标三步任务上从36%提升至99%，并在广泛的2D/3D导航、到达与操作任务上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: TEMPO作为一种代价而非模型，通用性强，适用于每状态单一潜向量、以潜距离规划的冻结世界模型，有效解决了长程规划中的目标排序问题。

Abstract: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [367] [Pessimistic Minimax Learning for Public-Private Information Games under Unilateral Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04997)
*Shuze Daniel Liu,Claire Chen,Jiuqi Wang,David Simchi-Levi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究具有公开与私有信息的双人零和上下文博弈中的离线学习，提出单边规定性可集中性概念，并给出有限状态-动作空间与一般函数逼近下的悲观算法及可利用性速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由拍卖、谈判等具有私有估值的策略场景驱动，研究公开-私有信息约束下的离线均衡学习问题。

Method: 提出单边规定性可集中性（unilateral prescriptive concentrability）；针对有限状态-动作空间设计悲观算法；进一步提出适用于一般函数逼近的悲观策略镜像下降框架 PPA-PMD，配合无遗憾的 actor 更新。

Result: 有限状态-动作空间下达到 \tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n}) 的可利用性速率，与完全观测极小极大博弈的标准样本量依赖性匹配；PPA-PMD 获得统一的 \tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T}) 可利用性速率。

Conclusion: 这些结果构成了公开-私有信息约束下离线均衡学习的首个理论框架。

Abstract: We study offline learning in two-player zero-sum contextual games with public and private information, motivated by strategic settings such as auctions and negotiations with private valuations. We introduce unilateral prescriptive concentrability and show that asymmetric information can change offline coverage through its effect on equilibrium behavior. For finite state-action spaces, we develop a pessimistic algorithm with an $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ exploitability rate, matching the standard sample-size dependence for fully observed minimax games. We further develop a pessimistic policy mirror descent framework, PPA-PMD, for general function approximation and obtain a unified $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$ exploitability rate with no-regret actor updates. Together, these results provide the first theoretical framework for offline equilibrium learning under public-private information constraints.

</details>


### [368] [Beyond Overparameterization: Provable Learning of Input-Convex Multi-Layer Polynomial Networks with Active Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04999)
*Jinqi Tang,Qian Chen,Shihong Ding,Cong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ASPIRE算法，通过主动查询与逐层采样对角化，首次实现了深层目标网络在多项式时间内按参数精度恢复，样本复杂度随深度仅多项式增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多层神经网络的理论理解多局限于过参数化场景，掩盖了参数可辨识性并带来高样本复杂度；NTK理论虽适用于宽网络，却无法给出高效样本复杂度保证。现有特征学习结果多限于浅层或特定结构且处于过参数化区间，缺乏对深层网络参数级恢复的分析。

Method: 研究具有偶次k阶单项式激活和非负高层权重的L层多项式网络，该结构使目标网络输入凸，但参数优化地形高度非凸。利用输入凸性与主动数据查询，提出ASPIRE（基于特征方向的主动采样迭代恢复），一种逐层、基于采样的对角化算法来恢复全部网络参数。

Result: ASPIRE可在多项式时间内将所有网络参数恢复到δ精度，样本复杂度为Õ_{k,L}(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e})，其指数随深度仅呈多项式增长。

Conclusion: 这是首个针对深层目标网络的参数恢复保证，其指数随深度仅多项式增长；也是首次论证使用高质量数据对神经网络训练有效性的理论依据，且表现出显著的指数级分离。

Abstract: The theoretical understanding of multi-layer neural networks is largely confined to overparameterized settings, which obscure parameter identifiability and incur high sample complexity. Neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides a general theory for wide networks, but does not offer efficient sample-complexity guarantees. Recent feature-learning results go beyond kernel methods for single-neuron, multi-index, and hierarchical targets. However, the analysis is often restricted to shallow or specific architectures and to the overparameterized regime. We break this paradigm to achieve parameter-level recovery of deep target networks, albeit by using active data queries. Specifically, we study $L$-layer polynomial networks with even degree-$k$ monomial activations and nonnegative higher-layer weights. This structure makes the target network input-convex, while the optimization landscape remains highly nonconvex with respect to the parameters. Leveraging input convexity and active queries, we propose \textbf{ASPIRE} (\textbf{A}ctive \textbf{S}am\textbf{P}ling for \textbf{I}terative \textbf{R}ecovery via \textbf{E}igendirections), a layerwise sampling-based diagonalization algorithm that recovers all network parameters to $δ$-accuracy with sample complexity $ \widetilde O_{k,L}\left(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e}\right) $ in polynomial time. To our knowledge, this is the \emph{first} parameter-recovery guarantee for deep target networks whose exponent grows only polynomially with depth, as well as the \emph{first} justification for the effectiveness of using high-quality data in neural network training, with a remarkably \emph{exponential} separation.

</details>


### [369] [Physics-Augmented Graph Transformers for Patch-Antenna Forward and Inverse Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05004)
*Avi Epstein,Snir Nehemia,Haim Suchowski,Lior Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出网格原生、物理增强的图学习框架，将贴片天线辐射方向图预测视为不规则表面网格上的信号重建，用物理增强中间监督（PAIS）预测复表面电流，并用方向条件解码与可微辐射积分一致性损失，实现高精度正向预测与高效逆向设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全波电磁仿真虽精确但计算昂贵，难以支撑大规模正向预测与逆向设计，需要兼顾物理准确性与计算效率的学习型替代方法。

Method: 基于不规则表面网格的图学习框架：正向任务使用 GPS 图 Transformer，配合 PAIS 辅助节点级目标预测复表面电流（连接几何与辐射的物理中间量）；采用方向条件解码和可微辐射积分一致性损失；逆向设计使用代理模型过滤的扩散模型。

Result: 在 80,000 样本 CST 基准上，GPS+PAIS 达到 MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67，可泛化到 PCA 划分，并零样本迁移到标准贴片；PAIS 在不增加推理成本下提升多种 GNN 骨干，打乱电流与非物理对照验证增益源于物理对应性；逆向设计比最近邻检索相对 MSE 降低 32%。

Conclusion: 物理中间监督与网格原生图学习结合可有效提升天线辐射预测精度与泛化性，并在逆向设计中优于检索式方法。

Abstract: Full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulation enables accurate patch-antenna analysis but is computationally expensive for large-scale forward prediction and inverse design. We present a mesh-native, physics-augmented graph-learning framework that treats radiation-pattern prediction as signal reconstruction on an irregular surface mesh. For the forward problem, a GPS graph transformer is trained with Physics-Augmented Intermediate Supervision (PAIS), an auxiliary node-level objective that predicts complex surface currents, the physical intermediate linking geometry to radiation. PAIS improves multiple GNN backbones at no inference-time cost, while shuffled-current and non-physical controls show the gain comes from physical correspondence. Direction-conditioned decoding and a differentiable radiation-integral consistency loss further exploit this structure. On an 80,000-sample CST benchmark, GPS+PAIS reaches MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67, generalizes to a PCA split, and transfers zero-shot to canonical patches. For inverse design, surrogate-filtered diffusion beats nearest-neighbor retrieval by 32% relative MSE.

</details>


### [370] [MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05014)
*Xueyi Chen,Shiyu Liu,Xin Jin,Yuhua Zheng,Xin Li,Haolei Bai,Junhan Zhu,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MetaKernelBench，衡量跨 DSL 核函数经验的复用价值：从一种 DSL 的尝试中蒸馏出的自然语言技能，能否提升另一 DSL 下同一问题的全新尝试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GPU 核函数优化智能体会把经验存入知识库或蒸馏为技能，但核函数基准只对每次尝试的实现打正确性与速度分，未度量所保留经验的复用价值，缺少对"经验能否迁移到新尝试"的评估。

Method: 构建含 74 个问题、覆盖六个算子族的基准，每个问题以 CuTe DSL 与 TIRx 两个仅 DSL 不同的变体成对呈现。智能体先单独尝试每个变体，并被要求把所学蒸馏为自然语言技能（源尝试通过与否都进行迁移），该技能是同一模型在另一 DSL 中"技能条件尝试"的唯一额外输入。在匹配的单次预算下比较技能条件尝试与单独尝试。

Result: 在六个模型、两个迁移方向上，配对提升范围为 -19% 到 +29%；四个模型在两个方向均获益，但每个模型和方向都有 16% 至 45% 的问题出现回退。结果取决于源尝试相对目标单独尝试的水平，而非仅源尝试是否成功：源水平更高时 71% 的比较改善，源水平更低时 54% 回退。

Conclusion: MetaKernelBench 通过度量同一问题上的跨 DSL 核函数知识迁移，补充了实现质量类指标，揭示经验复用既有增益也伴随显著风险。

Abstract: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.

</details>


### [371] [Operational Abstractions of Neural Network Concepts via Topological Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05017)
*Mathieu Pont,Christoph Garth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑概念表示（TCR），一种事后可操作抽象，统一刻画学习表示中的概念及其关系，通过拓扑紧凑编码概念组织，使不同概念级操作共享同一优化框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念编辑方法通常针对特定干预专门设计，缺乏统一、可编辑的概念组织表示，难以共享优化框架并分离"想要的概念组织"与"实现机制"。

Method: TCR从概念可恢复性和交互得分构建中间概念空间，用拓扑紧凑编码其组织；干预通过对该抽象的修改表达，并传播回底层学习表示；同时建立稳定性与重参数化不变性，并关联现有概念编辑公式。

Result: 用TCR解耦概念作为现有擦除方法的预处理，在相当概念泄漏下最差组准确率平均提升21.89；用TCR进行教师到学生的概念迁移，概念可恢复性最多提升5.54，同时保持或提升有竞争力的测试top-1准确率。

Conclusion: TCR提供了统一、可编辑的概念组织表示，为多种概念级操作提供共享框架，并有效提升解耦与概念迁移性能。

Abstract: Concept-based methods provide a semantic level for interpreting and manipulating learned representations, but existing editing approaches are typically specialized to particular interventions and do not provide a common and editable representation of concept organization.
