Result: 理论分析表明，较粗的量化更容易受到扰动影响，而较细的量化受影响较小；实验结果验证了所预测的行为以及所提出的平均策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究为在不同PTQ条件下执行权重平均提供了统一的理论指导，有助于使权重平均技术更可靠地应用于预训练到量化的过渡过程。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed. It can be shown that coarser quantization is more susceptible to perturbations, whereas finer quantization could be less affected. Thus, our results could provide unified theoretical guidance for performing weight averaging under different PTQ conditions. Experiments validate both the predicted behavior and the proposed averaging strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq.

</details>


### [408] [Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05332)
*Kim-Dung Tran,Dang-Man Nguyen,Vu-Linh Nguyen,Xuan-Truong Hoang,Sébastien Destercke,Van-Nam Huynh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对深度集成学习中的训练存储负担与谨慎（集合值）预测鲁棒性问题，提出采用紧凑集成（如贝叶斯神经网络、MC Dropout卷积网络）产生概率预测，并通过统计距离构造代表性分布以实现任意效用的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP），同时提出满足优良性质且可高效求解的集合效用族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度集成学习存在训练与存储负担重的问题，且面向多重效用的谨慎（集合值）预测鲁棒性不足，可能涉及奖励敏感性。

Method: 采用紧凑集成（贝叶斯神经网络、带Monte-Carlo dropout预测的卷积神经网络）生成概率预测；对每个查询实例，用这些概率预测定义优化某种统计距离的代表性分布；再基于该代表性分布定义任意效用的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP）；并提出一族满足期望性质、可高效求解集合值BOP的集合效用。

Result: 给出了经验性证据，说明所提集成学习框架的潜在优势与不足。

Conclusion: 所提框架通过紧凑集成与代表性分布，在缓解训练存储负担的同时，借助集合效用族实现高效的集合值贝叶斯最优预测，为谨慎预测的鲁棒性提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. To address the potential unrobustness of singleton prediction making, we propose a family of set-utilities satisfying some desirable properties and whose set-valued BOPs can be found efficiently. Empirical evidence is then given to illustrate the potential (dis)advantages of the proposed ensemble learning framework.

</details>


### [409] [Diffusion Transformers are Provably Optimal In-context Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05333)
*Guoji Fu,Tomoya Wakayama,Ryotaro Kawata,Atsushi Nitanda,Wee Sun Lee,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析了预训练Diffusion Transformer（DiT）如何在推理时利用少量演示进行上下文学习，证明其目标应为捕获任务不确定性的预测分布，并可通过score estimation学习该分布，最终达到Hölder任务类上的minimax最优速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式基础模型能在推理时仅凭少量演示（demonstrations）产生期望输出而无需更新参数，但少量演示无法唯一确定任务，核心挑战在于如何学习并采样一个能反映这种任务不确定性的输出分布。现有工作缺乏对DiT如何从演示中学习并生成预测分布的理论刻画。

Method: 作者对跨多样任务预训练的Diffusion Transformer进行理论分析：首先论证从有限演示生成的自然目标不是基于单一任务估计的输出，而是捕获观测演示后残余任务不确定性的预测分布；随后证明DiT可通过score estimation学习该预测分布，其中attention用于聚合演示信息，diffusion用于生成样本。

Result: 理论证明：在充足的预训练资源和扩散采样步数下，所得DiT在Hölder类测试任务上达到minimax最优速率（minimax optimal rate）。

Conclusion: 结果表明DiT是一种有统计理论支撑的上下文生成器（in-context generator），能够生成适应新任务的分布，同时保留有限演示中固有的不确定性。

Abstract: Generative foundation models are attracting interest for their ability to produce desired outputs from demonstrations given at inference time, without updating parameters. However, since a few demonstrations cannot uniquely identify the intended task, the challenge is how to learn and sample from an output distribution that reflects this task uncertainty. In this work, we theoretically analyze how a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), pretrained across diverse tasks, learns and generates predictive distributions for a new query from demonstrations. We first show that the natural target to generate from finite demonstrations is not an output derived from estimating a single task, but rather a predictive distribution that captures the task uncertainty remaining after observing the demonstrations. We then prove that a DiT can learn this predictive distribution through score estimation, using attention to aggregate information from demonstrations and diffusion to generate samples. Owing to this property, with sufficient pretraining resources and diffusion sampling steps, the resulting DiT achieves the minimax optimal rate over a Hölder class of test-time tasks. These results imply that DiT acts as a statistically grounded in-context generator capable of generating distributions adapted to new tasks while retaining the uncertainty inherent in finite demonstrations.

</details>


### [410] [Green-Routed Neural Operators:\\Physics Determines Where the Network Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05337)
*Chenhao Si,Ming Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO)，利用控制方程决定潜特征的采样位置，在多个PDE系统上取得最低误差，表明方程指定的读取坐标为长期PDE预测提供有效结构先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多PDE中传输字段的物理作用是"选择读取坐标"，而神经算子通常仅将其当作普通输入值处理，二者之间存在错配。

Method: GRNO用无参数方程适配器评估诊断关系并构造偏移图（其值即读取坐标）；多尺度编码器-解码器结合中心读取与路由读取来学习完整有限时间更新。

Result: 在5个2D/3D PDE系统上，GRNO在4个系统的40步自回归评估中取得最低平均最终相对L2误差，在Keller-Segel上保持竞争力；消融显示其优于仅将传输字段作为输入、用学习位移替代方程指定路径或用空间错位路径的变体；也显著优于直接对流物理状态再学习剩余更新的方法。

Conclusion: 方程指定的读取坐标是一种有效的结构先验，可提升长期PDE预测性能。

Abstract: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.

</details>


### [411] [On Semi-Markov Suboptimality in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05338)
*Bingyun Liu,Yuheng Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一价值函数与广义分层贝尔曼方程，分离并分析HRL中的执行次优性与策略次优性，把执行设计变为分层策略优化的显式组成部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层强化学习依赖时间延展的子任务进行探索，但一旦承诺执行子任务，可能同时限制部署与策略学习。作者试图识别并区分由此产生的执行次优性与策略次优性。

Method: 用任务树与执行树区分奖励目标、策略选择与决策中断；提出HRL统一价值函数和四阶段广义分层贝尔曼方程；在有界奖励与均匀终止条件下建立分层策略与执行改进结果；分析任务子树兼容性与节点策略最优性。

Result: 在剩余节点策略固定时，给出Markov执行最优的条件；该分解导致行为、目标与部署可独立选择执行方式；在任意层级深度实例化执行改进与一阶段/两阶段策略改进；基于选项与目标条件的实验显示改变执行与改变学习目标带来互补收益；受控随机环境表明收益依赖随机转移强度与空间结构。

Conclusion: 该框架将执行设计明确纳入分层策略优化，为HRL中执行与策略的联合改进提供统一分析工具。

Abstract: Hierarchical reinforcement learning uses temporally extended subtasks for exploration, yet committing to their execution can restrict both deployment and policy learning. We identify and separate the resulting execution and policy suboptimality. Task and execution trees distinguish reward objectives from policy choices and decision interruption. A Unified Value Function for HRL and a four-stage Generalized Hierarchical Bellman Equation then support a common analysis of both losses. Under bounded rewards and uniform termination, we establish hierarchical policy and execution improvement results. With the remaining node policies fixed, task-subtree compatibility and node-policy optimality under the original execution mode establish when Markov execution is optimal. The resulting decomposition leads to independent execution choices for behavior, targets, and deployment. We instantiate this principle through execution improvement and one-stage or two-stage policy improvement at arbitrary hierarchy depth. Option-based and goal-conditioned experiments demonstrate complementary gains from changing execution and changing the learning target. Controlled stochastic environments show how these gains depend on stochastic transition strength and spatial structure. This framework makes execution design an explicit component of hierarchical policy optimization.

</details>


### [412] [Reflections and Fragments: Securing LLMs Against Sequential Mosaic Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05346)
*Emanuele La Malfa,Saar Cohen,Gabriele La Malfa,Mickel Liu,Christian Schroeder de Witt,Natasha Jaques,Michael J. Wooldridge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"马赛克攻击"（多轮对话中片段单独无害但组合有害）的防御理论，形式化"看门人"（watchman）在线状态机制，证明在明确假设下可实现零失败防御且保持正向良性有用性，并给出状态与查询下界分析，最后用LoRA自博弈实验验证攻防双方能力提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自博弈红队测试通过攻防零和博弈提升模型安全性，但真实对手越来越多采用马赛克攻击：单轮碎片本身无害，多轮拼接后形成有害载荷。现有固定窗口式防御无法应对这类跨越长距离交互的安全相关信息，因此需要一个关于马赛克防御的理论框架，厘清"在不牺牲有用性的前提下需要什么才能阻止此类攻击"。

Method: 1. 证明不存在固定有界窗口（最近若干提示）足以防御，因为安全相关信息可能出现在任意久远的历史中。2. 形式化"看门人"（watchman）——一种将信息向前传递的在线状态机制，证明在显式假设下可实现零失败防御且保持正向良性有用性，并在更强条件下证明其在零失败防御者中最优。3. 给出状态复杂度与查询复杂度下界：精确看门人可能需要指数级状态，无结构黑盒模型下精确恶意性检测可能需要指数级查询；同时区分这些下界与"难学习"，指出状态下界构造是可从标注样本高效学习的。4. 指出自博弈均衡本身不能证明有用性，提出"在零失败防御者中最大化最坏情况良性有用性"的约束式公式。5. 实验上在冻结LLM上通过多轮自博弈训练角色专属的攻击者与防御者LoRA适配器。

Result: 理论上：确立固定窗口不足、看门人机制可行且（在更强条件下）最优，并给出指数级状态与查询下界，同时说明下界不直接意味着难以学习。实验上：多轮自博弈训练使攻防双方同时增强——攻击者更能诱导有害回复，防御者对攻击更鲁棒，且改进可泛化到未见过的攻击目标。

Conclusion: 马赛克攻击防御需要能够跨任意长历史携带安全信息的在线状态机制（看门人），而非固定窗口；在明确假设下可实现零失败且保持有用性的防御。自博弈均衡本身不足以证明有用性，需采用约束式目标最大化最坏情况良性有用性。基于LoRA的多轮自博弈能协同提升攻防双方能力并泛化到新攻击目标。

Abstract: Self-play red-teaming improves language-model safety by pitting attacker and defender roles against each other in a zero-sum game. However, real adversaries increasingly use mosaic attacks: multi-turn sequences whose individual fragments are innocuous in isolation yet assemble into a harmful payload. We develop a theory of mosaic defense that characterizes what is required to prevent such attacks without sacrificing helpfulness. We first show that no fixed bounded window of recent prompts is sufficient in general: safety-relevant information may occur arbitrarily far back in the interaction. We formalize a watchman, an online state mechanism that carries this information forward, and show that under explicit assumptions it enables zero-failure defense with positive benign helpfulness. Under stronger conditions, it is also optimal among zero-failure defenders. An exact watchman may nevertheless require exponentially many states, while exact maliciousness detection can require exponentially many queries in an unstructured black-box model. These state and query lower bounds do not by themselves imply hard learning: the construction underlying the state lower bound is efficiently learnable from labeled examples, whereas certifying worst-case safety can require substantially more information under restricted access. We also show that self-play equilibrium alone does not certify usefulness, motivating a constrained formulation that maximizes worst-case benign helpfulness among zero-failure defenders. Empirically, training role-specific attacker and defender LoRA adapters over frozen LLMs via multi-turn self-play strengthens both roles: attackers become more effective at eliciting harmful responses, while defenders become more robust to attack, with improvements also observed on unseen attack objectives.

</details>


### [413] [Task Inference Beyond Least Squares in Behavioral Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05350)
*Kuan-Hsun Tu,Chien-Sheng Chiang,Hsin-Wei Chen,Ping-Chun Hsieh,Tsung-Wei Ke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出BLS方法，用于行为基础模型（BFMs）的高效测试时任务推断，在奖励重建误差与后继测度不匹配之间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BFMs通过从奖励函数推断任务向量来避免测试时策略学习，但常用OLS推断的任务向量虽能最小化奖励重建误差，却不约束奖励的排序，导致检索出的零样本策略的后继测度偏离最优策略，策略次优。

Method: 提出BLS，一种高效的测试时推断方法，同时最小化奖励重建误差并降低后继测度不匹配。

Result: 理论上给出了由后继测度和奖励函数残差共同刻画的次优性上界；在运动、操作和人形控制等基准上基于最先进BFMs进行评估，BLS以可忽略的计算开销优于现有任务推断基线。

Conclusion: BLS在保持高效的同时改善了零样本策略的任务推断质量，验证了同时约束奖励重建与后继测度匹配的有效性。

Abstract: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) aim to solve a wide range of downstream tasks without test-time policy learning by inferring a task vector from the reward function. While efficient, the retrieved policies are often suboptimal because of how this task vector is inferred, typically with ordinary least squares (OLS). OLS minimizes reward reconstruction error but leaves the ordering of rewards unconstrained, which can bias the successor measure of the retrieved zero-shot policy away from that of the optimal policy. In this work, we propose BLS, an efficient test-time inference method that balances minimizing reward reconstruction error with reducing successor-measure mismatch. Theoretically, we provide a suboptimality gap upper bound characterized by both successor-measure and reward-function residuals. Empirically, we evaluate BLS on top of state-of-the-art BFMs across benchmarks for locomotion, manipulation, and humanoid control. BLS outperforms existing task inference baselines with negligible computational overhead. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/BLS

</details>


### [414] [Rethinking Tabular Foundation Models On Data Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05352)
*Nilesh Verma,Daniel Nowak-Assis,Afonso Lourenço,Albert Bifet,Bernhard Pfahringer,Maroua Bahri,Nick Jin Sean Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了表格基础模型（TFM）在数据流场景下的表现，涵盖内存管理、计算成本以及概念漂移和标签延迟等流式特有挑战。结果显示TFM预测性能最高，简单保留最近样本与现有内存管理方法效果相当，且漂移后恢复更快、标签延迟下精度最高，但代价是极高的服务成本，因为几乎不变的上下文在每次预测时都要重新编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型在静态表格基准上通过上下文学习超越了传统机器学习模型，因此研究者希望将其应用于数据流场景。在流式环境中，TFM通过更新上下文而非参数来适应，因此其精度与成本取决于保留哪些样本以及重建上下文的频率，这带来了新的研究问题。

Method: 对TFM在数据流上的应用进行系统性研究，考察内存管理策略、计算成本，以及概念漂移、标签延迟等流式特有挑战。

Result: TFM取得最高的预测性能；简单保留最近样本与现有内存管理技术同样有效；在概念漂移后比流式学习器恢复更快；在标签延迟下保持最高精度；但服务成本很高，因为每次预测都需对几乎不变的上下文重新编码。

Conclusion: TFM在数据流上精度优势明显，但服务成本高昂；未来方向在于提升架构效率，以支撑上下文式流学习。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform established machine learning models on tabular benchmarks through in-context learning. Building on this success, interest is growing in applying them to data streams, where data arrive continuously and evolve over time. On a stream, a TFM adapts by updating its context rather than its parameters, so its accuracy and cost depend on which examples it keeps and how often it rebuilds its context. We therefore present a systematic study of TFMs on data streams, covering memory management, computational cost, and stream-specific challenges such as concept drift and delayed labels. We find that TFMs achieve the highest predictive performance and that simply retaining the most recent examples is as effective as existing memory management techniques. They also recover faster than streaming learners after drift and keep the highest accuracy under label delay. This accuracy, however, comes at a high serving cost, since a nearly unchanged context is re-encoded at every prediction. These results point to architectural efficiency as the way forward for in-context stream learning.

</details>


### [415] [FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05353)
*Sazan Mahbub,Caleb N. Ellington,Eric P. Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FACET，一种因子化非对称条件生成框架，通过将序列语义、跨蛋白共有的粗定位模式与蛋白特异残差显式分离，实现高效、高保真的细胞内蛋白定位图像合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 荧光显微成像只能在同一细胞中同时观测有限数量的蛋白。若能从氨基酸序列与细胞形态上下文生成图像，便可在计算上推断未成像蛋白的定位。但序列与形态上下文的作用是非对称的：形态上下文与目标空间对齐，而序列是非空间的，需在上下文内指定依赖蛋白的定位方式；其中既包含跨蛋白重复出现的粗粒度模式，也包含更细的蛋白特异变化。现有生成器对二者联合条件化，未区分各自解释的部分。

Method: FACET（Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport）将上述结构编码为显式归纳偏置的概率生成框架：序列语义从上下文未解释的部分中学习；粗粒度定位规律通过语义记忆在蛋白间共享；蛋白特异变化建模为围绕共有模式的有界残差。此外，采用保方差的状态投影，使FACET能借助预训练扩散预测器进行连续随机传输，参数开销极小。

Result: 在留出蛋白上，相比骨干匹配的基线，FACET在Human Protein Atlas上空间重叠提升34.3%，在OpenCell上提升14.0%；FID分别降低27.2%和46.5%，同时网络评估次数减少75%。此外还显著改善了蛋白关联结构恢复，并给出校准更好的预测；详细消融实验表明各设计选择具有互补贡献。

Conclusion: 结果表明，因子化非对称条件（而非单纯的生成器容量）是实现高保真、高效且具生物学意义的细胞图像合成的关键杠杆。

Abstract: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell's morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET (Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.

</details>


### [416] [The Effect of Missingness-Pattern Mismatch on Method Selection for Time-Series Classification: A Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05368)
*Ruiqi Zhao,Zishun Yuan,Zhentao Wang,Jiahao Quan,Kangzheng Li,Jianfan Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 验证集与部署期缺失模式不匹配会降低分类器选择效果，平均损失1.14个百分点，且随缺失率升高而增大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列分类器通常依据验证数据选择，但部署时的缺失观测模式可能与验证时不同，这种错配是否影响基于验证的分类器选择尚不明确。

Method: 采用2×2受控设计，对64个单变量UCR数据集的验证集和测试集施加随机点缺失或循环块缺失（缺失率5%至30%共六档），用线性插值填补，在三个预设候选模型（1NN-DTW、带Ridge的MiniRocket、统计特征随机森林）中进行选择；训练数据保持完整，比较匹配与错配验证模式下的选择在同一掩蔽测试集上的表现。

Result: 验证模式错配使所选分类器的测试平衡准确率平均下降1.14个百分点（95% CI 0.79–1.51），64个数据集中49个出现损失；5%缺失率时损失可忽略，30%时升至2.46个百分点；损失集中于点缺失部署场景（1.84个百分点），块缺失验证使选择偏离通常最优候选，而块缺失部署场景影响较小且不显著；错配在35.5%的配对比较中改变了所选分类器，但改变选择并不总导致性能下降；非环绕线性块补充分析结果一致且效应更大（1.67个百分点）。

Conclusion: 将验证数据的缺失模式与预期部署模式匹配，是方法选择的简单保障措施，在较高缺失率下尤为重要。

Abstract: Classifiers for time-series classification are commonly selected on validation data, but the temporal pattern of missing observations at deployment may differ from the pattern seen during validation. We examine whether such a mismatch affects validation-based classifier selection. In a controlled $2 \times 2$ design, validation and test sets of 64 univariate UCR datasets were masked with either random point missingness or circular block missingness at six rates from 5% to 30%, imputed by linear interpolation, and used to select among three prespecified candidates: 1NN-DTW, MiniRocket with a Ridge classifier, and a statistical-feature Random Forest. Training data remained complete, and selections made under matched and mismatched validation patterns were compared on the same masked test sets. Mismatched validation reduced the test balanced accuracy of the selected classifier by 1.14 percentage points on average (95% CI 0.79 to 1.51), with losses on 49 of the 64 datasets. The loss was negligible at 5% missingness and increased to 2.46 percentage points at 30%. It was concentrated in point-masked deployment (1.84 percentage points), where block-masked validation shifted selection away from the usually best candidate, while the effect for block-masked deployment was small and not significant. Mismatch changed the selected classifier in 35.5% of paired comparisons, but a changed selection did not always reduce performance. A supplementary analysis with non-wrapping linear blocks reproduced these findings with a larger effect (1.67 percentage points). Matching the missingness pattern of validation data to the expected deployment pattern is therefore a simple safeguard for method selection, particularly at higher missingness rates.

</details>


### [417] [Robust Ensemble Guidance for Scientific Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05371)
*Zixiang Li,Wei Wang,Yunchao Wei,Yao Zhao,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出鲁棒集成引导（REG），通过加权与截断两项简单修改改进集成引导的修正项，在科学逆问题中提升重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成引导将预训练扩散先验与黑盒前向模型结合，无需对物理模拟器求导即可求解逆问题。但观测坐标中预测方差大或残差极端的部分会主导集成修正，导致重建精度下降。作者旨在解决观测异质性与残差影响带来的不稳定性。

Method: REG 利用集成预测方差平衡观测尺度（加权），并对标准化残差进行自适应截断以限制极端差异的影响。两种操作复用现有粒子与前向预测，不增加去噪器或前向模型评估。作者在局部线性高斯模型下推导了一步估计风险降低的条件，界定了单个观测坐标的影响，并刻画了有限集成下收益持续的条件。

Result: 在 Navier-Stokes 反演、黑洞成像与声学全波形反演实验中，REG 相比底层集成求解器均取得更好重建。黑洞重建 PSNR 在三种观测情形下提升 6.2–8.2 dB；在匹配预算比较中，Navier-Stokes 重建误差降低 26.4%。

Conclusion: 观测异质性与残差影响是设计可靠生成式科学逆问题求解器的关键因素，加权与截断是简单而有效的改进手段。

Abstract: Ensemble guidance combines pretrained diffusion priors with black-box forward models to solve inverse problems without differentiating through the physical simulator. However, observation coordinates with large predictive spread or extreme residuals can dominate the ensemble correction, degrading reconstruction accuracy. We show that two simple modifications, weighting and clipping, substantially improve this correction. Our method, Robust Ensemble Guidance (REG), uses ensemble predictive spread to balance observation scales and adaptively clips standardized residuals to limit the influence of extreme discrepancies. Both operations reuse existing particles and forward predictions, requiring no additional denoiser or forward-model evaluations. Under a local linear Gaussian model, we derive conditions for reduced one-step estimation risk, bound the influence of individual observation coordinates, and characterize when these benefits persist with finite ensembles. Experiments on Navier-Stokes inversion, black-hole imaging, and acoustic full-waveform inversion demonstrate improved reconstruction over the underlying ensemble solver. In particular, REG increases black-hole reconstruction PSNR by 6.2-8.2 dB across three observation regimes and reduces Navier-Stokes reconstruction error by 26.4\% in a matched-budget comparison. These findings highlight the importance of observation heterogeneity and residual influence in designing reliable generative solvers for scientific inverse problems.

</details>


### [418] [Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05378)
*Dario Fenoglio,Gabriele Dominici,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出分布式潜隐学习（DSL），通过传递任务无关输入上的模型行为输出而非权重来共享知识，在LLM组合与联邦学习中大幅降低通信量并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统协作学习（联邦学习、独立适配的基础模型组合）通过交换模型参数或适配器来传递知识，通信量随模型规模增长，且本地特化需要在权重空间中对齐，易产生干扰。作者希望探索能否改由"任务无关输入上的模型行为"来共享知识，从而避免传输权重。

Method: 提出分布式潜隐学习（DSL）这一协作学习原语：各参与方在本地适配同一模型，用任务无关输入探测模型，仅传输由此产生的"载体输出"（carrier outputs）；协调方汇总这些输出并将其蒸馏进共享模型中。该原语支持两种形态：通过载体补全（carrier completions）实现一次性基础模型组合，通过载体 logits 实现迭代式联邦学习，均无需传输模型更新，也不需要任务相关的代理数据。

Result: 在LLM组合任务中，相比LoRA平均法，DSL的偏好保持率更高（94.56% vs. 87.76%），在GSM8K上相对基座模型增益更大（22.0 vs. 0.6 分），同时上传量减少30.6–49.0倍。在联邦分类任务中，DSL在MNIST上达到96.83%，上行通信比FedAvg少8.9倍，并在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上提供更低通信量下的工作点。

Conclusion: 随机载体输出可作为跨不同协作学习范式的实用通信原语，用于知识共享，在显著降低通信开销的同时保持甚至提升模型性能。

Abstract: Collaborative learning typically exchanges model parameters: federated clients communicate updates, while independently adapted foundation models are combined by exchanging adapters or checkpoints. This makes communication scale with model size and requires local specializations to be reconciled in weight space, where interference is common. We ask whether knowledge can instead be shared through model behavior on task-unrelated inputs. We introduce Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL), a collaborative learning primitive in which participants adapt a common model locally, probe it with task-unrelated inputs, and transmit only the resulting carrier outputs. A coordinator pools these outputs and distills them into a shared model. The primitive supports one-shot foundation-model composition through carrier completions and iterative federated learning through carrier logits, without transmitting model updates or requiring task-related proxy data. In LLM composition, compared with LoRA averaging, DSL achieves higher preference retention (94.56% vs. 87.76%) and a larger GSM8K gain over the base model (22.0 vs. 0.6 points), while reducing upload by 30.6-49.0$\times$. In federated classification, DSL reaches 96.83% on MNIST with 8.9$\times$ less uplink than FedAvg and provides lower-communication operating points on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet. These results establish random-carrier outputs as a practical communication primitive for knowledge sharing across distinct collaborative learning paradigms.

</details>


### [419] [Does Explainability Survive Data Drift?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05379)
*Samuel Ozechi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究数据漂移下解释保真度的衰减问题：在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上发现显著协变量漂移但无显著概念漂移，结果显示旧解释虽保留决策相关性，但保真度始终低于新生成的解释，且差距并未系统性扩大，说明解释需要独立监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型性能监控已是常规实践，概念漂移导致的模型衰减被持续追踪；但在金融、医疗等受监管领域，解释保真度却很少被同等监控。作者质疑：当特征-目标关系保持稳定时，仅数据漂移是否也会导致解释衰减？漂移前生成的解释是否仍对替代模型忠实？

Method: 使用IEEE-CIS交易欺诈检测数据集，通过条件漂移检验分离协变量漂移与概念漂移；采用ExIFFI生成局部解释，并从路径有效性、结构行为和受控干预下的保真度三个层面评估解释。

Result: 检测到统计显著的协变量漂移，但无统计显著的概念漂移证据，构成可单独研究输入分布变化的实证场景。旧解释对重训练模型仍保留较高决策相关性，但保真度始终低于新生成解释，且在评估窗口内没有系统性扩大的差距。

Conclusion: 解释保真度需要独立监控；解释的结构稳定性并不保证功能保真度；解释应被视为依附于生成它的模型的产物。

Abstract: Model performance monitoring is a standard practice in machine learning deployments. Detection performance is tracked continuously, and model decay is expected as the relationship between the feature and target variables degrades, a phenomenon known as concept drift. Explanation fidelity, however, is rarely monitored with the same discipline, even in domains such as financial systems, healthcare, and other regulated environments where explanations are required for governance purposes. This paper investigates whether explanations can decay under data drift, even when the feature-target relationship remains stable, and whether explanations produced before drift occurs remain faithful to the decisions of the model that replaces them. Using the IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection dataset, we find statistically significant covariate shift but no statistically significant evidence of concept drift under the implemented conditional-drift tests, thereby providing an empirical setting in which input distributional change can be studied separately from detectable changes in the feature-target relationship. Local explanations are generated with ExIFFI and evaluated at three levels: path validity, structural behaviour, and fidelity under controlled intervention. Results show that while prior explanations retain substantial decision relevance to a retrained model, they are consistently less faithful than newly generated explanations, with no evidence of a systematically widening gap across the evaluated windows. The study shows that explanation fidelity requires its own monitoring, that structural stability of explanations does not guarantee functional fidelity, and that explanations should be treated as artifacts tied to the model that produced them.

</details>


### [420] [GNN-CB: A Graph Neural Network Competition Benchmark for Human and LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05387)
*Murad Hossen,Tasneem Selim,Gurur Gamgam,Tuga Yousif,Abderrahmane Kasmi,Ikram Aissiou,Mubaraq Onipede,Faran Taimoor Butt,Sanae Zrigui,Rosa Y. G. Paccotacya-Yanque,Ignatius Balayo,Ikram Elhouiti,Hadil Affes,Bijay Adhikari,Sargam Goyal,Muhammad Ibrahim Isah,Mohammad Idrees Bhat,Samuel Kangoni Matia,Peguy Kem-Meka Tiotsop Kadzue,Maha Trabelsi,Emmanuel Owusu,Vinit,Nour Majdoub,Tamiru Alemnew,Islem Rekik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GNN-CB，首个用于评估人类与LLM在图神经网络编码任务上表现的竞赛式基准，包含18个覆盖节点/边/图级预测的竞赛，采用隐藏测试集与统一自动化评估流程。结果显示LLM在大多数任务上难以匹敌人类顶尖水平，且表现不稳定，无单一模型全面领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在编码和推理基准上表现强劲，但其解决图结构机器学习问题的能力尚未被充分探索。目前缺乏能评估LLM在真实竞赛环境下自主完成端到端GNN编码任务的基准，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: GNN-CB 包含18个精心设计的竞赛，涵盖节点、边、图级预测，跨多样图类别、领域和难度层次。所有提交通过统一的自动化流程评估，使用隐藏测试集和标准化评分。人类参与者在受控竞赛约束下解题；LLM采用冻结的零样本提示协议（plan-then-code范式，带有限制的执行-修复循环）。该基准还支持非智能体与自主智能体两种评估方式。

Result: 在评估协议下，LLM很少能匹配人类顶尖表现，且在竞赛间表现稳定性较差。没有单一模型占优：少数竞赛由LLM获胜，但多数任务的最高分仍由人类保持。

Conclusion: GNN-CB 作为持续更新的活基准发布，提供自动化评估基础设施、动态排行榜和可复现执行流程，为研究渐进式多样化图学习任务下的GNN实现提供面向实践的资源。基准与评估框架已公开。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks; however, their ability to solve graph-structured machine learning problems remains largely unexplored. In particular, no benchmark currently evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously solve end-to-end Graph Neural Network (GNN) coding tasks under realistic competition settings. To address this gap, this paper introduces GNN-CB, the first competition-based benchmark for evaluating both humans and LLMs on GNN coding tasks. GNN-CB consists of 18 curated competitions spanning node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction across diverse graph categories, domains, and difficulty tiers. All submissions are evaluated through a unified automated pipeline with hidden test sets and standardized scoring. Human participants solve tasks under controlled competition constraints, while LLMs are evaluated using a frozen zero-shot prompting protocol based on a plan-then-code paradigm with bounded execute-and-repair loops. The benchmark additionally supports both non-agent and autonomous agent-based evaluation within the same protocol. Under our evaluated protocol, LLMs rarely match Human Top performance and show less stable performance across competitions. No single model dominates: a few competitions are won by LLMs, yet humans still hold the top score on most tasks. We release GNN-CB as a living benchmark with automated evaluation infrastructure, dynamic leaderboards, and reproducible execution pipelines. Beyond benchmarking, GNN-CB provides a practice-oriented resource for studying GNN implementation across progressively diverse graph-learning tasks. The benchmark and evaluation framework are publicly available at https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/.

</details>


### [421] [Efficient Graph Generation via Direct Prediction and Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05397)
*Susie Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM)，一种直接预测干净图并采用连续流匹配范式的图 Transformer，用于高效高质量图生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图生成模型的目标是学习干净图的拓扑性质（如连通性与度分布），但标准扩散模型的噪声预测方式并不显式学习这些拓扑性质，因此难以生成具有期望结构统计的图。此外扩散模型采样步骤多、效率低。

Method: DiGFM 采用连续流匹配范式并集成直接图预测：将先验噪声分布通过多步过程映射到干净图分布，模型反复预测潜在干净图，并通过变换将模型输出转换为指向干净图分布方向的速度向量。

Result: DiGFM 仅需扩散模型 2.5% 至 15.6% 的步数即可生成高质量样本，推理时间加速 5.3x 至 257x；在通用图基准与分子数据集上超越或匹配先前最先进模型，生成图的结构统计与真实值高度吻合。

Conclusion: DiGFM 通过直接图预测与流匹配结合，在保持或提升生成质量的同时大幅提升采样效率，为图生成提供了一种高效的新方案。

Abstract: Generative modeling of graph-structured data is crucial for tasks ranging from drug discovery to social network simulation. Among these models, denoising diffusion models have achieved great success in graph generation by learning to progressively reverse a process that adds noise to the original graph. However, the standard noise-prediction approach of diffusion models is suboptimal for graph data. The goal for a graph generative model is to learn the clean graphs' topological properties, such as connectivity and degree distribution. Because a diffusion model that predicts noise does not explicitly learn these topological properties, it is challenging for the model to output graphs with the desired structural statistics. To address this challenge, we introduce Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM), a novel graph transformer model guided by two goals: predict clean graphs and improve sampling efficiency. Distinct from the prevailing diffusion approach, DiGFM employs a continuous flow-matching paradigm and integrates direct graph prediction. Specifically, DiGFM maps the prior noise distribution to the clean graph distribution via a multi-step process: the model repeatedly predicts the underlying clean graph, and a transformation is employed to convert the model output to the velocity vector that points in the direction toward the clean graph distribution. This design enables DiGFM to generate high-quality samples using only 2.5% to 15.6% of the steps required by diffusion-based models, which leads to a 5.3x to 257x speedup in wall-clock inference time. Experiments demonstrate that DiGFM outperforms or matches prior state-of-the-art models across general graph benchmarks and molecular datasets, generating graphs with strong adherence to ground-truth structural statistics at significantly faster inference speeds.

</details>


### [422] [No Concept Escapes the Audit: Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05401)
*Kaiyuan Deng,Yuchen Li,Gen Li,Yang Xiao,Geng Yuan,Xiaoyong Yuan,Bo Hui,Xiaolong Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AVCE 框架，从扩散模型潜在表征层面进行概念擦除，通过审计感知的闭式编辑与微调，在多个模型和任务上显著降低攻击成功率并提升审计分数，同时保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型可生成被禁止内容，因此需要机器遗忘来擦除概念。大多数擦除方法在文本接口干预（提示修改或文本条件权重的局部更新），并以给定提示下的输出作为评估标准，但这种方式看不到网络仍然编码的内容。潜在空间审计绕过文本条件直接探测去噪网络，显示被擦除的概念仍可从内部表征中恢复；这对声称能抵抗对抗提示的方法同样成立，且问题随擦除概念数量增加而加剧。

Method: 提出 AVCE（Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure）框架，将擦除建立在模型潜在表征之上。AVCE 审计每个概念的嵌入邻域，将发现的脆弱方向压缩为最弱几何点处的锚点；在该锚点上以闭式解编辑交叉注意力和自注意力投影，随后用路径级审计损失对两条路径微调，并利用正交梯度投影来整合多个概念。

Result: 在 SD v1.5、SDXL 和 Flux 1.0 上，针对物体、显式内容和艺术风格三类遗忘任务，AVCE 相比最强基线将攻击成功率降低 5.07 倍，审计分数提升 3.84 倍，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。

Conclusion: AVCE 通过将概念擦除扎根于潜在表征，并结合审计感知的闭式编辑与微调，实现了可验证的概念擦除，在多种模型与任务上优于现有方法，兼顾擦除效果与生成质量。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate prohibited content, which motivates concept erasure through machine unlearning. Most erasure methods intervene at the text interface, through prompt modification or localized updates to text-conditioning weights, and they are evaluated by what the model outputs for given prompts. Such evaluation cannot see what the network still encodes. Latent-space auditing, which bypasses text conditioning and probes the denoising network directly, shows that erased concepts remain recoverable from internal representations. We find that this also holds for methods built to be robust against adversarial prompts, and that the problem grows with the number of erased concepts. We propose Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models (AVCE), a framework that grounds erasure in the model's latent representations. AVCE audits the embedding neighborhood of each concept and condenses the discovered vulnerable directions into an anchor at the weakest geometric point. It edits cross-attention and self-attention projections in closed form at this anchor, then fine-tunes the two pathways with pathway-level auditing losses, using orthogonal gradient projection to consolidate multiple concepts. Experiments on SD v1.5, SDXL, and Flux 1.0 across object, explicit-content, and artistic-style unlearning show that AVCE reduces attack success rates by 5.07x and improves auditing scores by 3.84x over the strongest baseline, while preserving competitive generation quality.

</details>


### [423] [Task Vector Descent: Learning from Non-IID Batches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05402)
*Anton Baumann,Jonas Hübotter,Zeynep Akata,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究连续学习中任务向量应完全保留还是部分应用的问题，提出对任务向量和优化器状态按系数λ缩放的部分整合方法，发现中等λ值常优于完全整合（λ=1），尤其在长时间同分布序列后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续学习的核心挑战是在获取新知识的同时不遗忘旧知识。当训练数据来自不同领域、用户或任务分布且非均匀出现时，连续的小批次会按分布聚集而非独立同分布采样，导致稳定性-可塑性权衡。作者发现这种权衡会随同一分布暴露时间延长而加剧，因此提出任务向量（参数位移）应完全保留还是部分应用的问题。

Method: 作者比较两种方案：完全整合（λ=1）与部分整合，后者在将任务向量应用到继续训练的模型前按λ缩放，并对优化器状态施加相同系数的缩放。研究覆盖连续预训练、随机初始化预训练、监督后训练和强化后训练等多种场景。

Result: 在多种训练场景中，中间值的λ往往比完全整合（λ=1）更能提升继续训练模型的平均性能，特别是在较长的同分布序列之后。在连续预训练的受控数据流和自然定义的适应序列实验中，任务向量缩放优于完全整合，且其优势不能仅通过缩放学习率来复现。

Conclusion: 部分整合任务向量（通过对任务向量和优化器状态按λ缩放）是缓解连续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡的有效手段，中等λ值在长时间同分布序列后尤为有益，其效果独立于学习率缩放。

Abstract: A central challenge in continual learning is to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what the model has already learned. This challenge appears in language model training when training data comes from various domain-, user-, or task-specific distributions that are encountered unevenly over time. In such settings, successive minibatches are temporally clustered by distribution instead of being sampled i.i.d. from the overall data mixture. Training on temporally clustered data induces a stability-plasticity tradeoff. Adapting the model to the active distribution can improve the model on the active distribution but may lead to a performance degradation on data it previously trained on. We find that this tradeoff intensifies with longer exposure to the same distribution. We therefore ask if the parameter displacement produced by such a sequence (the task vector) should be fully retained or applied partially. We compare applying the full displacement ($λ=1$) with partial integration, which scales the task vector by $λ$ before applying it to the continuing model and scales the optimizer state by the same coefficient. Across continual pretraining, pretraining from random initialization, supervised post-training, and reinforcement post-training, we find that intermediate values of $λ$ often improve average continuing-model performance relative to full integration, particularly after longer same-distribution sequences. In continual-pretraining experiments with both controlled streams and naturally defined adaptation sequences, task-vector scaling outperforms full integration at the matched learning rate, showing that its benefits are not reproduced by learning-rate scaling alone.

</details>


### [424] [BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05409)
*Yue Li,Kangqi Ni,Zhen Tan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BeliefGraph-JEPA，将未来驱动因素的影响分解为类型化潜在效应状态，通过图结构路由至各目标，构建联合嵌入预测架构，在四个多目标系统中优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件下的时间序列预测需考虑未来动作与外生强迫如何通过部分可观测、延迟与持续性各异的效应影响多目标。直接条件化使这些效应的演化与目标特异性影响隐含于预测器中，静态关系图又无法追踪动态效应。

Method: 将驱动影响分解为类型化潜在效应状态，在未来驱动下向前滚动，并经图路由至各目标的专门节点，构成联合嵌入预测架构的预测基础；另用容量受控的残差补充直接驱动信息。

Result: 在临床、农业、环境与工业四个多目标系统上优于多种预训练及有监督的已知未来协变量基线。匹配对照实验分离了潜在动态、未来滚动、图路由与残差容量，未来滚动与图优先残差路由在四个系统中均提升预测性能。

Conclusion: 结构化的潜在效应状态与图路由机制能有效刻画未来驱动对多目标的影响，验证了各组件（尤其是未来滚动与图优先残差路由）的贡献。

Abstract: Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

</details>


### [425] [Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping for Off-Policy Subgoal Value Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05446)
*Bingyun Liu,Yuheng Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出层次时间感知自举(HTB),解决HIRO子目标重标记后价值更新目标错位问题,在AntFall上成功率32.8%远超HIRO的9.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离策略层次强化学习需要在低层策略变化时估计高层决策的价值。HIRO通过子目标重标记适配回放数据,但标签改变后,价值更新指向的是重标记后的子目标,而非高层策略原本需要更新的子目标,导致更新目标不一致。

Method: HTB在当前低层策略下评估指定的子目标,同时保留累积任务奖励;用剩余执行时间区分"子目标延续"与"新高层决策";结合原始动作条件,实现基于平稳环境转移律的离策略Bellman更新,并融合单步更新、多步后缀回报与截断重标记以减少对中间价值估计的依赖;共享价值组件配合非负残差约束向上修正。

Result: 在固定混合权重0.95、5个配对种子、10M环境步下,HTB在AntFall上成功率达32.8%,而匹配的HIRO仅9.6%。消融实验确认递归延续与混合监督的贡献;固定策略测试显示,对被排除拟合的动作,HTB预测更准确。

Conclusion: 通过时间感知自举、递归延续与截断重标记的组合,HTB修正了HIRO的子目标价值更新错位问题,显著提升离策略层次强化学习的性能与价值预测准确性。

Abstract: Off-policy hierarchical reinforcement learning must estimate the values of high-level decisions while the low-level policy changes. HIRO adapts replay data through subgoal relabeling, but after a label change, the value update targets the relabeled subgoal instead of the subgoal the high-level policy originally needed to update. We propose Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping (HTB), which evaluates specified subgoals under the current low-level policy while retaining accumulated task rewards. Remaining execution time distinguishes subgoal continuation from a new high-level decision. Together with primitive-action conditioning, it enables off-policy Bellman updates based on the stationary environment transition law. HTB combines these one-step updates with multi-step suffix returns and truncated relabeling, reducing dependence on intermediate value estimates. A shared value component supports learning across actions, while nonnegative residuals constrain upward corrections relative to that component. At a fixed mixture weight of 0.95, HTB achieves 32.8% AntFall success versus 9.6% for matched local HIRO over five paired seeds at 10M environment steps. Ablations identify contributions from recursive continuation and mixed supervision; fixed-policy tests show more accurate predictions for actions whose returns were excluded from fitting.

</details>


### [426] [Groupwise Distortion Guarantees for Preference-Based Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05450)
*Jacob Brodkey,Roberto Tamez,Aaron Roth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出GLHF算法，从每位用户一次比较中学习单一分组条件策略，在每组上渐近达到GHY最优种群扭曲界，实验表明其降低各组扭曲并显著减少最差组扭曲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF与NLHF等方法通过成对偏好聚合学习LLM策略，但目标往往是最大化社会福利（平均基数效用），而仅靠比较未必能识别该目标。GHY用扭曲度量差距，并证明当所有用户获得相同彩票时NLHF最优；然而基于账户的LLM可获取用户信息，能够为不同人群提供不同彩票，因此需要研究分组条件下能否同时达到最优。

Method: 提出高效算法GLHF，在每位用户仅提供一次比较的条件下学习单一分组条件策略。假设个体Bradley-Terry比较，在预先指定且可能重叠的组集合上，同时实现GHY最优种群扭曲界；样本复杂度随组数对数增长，与最小组质量成反比。对于偏好相似的组，若成员共享可实现的最爱响应，则给出逼近扭曲为1的更紧保证。

Result: 理论上GLHF渐近匹配GHY最优种群扭曲界并在每个组上同时成立，样本复杂度为组数的对数、最小组质量的倒数；相似偏好组可逼近扭曲1。实验使用人类咖啡评分和合成LLM生成评分，GLHF在评估的每个组中降低扭曲，且相对NLHF及其他组无关基线显著降低最差组扭曲。

Conclusion: GLHF表明利用用户组信息可从单次比较中有效学习分组条件策略，在保持样本效率的同时改善社会福利对齐，尤其在保护表现最差的群体方面优于组无关方法。

Abstract: Preference-based alignment methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) aggregate pairwise preferences to learn an LLM policy, but a natural goal is maximizing social welfare (average cardinal utility), which comparisons alone need not identify. Gölz, Haghtalab, and Yang (GHY) measure the gap by distortion: the worst-case ratio between the welfare of the best fixed lottery (distribution over responses) and of the learned lottery. They show NLHF is optimal when every user receives the same lottery. Account-based LLMs, however, have information about their users and can serve different lotteries to different people. We give an efficient algorithm, GLHF, that learns a single group-conditioned policy from one comparison per user. Under individual Bradley--Terry comparisons, GLHF asymptotically matches GHY's optimal population distortion bound simultaneously on every group in a prespecified, possibly overlapping collection, with sample complexity growing logarithmically in the number of groups and inversely with the smallest group mass. A sharper guarantee for groups with similar preferences approaches distortion of one when members share a feasible favorite response. In experiments using human coffee ratings and synthetic LLM-generated ratings, GLHF lowers distortion in every evaluated group and substantially reduces worst-group distortion relative to NLHF and other group-agnostic baselines.

</details>


### [427] [VERA: Verdict-Conditioned Reliability for Adaptive LLM Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05452)
*Qiushui Xu,Syamil Mohd Razak,Tao Yuan,Piotr Habas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VERA（判决条件化可靠性轴），从隐藏激活中估计裁判可靠性，并据此设计周期性适应框架，在Chatbot Arena适应后8B/14B裁判在四个公开基准上均超过最强基线，最高相对提升23.01%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将LLM裁判适应新验证反馈时，需在保持已学行为的同时准确估计判断可靠性；现有方法依赖输出层面的置信度，往往过度自信且与判断正确性对齐不佳。

Method: 提出VERA，一种判决条件化的可靠性轴，通过在每个预测判决组内区分正确与错误判断，从隐藏激活中估计可靠性；以VERA为控制信号构建周期性适应框架，包含按可靠性排序的纠正更新、可靠性残差回放以及可靠性方向的周期性刷新。

Result: 在Chatbot Arena上进行VERA引导的适应后，8B与14B参数裁判在四个留出公开基准上均优于最强基线，相对提升最高达23.01%；在另一项专有时间审计任务上，焦点类召回率相对最强自适应基线最高提升16.1%。

Conclusion: 基于隐藏激活的判决条件化可靠性估计（VERA）可作为有效的适应控制信号，在保持既有行为的同时显著提升LLM裁判的可靠性泛化能力。

Abstract: Accurately estimating judgment reliability is a central challenge in adapting LLM judges to newly verified feedback while preserving previously learned behavior. However, existing approaches often rely on output-level confidence, which can be overconfident and poorly aligned with judgment correctness. We propose VERA, a VErdict-conditioned Reliability Axis that estimates reliability from hidden activations by distinguishing correct from incorrect judgments within each predicted-verdict group. Using VERA as a control signal, we develop a VERA-guided periodic adaptation framework that integrates reliability-ranked corrective updates, reliability-residual replay, and periodic refresh of the reliability directions. After VERA-guided adaptation on Chatbot Arena, 8B- and 14B-parameter judges outperform the strongest baseline on each of four held-out public benchmarks, with relative gains of up to 23.01%. The framework also improves focal-class recall by up to 16.1% relative to the strongest adaptive baselines on a separate proprietary temporal auditing task.

</details>


### [428] [Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05458)
*Erland Hilman Fuadi,Chong Tian,Xiaosong Ma,Qirong Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 不同GPU厂商运行同一语言模型会产生不同的logits，本文系统分析了跨厂商不匹配现象，追溯其来源并评估多种缓解手段的效果与代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一模型权重与输入在不同GPU厂商上运行时会出现logits差异，这种跨厂商不匹配可能影响模型的一致性与可复现性，尤其在训练与蒸馏场景下后果未知，因此需要系统刻画其来源、程度与缓解代价。

Method: 在两个稠密模型与两个MoE模型上，从五个指标族（逐位相等、logit差异、top-K一致性、token一致性、任务准确率）分析跨厂商不匹配；追溯来源至厂商矩阵指令内部累加顺序；评估FP32/Fp16升精度、仅MLP保持BF16、输出头LoRA等缓解手段，并检验其对训练蒸馏的影响。

Result: 升精度到FP32使稠密模型logit误差降低43%但运行时为3倍；仅将MLP保持BF16可保留94%收益而运行时间仅1.3倍。MoE模型中FP32与FP16降低概率误差却增大logit误差并改变专家选择，FP16在稠密模型中失效；输出头LoRA无效，因最终隐状态无法预测不匹配。固定所有随机种子，基于AMD教师蒸馏的学生与基于NVIDIA教师蒸馏的学生在431道MMLU问题上答案不同。FP32升精度下逐位相等几乎不变，而输出分布大幅趋近参考，说明单一指标会误判代价与收益。

Conclusion: 跨厂商不匹配源于矩阵指令累加顺序，会传导至训练与蒸馏结果；不同缓解手段在误差与代价上权衡各异，且不能以单一指标评判跨厂商一致性。仅MLP保持BF16是较优折中，代码已开源。

Abstract: Running the same language model on different graphics processing unit (GPU) vendors can produce different logits, even when the model weights and inputs are the same. We analyze cross-vendor mismatch in two dense and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with five metric families, namely bitwise equality, logit differences, top-K consistency, token agreement, and task accuracy. We trace one source of the mismatch to accumulation order inside vendors' matrix instructions. Upcasting to FP32 reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, yet keeping only the MLPs in BF16 retains 94% of this gain at 1.3 times the runtime, so most of the cost of full upcasting buys little. In the MoE models, FP32 and FP16 both lower the probability error but raise the logit error and change expert selection, and FP16 fails in the dense model. An output-head low-rank adapter (LoRA) does not help either, since the final hidden state does not predict the mismatch. The mismatch also carries into training. With every seed fixed, a student distilled from a teacher running on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled from the same teacher on NVIDIA. Under FP32 upcasting, bitwise equality barely changes while the output distributions move most of the way to the reference, so judging cross-vendor agreement by a single measure misreads both its cost and its gains. Code is available at https://github.com/crova-project/crova.

</details>


### [429] [Population Scaling or Data Dilution? Dynamics of Local Topology Evolution in Decentralized Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05476)
*Yin-Kuan Liang,Yan Gao,Yang Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究去中心化学习中客户端数量N增加时的耦合效应，发现扩展性不仅取决于N，还受数据分配、拓扑混合与通信能力共同影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化学习扩展时，N的增加同时改变了信息传播与共识动态，仅从客户端数量理解扩展效应是不充分的，因为数据分配、拓扑依赖的混合与通信容量可能同时变化。

Method: 在CIFAR-10上以N∈{10,50,100,200}进行实验，比较度数为2的Ring、Static Random图以及基于朋友的朋友发现的自适应拓扑过程LFHE，并分析Ring的Metropolis谱隙随N的衰减。

Result: Ring的Metropolis谱隙按Θ(N^{-2})衰减，导致模型分歧收缩随规模增长而变慢；固定名义本地数据量可显著降低固定总数据量分摊时的表观规模惩罚；剩余性能下降强烈依赖通信结构，Ring进入高分歧状态，而Static Random与LFHE接近共识；提高LFHE的度阈值可进一步提升精度与共识，但模型传输成本大幅增加。

Conclusion: 去中心化扩展由学习与通信动态的耦合决定，而非仅由客户端数量决定。

Abstract: Scaling decentralized learning changes not only the number of clients $N$, but also the dynamics of information propagation and consensus. We argue that the effect of increasing $N$ cannot be understood in isolation, because data allocation, topology-dependent mixing, and communication capacity may change simultaneously. We study these coupled effects on CIFAR-10 with $N\in\{10,50,100,200\}$, comparing a degree-two Ring, a Static Random graph, and Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a locally adaptive topology process based on friend-of-friend discovery. The Ring provides an analytically transparent failure mode: its Metropolis spectral gap decays as $Θ(N^{-2})$, implying progressively slower contraction of model disagreement as the population grows. Experiments show that holding the nominal local dataset size fixed substantially reduces the apparent population penalty observed when a fixed total dataset is divided among more clients. The remaining degradation depends strongly on communication structure: Ring enters a high-disagreement regime, whereas Static Random and LFHE remain close to consensus. Increasing LFHE's degree threshold further improves accuracy and consensus, but at a substantially higher model-transmission cost. These results show that decentralized scaling is governed by coupled learning and communication dynamics, rather than by the number of clients alone.

</details>


### [430] [Universal Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05484)
*Zefan Cai,Qinzhe Hu,Ziqiao Ma,Hao Tan,Junjie Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出uTTT，让所有层共享一个跨时间与深度递归的记忆，替代传统每层私有快重权重，在语言建模与新颖视角合成上取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTT架构将上下文压缩进快权重作为记忆，但记忆在每层私有、仅沿时间递归，深度仅索引L个独立记忆，作者认为记忆归属不必绑定深度。

Method: 引入Universal Test-Time Training（uTTT），所有层读写同一共享记忆但保留层特定主干参数，记忆以chunk和layer为单位沿时间与深度两维递归。实例化为uTTT-MoE（每token头路由到全层共享专家池中的少数专家）与uTTT-Dense（每层直接应用整个共享记忆）。

Result: 语言建模中，uTTT-MoE在124M和760M达到15.5与27.9 RULER准确率，分别比层私有对应模型高2.6和2.1分，为所测有界状态模型最高，且每token损失匹配或优于全注意力。新颖视角合成中，固定每层计算下，路由模型view-23物体PSNR提升0.92 dB，密集模型提升0.76 dB。

Conclusion: 共享跨时间与深度的记忆是可行的TTT设计，可在等状态与等活跃计算下超越层私有方案，并在多任务上带来一致增益。

Abstract: Recent Test-Time Training (TTT) architectures compress context into fast weights that are updated online and queried as memory. Existing TTT designs keep this memory private to each layer: it recurs only over time, and depth merely indexes L separate memories. We argue that memory ownership need not be tied to depth, and introduce Universal Test-Time Training (uTTT), in which all layers read and write one shared memory while retaining layer-specific backbone parameters. The shared memory thus recurs over two dimensions, time and depth, with chunks and layers as their units: a write by a deep layer in one chunk can be read by a shallow layer in the next. We instantiate this idea as uTTT-MoE and uTTT-Dense. uTTT-MoE routes each token head to a few experts in a pool shared by all layers; uTTT-Dense applies the whole shared memory at every layer without routing. In language modeling, uTTT-MoE reaches 15.5 and 27.9 RULER accuracy at 124M and 760M, 2.6 and 2.1 points above its layer-private counterpart at equal state and active compute, the highest among tested bounded-state models, with per-token loss matching or beating full attention. In novel view synthesis, sharing at fixed per-layer compute gains 0.92 dB in view-23 object PSNR in routed models and 0.76 dB in dense models.

</details>


### [431] [Underscoring the Problem: Why Softpick Fails at Initialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05488)
*Aryan Sood,Jaikaran Singh,Ishaan Bansal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将 Softpick 在大规模下的失效重新定义为归一化问题，通过分离正负位移分母算子族定位到初始化时 D+ 为零导致的梯度爆炸，并提出 stop-gradient 变体解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Softmax 注意力使每个 token 都有非零权重，在训练模型中集中为 attention sinks 和 massive activations，扩大了低精度推理需覆盖的动态范围。Softpick 通过整流分数消除了 sinks 并降低隐藏态峰度，但其优势随规模增大而消失。

Method: 将 Softpick 的分母拆分为正、负位移求和 D+ 与 D-，并将其分离为一个可独立选择每个分母的算子族，从而隔离二者在前向与反向传播中的角色。

Result: 失效根源在初始化：每层都存在 D+ 恰为零的行，近死行无论反向分母如何都会产生超过 10^12 的梯度范数。只有 Softpick 和 stop-gradient 变体（前向保留 D+ + D-，反向仅通过 D+）能从零训练。在 230M 参数下，stop-gradient 算子在量化上匹配 Softpick，死头更少，passkey 检索更可靠，仅在峰值注意力权重峰度上略逊。

Conclusion: 通过把 Softpick 的规模化失效归因于归一化与初始化问题并拆解分母角色，论文提出的 stop-gradient 算子在不牺牲量化表现的前提下改善了训练稳定性与检索可靠性。

Abstract: Softmax attention gives every token a nonzero weight, which in trained models concentrates into attention sinks and massive activations that widen the dynamic range low-precision inference must cover. Softpick removes this constraint by rectifying scores, eliminating sinks and lowering hidden-state kurtosis, but its advantage fades at scale. We reframe this failure as a normalization problem. Softpick's denominator splits into positive- and negative-shifted sums $D^+$ and $D^-$, used identically in the forward and backward pass, preventing their roles from being isolated. We separate them into a family of operators that independently choose each denominator. The failure originates at initialization: every layer contains rows where $D^+$ is exactly zero, while near-dead rows produce gradient norms above $10^{12}$ regardless of the backward denominator. Only Softpick and a stop-gradient variant, which keeps $D^+ + D^-$ forward but backpropagates through $D^+$ alone, train from scratch. At 230M parameters, the stop-gradient operator matches Softpick on quantization, has fewer dead heads, and retrieves passkeys more reliably, trailing only on peak attention-weight kurtosis.

</details>


### [432] [Universality and Convergence of Generative Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05490)
*Leo Brunswic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论与形式化验证角度分析生成流（generative flows）训练损失的"价值"：损失小是否保证采样准确、损失能否降至零、梯度下降收敛多快。作者证明差分型损失可界定采样误差（总变差），比值型（flow-matching）损失一般无此界；在图上，固定反向策略后平衡变为反向链的不变性，Green算子范数（逆谱隙）决定损失曲率阶与训练收敛速率下限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践者通常把生成流的平衡训练损失当作监控信号，但该信号的理论意义不清：小损失是否意味着采样器准确、损失能否趋零、收敛速率如何，均缺乏明确刻画。论文希望回答这三个问题，并给出可验证的定量保证。

Method: 1) 对差分型平衡损失，证明其以显式（与策略无关）常数界定采样器的总变差误差；对比值型flow-matching损失，在单循环上证明当其生成器在平衡处连续时不存在此类界。2) 在图上固定反向策略后，将平衡问题转化为反向链的不变性，利用其Green算子范数（逆谱隙）刻画损失在平衡流附近曲率的上下阶及收敛速率下限；机制为梯度下降沿反向策略扩散流。3) 对detailed balance与trajectory balance的平方对数生成器，证明在任意有限路径连通图上、任意正初始化下，状态平衡损失的训练全局收敛。4) 通过可枚举状态空间上的精确计算检验界与速率，并用Lean 4形式化每个定理的认证状态。

Result: 差分型损失以不含策略的显式常数控制采样误差的总变差；比值型flow-matching损失即使在单循环上也无可比界（生成器平衡处连续时）。图上：反向策略冻结后存在性在有限图上自动成立，Green算子范数同时决定损失曲率的上下阶与近平衡训练收敛速率下限；该常数可有限而反向轨迹平均很短，此时精确flow matching可能失败。平方对数生成器的平衡损失在有限路径连通图上从任意正初始化全局收敛。所有界与速率经可枚举状态空间精确计算检验，定理均附Lean 4认证状态。

Conclusion: 训练损失并非可靠的采样质量证书：差分型损失可提供显式误差界，比值型flow-matching损失则不然。在图上，反向链Green算子范数是决定曲率与收敛速率的核心常数，且可有限而精确flow matching失败。结果均经数值精确检验与Lean 4形式化认证，为生成流损失的理论意义提供了可验证的定量框架。

Abstract: Generative flows sample from an unnormalized target by training a flow to be balanced, and the training loss is the signal a practitioner watches. We ask what that signal is worth: whether a small loss certifies an accurate sampler, whether the loss can be driven to zero, and how fast gradient descent does so. The loss decides the first. Losses that compare the two sides of the balance by their difference bound, in total variation, the error of the sampler the flow implies, with explicit constants that do not involve the policy; flow-matching losses that compare them through a ratio admit no such bound, already on a single cycle, whenever their generator is continuous at balance. On graphs, the backward policy decides the other two. Once it is frozen, balance becomes invariance under the backward chain, so that existence is free on finite graphs, and one constant --- the norm of that chain's Green operator, which plays the role of an inverse spectral gap --- fixes the order of the curvature of the loss around the balanced flow, from above and below, and sets a floor under the rate at which training converges near it. The mechanism is that gradient descent diffuses the flow along the backward policy. For the squared-logarithm generator of detailed and trajectory balance, training the balance loss on states converges globally on every finite path-connected graph, from every positive initialization. The constant can be infinite while backward trajectories are short on average, and exact flow matching can then fail. The bounds and rates are tested by exact computation on enumerable state spaces, and every theorem carries a certification status computed from a Lean~4 development.

</details>


### [433] [When Does Retrieval Help? A Study of In-Context Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05492)
*Zixuan Liu,Joris Köster,Zizhan Zheng,Siavash Khajavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在RICL框架中，不同检索机制对VLA模型检索质量和下游任务性能的影响，发现没有单一检索方法能持续占优，甚至随机检索也取得非平凡成功率，且检索质量诊断指标无法可靠反映下游性能，表明需要更谨慎地设计检索机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型作为通用机器人策略潜力巨大，但适应未见任务通常需要高昂的参数更新成本。RICL等近期工作通过基于当前VLA观测检索专家演示作为测试时上下文，实现了上下文适应能力，而其效果关键取决于检索机制。因此有必要系统研究不同检索方法如何影响检索质量和任务性能。

Method: 在RICL框架下比较四种检索方法：基于图像的检索、增加VLA状态的检索、使用VLA骨干特征的检索，以及随机检索，并评估其对检索质量和任务性能的影响。

Result: 实验得到三点主要发现：第一，没有一种检索方法在任务成功率上持续占优，而随机检索竟也取得非平凡的成功率；第二，标准检索质量诊断指标无法可靠反映下游VLA性能；第三，来自不同但相关任务的演示能提供有用的可迁移信息。

Conclusion: 该工作为理解检索机制如何塑造VLA模型的上下文学习能力及其下游任务性能迈出初步一步，同时凸显了为实现可靠的测试时适应，需要对检索机制进行更细致的设计与评估。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential as generalist robot policies, but adapting them to unseen tasks often requires costly parameter updates. Recent work such as RICL introduces in-context adaptability by retrieving expert demonstrations based on the current VLA observation and providing them as additional context at test time. The effectiveness of this adaptation therefore depends critically on the retrieval mechanism. In this work, we systematically study how different retrieval methods affect both retrieval quality and task performance within the RICL framework. Specifically, we compare four different methods: image-based retrieval, retrieval augmented with VLA's state, retrieval using features from the VLA backbone, and random retrieval. Our experiments yield three main findings. First, no retrieval method consistently dominates the others in task success, while surprisingly, random retrieval achieves a non-trivial success rate. Second, standard retrieval-quality diagnostics do not reliably reflect downstream VLA performance. Third, demonstrations from different but related tasks can provide useful transferable information. Together, these results provide an initial step toward understanding how retrieval mechanisms shape the in-context learning capability of VLA models and their downstream task performance, while highlighting the need for more careful design and evaluation of retrieval mechanisms for reliable test-time adaptation.

</details>


### [434] [LEON: Location Embeddings from OSM Neighborhoods via Hexagonal Graph Masked Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05497)
*Szymon Soltysiak,Radoslaw Malek,Jedrzej Kusnierz,Milosz Chojecki,Piotr Szymanski,Aleksandra Kawala-Sterniuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEON，一种基于图掩码自编码器（GraphMAE）的自监督地理空间区域表示学习框架，利用H3六边形网格构建图结构，从OSM兴趣点分布中学习空间嵌入，并在EuroSAT分类及多种地理预测任务上取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理信息系统日益依赖复杂的地理空间表示学习技术以从复杂地理数据中提取有意义的模式，但现有方法在利用广泛可得的众包数据方面仍有不足。本文旨在探索自监督学习作为地理空间区域表示学习有效范式的可行性。

Method: 提出LEON自监督框架，将GraphMAE适配于地理空间区域表示学习。方法利用H3索引构建六边形网格图以利用地理数据固有的空间结构，并采用掩码自编码技术，从OpenStreetMap（OSM）设施分布模式中学习鲁棒的空间嵌入。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上评估，包括EuroSAT卫星影像分类及房价、犯罪预测、城市分析等地理预测任务。EuroSAT分类准确率提升最高达1.87%，且在各地理预测基准上均取得一致性能增益。所学嵌入呈现高度结构化且区分性强的特性，适合下游空间分析任务。

Conclusion: 自监督学习为使用广泛可得的众包数据进行地理空间区域表示学习提供了一种有效范式，LEON验证了该路径的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Geographic information systems increasingly rely on sophisticated spatial representation learning techniques to extract meaningful patterns from complex geospatial data. This paper introduces LEON, a novel self-supervised framework that adapts Graph Masked Autoencoders (GraphMAE) for geospatial region representation learning. Our method leverages the inherent spatial structure of geographic data by constructing hexagonal grid graphs using H3 indexing and applying masked autoencoding techniques to learn robust spatial embeddings from OpenStreetMap (OSM) amenity distribution patterns. We evaluate LEON on multiple real-world datasets including EuroSAT satellite imagery classification and various geographic prediction tasks (housing prices, crime prediction, and urban analytics). Experimental results demonstrate that LEON achieves significant improvements in spatial understanding, with up to 1.87% accuracy improvement on EuroSAT classification and consistent performance gains across geographic prediction benchmarks. The learned embeddings exhibit highly structured and distinct properties, making them particularly suitable for downstream spatial analysis tasks. Our findings suggest that self-supervised learning provides an effective paradigm for geospatial region representation learning using widely available crowdsourced data.

</details>


### [435] [Logic-Logit: A Logic-Based Approach to Choice Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05501)
*Shuhan Zhang,Wendi Ren,Shuang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型可解释选择模型 Logic-Logit，利用逻辑规则（OR-of-ANDs）刻画人类"先筛选后选择"的决策过程，并结合列生成与 Frank-Wolfe 算法高效提取规则，在合成及商业、医疗真实数据上兼具可解释性与准确性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择模型广泛应用于商业需求预测、推荐系统和消费者行为分析等领域，但现有模型存在明显权衡：参数化与非参数模型灵活性有限，而深度网络模型虽计算能力强，却参数庞大、缺乏可解释性，难以适用于对透明度要求高的场景。实证研究表明，个体通常先使用启发式决策规则（以 OR-of-ANDs 形式表达）构建考虑集，再从中选择，这种"先考虑后选择"的过程能降低认知与搜索成本。受此启发，作者希望借助逻辑规则来建模人类选择，为偏好建模提供新视角。

Method: 提出基于规则的可解释选择模型 Logic-Logit。核心是用逻辑规则（合取的析取，即 OR-of-ANDs）来刻画人类的启发式决策过程，从而解释选择行为。由于规则提取被识别为 NP-hard 问题，作者创新性地结合列生成（column generation）技术与 Frank-Wolfe 算法，以实现高效的规则提取与偏好建模。评估在合成数据集以及商业和医疗领域的真实数据上进行。

Result: 在合成数据集以及来自商业和医疗领域的真实数据上的实证评估表明，Logic-Logit 在可解释性和准确性两个维度上均显著优于基线模型。

Conclusion: Logic-Logit 通过将逻辑规则与高效优化算法相结合，为可解释的偏好建模提供了新思路，在难以取舍的可解释性与预测准确性之间取得了良好平衡，适用于透明度至关重要的实际应用场景。

Abstract: In this study, we propose a novel rule-based interpretable choice model, Logic-Logit, designed to effectively learn and explain human choices. Choice models have been widely applied across various domains---such as commercial demand forecasting, recommendation systems, and consumer behavior analysis---typically categorized as parametric, nonparametric, or deep network-based. While recent innovations have favored neural network approaches for their computational power, these flexible models often involve large parameter sets and lack interpretability, limiting their effectiveness in contexts where transparency is essential. Previous empirical evidence shows that individuals usually use heuristic decision rules to form their consideration sets, from which they then choose. These rules are often represented as disjunctions of conjunctions (i.e., OR-of-ANDs). These rules-driven, consider-then-choose decision processes enable people to quickly screen numerous alternatives while reducing cognitive and search costs. Motivated by this insight, our approach leverages logic rules to elucidate human choices, providing a fresh perspective on preference modeling. We introduce a unique combination of column generation techniques and the Frank-Wolfe algorithm to facilitate efficient rule extraction for preference modeling---a process recognized as NP-hard. Our empirical evaluation, conducted on both synthetic datasets and real-world data from commercial and healthcare domains, demonstrates that Logic-Logit significantly outperforms baseline models in terms of interpretability and accuracy.

</details>


### [436] [Lightweight Semantic EEG Foundation Model for Frozen Cross-Disorder Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05503)
*Rita Huan-Ting Peng,Nhat Bui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: USE-FM是一个轻量级EEG基础模型，仅有146万参数，通过自监督信号重建预训练，在冻结迁移协议下取得与大型模型相当的跨任务表现和语义表征能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大规模EEG基础模型虽具跨神经疾病迁移性，但参数量达百万级、计算资源需求高，限制了临床应用的可及性与效率。

Method: 在TUEG语料上进行自监督信号重建预训练；预训练后冻结编码器，采用统一冻结迁移协议，在异常EEG检测（TUAB）与癫痫发作识别（TUEP）两个下游任务上评估，并与LUNA-Base、CBraMod等模型对比；同时用k-means聚类结合PCA与t-SNE分析潜在表征。

Result: 仅1.46M参数（约为现有模型的五分之一），TUEP上敏感度75.00±14.14、F1为70.37±4.01，TUAB上AUC为85.24±5.61；潜在表征分析显示其学习到与更大模型相当的有组织语义EEG表征。

Conclusion: 大规模自监督预训练可使轻量架构学习可迁移的语义EEG表征，为跨疾病分析和未来神经疾病临床决策支持提供计算高效的基础模型。

Abstract: Large-scale EEG foundation models have demonstrated promising transferability across neurological disorders, but often require millions of parameters and substantial computational resources. In this paper, we present the Universal Semantic EEG Foundation Model (USE-FM), a lightweight EEG foundation model that learns transferable neural representations through self-supervised signal reconstruction on the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus (TUEG). After pretraining, the encoder is frozen and evaluated on two clinically distinct downstream tasks, abnormal EEG detection (TUAB) and epileptic seizure recognition (TUEP), using a unified frozen-transfer protocol against recent EEG foundation models, including LUNA-Base and CBraMod. With only 1.46 million parameters, approximately one-fifth the size of existing models, USE-FM achieves competitive overall performance, including strong sensitivity and F1-score on TUEP (SEN $75.00 \pm 14.14$, F1 $70.37 \pm 4.01$), while maintaining competitive performance on TUAB (AUC $85.24 \pm 5.61$). Beyond downstream classification, latent representation analysis using $k$-means clustering together with PCA and t-SNE demonstrates that USE-FM learns organized semantic EEG representations comparable to substantially larger foundation models. These results suggest that large-scale self-supervised pretraining enables lightweight architectures to learn transferable semantic EEG representations, providing a computationally efficient foundation for cross-disorder analysis and future clinical decision support in neurological disorders.

</details>


### [437] [What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05533)
*Bowen Xu,Boyu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过预注册研究考察harness搜索分数提升的来源，注入六类评估缺陷并报告全部47个主要终点，发现提升多来自不可读答案而非真实能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: harness搜索只要提高分数就会保留对提示、推理开关、token预算或解析器的改动，但这种增益可能来自解析器此前无法读取的答案、弱比较或评估缺陷，需要系统考证增益来源。

Method: 预注册研究，采用三个小模型、三个基准、复制与测试分区、一个GEPA搜索臂，并逐一注入六种评估缺陷，报告全部47个主要终点。

Result: 关闭思考在9个模型-基准单元中有5个提升准确率，增益主要来自受限思考下无可读答案的问题；关闭思考在13次比较中11次不逊于救援配置或GEPA所选harness，仅在GSM8K上对两个模型输给救援配置；GEPA修复了破损起点但所选harness均未超过关闭思考；服务引擎的思考预算在9个单元中6个降低截断并提高解析率；15对可评估缺陷-模型中有6对在复制中重现了缺陷扭曲；LongevityBench多选题上仅长寿微调模型胜过最强常数标签基线。

Conclusion: harness搜索的许多增益并非真实能力提升，而源于解析、比较与评估缺陷；GEPA虽能修复起点却未带来更优harness，评估管线本身可能复制而非暴露缺陷。

Abstract: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 5 of 9 model-benchmark cells, and in each the gain came mostly from questions where the capped setting gave no readable answer. The thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration or four GEPA-selected harnesses in 11 of 13 comparisons, and lost to the rescue on GSM8K for two models. GEPA repaired its broken starting points, but none of its selected harnesses was more accurate than the thinking-off setting. A thinking budget in the serving engine, which also allows a longer answer, lowered truncation and raised the parse rate in 6 of 9 cells. In 6 of 15 evaluable defect-model pairs, replication through the same pipeline reproduced the defect's distortion instead of revealing it. On the LongevityBench multiple-choice tasks, only the longevity-tuned model beat the strongest constant-label baseline.

</details>


### [438] [LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05538)
*Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani,Pedro M. P. Curvo,Gertjan J. Burghouts,Jan-Willem van de Meent,Cees G. M. Snoek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LiFT是一种循环式生成模型，通过重复应用共享的DiT核心来扩展计算量，仅对标准架构做轻微改动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展生成模型的推理计算通常需要增加参数或重新训练，LiFT希望在不增加参数的情况下让推理计算可增长以提升生成质量。

Method: 每个循环步骤使用单一回归目标——从模型初始估计到flow-matching目标直线路径上的一个点，并以连续深度坐标索引这些目标；训练后的模型可以循环远超训练深度而无需重训练、早退或其他修改。

Result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，LiFT-L/2的FID比密集DiT-XL/2基线低3.34点，同时参数减少约60%、训练FLOPs减少32%、推理FLOPs减少52%。

Conclusion: 更长的循环展开能改善生成质量，使推理计算可在不增加参数的情况下增长，LiFT在效率与质量上均优于密集基线。

Abstract: We introduce Loop Flow Transformers (LiFT), a family of looped generative models that scales computation by repeatedly applying a shared Diffusion Transformer (DiT) core, with only light changes to the standard architecture. Rather than asking every recurrent step for the final prediction, LiFT trains each step with a single regression target: a point on a straight path from the model's initial estimate to the flow-matching target. Because we index these targets by a continuous depth coordinate, a trained model can loop far beyond its training depth with no retraining, early exits, or other modifications. In our experiments, these longer rollouts improve generation, so inference computation can grow without adding parameters. On ImageNet at 256x256, LiFT-L/2 achieves an FID 3.34 points lower than our dense DiT-XL/2 baseline while using approximately 60% fewer parameters, 32% fewer training FLOPs, and 52% fewer inference FLOPs.

</details>


### [439] [Don't Judge an LLM Only by Its Activations: Discovering Suppressed Safety Features via Counterfactual Activation Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05541)
*Swadesh Swain,Sanghamitra Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示LLM中"未激活"特征集包含对拒绝有害提示因果关键的"被压制安全特征"，提出CAP指标与CSFD两阶段发现算法，证明越狱部分通过压制安全特征实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机理可解释性工具主要关注被激活的神经元或特征，忽视了大量未被激活（压制状态）组件的作用。本文认为这些被压制特征中隐藏着安全关键信息，是激活导向解读的必要补充。

Method: 提出反事实激活势（CAP）指标，量化被压制特征的潜在激活倾向，即编码器对齐度、压制强度与安全关键性三者的乘积；并提出CAP引导的安全特征发现（CSFD），一种两阶段过滤算法，可从数十万transcoder特征中无需穷举消融地筛选候选安全特征。

Result: 消融候选特征后，大量试验中模型对有害提示由拒绝转为服从；自然越狱下最高CAP特征所受压制增强2-4倍，其激活对应下降最高达80%；放大某特征的压制者会降低其激活并提升相关有害服从率，随机特征无此效果。实验覆盖Gemma、Qwen、Llama五个模型、多种参数规模。

Conclusion: 越狱可能部分通过压制安全关键特征（而非仅激活有害特征）实现，被压制特征是安全行为激活导向可解释性的必要补充。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has emerged as the primary means to understand safety behavior of LLMs. However, existing tools primarily focus on the activating neurons or features of a model. The role of the remaining large set of inactive components is invisible to such methods. This work demonstrates that the inactive set contains safety-critical features that are causally relevant for refusal of harmful prompts. Suppressing such features could turn refusals into compliance, while passing undetected by prevalent interpretability tools. We introduce the Counterfactual Activation Potential (CAP), a metric that quantifies a suppressed feature's latent activation tendency as the product of its encoder alignment (how strongly the input drives it), suppression strength (how strongly active features inhibit it), and safety criticality (how much refusal depends on it). To find suppressed safety features at scale, we propose CAP-guided Safety Feature Discovery (CSFD), a two-stage filtering algorithm that identifies candidate safety features from hundreds of thousands of transcoder features without exhaustive ablation. A significant fraction of trials turn compliant with harmful prompts when a candidate feature is ablated. Under natural jailbreaks, the suppression acting on the highest-CAP features rises 2-4x, and their activation correspondingly falls by up to 80%. Amplifying a feature's suppressors pushes its activation down and raises harmful compliance with prompts related to the suppressed feature, with no such effect for random features. Our experiments span five Gemma, Qwen, and Llama models across various parameter sizes. Our findings indicate that jailbreaks could operate in part by suppressing safety-critical features rather than solely activating harmful ones, and that suppressed features are a necessary complement to activation-focused interpretability of safety behavior.

</details>


### [440] [Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05544)
*Rushil Gupta,Romain Lopez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FractAL，一种面向少轮次、大批量主动学习场景的“软策略选择”方法，通过影响函数数据归因推断各策略奖励，并用在线镜像下降分配预算，在 7 个基准上匹配或超越所有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实部署中从业者必须在任何数据被标注前选定采集策略，而策略性能随数据集、代理模型等设置变化巨大且无法在部署前评估。现有策略选择方法每轮只探索一个策略，需依赖 bandit 反馈或模型重训练，浪费大量采集轮次；这类开销在遗传扰动筛选、定向进化等高通量实验中尤为致命，因为此类 AL 运行仅含少数轮次却批量很大。

Method: 该场景允许在单个批次内使用多个 AL 策略采集数据，作者称之为“软策略选择”。FractAL 基于影响函数的数据归因推断每个策略的奖励，无需额外重训练；随后利用在线镜像下降计算各策略的预算份额，从而把预算集中到强策略并剪枝弱策略。

Result: 在涵盖分类、回归与遗传扰动效应预测的 7 个设置上进行基准测试。结果表明策略选择本身是难题：每种现有方法都至少在 1 个设置上劣于随机采样。FractAL 则在全部 7 个设置上匹配或超越所有基线（包括随机采样），其分配会集中于组合中的最强策略并剪除最弱者。

Conclusion: FractAL 在最优策略事先未知的真实部署中是可靠选择，是推动 AL 实用化、服务高通量实验与现代科学发现的重要一步。

Abstract: Real-world deployment of active learning typically forces practitioners to choose an acquisition strategy before any data is labeled. This is a daunting task: strategy performance varies widely across settings (e.g. datasets, surrogate models) and cannot be assessed without deployment. Existing strategy selection methods explore one strategy from a portfolio at each round and identify the optimal one using bandit feedback or model retraining. Many acquisition rounds are therefore spent exploring strategies rather than collecting the most informative data. Such overhead is a major barrier to AL-driven design of high-throughput experiments, such as genetic perturbation screens and directed evolution, where AL runs consist of only a few rounds with large batch sizes. This regime permits a natural alternative: acquiring data using multiple AL strategies within a single batch. We refer to this as soft strategy selection and introduce FractAL, a method specifically designed for this task. FractAL infers a per-strategy reward using influence-function-based data attribution, which requires no additional retraining, and then computes budget shares for each strategy in the portfolio using online mirror descent. We benchmark FractAL across 7 setups spanning classification, regression, and genetic perturbation effect prediction. The results highlight that strategy selection is a hard problem: every existing method performs worse than random sampling on at least one setup. FractAL, however, matches or outperforms every baseline, including random sampling, on all 7 setups. Its allocations concentrate budget on the strongest strategies in the portfolio while pruning the weakest. FractAL is therefore a reliable choice for real-world deployments, where the optimal strategy is unknown in advance, an important step towards making AL practical for high-throughput experiments and modern scientific discovery.

</details>


### [441] [Joint Estimation of Common-Slope Decay Rates and Spatial Amplitudes Using Parameterized Nonnegative Matrix Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05549)
*Jeremy B. Bai,Filip Elvander,Sebastian J. Schlecht*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将房间脉冲响应中衰减率与幅度的联合估计表述为以Itakura-Saito散度为损失函数的参数化非负矩阵分解（IS-NMF），提出贡献加权SAGE算法加速估计，无需反向积分即可从RIR功率直接得到频率相关的混响时间曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统混响时间估计通常依赖反向积分（如Schroeder方法），难以直接处理耦合房间中多个衰减分量共存的情况。作者希望直接从RIR功率出发，联合估计多个共同斜率衰减分量的衰减率与幅度，得到细致的频率相关RT曲线，并揭示耦合空间中不同衰减分量的时空贡献。

Method: 将RIR的短时傅里叶变换各频率 bin 上的衰减建模为参数化非负矩阵分解，损失函数采用Itakura-Saito散度（IS-NMF）。使用标准的空间交替广义期望最大化（SAGE）算法求解，得到幅度的闭式更新以及对每个衰减率更新而言的凸子问题。为进一步加速，提出贡献加权SAGE，即在估计时对每个分量贡献较强的观测赋予更高权重。

Result: 在合成数据实验中，方法能准确恢复分离良好的衰减分量，且损失下降速度快于标准SAGE。应用于实测耦合房间RIR时，得到频率相关的RT曲线，并揭示了共享衰减分量的互补时空贡献。

Conclusion: IS-NMF结合（贡献加权）SAGE为RIR衰减分析提供了无需反向积分的直接估计框架，可有效处理多分量、频率相关的混响时间估计，并适用于耦合房间等复杂声学场景。

Abstract: We formulate joint estimation of common-slope decay rates and amplitudes from room impulse responses (RIRs) as parameterized nonnegative matrix factorization with the Itakura--Saito divergence as the loss function (IS-NMF).
