Estimation at each short-time Fourier transform frequency bin produces detailed reverberation time (RT) curves directly from RIR powers with no backward integration needed. Standard space-alternating generalized expectation-maximization (SAGE) algorithm yields closed-form amplitude updates and a convex subproblem for each decay rate update. To accelerate estimation, we introduce contribution-weighted SAGE, which emphasizes observations where each component contributes strongly to the modeled power. Experiments with synthetic data show accurate recovery of well-separated decays and faster loss reduction than standard SAGE. Application to measured coupled-room RIRs yields frequency-dependent RT curves and reveals complementary space-time contributions of the shared decay components.

</details>


### [442] [When Low Prediction Error Misleads Planning: Diagnosing Representation, Dynamics, and Decision Failures in Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05550)
*Rui Min,Xianyao Li,Fang Xu,Jing Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 潜在世界模型中主导预测误差的组成部分，未必是修复后最能改善动作选择的那一部分；研究将误差分解为中心误差与动作相对响应，发现二者对决策的影响在多数模型-任务组合中并不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实践常以降低整体预测误差（如MSE）作为改进世界模型的依据，但误差大小与决策质量之间可能存在错位。作者希望检验"误差主导成分"是否等同于"最值得修复的成分"，从而把表征、预测与规划作为可分离的阶段来评估。

Method: 从相同物理起点比较动作序列，将端点误差分解为候选池中心误差与动作相对响应误差。跨4个模型家族、4个任务，使用每任务256个新起点、每起点300个共享候选构成的确认池；并用oracle分别只修正中心或只修正动作相对响应，比较物理排名相关性与top-30精英质量。另设独立LeWM研究执行oracle所选动作，并做匹配候选测试与72次运行的目标函数研究。

Result: 中心误差在14/16个模型-任务单元中主导MSE；但在其中6个单元中，仅修正动作相对响应的oracle在物理排名相关性和top-30精英质量上优于仅修正中心，同时保留更多潜在MSE（家族校正区间）。偏好随设定而异：LeWM执行oracle动作时，PushT及渲染匹配目标的Reacher更偏好中心修复。匹配候选测试显示，LeWM编码真实端点后Reacher的物理Spearman从0.464升至0.975，PushT从0.193升至0.631，而Cube的编码目标代价仍不具信息量。72次运行的目标研究改善了所选响应诊断，但闭环规划增益尚未确认。

Conclusion: 误差幅度不能代表oracle修正的决策效应，二者需分开评估；应将表征、预测与规划作为独立阶段进行评价，而非以单一预测误差指标指导模型改进。

Abstract: The component that dominates a latent world model's prediction error need not be the one whose repair most improves action selection. We show this by comparing action sequences from identical physical starts and separating endpoint error into a candidate-pool center and action-relative responses. Across four model families and four tasks, a confirmation pool of 256 new starts per task and 300 shared candidates per start shows that center error dominates MSE in 14/16 model-task cells. Yet in six of these cells, an oracle that corrects only the action-relative responses yields better physical rank correlation and top-30 elite quality than one that corrects only the center, while leaving more latent MSE (family-wise corrected intervals). The preference differs across the evaluated settings: a separate LeWorldModel (LeWM) study that executes oracle-selected actions favors center repair on PushT and on Reacher with a render-matched goal. Matched-candidate tests localize ordering loss: for LeWM, encoding realized endpoints raises physical Spearman from 0.464 to 0.975 on that Reacher setting and from 0.193 to 0.631 on PushT (64 starts per task), while Cube's encoded-goal cost remains uninformative. A 72-run objective study improves selected response diagnostics, while incremental closed-loop planning gains remain unconfirmed. These results separate error magnitude from the decision effects of oracle correction and motivate evaluating representation, prediction, and planning as separate stages.

</details>


### [443] [An equality condition for the Dobrushin bound on attention rollout and how often it holds in trained transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05558)
*Przemysław Rola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究注意力 rollout 的 Dobrushin 系数上界何时取等号，提出"相互自主导"判据，并系统检验其在多种模型上的成立情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力 rollout（各层注意力矩阵（I+A）/2 相乘）常被用于分析信息在层间的混合与平滑，而其 Dobrushin 系数可由逐层上界相乘得到。但该逐层上界何时是紧的、在真实模型中出现频率如何，此前缺乏刻画与实证。

Method: 从不等式 κ((I+A)/2) ≤ (1+κ(A))/2 出发，将各层不等式相乘得到整体 rollout 系数的界；给出该逐层界取等号的充要条件：存在一对达到 κ(A) 的 token，二者相互自主导（各自对自身的注意力不低于对方对自己的注意力）。随后在 head 平均、仅限内容 token（排除 cls、register、分隔符）的设定下，逐输入逐层检验条件：DINOv2（三个规模）、RoBERTa、DistilBERT、DeiT-B、ViT-B/16 以及两个表格基准上的 FT-Transformer；并统计均匀随机随机矩阵满足条件的比例及特殊 token 的影响。

Result: 均匀随机的随机矩阵仅有 24–30% 满足该条件，说明条件并非自动成立。在内容 token 上，DINOv2、RoBERTa、DistilBERT 几乎每个输入、每一层都满足；DeiT-B 与 ViT-B/16 分别在 91% 和 64% 的输入-层对上满足，失败均出现在较深层。FT-Transformer 在表格基准上仅 11–44% 满足。若纳入特殊 token，DINOv2 与语言模型的满足比例降至 82–97%，说明特殊 token 是主要失败来源。

Conclusion: 逐层 Dobrushin 界在真实模型中往往可取等号，尤其对内容 token 上的自监督与语言模型几近普遍成立；失败主要集中于有监督视觉模型的深层、表格 Transformer 以及特殊 token 处，提示该紧性条件可作为区分模型/层行为的一个可计算指标。

Abstract: The Dobrushin coefficient of each attention-rollout factor satisfies $κ(\frac12(I+A))\le\frac12(1+κ(A))$, and multiplying these inequalities over layers bounds the coefficient of the whole rollout. We characterise exactly when the layerwise bound is tight: equality holds if and only if some token pair attaining $κ(A)$ is mutually self-dominant - each of the two attends to itself at least as strongly as the other attends to it. The condition is far from automatic: uniformly random stochastic matrices satisfy it only 24-30% of the time.
  When tested on the head-averaged attention of each individual input and restricted to content tokens - image patches, words or tabular features, excluding cls, register and separator tokens - the condition holds for essentially every input at every layer of DINOv2 (three model sizes), RoBERTa and DistilBERT. In the supervised models DeiT-B and ViT-B/16 it holds for 91% and 64% of input-layer pairs respectively, with all failures occurring late in depth. In FT-Transformer trained on two standard tabular benchmarks it holds for only 11-44% of input-layer pairs. The special tokens account for almost all failures in DINOv2 and the language models: when they are included, the condition holds for only 82-97% of input-layer pairs.

</details>


### [444] [Cut Binary Cross Entropy: Efficient Large-Vocabulary Loss and Gradient Kernels for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05559)
*Yaoyiran Li,Haowen Ning,Mohamed Hammad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CutBCE 是一种面向超大规模物品目录多标签推荐的精确、硬件加速 BCE 损失与梯度算子，在 JAX/Pallas 中实现，消除 OOM 并显著降低 HBM 占用、提升训练速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业级序列推荐系统的物品规模可达 10^5–10^7，多标签推荐在全词表上使用 BCE 损失训练时，标准实现会产生稠密的 [B, N, V] 对数张量，导致 O(B·N·V) 的显存开销和致命的 OOM 错误。虽然 LLM 领域对 Softmax 交叉熵已有分块优化，但大规模多标签 BCE 优化在深度学习生态中仍属空白。

Method: 提出 CutBCE，包含四个关键设计：(1) 精确的融合重表述，分别计算稠密背景损失与稀疏目标修正；(2) 自定义 VJP 及专用 Pallas TPU 反向核，在前向与反向两遍中均片上计算对数分块，使对数及其梯度永不驻留 HBM；(3) 动态 VMEM 预算与分片感知的集合通信提升（collective hoisting），适配分布式 mesh；(4) 基于计数的零开销训练指标。

Result: 在单芯片 TPU v5e/v6e 微基准上，CutBCE 消除了 OOM 错误，最高带来 91.9% 加速。在 8 芯片 TPU 切片上训练 876k 物品的多标签 SASRec（Yambda-50M），峰值 HBM 降低 65.7%（每芯片节省超 14 GiB），训练速度提升 225.9%，精度相当。

Conclusion: CutBCE 为大规模多标签推荐中的 BCE 损失提供了精确且硬件高效的解决方案，在显著降低显存占用、提升训练速度的同时保持精度，并已开源。

Abstract: Industrial sequential recommender systems operate over massive item catalogs (e.g., 10^5--10^7 items). Multi-label recommendation models are trained with Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss over the full vocabulary, but standard BCE materializes a dense [B, N, V] logits tensor in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), incurring prohibitive $O(BNV)$ memory and fatal Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors. While chunked loss optimizations exist for Softmax Cross-Entropy in LLMs, large-scale multi-label BCE optimization remains unexplored across deep learning ecosystems.
  We propose CutBCE, an exact, hardware-accelerated BCE loss and gradient operator implemented in JAX and Pallas for large-vocabulary workloads. CutBCE introduces (1) an exact fused reformulation evaluating dense background loss and sparse target corrections; (2) a custom Vector-Jacobian Product (VJP) with a dedicated Pallas TPU backward kernel computing logit tiles on-chip in both passes so logits and their gradients never reside in HBM; (3) dynamic VMEM budgeting and sharding-aware collective hoisting for distributed meshes; and (4) count-based zero-overhead training metrics. On single-chip TPU v5e/v6e mini-benchmarks, CutBCE eliminates OOM errors with up to 91.9% speedup. On 8-chip TPU slice training for multi-label SASRec with 876k items (Yambda-50M), CutBCE reduces peak HBM by 65.7% (>14 GiB saved per chip) and increases training speed by 225.9% with comparable accuracy. CutBCE is open-sourced at https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/RecML/blob/main/recml/core/ops/binary_cross_entropy_ops.py.

</details>


### [445] [Poisson-GENERIC Neural Operators: Exact Metriplectic Structure in Function Space via Casimir Entropies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05570)
*Jason Sulskis,Sathya Ravi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种真正满足GENERIC结构的神经算子，通过兼容Lie-Poisson pencil与常数Poisson乘子实现无投影的退化条件，在保持Jacobi恒等式的同时获得精确的metriplectic结构，并在多个PDE任务上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有热力学一致的神经算子通过将可逆算子投影到熵梯度补空间来施加GENERIC退化条件，这导致算子状态依赖并丧失Jacobi恒等式，结果只是"metriplectic退化"而非真正的metriplectic结构。作者希望以GENERIC本身的构造方式获得退化性。

Method: 对非线性输运用兼容Lie-Poisson pencil αD+λ(uD+Du) 作为可逆算子L，否则用常数、平凡Poisson的Fourier乘子。在含潜熵密度的增广状态(u,s)上，S=∫s 是L的Casimir，故 L δS/δz=0 恒成立而无需投影。能量由固定力学二次项、学习的无规范势能和凸内能组成。摩擦算子 M=AA^T 逐点满足 M δE/δz=0，其Onsager奇偶结构允许扩散与阻尼但排除输运。采用离散梯度积分器实现精确的离散第一、第二定律。

Result: 对任意参数，反对称性、正性、两个退化条件及Jacobi恒等式（Lie-Poisson项在解析频带上）均达到机器精度。热传导与阻尼波存在精确闭式摩擦算子，第二定律在可检验的曲率条件下约束物理能量。在1D/2D四个PDE、三种骨干（FNO、Transolver、CNO）上，模型在72个种子级比较中赢61个；学习到精确的输运与波符号，在热与Burgers上耗散率误差在13%以内，在平流上不耗散。常数L消融显示精确Jacobi的代价是Burgers性能损失，学习熵消融在每个可逆-不可逆问题上都注入能量。

Conclusion: 以GENERIC固有方式（而非投影）获得退化性，可实现无投影、状态无关、保持Jacobi恒等式的metriplectic神经算子，在多个PDE上优于同骨干的无约束基线，并通过消融验证了各结构组件的必要性。

Abstract: Existing thermodynamically consistent neural operators impose the GENERIC degeneracy conditions by projecting the reversible operator onto the complement of the entropy gradient. This makes the operator state-dependent and forfeits the Jacobi identity, so the result is metriplectic-degenerate rather than metriplectic. We instead obtain degeneracy the way GENERIC does. For nonlinear transport, the reversible operator $L$ is the compatible Lie-Poisson pencil $αD+λ(uD+Du)$; otherwise it is a constant, trivially Poisson Fourier multiplier. On an augmented state $(u,s)$ with a latent entropy density, $S=\int s$ is a Casimir of $L$, so $L\,δS/δz=0$ holds identically without projection. The energy combines a fixed mechanical quadratic, a learned gauge-free potential, and a convex internal energy. The friction operator $M=AA^\top$ satisfies $M\,δE/δz=0$ pointwise, and its Onsager parity structure permits diffusion and damping while provably excluding transport. For any parameters, skewness, positivity, both degeneracies, and the Jacobi identity (on the resolved band for the Lie-Poisson term) hold to machine precision. Heat conduction and damped waves admit exact closed-form friction operators, the second law bounds physical energy under a checkable curvature condition, and a discrete-gradient integrator yields exact discrete first and second laws. On four PDEs in 1D and 2D with three backbones (FNO, Transolver, CNO), the model wins 61 of 72 seed-level comparisons against same-backbone unconstrained baselines, learns the exact transport and wave symbols, matches the true dissipation rate within 13% on heat and Burgers, and dissipates nothing on advection. A constant-$L$ ablation isolates the cost of exact Jacobi as the loss of Burgers, while a learned-entropy ablation injects energy on every reversible-irreversible problem.

</details>


### [446] [Disentangling Task Difficulty from Run-Level Failure in Agent Failure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05572)
*Mohsen EsfandyariDoulabi,Lawrence Arkoh,Biruk Tadesse,Vaishvi Patel,Mehul Sharma,Marcelo d'Amorim,Wesley Assunção*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有LLM agent失败预测的高AUROC多来自任务难度识别而非运行级失败检测；跨单元配对比占99.93%以上，任务内早期判别接近随机，评价标准需匹配部署决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作报告了LLM agent失败预测的高性能（AUROC 0.85–0.94），但预测器通常在多任务运行池上训练。作者怀疑部分性能源自识别"哪些任务更难"，而非检测某次运行是否走向失败。这一区分很关键：任务级难度支持算力分配决策，而运行级预测才用于决定是否干预进行中的轨迹。

Method: 研究含同一agent对同一任务重复尝试的基准，将跨单元比较与同一model-task单元内成功/失败运行的比较分离。统计正负样本对的构成，并对比仅依赖任务难度的"难度oracle"与各类运行级预测器（轨迹预测器、已发布监控器、隐状态探针）在池化与任务内AUROC上的表现，再在固定token预算下比较任务级分配与仅中止策略。

Result: 在所评估语料中，支撑池化AUROC的正负样本对超过99.93%是跨单元的。因此从不观察当前运行的预测器也能获得高池化性能，难度oracle最高AUROC达0.945，但在任务内仅为随机水平。早期运行级判别在所有方法中一致偏弱（任务内AUROC约0.50–0.55），随执行推进而改善，且在能力较弱的agent上更强。固定token预算下，任务级分配优于仅中止策略；只有当任务内AUROC达到约0.84–0.93时早停才有收益，远高于早期监控器的水平。

Conclusion: 失败预测不应只按结果准确率评价，而应检验所捕获的信号是否支持预期的部署决策。池化AUROC会因跨单元（任务难度）成分而虚高，掩盖早期运行级预测的薄弱；需报告任务内指标并区分任务级与运行级用途。

Abstract: Predicting whether an LLM agent will fail has emerged as a promising direction for supporting intervention during execution. Recent approaches report strong predictive performance, often with AUROC values between 0.85 and 0.94. However, predictors are typically trained by pooling runs from many tasks. We hypothesize that part of this performance comes from recognizing that some tasks are harder than others, rather than detecting whether a particular run is heading toward failure. This distinction matters because task-level difficulty supports decisions about where to allocate computation, while run-level prediction is needed to decide whether to intervene in an ongoing trajectory. We study benchmarks with repeated attempts of the same task by the same agent and separate cross-unit comparisons from comparisons between successful and failed runs of the same model-task unit. Across the evaluated corpora, more than 99.93% of the positive-negative pairs underlying pooled AUROC are cross-unit. Accordingly, predictors that never observe the current run can achieve high pooled performance, including a difficulty oracle with AUROC up to 0.945, while remaining at chance within task. Early run-level discrimination is consistently weak across trajectory predictors, released monitors, and hidden-state probes, although it improves later in execution and is stronger for weaker agents. Under fixed token budgets, task-level allocation outperforms abort-only strategies, while early stopping becomes beneficial only when within-task AUROC reaches about 0.84-0.93, far above the 0.50-0.55 range observed for early monitors. These results show that failure prediction should be evaluated not only by outcome accuracy, but by whether the captured signal supports the intended deployment decision.

</details>


### [447] [What Does an Observability Foundation Model Know?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05577)
*Dhyey Dharmendrakumar Mavani,Rian Atri,Tairan Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计了可观测性预测基础模型Toto，通过线性探针比较其冻结残差流与原始输入窗口模型，发现短期/中期节奏与指标类型在Toto残差中比最强原始窗口模型更易线性恢复，但可恢复性并不等于模型实际使用该信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性探针只能显示标签可从模型隐状态中恢复，但无法判断这是否超出输入本身所揭示的信息，也无法判断模型是否真正使用了该标签。因此需要区分"可恢复性"与"实际使用"。

Method: 在可观测性指标基准（BOOM）上，对Toto进行审计，跨越五个序列不相交的重划分：将Toto冻结残差流上的线性探针，与读取原始输入窗口的模型、以及去除训练配置的Toto架构进行对比。同时对burstiness进行因果干预实验（将Toto残差替换为高burst捐助者的残差），并测试BOOM训练的协调探针在外部基准上的零样本表现。

Result: 短期/中期节奏和指标类型在Toto残差中的可恢复性（macro-F1 0.766 vs 0.633 和 0.545 vs 0.498）在每个重划分中都高于最强原始窗口模型；领域几乎持平；序列基数在原始窗口中恢复得更好。MOMENT-base显示相关的节奏、指标类型和领域读出。交换为高burst捐助者残差能按预期移动burstiness读出，但预测并未比随机捐助者更持续地burstier。BOOM训练的协调探针在测试的外部基准上具有负的零样本R^2。

Conclusion: 可恢复性并不等于使用：即使标签可从Toto残差中线性解码，也不意味着模型在实际预测中依赖该信息。研究强调应将每个标签与其最强基线进行对照报告，以更严格地审计基础模型。

Abstract: A linear probe can show that a label is recoverable from a model's hidden states, but not whether that goes beyond what the input already reveals, or whether the model uses it. We audit Toto, an observability forecasting foundation model, on the Benchmark of Observability Metrics (BOOM) across five series-disjoint resplits, comparing linear probes on its frozen residual stream with models that read the raw input window and with Toto's architecture stripped of its trained configuration. Short-vs-medium cadence and metric type are more linearly recoverable from Toto's residuals than from the strongest raw-window model in every resplit (macro-F1 0.766 vs. 0.633 and 0.545 vs. 0.498). Domain is nearly tied, and series cardinality is recovered far better from the raw window. MOMENT-base shows related cadence, metric-type, and domain readouts. Recoverability is not use: exchanging Toto's residuals with those of high-burst donors moves a future-burstiness readout as intended but does not make forecasts consistently burstier than a randomized donor. A BOOM-trained coordination probe has negative zero-shot R^2 on the tested external benchmarks. We report each label against its strongest baseline.

</details>


### [448] [Expanding LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05584)
*Rian Atri,Evan Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究在已有推理链内部何处开始额外的延续应最有效，定义并测量“扩展效用”（expansion utility），并在9个模型、6个基准（41个单元格）上进行审计，发现重启位置确实重要，但学习到的路由器相对“总是从最后可用步骤重启”这一固定规则没有检测到优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 额外推理计算通常用于采样更多推理链，但已有研究较少关注在单条链内部的哪个位置开始额外延续更划算。论文旨在探究重启位置对正确性的影响，并检验学习式选择器能否优于简单固定的位置规则。

Method: 定义扩展效用为“从存储步骤重启一条链后正确性的变化”，并在每个合格步骤上进行测量。使用9个模型、6个基准共41个模型-基准单元格。将被选位置与均匀放置进行对比，在互不重叠的延续集上评分，并进行留出审计（5、16、38个单元格以及新的5单元格审计）。提出学习路由器，并与“总是从最后可用步骤重启”（always-last）基线比较。还进行了交叉拟合的oracle选择分析，以及用最早索引打破步骤标签并列的五种子诊断实验。

Result: 重启位置有影响：在互不重叠延续集上评分时，所选步骤优于均匀放置（新五单元格审计中提升+4.25点，置信区间[+2.51, +6.63]）。always-last是强基线：学习路由器优于均匀放置，但相对always-last没有检测到增益；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500上，always-last在匹配总生成输出下超过精确自洽前沿+0.052（[+0.008, +0.098]），总生成输出仅为四样本自洽的0.774倍。交叉拟合oracle选择仍在声明的位置类别之外发现留出空间。按最早索引打破步骤标签并列会翻转点式选择器相对均匀放置的增益符号（五个种子均如此），随机化并列可消除该偏差。

Conclusion: 链内重启位置的选择是有意义的研究方向，但简单的always-last规则已经很强，学习式路由未显示超过它的稳定收益。未来选择器仍有留出提升空间，同时实验中的并列打破方式会引入偏差，需要随机化处理。

Abstract: Extra inference compute is usually spent on sampling more reasoning chains. We study where inside an existing chain an additional continuation should begin. We define expansion utility, the change in correctness from restarting a chain at a stored step, and measure it at every eligible step for nine models on six benchmarks (41 model and benchmark cells). Restart position matters: steps selected on one set of continuations beat uniform placement when scored on disjoint ones, in held-out audits on 5, 16, and 38 cells (+4.25 points [+2.51, +6.63] in a fresh five-cell audit). A fixed rule that restarts from the last eligible steps, always-last, is a strong baseline: our learned router beats uniform placement but shows no detected gain over it, and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500 always-last exceeds the exact self-consistency frontier at matched aggregate generated output by +0.052 [+0.008, +0.098], using 0.774x the aggregate generated output of four-sample self-consistency. Cross-fitted oracle selection still finds held-out headroom beyond declared positional classes, a target for future selectors. Finally, breaking step-label ties by earliest index flips the sign of a pointwise selector's gain over uniform placement in every seed of a five-seed diagnostic with four rollouts per step; randomized ties remove the bias.

</details>


### [449] [ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05590)
*Jiheng Liang,Chen Zhao,Di Wu,Chenyang Bu,Yunpeng Hong,Xingquan Zhu,Yi He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ColdDDI 是一个基于 DrugBank 5.1.13 构建的可重建诊断基准，用于评估冷启动药物相互作用预测中模型是否真正利用了药理学机制证据，而不仅仅是获取证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有冷启动 DDI 基准多只报告聚合的边预测分数，无法回答一个关键评估问题：当模型接收到分子、文本或知识图谱证据时，是否真正使用了那些在药理学上支持该相互作用的证据。因此需要区分“证据可获得性”与“预测依赖性”。

Method: 构建 ColdDDI 基准，包含 1,900 个已批准小分子药物与 565,731 个正向 DDI 对，覆盖零个、一个或两个未见药物的配对。对每个相互作用标注其是否改变药物暴露或药物效应，以及知识图谱中是否存在可合理介导该相互作用的共享酶、转运体或靶点。评估 8 种传统 DDI 方法与 13 个 LLM；对开源 LLM 测试五种提示模式，并采用掩码、药物替换与通道敏感性指标探测知识利用情况。

Result: 在最难的双未见药物划分中，主要性能差异来自介导物可获得性：微调 1B LLM 对有共享酶、转运体或靶点的相互作用恢复率达 89–93%，而无此类介导物时仅 40–62%。此外，KG 提供的证据并不总被使用：多个 KG 增强基线在共享介导物被掩码或扰动时变化很小，而微调 LLM 对该干预反应强烈。

Conclusion: ColdDDI 评估的是知识利用而非仅知识获取，揭示了冷启动 DDI 模型在何处依赖机制证据、以及在何处即使获得证据仍然失败。代码已开源于 https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026。

Abstract: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved small-molecule drugs and 565,731 positive DDI pairs. ColdDDI evaluates pairs with zero, one, or two unseen drugs. It also annotates each interaction by whether it changes drug exposure or drug effect, and by whether the biomedical knowledge graph contains shared enzymes, transporters, or targets that can plausibly mediate the interaction. These annotations separate evidence availability from predictive dependence. We evaluate eight conventional DDI methods and 13 LLMs; for open-weight LLMs, we test five prompt patterns and use masking, drug replacement, and channel-sensitivity metrics to probe knowledge utilization. ColdDDI exposes that, in the hardest split where both drugs are unseen, the main performance divide is mediator availability. A fine-tuned 1B LLM recovers 89-93% of interactions with a shared enzyme, transporter, or target, but only 40-62% without such a mediator. More importantly, KG-provided evidence is not always used; several KG-augmented baselines change little when the shared mediator is masked or disrupted, whereas fine-tuned LLMs respond strongly to this intervention. Thus, ColdDDI evaluates knowledge utilization rather than knowledge access alone, showing where cold-start DDI models rely on mechanistic evidence and where they fail despite receiving it. Code is available at https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026.

</details>


### [450] [When the Cross-Silo Federation Goes Offline: Continual Learning for Site Onboarding with Limited Unlabeled Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05598)
*Ahmadreza Eslaminia,Klara Nahrstedt,Chenhui Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自主三阶段流程，使联邦学习中的新加入站点能够在无标签、无旧数据的情况下扩展模型，识别新类别并保持旧类别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织常缺乏可泛化的标注数据，而拥有数据的组织无法共享记录。跨孤岛联邦学习虽可交换模型参数而非数据，但通常预先固定参与站点和可预测类别，部署时新站点可能在原有站点离线后加入，且其数据无标签并混合已知与未知条件，导致遗忘问题且缺少常规防御手段。

Method: 提出三阶段自主流程，仅在加入站点执行：1）重构专家筛查新颖性；2）聚类将标记记录分离为候选条件；3）类均值描述旧类别，全部在一个共享表示内完成。旧类知识来自联邦持有的原型或加入站点持有的记录两种来源之一，以弥补无法使用常规防遗忘证据的缺陷。

Result: 在真实工业状态监测数据集上端到端运行且不查询标签，两种来源均使旧类准确率保持在0.868以上，遗忘最多0.063，二者相差0.021。新旧类准确率保持平衡，而所有对比方法均牺牲一方换另一方；相比蒸馏和正则化基线，旧类保留更多。每个新到条件仅6条标注记录、每个旧类保留3条时平衡仍成立。

Conclusion: 该流程可在无标签、旧数据不可得的新站点场景下自主扩展联邦模型，兼顾新旧类别，并允许根据披露许可而非准确率来选择配置。

Abstract: An organization often holds too little labeled data to train a model that generalizes, and the records that would supply the rest sit with organizations that cannot release them. Cross-silo federated learning offers a way through, since participants exchange model parameters rather than records, but it ordinarily settles two aspects of the arrangement in advance, the participating sites and the classes the model can predict, and deployment can breach both. A new site joins after training, once the established sites have finished their engagement and gone offline, and its records arrive unlabeled, mixing conditions the model already recognizes with conditions no participant has observed. We present an autonomous three-stage procedure that expands the model entirely at the joining site: reconstruction experts screen for novelty, clustering separates the flagged records into candidate conditions, and class means describe the old classes, all inside one shared representation. Those classes were learned from records that never leave their owners, so the usual defenses against forgetting are unavailable, and the procedure supplies the evidence they would have carried from either of two dissimilar sources, prototypes held by the federation or records held by the joining site. On a real industrial condition-monitoring dataset, run end to end with no label consulted, either source holds old-class accuracy at 0.868 or above with forgetting at most 0.063, and the two differ by 0.021, so a configuration can be chosen by the disclosure it permits rather than the accuracy it delivers. Both keep old- and new-class accuracy in balance where every alternative we measure gives up one for the other, and both retain more of the old classes than distillation- and regularization-based baselines. The balance still holds with only 6 labeled records per arriving condition and 3 retained per old class.

</details>


### [451] [An LLM-in-the-loop RL Framework for Bioinformatics Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05600)
*Xinyuan Wang,Deepti Agrawal,Yanjie Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LLM-in-the-loop强化学习框架，用于生物信息学高维特征选择，通过LLM引导探索和提供混合奖励，提升性能、稳定性与收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维生物信息学数据存在特征多、样本少的特点，面临"维数灾难"，导致过拟合、计算成本高、泛化能力差。传统特征选择方法在此类领域可扩展性和适应性有限，因此需要新方法来应对这些挑战。

Method: 将特征选择建模为强化学习的序贯决策任务，RL智能体负责决策；LLM在循环中通过两种方式增强过程：(1)利用领域知识指导探索；(2)提供融合数据驱动性能与知识驱动评估的混合奖励。同时LLM生成解释以提升可解释性，但不改变RL策略更新。

Result: 在多个生物信息学数据集上的实验表明，该LLM-in-the-loop框架优于基线方法，在不同下游模型上性能稳定，并且比纯强化学习收敛更快。

Conclusion: LLM与强化学习结合的特征选择框架能有效应对高维生物信息学数据的特征选择难题，在性能、稳定性和收敛效率上均具优势，并通过解释增强了可解释性。

Abstract: High-dimensional bioinformatics data, characterized by a large number of features relative to the number of samples, pose major challenges such as the ``curse of dimensionality,'' leading to overfitting, high computational cost, and poor generalization. Traditional feature selection methods often suffer from limited scalability and adaptability in such domains. We propose an LLM-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (RL) framework for bioinformatics feature selection, where the RL agent formulates feature selection as a sequential decision-making task, while the large language model (LLM) enhances the process in two ways: (1) guiding exploration through domain-informed advice, and (2) providing hybrid rewards that integrate data-driven performance with knowledge-driven evaluation. The LLM also produces explanations to improve interpretability for human experts without altering the RL policy update. Experiments on diverse bioinformatics datasets show that the LLM-in-the-loop framework outperforms baselines, achieves stable performance across downstream models, and converges faster than pure RL.

</details>


### [452] [Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05601)
*Kaiyuan Deng,Yuchen Li,Yang Xiao,Bo Hui,Geng Yuan,Xiaolong Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Tracer 框架，用于在未知被擦除概念的情况下，快速准确地识别被擦除概念并估计其数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对已遗忘扩散模型的攻击假设被擦除概念已知，专注恢复它们。但实际中模型提供者可能不披露被移除的概念，即使有原始基础模型，攻击者也可能缺乏明确目标。因此需要回答：模型擦除了哪些概念、总共擦除了多少。

Method: Tracer 高效识别擦除概念而不生成和分类图像；结合权重足迹的轻量级谱分析，实现大候选词表的高效搜索；引入足迹覆盖目标引导顺序发现多个擦除概念；通过检测候选置信度在被选概念覆盖擦除足迹时的急剧下降来估计擦除概念数量，无需标注样本校准。仅需轻量线性代数和有限前向探测，不依赖遗忘算法先验知识。

Result: 在文本到图像和文本到视频骨干及多种遗忘方法上，Tracer 在数秒内识别擦除概念并估计数量，在图像和视频模型上分别比 MIA 和暴力搜索加速 150 到 137,000 倍及 133 到 20,000 倍，识别准确率显著更高。

Conclusion: Tracer 能在无被擦除概念先验知识条件下，快速准确识别擦除概念并估计数量，具有广泛适用性和显著效率与准确率优势。

Abstract: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer, a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds, achieving 150 to 137,000 times and 133 to 20,000 times speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.

</details>


### [453] [Delay-coordinate reconstruction and conditional-moment causal diagnostics in stochastic systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05632)
*Jun Ohkubo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出随机系统延迟坐标重构的条件矩解释：延迟向量用于重构未来分布的条件矩，而非唯一未来样本路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统延迟坐标重构与部分观测基于确定性动力系统理论，但许多系统具有内在随机性，需要为随机系统建立延迟重构的理论解释。

Method: 通过两条互补论证：一是随机微分方程的概率密度服从确定性的Fokker-Planck方程，在一定假设下可由无限确定性矩层级表示，从而有限矩闭合给出Takens式有限维近似；二是基于Koopman算子理论说明Mori-Zwanzig形式中可观测量演化对应随机系统中的条件期望，系数空间方程的正交“噪声”项在随机情况下消失；并将该观点应用于收敛交叉映射（CCM）。

Result: 证明条件矩视角在矩方法与Koopman/Mori-Zwanzig框架下一致；说明基于嵌入定理的CCM一般不能用于随机系统，但利用条件矩可检验某些类型的因果关系；并用加性与乘性耦合的耦合logistic系统讨论因果关系如何嵌入随机系统。

Conclusion: 延迟坐标重构可推广为随机系统中的条件矩重构，为随机系统因果关系诊断提供理论基础，并扩展CCM的适用场景。

Abstract: Partial observation and delay-coordinate reconstruction are rooted in deterministic dynamical-systems theory, whereas there are many systems with intrinsic stochasticity. We propose a conditional-moment interpretation of delay-coordinate reconstruction for stochastic systems, in which a delay vector is used to reconstruct conditional moments of a future distribution rather than a unique future sample path. Two complementary arguments motivate this viewpoint. First, the probability density of a stochastic differential equation obeys a deterministic Fokker-Planck equation and, under certain assumptions, is represented by an infinite deterministic hierarchy of moments. Hence, a finite-moment closure suggests a Takens-like finite-dimensional approximation. Second, a discussion based on the Koopman operator theory clarifies that the time evolution of an observable in the Mori-Zwanzig formalism yields a conditional expectation in stochastic systems. Then, the orthogonal "noise" term in the coefficient-space Mori-Zwanzig equation vanishes in the stochastic cases; this result is consistent with the moment-based argument. As an application of this stochastic delay-reconstruction viewpoint, we revisit convergent cross mapping (CCM) for diagnosing certain causal relationships. Although CCM based on the embedding theorem cannot generally be applied to stochastic systems, it is possible to examine certain types of causal relationships by using conditional moments. Using coupled logistic systems with additive and multiplicative coupling mechanisms, we discuss how causal relationships are embedded in stochastic systems.

</details>


### [454] [When Does a Diffusion Model Decide What to Draw ?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05645)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在CIFAR-10上测量扩散模型从纯噪声生成图像过程中"何时"从可以变成任何东西转变为确定具体类别，提出用"committor"（半成品图像反复重启生成后各类别出现频率）直接测量，并发现模型先决定粗略类别后决定精细类别；一个更便宜的基于分类器分歧的测量能还原顺序但无法准确还原时间点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型从纯噪声逐步去噪，在某个噪声水平上会从"可以成为任何东西"的开放状态转变为对某一具体类别的承诺。作者希望量化这一"承诺时刻"何时发生，并揭示训练好的模型在这一过程中犯的错误。

Method: 在CIFAR-10上，最直接的测量方法是：冻结一张半成品图像，从该点多次重启生成，统计每个类别的出现频率，该概率被称为"committor"。此外，作者使用一种更廉价的测量方式——分类器对两个类别的观点分裂成两个不同组时的噪声水平——来判断决策顺序。

Result: 按committor测量，模型在约两倍于精细问题（哪种动物？）的噪声水平上就解决了粗略问题（车辆还是动物？）。更廉价的分类器分歧测量能正确还原这些决策的顺序（秩相关0.73-0.88），但无法准确还原其确切时间点。作者随后将预训练模型与其（后续内容被截断）进行比较。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的类别承诺存在层次结构：粗略类别决策发生在更高的噪声水平（更早），精细类别决策发生在更低的噪声水平（更晚）；分类器分歧可作为决策顺序的廉价代理指标，但不能用于精确定时。

Abstract: A diffusion model starts from pure noise and removes it step by step. Somewhere along the way it stops being able to become "anything" and becomes committed to, say, a horse rather than a truck. We measure when this happens, and what a trained model gets wrong about it, on CIFAR-10. The most direct measurement is to freeze a half-finished image, restart the generation from that point many times, and count how often each class comes out. We call this probability the committor. Measured this way, the model settles coarse questions (vehicle or animal?) at roughly twice the noise level of fine ones (which animal?). A much cheaper measurement, the noise level at which a classifier's opinion about two classes splits into two distinct groups, gets the order of these decisions right (rank correlation 0.73-0.88) but not their exact timing. We then compare pretrained models with their

</details>


### [455] [Training and Scaling Compute-Optimal Physiological Waveform Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05649)
*Pingzhi Li,Jie Peng,Shuqing Luo,Zachary Plotkin,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究训练了超过一百个规模从20M到2.1B参数的生理波形基础模型Aether，基于最多36.3M小时波形数据，构建8项临床任务，发现720M模型超越所有基线，并拟合出模型规模、预训练时长与标注患者数的缩放律，揭示了计算最优训练规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索生理波形基础模型的缩放规律与计算最优训练策略，为临床预测提供量化的训练配方和可持续的扩展路径。

Method: 训练Aether系列（20M至2.1B参数，100余个模型），使用最多36.3M小时生理波形预训练；基于MIMIC-III构建8项临床预测任务，通过线性探测评估；拟合模型规模、预训练时长与标注患者数对下游排名误差（1-AUROC）的缩放律。

Result: 720M模型在全部8项任务上超越所有基线；缩放律在留出规模上MAE为0.5%，外推至2.1B参数时MAE为0.9%；计算量增10倍时模型规模增1.2倍、预训练时长增8.2倍；模型规模翻倍可减少51.8%所需预训练时长；预训练从120K延长至36.3M小时可使720M模型所需患者数减少61%。

Conclusion: 研究提供了生理波形建模的定量训练配方，证明预训练与临床监督相互促进，展示了有前景且可持续的缩放路径。

Abstract: We investigate the scaling laws and compute-optimal training of physiological waveform foundation models (FMs). We train Aether, a family of over one hundred FMs ranging from 20M to 2.1B parameters, on up to 36.3M hours of physiological waveforms. We construct eight clinical prediction tasks from MIMIC-III and evaluate the FMs through linear probing. The 720M FM outperforms all existing baseline FMs across all eight tasks. A scaling law of model size, pretraining hours, and labeled patients predicts downstream ranking error, i.e. $1-\mathrm{AUROC}$, effectively with $0.5\%$ prediction MAE at held-out resource scales and $0.9\%$ MAE when extrapolating to 2.1B parameters. We present three findings: (1) Compute-optimal training scales both FM size and pretraining hours. Under the fitted law, a $10.0\times$ increase in compute FLOPs scales model size by $1.2\times$ and pretraining hours by $8.2\times$. (2) Larger FMs use waveform data more efficiently, and greater pretraining exposure increases the benefit of model scaling. Starting from 25M parameters and 4.8M pretraining hours, doubling FM size reduces the predicted hours needed for the same performance by $51.8\%$. (3) Pretraining and clinical supervision reinforce each other: more labeled patients increase the return to pretraining, while larger FMs and longer pretraining reduce labeling requirements. For the example of the 720M FM, extending pretraining from 120K to 36.3M hours reduces the predicted patient requirement by $61\%$ at a target ranking error. These findings provide a quantitative training recipe and a promising and durable scaling path for physiological waveform modeling and downstream clinical prediction.

</details>


### [456] [Graph Data Augmentation via Contrastive Generator Inversion ($\texttt{DCBA}$)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05653)
*Mateusz Stolarski,Michał Czuba,Łukasz Kraiński,Katarzyna Musial,Paweł Prałat,Bogumił Kamiński,Piotr Bródka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DCBA，一种基于模型的图数据增强方法，通过从观测网络推断合成图生成器（ABCD）的配置，实现网络宏观结构保持的增强，并在社区检测下游任务中显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图机器学习方法的发展常受限于大规模、多样化图数据集的稀缺，因此需要有效的图数据增强手段。

Method: DCBA将图数据增强建模为推断合成图生成器配置的问题，采用ABCD生成器（产生具有社区结构的无标度网络）。模型使用多正样本对比目标并配合软负样本加权，学习图与生成器参数化的联合表示，进而预测能保持生成器所编码宏观结构的ABCD配置。

Result: 实验表明，DCBA在恢复生成器参数方面比算法逆建模基线更准确、更鲁棒；在下游社区检测任务中，用推断配置微调PRoCD，使合成网络上AMI平均提升161%，真实网络上平均提升273%。

Conclusion: DCBA验证了基于模型的图数据增强的有效性，能够可靠推断生成器配置并显著提升下游社区检测性能。

Abstract: Graphs provide a natural representation of many complex systems, ranging from social platforms to ecosystems. However, the development of graph-based machine learning methods is often constrained by the limited availability of large and diverse graph datasets. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{DCBA}$, a model-based approach to graph data augmentation that infers the configuration of a synthetic graph generator from an observed network. We instantiate the proposed framework using the $\texttt{ABCD}$ generator, which produces scale-free networks with community structure. Our model learns a joint representation of graphs and generator parametrisations using a multi-positive contrastive objective with soft negative weighting. The learned representation enables the prediction of an $\texttt{ABCD}$ configuration whose stochastic realisations preserve the macrostructural properties encoded by the generator. Experiments show that $\texttt{DCBA}$ recovers generator parameters more accurately and robustly than an algorithmic inverse-modelling baseline. Its downstream utility is further demonstrated in community detection, where inferred configurations used to fine-tune $\texttt{PRoCD}$ improve AMI on average by $161\%$ on synthetic and $273\%$ on real-world networks.

</details>


### [457] [Bellman-Centric Learning: Near-Optimal Regret for Linear Bandits with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05659)
*Jingyuan Liu,Huiwen Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带记忆的线性bandit问题，提出RSM-LinUCB算法，将遗憾分解为记忆诱导误差与奖励估计误差，证明记忆仅带来加性成本，达到近乎最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去动作通过已知有界矩阵值记忆映射引起内生非平稳性，需在考虑记忆动态的同时权衡探索与利用。

Method: 提出RSM-LinUCB，一种以Bellman为中心的算法，像线性bandit一样学习、像强化学习一样规划；引入新的遗憾分解，将记忆诱导误差与累积奖励估计误差分离。

Result: 证明高概率遗憾界 Õ(dRS(M+1)+σd√T)，其中T为学习时域，d为参数维度，M为记忆长度，R、S分别为记忆映射算子范数和奖励参数范数上界，σ为次高斯噪声尺度；并给出匹配的极小极大下界。

Conclusion: 记忆与视界的乘法耦合并非本质，记忆仅贡献加性成本（至多对数因子）；算法可扩展至广义线性奖励，保持分离性与近乎最优性，在合成及KV缓存、语义缓存任务上优于基线。

Abstract: We study linear bandits with memory, where past actions induce endogenous nonstationarity through an arbitrary known, bounded matrix-valued memory map. To trade off exploration and exploitation while accounting for the memory dynamics, we develop RSM-LinUCB, a Bellman-centric algorithm that learns as in linear bandits and plans as in reinforcement learning. This design admits a novel regret decomposition which separates the memory-induced error from the cumulative reward estimation error along the learner's trajectory. We prove a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde O\big(dRS(M+1)+σd\sqrt T\big)$, where $T$ is the learning horizon, $d$ is the parameter dimension, $M$ is the memory length, $R$ and $S$ bound the memory-map operator norm and reward-parameter norm, respectively, and $σ$ is the sub-Gaussian noise scale. Our results reveal that the multiplicative memory-horizon coupling in prior bounds is not intrinsic: memory only contributes an additive cost, up to logarithmic factors. We also prove a matching minimax lower bound, establishing near-optimality. We further extend the algorithm to generalized linear rewards, preserving this separation with near-optimal memory and leading statistical dependence. Our algorithms outperform the baselines in numerical experiments on synthetic instances and semi-synthetic KV- and semantic-cache tasks.

</details>


### [458] [Sharp Integrality Gaps in Calibration Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05679)
*Zinan Wang,Xinhao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究二元单位权重序列在总绝对变化代价下确定性校准距离 C 与其分数松弛 L 之间的离线差距，将已有的 C ≤ L + O(√T) 改进为紧的 Θ(T^(1/3)) 最坏情况阶。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作（Qiao 和 Zheng, 2024）仅给出确定性校准距离 C 与分数松弛 L 之间差距的 O(√T) 上界，本文旨在确定该离线差距的最优最坏情况阶，并探讨稀疏情形下的界与可计算算法。

Method: 构造紧的上界与下界：证明对每个长度 T 的输入均有 C ≤ L + O(T^(1/3))，并构造每个 T ≥ 216 的有理数下界输入达到 Ω(T^(1/3))。此外针对具有 m 个不同预测的输入给出 C ≤ L + m，并设计无网格、多项式比特时间的算法返回满足 B ≤ L ≤ U 且 U − B < η 的界以及紧凑校准修复。

Result: 得到 Δ_T = sup(C − L) 满足 T^(1/3)/1000 ≤ Δ_T ≤ 41 T^(1/3)（T ≥ 216）；上界对所有输入成立，每个 T ≥ 216 均有下界输入。对含 m 个不同预测的输入有 C ≤ L + m，不受限样本的最坏情况稀疏阶为 Θ(m)。算法可在多项式比特时间内返回 B ≤ L ≤ U，U − B < η，并给出代价至多 U + m ≤ L + m + η 的精确校准紧凑修复。

Conclusion: 该工作精确刻画了确定性校准与分数松弛之间的离线差距为 Θ(T^(1/3))，并给出了稀疏情形下的紧界与高效算法，为校准距离的理论理解提供了尖锐结果。

Abstract: We study the offline gap between deterministic calibration distance C and its fractional relaxation L for binary unit-weight sequences under total absolute-change cost. We sharpen the offline comparison C <= L + O(sqrt(T)) (Qiao and Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2) to the sharp worst-case order Theta(T^(1/3)). If Delta_T is the supremum of C - L over length-T inputs, then T^(1/3)/1000 <= Delta_T <= 41T^(1/3) for T >= 216. The upper bound holds for every input, while each T >= 216 has a rational lower-bound input. For every input with m distinct forecasts, C <= L + m, and the unrestricted-sample worst-case sparse order is Theta(m). For rational forecasts and accuracy, with binary-encoded multiplicities of separately assignable unit identities, a grid-free polynomial-bit-time procedure returns B <= L <= U, U - B < eta, and an exactly calibrated compact repair of cost at most U + m <= L + m + eta.

</details>


### [459] [Square-Root Regret for Adversarial Multiplayer Bandits without Collision Information or Shared Randomness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05688)
*Chenyu Gan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究无碰撞信息、无共享随机性、无外部通信信道的对抗性多人多臂老虎机，提出构造性通信与同步协议及慢-快学习流程，实现次线性遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗性多人老虎机研究通常依赖碰撞信息、共享随机性或外部通信信道。本文移除这些假设，在更困难的信息受限场景下设计通信与学习机制，以协调多玩家并控制遗憾。

Method: 针对K个臂、m个带标签玩家，设计基于Monte Carlo公共构造器的构造性通信与同步协议。利用正奖励观测建立公共学习时间表并在学习前同步玩家；将延迟通信代价记入正奖励支撑集；采用慢-快学习流程，在交换分配与分数时保持有效奖励估计。

Result: 在预处理上以至少1-CN^{-32}的概率（N=2Km(T+1)），其固定发布输出对所有预处理后选择的无记忆奖励序列同时满足期望遗憾R_T ≤ C K^{5/2}√T log^2(2Km(T+1))。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，即使在无碰撞信息、无共享随机性和无外部通信信道的对抗性多人老虎机中，通过构造性同步协议和慢-快学习也能获得次线性遗憾保证。

Abstract: We study adversarial multiplayer bandits with $K$ arms and $2\le m<K$ labeled players, without collision information, shared randomness, or an external communication channel. We design a constructive communication and synchronization protocol with a Monte Carlo public constructor. With probability at least $1-CN^{-32}$ over preprocessing, where $N=2Km(T+1)$, its fixed published output satisfies \[
  R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt T\log^2(2Km(T+1)) \] simultaneously for every oblivious reward sequence chosen after preprocessing. Here $R_T$ is expected regret over the players' private execution randomness. Positive reward observations establish a common learning schedule and synchronize players before learning begins. The cost of delayed communication is charged to the support of positive rewards, ensuring that periods with little useful feedback incur only limited regret. A slow--fast learning procedure then maintains valid reward estimates while assignments and scores are exchanged.

</details>


### [460] [Planetary Geospatial Foundation Models: A New Paradigm for Global Public Health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05699)
*Arbaaz Muslim,Aviv Slobodkin,Katherine Wheeler-Martin,Eric Zhou,John Brittain,Martin Frasch,Hamsa Subramaniam,Jacob Bien,Hamed Sadeghi,Sarah Conderino,Stone Jiang,Ben Spoer,Daniel Neill,Mimi Sun,Joydeep Paul,Yun Liu,Tomer Shekel,Amy Chung-Yu Chou,Anna Carter,Charles Elliott,Aaron Bell,Reuven Sayag,Avinatan Hassidim,Niv Efron,Yossi Matias,Kasumi Widner,Eduardo Lopez Ortiz,José Alberto Díaz-Quiñonez,Moritz U. G. Kraemer,John Brownstein,Isaias Fernandes Co,Etien Luc Koua,Monica Bharel,Benjamin Rader,Lorna Thorpe,Marc Gourevitch,Shravya Shetty,Gautam Prasad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出并评估了 Google Earth AI 的 Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM)，一个行星级地理空间基础模型，通过多国、多疾病、多任务的全球健康案例研究，证明其能弥补传统疾病预测在空间与时间上的监测缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统疾病预测受限于空间断裂与时间滞后，导致疫情在未被察觉时升级、慢性病负担多年后才被量化、数据稀疏地区的高风险人群长期得不到覆盖，进而影响资源部署的时机与目标选择。作者希望借助地理空间基础模型来补充现有流行病学工作流，实现可操作的监测改进。

Method: 将多模态搜索、移动性与环境信号编码为可泛化的"地点表征"，构建 PDFM 地理空间推理基础模型；在四个健康领域（疫苗可预防疾病、传染病、非传染病、孕产妇心理健康）、五类任务（空间外推、插值/临近预报、概率预测、前瞻性预测、风险分层）和四个国家（美国、加拿大、墨西哥、刚果民主共和国）开展独立案例研究。

Result: PDFM 在多个领域弥补了关键监测缺口：通过捕捉跨境行为溢出效应，改善了美加边境 MMR 疫苗接种覆盖率预测（本土模型无法做到）；对心血管疾病进行临近预报以加快数据可用性；提升墨西哥市级登革热短期预测以支持及时的病媒控制；改善霍乱热点预测；并在模型未见过的美国各州为个体产后抑郁风险预测提供可迁移信号，但它不能替代个体社会经济数据，也无法弥合人口统计筛查缺口。

Conclusion: 这些结果共同展示了地理空间基础模型在公共卫生监测中的能力，说明其可作为现有流行病学流程的补充工具，提升资源部署的及时性与针对性。

Abstract: The efficacy of traditional disease prediction is limited by spatial gaps and temporal lags, which impact the timing and targets of resource deployments. Outbreaks escalate undetected, chronic disease burdens are quantified years later, and at-risk populations in data-sparse regions remain unaddressed. Planetary geospatial foundation models complement existing epidemiological workflows to provide operational improvements, encoding multimodal search, mobility, and environmental signals into generalizable place representations. As illustrations of this complementarity, we present independent global health case studies of Google Earth AI's Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) -- a foundation model for geospatial inference -- across four domains (vaccine-preventable, communicable, noncommunicable, maternal mental health), five tasks (spatial extrapolation, interpolation/nowcasting, probabilistic forecasting, prospective forecasting, risk stratification), and four countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo). Across these case studies, PDFM addresses critical surveillance gaps across domains: improving US-Canada border MMR vaccination coverage predictions by capturing cross-border behavioral spillovers domestic models miss; nowcasting cardiovascular disease to accelerate data availability; enhancing short-term municipal Mexican dengue forecasts for timely outbreak vector control; improving forecasts of cholera hotspots; and adding a transferable signal to individual-level postpartum-depression risk prediction in US states the model had never seen, while not replacing individual socioeconomic data or closing demographic screening gaps. Together, these results showcase capabilities of geospatial foundation models for public health surveillance.

</details>


### [461] [Voltic: Distinguishing Volatility from Stochasticity in Recurrent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05700)
*Parsa Hejabi,Morteza Dehghani,Payam Piray*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将循环记忆的写入视为贝叶斯滤波中的卡尔曼增益，提出Voltic，使协方差各向异性且噪声方差依赖输入，用对角/准对角近似保持delta-rule形式与并行训练，在召回任务和语言模型上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环序列模型需要决定每个token上以多强程度覆写记忆，但已有门控delta-rule记忆未显式建模不确定性来源。作者希望从贝叶斯滤波视角，让写入由波动性（关联变化速度）与随机性（观测噪声）两者的不确定度递归决定，使记忆对变化更敏感。

Method: 首先证明门控delta-rule记忆的更新是各向同性不确定度下该滤波器的形式。然后提出Voltic，保持协方差各向异性，令两种噪声方差依赖输入，使写入为向量值并携带序列累积的不确定度。为避免逐token传播稠密协方差而破坏并行训练，给出对角与准对角两种假设密度近似，二者都保持delta-rule形式并可复用分块内核。

Result: 在关联变化且观测被破坏的受控召回任务上，Voltic领先所有基线；在同时包含波动性与随机性的任务上，其相对最强基线的优势在外推尺寸下比训练尺寸更大。在45M参数语言模型上，它领先八任务推理平均，并在超出训练上下文长度时取得比门控基线更高的检索准确率，吞吐量接近这些基线。

Conclusion: 从不确定度递归推导写入，能使记忆对变化更具响应性，同时保持delta-rule的高效并行训练。

Abstract: Recurrent sequence models must decide how strongly to overwrite their memory at each token. Read as Bayesian filtering, this write is the gain of a Kalman update, set by uncertainty from two sources that pull it in opposite directions: volatility, how quickly the underlying associations change, and stochasticity, how noisy each observation of them is. First, we show that the update of gated delta-rule memories is the form this filter takes under isotropic uncertainty. Next, we introduce Voltic, a recurrent memory that keeps the covariance anisotropic and makes both noise variances input-dependent, so the write is vector-valued and carries uncertainty accumulated over the sequence. A dense covariance would have to be propagated token by token, ruling out the parallel training these models depend on. We therefore give two assumed-density approximations, diagonal and quasi-diagonal, both of which leave the memory update in delta-rule form and reuse its chunked kernels. On controlled recall tasks in which associations change and observations are corrupted, Voltic leads all baselines. On the task combining volatility and stochasticity, its margin over the strongest baseline is larger at both extrapolation sizes than at the training sizes. In 45M-parameter language models it leads an eight-task reasoning average and achieves higher retrieval accuracy beyond the training context length than gated baselines, at throughput close to those baselines. Deriving the write from an uncertainty recursion therefore makes memory more responsive to change.

</details>


### [462] [From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05711)
*Vicente Balmaseda,Ching-Long Lin,Tianbao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCION，在一个模型中联合学习生成与自监督表示，实现无需标签或预训练模型的自条件生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强图像生成模型依赖标签监督或预训练编码器/自编码器，限制了适用性。作者希望在同一模型中同时进行生成与自监督表示学习，实现无标签、无预训练的自条件生成。但两者目标存在冲突：对比学习需干净增强视图并偏好粗粒度不变语义，流匹配需含噪图像并保留细节与空间布局。

Method: SCION核心是单一像素空间编码器，以流时间步和嵌入为条件。表示学习时，条件嵌入为跨图像共享的可学习全局向量，编码器[CLS] token作为对比损失训练的语义表示；生成训练时，条件嵌入为图像自身的[CLS]表示，patch token经解码器预测图像。为在推理时无参考图采样，联合学习嵌入先验。通过梯度范数平衡与stop-gradient机制实现单次联合优化。

Result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，使用JiT-B配方且无表示引导时，SCION达到8.92 FID，超过类别无条件iREPA（对齐预训练DINOv2，46.44）和RCG（以其为条件，14.27）。使用JiT-L时，SCION无引导达5.89 FID，有表示引导达3.47，优于采用ADM配方的RCG（6.24）。

Conclusion: SCION是自监督且自包含的，无需标签或预训练模型，成功统一了自监督表示学习与自条件生成，并在实验中显著超越依赖预训练表示的基线。

Abstract: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

</details>


### [463] [ReMaD: Tuning-free Domain Adaptation for Classification and Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05718)
*Elijah Bolluyt,Cristina Comaniciu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReMaD（降秩马氏距离），一种无需微调的基于原型距离的分类与OOD检测改进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在将大型预训练模型适配到新领域时，往往需要微调或超参数搜索，成本高且缺乏对OOD数据的先验知识。作者希望找到一种无需训练、无需OOD先验的简洁适配方案。

Method: 利用目标数据集嵌入在模型隐空间中拟合闭式分布统计量，基于原型分类与OOD检测，分析预训练模型处理新数据集时的分布特性；据此对马氏距离做简单修改，通过"去除未使用特征"来调整隐空间分布以适配新领域，无需微调或超参数搜索。

Result: 在四个目标数据集上测试，将现有大型预训练图像嵌入模型适配到其训练能力之外的新分类领域，在分类与OOD检测两项任务上均取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: ReMaD为预训练模型在新领域的分类与OOD检测提供了一种免训练、免超参搜索的轻量适配方案，具备实用价值。

Abstract: We introduce Reduced-rank Mahalanobis Distance (ReMaD), a novel prototypical distance-based refinement to classification and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection using pretrained models without finetuning. We use embeddings of the target dataset to fit closed-form distribution statistics in the model's latent space which can classify in-distribution samples and detect OOD samples, all without training or prior knowledge of the OOD data. Building on prototype classification and OOD detection, we analyze the distribution properties of large pretrained models when processing new datasets; based on this analysis, we formulate a simple modification to Mahalanobis Distance to adapt models' latent space distributions to new domains by removing unused features, without the finetuning or hyperparameter searches required by other adaptation procedures. We demonstrate the efficacy of this method to adapt existing large pretrained image embedding models to new classification domains outside their trained capabilities by testing across four target datasets, with competitive performance in both classification and OOD detection.

</details>


### [464] [Inferring physical fields in coupled systems with unknown parameters from incomplete observations using physics-constrained attentive neural operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05723)
*Shilun Wei,Xiaoqiang Sun,Wei Li,Kejun Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种机器学习框架，仅凭单个物理场的稀疏观测，实现耦合系统全场重构与未知参数辨识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单一物理场的有限观测中推断耦合系统完整状态并识别未知参数极具挑战：需同时重建多个耦合场，而系统参数未知。

Method: 采用交叉注意力编码器将稀疏传感器观测映射到规则网格，构建传感器条件潜表示；用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）解码器捕捉全局空间依赖以重建所有耦合物理场；通过最小化观测损失、控制方程残差及边界/初始条件约束联合优化网络参数与未知物理参数。

Result: 在二维与三维顶盖驱动方腔流、二维圆柱尾流及二维非理想磁流体力学问题上验证，展示从非完整观测中恢复未观测场与物理参数的性能。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效从单场稀疏观测中重构耦合系统全场并辨识未知参数，具有良好的适用性。

Abstract: Given incomplete measurements of a single physical field in a coupled system with unknown parameters, can we infer its full physical state and identify the underlying parameters? This problem is challenging because multiple coupled fields must be reconstructed simultaneously from limited observations of only one, while the system parameters are unknown. In this work, we propose a machine learning framework for full-field reconstruction and parameter identification of unknown physical systems from sparse observations of a single physical field. Specifically, the cross-attention encoder propagates sparse sensor observations onto a regular grid to construct a sensor-conditioned latent representation, while a Fourier neural operator (FNO) decoder captures global spatial dependencies to reconstruct all coupled physical fields. The network parameters and unknown physical parameters are jointly optimized by minimizing observation losses, governing equation residuals, and boundary/initial condition constraints. The proposed approach is validated on two- and three-dimensional lid-driven cavity flows, a two-dimensional cylinder wake, and a two-dimensional non-ideal magnetohydrodynamics problem, demonstrating the recovery performance of unobserved fields and physical parameters from incomplete observations.

</details>


### [465] [PACMI: Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation for Long-Term LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05732)
*Yiqi Wang,Jiaqi Liu,Jiaqi Zhang,Zhangkai Wu,Yiqun Duan,Mingkai Zheng,Taotao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PACMI框架，通过溯源图与类型化依赖边实现记忆失效的级联传播与历史保留，并构建诊断基准验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在长周期任务中依赖长期记忆，但现有方法难以处理因新观察或领域证据而变得过时的记忆。这些过时记忆仍可能语义相关、影响下游记录，并具有历史证据价值，因此需要依赖追踪与历史保留两种能力。

Method: 提出Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation (PACMI)框架：以溯源图表示记忆与新证据，使用类型化依赖边；将记录分配至四状态有效性格；将有效性变化传播至依赖记忆；并基于状态进行检索与陈旧前提检测。同时构建包含100个案例、300个查询、覆盖五个领域的诊断基准，评估在节点、上下文和答案三个层面的性能。

Result: PACMI在该基准上取得最高的最终答案准确率，与最强基线的配对差异在精确McNemar检验下显著。前提检查器在受控查询分布上达到完美的精确率、召回率和F1。级联传播主要提升记忆状态正确性：移除它使最终答案错误从3增至11，但配对差异未达到0.05显著性阈值。

Conclusion: PACMI通过溯源感知的级联记忆失效机制，有效提升了长期记忆管理的答案准确性，并验证了前提检查与级联传播的贡献，代码与数据将公开。

Abstract: LLM agents rely on long-term memory to retain and reuse information when performing tasks over long horizons. Existing methods provide limited support for handling memories that become outdated as new observations or domain evidence arrive. Such outdated memories may remain semantically relevant, continue to affect dependent records, and retain value as historical evidence. This calls for two capabilities: dependency tracking to identify downstream effects and historical preservation to retain useful past records. We propose Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation (PACMI), a framework that represents memories and new evidence in a provenance graph with typed dependency edges. PACMI assigns records to a four-state validity lattice, propagates validity changes to dependent memories, and uses the resulting states for retrieval and stale-premise detection. We also introduce a diagnostic benchmark with 100 cases and 300 queries across five domains. The evaluation separates node, context-, and answer-level performance. PACMI achieves the highest final-answer accuracy on this benchmark, and its paired difference from the strongest baseline is significant under an exact McNemar test. The premise checker achieves perfect precision, recall, and F 1 on the controlled query distribution. Cascading propagation primarily improves memorystate correctness: removing it increases final-answer errors from 3 to 11, but the paired difference does not reach the 0.05 significance threshold. Code and data will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [466] [CIPHER-MoE: Balancing Efficiency and Routing Fidelity in Trillion-Scale MoE Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05744)
*Jing Li,Jian Meng,Yingmeng Gao,Suming Qiu,Linyuan Qiu,Dongfang Li,Baotian Hu,Binfan Zheng,Rongqian Zhao,Weijian Sun,Xin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CIPHER-MoE方法，通过亲和度感知的专家到令牌过滤与显式容量控制缓解MoE训练负载不均衡，无需额外硬件，实现最高64.9个百分点热点专家负载下降与1.10-1.94倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE在LLM训练中广泛采用，但非均匀令牌路由导致专家与设备间负载高度不均衡。在万亿参数规模下，这一问题放大资源开销，降低训练效率与硬件利用率：冷门专家资源闲置，热点专家需额外资源。现有方案依赖复杂并行策略或资源重分配，引入额外资源需求与高编排复杂度，在算力受限下难以承受。

Method: 提出CIPHER-MoE，在保持路由器令牌侧Top-K选择不变的前提下缓解负载不均衡。采用亲和度感知的专家到令牌（Expert-to-Token）过滤，并结合显式容量控制，在不增加硬件资源、不引入复杂运行时设计的情况下降低热点专家负载。

Result: 在包括DeepSeek-V4-Pro在内的大规模MoE模型上评估，热点专家Top-1负载最高降低64.9个百分点，训练加速1.10-1.94倍，同时保持训练质量。源代码即将发布。

Conclusion: CIPHER-MoE以轻量方式有效缓解MoE训练负载不均衡，兼顾效率与质量，为资源受限下的大规模MoE训练提供可行方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has been widely adopted in recent large language model (LLM) architectures. However, scaling up MoE in LLM training introduces system-level challenges on training, where non-uniform token routing can lead to highly imbalanced workloads across experts and devices, further destabilizing the training process. With trillion-scale LLMs, imbalanced expert workloads further amplify the resource cost of MoE training, resulting in degraded training efficiency and hardware utilization for underloaded experts, while hot experts require additional resources to accommodate excessive workloads. Recent studies address imbalanced MoE training through intricate parallelism strategies or resource reallocation. However, these system-level approaches often introduce additional resource requirements and considerable orchestration complexity, which become increasingly difficult to afford when training trillion-parameter LLMs under constrained computational resources. This work introduces CIPHER-MoE, which mitigates MoE workload imbalance while keeping the router's token-side Top-K selection unchanged. CIPHER-MoE applies affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering with explicit capacity control to reduce hotspot expert workloads without additional hardware resources or complex runtime design. The proposed method has been evaluated on large-scale MoE models, including DeepSeek-V4-Pro, showing up to 64.9 percentage points Top-1 expert workload reduction and 1.10$\times$-1.94$\times$ training acceleration, while preserving the training quality. The source code will be released soon.

</details>


### [467] [Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05745)
*Shen Ruan,Wenchang Gao,Jin Wang,Siao Liu,Zhoxizhuoma,Dongchun Ren,Xin Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究后训练量化VLA策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化性，发现量化策略虽保持分布内性能但对细微环境变化脆弱，且动作差异集中在少数rollout状态。为此提出PIVOT-Q，通过脆弱状态感知的在线策略蒸馏选择性纠正脆弱状态，在LIBERO-Plus七种环境变化下实现一致恢复，性能优于全状态蒸馏且仅用7.4%蒸馏预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化虽在标准评测下能保持VLA性能，但其是否保留全精度模型的鲁棒性与泛化性尚未被充分探索。作者希望系统研究量化VLA策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化性，并解决量化策略对细微环境变化脆弱的问题。

Method: 提出PIVOT-Q（Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning），一个脆弱性感知的On-Policy Distillation框架。它使用冻结的全精度策略作为教师，在量化学生rollout中选择性纠正脆弱状态；通过短时域上的折扣累积差异识别脆弱状态，应用相位平衡的稀疏监督，并使用Behavioral Anchor防止不必要的改变。

Result: 在七种LIBERO-Plus环境变化下，PIVOT-Q在多个VLA主干网络和量化方法上实现一致的恢复；在所有设置下持续优于全状态蒸馏，且仅使用其7.4%的状态级蒸馏预算。

Conclusion: 有效的后量化恢复需要有选择地干预脆弱状态，而非全局蒸馏学生模型。PIVOT-Q验证了脆弱状态感知的选择性蒸馏在量化VLA恢复中的有效性，在显著降低蒸馏预算的同时提升鲁棒性与泛化性。

Abstract: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.

</details>


### [468] [AdaSpark: Adaptive DSpark with Online Learning for Tree Verification and N-gram Fill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05774)
*Liquan Liu,Yifan Zhang,Bowei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaSpark 在服务过程中在线学习验证宽度的时间开销与候选接受概率，无需预先profile或调参，据此对树状推测解码的候选进行排序与定价，在六个公开数据集上实现1.5-3.1倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块级草稿器（如DSpark）一次前向给出多个位置的候选，树验证器一次性验证，验证行数需要在"更宽树能接受的token数"与"更宽验证耗时"之间权衡。现有调度器大多使用服务前测量的验证时间表或模型（在线最多用一个缩放因子修正），接受率则来自草稿器置信度或离线拟合映射，缺乏在线自适应能力。

Method: AdaSpark在服务过程中同时学习两个量，无需预先profile、校准或扫描：1）学习哪些验证宽度值得提供，并将每个宽度的验证时间拟合为上下文的函数；2）将每个候选的接受概率拟合到目标的验证结果上，以草稿器置信度头作为输入之一，并依据该拟合而非置信度头来排序和设定树的大小。同一模型还对请求自身文本的n-gram续写进行定价，使草稿候选与文本派生候选在同一best-first顺序中竞争行数。宽度选择通过对长期解码速率进行定价来决定。

Result: 在六个公开数据集的单轮与多轮对话上，针对三个dense目标和一个专家混合目标：AdaSpark比llama.cpp的DSpark（相同草稿器）解码快1.5-3.1倍；搭载AdaSpark的imparo引擎比运行三token链（llama.cpp默认设置）的imparo快1.17-1.52倍，且该增益仅来自调度器。在不进行宽度扫描的情况下，AdaSpark在任何dense目标或上下文区间上比最佳固定树宽度慢不超过0.3%。在专家混合目标上与最佳固定宽度持平，而4到16行的其他固定宽度慢5-14%。

Conclusion: AdaSpark通过在线学习验证时间与接受概率，将调度问题转化为基于长期解码速率的定价问题，消除了对离线profile、校准与宽度扫描的依赖，在多种目标模型和对话场景下实现了稳定且接近最优（甚至持平最佳固定宽度）的推测解码加速。

Abstract: Block drafters such as DSpark propose ranked candidates for several positions in one forward pass, and a tree verifier checks them in one pass of the target. The number of rows to verify trades the tokens a wider tree is expected to accept against the time a wider verify takes. Most schedulers that choose this number take the verify time from a table or model measured before serving, corrected online by at most one scale factor, and take acceptance from the drafter's confidence estimates or from a map fitted offline.
  AdaSpark learns both quantities while it serves, with no profile, calibration or sweep in advance. It learns which verify widths are worth offering and fits each one's verify time as a function of context. It fits each candidate's acceptance probability to the target's verify outcomes, with the drafter's confidence head as one input, and orders and sizes the tree by that fit instead of by the head. The same model prices n-gram continuations of the request's own text, so drafted and text-derived candidates compete for rows in one best-first order. The width is chosen by pricing time at the long-run decode rate.
  On single- and multi-turn conversations from six public datasets, on three dense targets and one mixture-of-experts target, AdaSpark decodes 1.5-3.1x faster than llama.cpp's DSpark with the same drafters. Our imparo engine with AdaSpark is 1.17-1.52x faster than imparo running with a three-token chain (the default llama.cpp setting); this gain comes from the scheduler alone. Without a width sweep, AdaSpark is never more than 0.3% slower than the best pinned tree width on any dense target or context band. On the mixture-of-experts target it ties the best pinned width, and the other pinned widths from 4 to 16 rows are 5-14% slower.

</details>


### [469] [Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05809)
*Lucas Rencker,Omid Tajalizadehkhoob,Khalid Elsayed,Artem Khachaturiants,Helda Pahlavani,Yan Guo,Jakob van de Laar,Erik Simons,Niranjan Saikumar,Hamed Sadeghian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于神经网络的SPM图像分辨率增强框架，并利用迁移学习实现模型在新结构上的复用，以减少成像时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进半导体节点要求亚纳米分辨率的同时保持高吞吐量以满足在线工艺控制需求，尽管高通量SPM工具已提升吞吐量，但仍需进一步缩短成像时间。

Method: 设计并应用神经网络分辨率增强器，用于SPM图像；在200 nm间距的Line/Space结构上进行测量验证框架有效性；并通过迁移学习，用100 nm间距结构上较小的测量数据集重新训练和校准新模型。

Result: 该框架在200 nm间距Line/Space结构上有效；迁移学习使预训练模型可复用于略有差异的结构（100 nm间距），并可用更小数据集完成再训练与校准。

Conclusion: 基于机器学习的图像分辨率增强可进一步降低SPM成像时间，且迁移学习能提升预训练模型的可复用性，降低新结构应用的数据需求。

Abstract: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. We showcase the effectiveness of this framework using measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 200 nm. For the reusability of a pre-developed pre-trained model, we additionally leverage transfer learning and show that a new model for slightly differing structures can be re-trained and calibrated with a smaller data set of measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 100 nm.

</details>


### [470] [Feature identification for parameter extraction and defect detection using machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05812)
*Yan Guo,Helda Pahlavani,Artem Khachaturiants,Khalid Elsayed,Jakob van de Laar,Erik Simons,Niranjan Saikumar,Hamed Sadeghian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个通用框架，利用高速扫描探针显微镜（SPM）系统采集的图像来训练机器学习网络，用于先进半导体制程控制中的特征检测（参数提取）或缺陷识别，从而加速特定图层与设备的专用图像处理算法开发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进半导体节点的制程控制对量测设备提出了更高要求：不仅分辨率与吞吐量受限，还需提取更丰富的数据以帮助工程师优化工艺、提升良率。向3D结构演进使得关键尺寸参数逐层差异巨大；EUV时代的随机缺陷增多，要求在低分辨率下识别nm级缺陷以满足HVM晶圆厂的吞吐需求。这两类需求都迫使开发图层与设备专属的定制化图像处理算法，而传统算法开发成本高、周期长。

Method: 作者提出一个通用框架，将高速扫描探针显微镜（SPM）系统获取的图像用于训练神经网络。该框架支持两类任务：一是特征检测以进行参数提取，二是缺陷识别。借助基于机器学习的图像处理方法，加速原本需针对特定图层与设备定制的算法开发过程。

Result: 论文给出了该通用框架的总体设计，说明高速SPM图像可用于训练网络完成特征检测/参数提取与缺陷识别两类任务，为后续具体算法开发提供基础方法支撑（摘要未提供具体量化性能指标）。

Conclusion: 面向先进半导体制程控制，基于ML的图像处理方法与高速SPM成像相结合，能够以通用框架的形式加速定制化算法的开发，兼顾3D结构关键尺寸参数提取与EUV时代nm级缺陷检测的良率与吞吐需求。

Abstract: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. The move towards 3D structures requires extraction of critical dimension parameters from structures which can vary largely from layer to layer. For in-line process control, the necessary automation forces the development of layer and equipment-specific dedicated image processing algorithms. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. With the emergence of ML-based image processing methods, this process of algorithm development for both cases can be accelerated. In this work, we provide the general framework under which the images obtained from high-speed scanning probe microscopy-based systems can be used to train a network for either feature detection for parameter extraction or defect identification.

</details>


### [471] [Usefulness of Quantile-Aware Diffusion Modeling for Highly Imbalanced Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05825)
*Abu Talha,Peng Liu,Souradyuti Paul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Quantile-TabDDPM，用分位数正则化去噪目标增强扩散模型对高度不平衡数据中稀有事件的建模能力，并在信用卡欺诈检测中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高度不平衡数据分类是金融科技、医疗等领域的重大挑战，少数类往往最关键但样本极少。扩散模型虽可用于生成合成数据缓解不平衡，但标准扩散模型采用二次误差损失，缺乏结构敏感性，难以捕捉稀有、极端值和少数类细微特征，不适合高度偏斜或重尾数据。

Method: 提出Quantile-TabDDPM方法，基于分位数正则化的去噪目标，将标准二次误差损失与分位数损失项结合，显式捕捉稀有事件，同时保留原始去噪目标的理论基础。

Result: 在真实的、具有极端类别不平衡的信用卡交易数据集上进行了广泛评估，结果表明扩散合成数据生成与分位数正则化去噪目标相结合，为高度不平衡数据集的欺诈检测提供了稳健有效的框架。

Conclusion: 将分位数正则化引入扩散模型的去噪目标，可有效缓解二次损失对稀有事件不敏感的问题，为高度不平衡场景下的合成数据生成与分类提供有力方案。

Abstract: Classification problem in the context of highly imbalanced data is a major challenge in many real-world applications (e.g., FinTech, healthcare, etc.). In these cases, the vast majority of instances belong to a single class and a small fraction represent the minority class (often the most critical class). Recently, diffusion models have emerged as powerful approaches to reduce the degree of ``imbalanced-ness'' in the dataset; they work by generating synthetic data by capturing complex data distributions using iterative transformations. However, standard diffusion models are not inherently suited to highly skewed or heavy-tailed data, due to inbuilt quadratic error loss, which lacks the structural sensitivity to capture rare, extreme values, and minority-class nuances. We propose a novel approach, namely, Quantile-TabDDPM, based on a quantile-regularized denoising objective that combines the standard quadratic error loss with a quantile loss term to explicitly capture rare events while preserving the theoretical grounding of the original denoising objective. We extensively evaluated our approach on a real-world credit card transaction dataset characterized by extreme class imbalance. The results demonstrate that the integration of diffusion-based synthetic data generation with a quantile-regularized denoising objective provides a robust and effective framework for fraud detection in highly imbalanced datasets.

</details>


### [472] [Selecting Long-Horizon Trajectories for Reliable and Efficient Terminal-Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05831)
*Cuong Dang,Hoang Anh Just,Ruoxi Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究"监督视界"（保留用于训练的轨迹token数）这一设计轴，发现可靠性随视界增长但会饱和，据此提出"选择性长视界精炼"方法，优于全量长视界训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体通常通过模仿长教师轨迹来训练，但每条轨迹应监督多少部分尚未被探索，而监督视界的长度对模型的可靠性与训练成本都有重要影响。

Method: 研究监督视界（保留训练的轨迹token数），并通过偏差-复杂度界分析其饱和现象；据此提出"选择性长视界精炼"——先在短前缀上训练，再仅对热启动模型下最可能的续写部分进行精炼。

Result: 在Terminal-Bench上，12K token视界比16K解决更多任务（29±0.7 vs. 26±0.8）且训练时间少30%。在16K下，选择性精炼将成功尝试从110±2.7提升到126±2.1，至少六次成功解决的任务从9±0.7提升到14±0.6；用一半长视界数据仍达122±2.4，训练时间减少23%。在Terminal-Bench v2.0（64±2.6→73±2.1）和OpenThoughts-TBLite（137±2.7→155±2.2）上也取得提升。

Conclusion: 监督视界是可靠性与成本的关键设计轴，且呈现饱和效应；对于长视界监督，选择正确的轨迹比在全部轨迹上训练更重要。

Abstract: Terminal agents are commonly trained by imitating long teacher trajectories, yet how much of each trajectory to supervise remains unexplored. We study the \emph{supervision horizon}, the number of trajectory tokens retained for training, and show that it is a key design axis for reliability and cost. Reliability improves with longer horizons but saturates: on Terminal-Bench, a 12K-token horizon solves more tasks than 16K ($29\pm0.7$ vs.\ $26\pm0.8$) while requiring 30\% less training time. The horizon also shapes agent behavior: short horizons cause premature termination, intermediate horizons yield productive error recovery, and long horizons induce over-persistence. We analyze this saturation through a bias--complexity bound, in which longer supervision reduces temporal supervision bias but increases finite-sample estimation error from more heterogeneous late-stage histories. Guided by this analysis, we propose \emph{selective long-horizon refinement}, which first trains on short prefixes and then refines only on continuations that are most likely under the warm-start model. It consistently outperforms full long-horizon training. At 16K, it raises successful attempts from $110\pm2.7$ to $126\pm2.1$ and tasks solved in at least six of eight attempts from $9\pm0.7$ to $14\pm0.6$; with half of the long-horizon data, it still reaches $122\pm2.4$ while cutting training time by 23\%. The gains transfer across benchmarks, from $64\pm2.6$ to $73\pm2.1$ on Terminal-Bench v2.0 and from $137\pm2.7$ to $155\pm2.2$ on OpenThoughts-TBLite. For long-horizon supervision, selecting the right trajectories matters more than training on all of them.

</details>


### [473] [HiER-BLS: A Hierarchy-Guided and Error-Correcting Robust Incremental Broad Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05834)
*Gongli Zhang,C. L. Philip Chen,Zhulin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HiER-BLS，将层次引导的表征生长与纠错学习相结合，以解决宽度学习系统（BLS）中新增模块学习方向不明及权重误差导致输出越界的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BLS支持解析训练与增量扩展，但其增长缺乏对新模块应从哪些输入学习的指导；同时权重误差会使已学输出跨越类别边界，造成预测错误。

Method: HiER-BLS通过特征重要性与相关性选择输入，让后续模块在保留先前表征的基础上逐步生长；演化分支以后空间尺寸与样本置信度引导编码学习器，使其学习经验同时影响特征视图与监督信号。并针对有限宽度读出，分析码字相关性如何改变拟合的类别分数。

Result: 在五个图像和五个表格数据集上，分类性能优于代表性BLS变体。组件研究表明，即使引导分支单独准确率较低，层次引导仍能提升编码分支，且融合二者分数可带来进一步增益；在干净准确率趋于饱和后，更长的码字在更强高斯权重误差下仍能持续提升准确率。

Conclusion: 预测保持能力取决于实际输出到最近解码边界的距离与模型对权重误差敏感度之间的相对关系；层次引导与纠错学习的耦合能有效提升BLS的鲁棒性与分类表现。

Abstract: Broad Learning System (BLS) supports analytical training and incremental expansion, but its growth needs guidance on which inputs new blocks should learn from. Weight errors pose a further challenge by displacing learned outputs across class boundaries. We propose HiER-BLS to couple hierarchy-guided representation growth with error-correcting learning. Successive blocks focus on inputs selected by feature importance and correlation while preserving earlier representations. The evolving branch guides encoded learners through subspace size and sample confidence, so its learning experience informs both their feature views and supervision. For finite broad readouts, we show how codeword correlations transform fitted class scores. Prediction preservation depends on the distance from the actual output to the nearest decoding boundary relative to the model's sensitivity to weight errors. Experiments on five image and five tabular datasets demonstrate improved classification performance over representative BLS variants. Component studies show that hierarchy guidance benefits the encoded branch even when the guiding branch has lower standalone accuracy, with further gains from combining their scores. Longer codes continue to improve accuracy under stronger Gaussian weight errors after clean accuracy has largely saturated.

</details>


### [474] [CACFG: Curvature-Aware Classifier-Free Guidance and Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05845)
*Max Collins,Dasith de Silva Edirimuni,Jordan Vice,Tim French,Ajmal Mian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将无分类器引导（CFG）采样建模为连续时间最优控制问题，发现CFG在无约束控制集下的特定路径代价中被恢复，并提出曲率感知CFG（CACFG），通过受VAE高斯正则化启发的超球约束修复高引导强度下的质量退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG是扩散模型条件生成的标准机制，但引导强度过高会损害图像质量与多样性，且CFG违背了有原则的扩散采样动力学；现有解释彼此不一致，也无法推广到实际使用的确定性采样器。作者希望同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 首先将CFG采样表述为连续时间最优控制问题，把采样轨迹视为一系列控制量，用于最大化目标条件概率；求解Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman方程，证明在特定路径代价与无约束控制集下CFG可被导出。作者认为缺乏约束正是高引导强度失效的原因，因为采样路径可任意偏离当前图像估计。为此提出CACFG，把控制集约束到受VAE训练中高斯正则化启发的超球面上。

Result: 实验表明，CFG采样产生的控制输入经常违反该超球边界；在不同扩散模型、数据集与引导调度下，CACFG在中高引导强度处取得更优的生成质量，且质量-多样性权衡比常规CFG更温和。

Conclusion: CFG可被理解为无约束最优控制的一个特例，其高引导强度下的失效源于控制集无约束；通过在控制空间引入曲率感知的超球约束，CACFG在保持条件对齐的同时改善了生成质量与多样性的权衡。

Abstract: Diffusion models generate samples by learning to reverse a fixed corruption process, and classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the standard mechanism for conditioning this process on a desired class or prompt. CFG can be applied at varying guidance strengths, and while higher strengths improve image quality and conditional alignment, too high a guidance strength can degrade image quality and diversity. Furthermore, CFG violates principled diffusion sampling dynamics, and existing explanations for why it works despite the violation disagree on the underlying theory or do not extend to deterministic samplers used in practice. We address both these issues. We first frame CFG sampling as a continuous-time optimal control problem, treating the sampling trajectory as a sequence of controls chosen to maximise the probability of the desired condition. Solving the resulting Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation shows that CFG is recovered under specific path costs when using an unconstrained control set. We argue this lack of constraint is responsible for CFG's failure at high guidance strengths, since it permits the sampling path to move arbitrarily far from the current image estimate. To fix this, we propose curvature-aware CFG (CACFG), which constrains the control set to a hypersphere informed by the Gaussian regularisation used when training variational autoencoders. We show that the control inputs produced by CFG sampling routinely violate this bound, and that across diffusion models, datasets, and guidance schedules, CACFG achieves superior generative quality at mid-to-high guidance strengths with a less severe quality-diversity tradeoff than regular CFG.

</details>


### [475] [RepICL: Reusable In-Context Prediction Across Heterogeneous Representation Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05852)
*Yu-Hsiang Liu,Kuan-Yu Chen,Chih-Sheng Chen,Meng-Hsuan Chang,Yu-Chen Den,Tien-Hao Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RepShiftBench基准与RepICL方法，证明少样本预测过程本身可以学习一次并在不同数据集与表征空间间复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
