Motivation: 冻结表征被广泛复用于下游分类，但每个新任务通常都要重新拟合一个预测器。作者追问：少样本预测过程本身能否被学习一次，并跨数据集与表征空间复用。为此需要构建能系统评估跨数据集、跨编码器、跨模态泛化的基准。

Method: 提出RepShiftBench，含1,218个编码器-数据集任务，覆盖文本、图像、音频，并分别评估对未见数据集、未见编码器、两者联合未见以及未见模态的泛化。提出RepICL，一个元训练的情境学习器，在预测前通过episodic whitening（片段白化）对每个片段进行规范化；其归纳式变体RepICL-I与直推式变体RepICL-T。另做消融分析。

Result: 基准揭示显著差距：独立拟合的Logistic Regression在所有设置下都优于所有被评估的in-context learner。RepICL-I在全部12个基准设置中超过Logistic Regression，RepICL-T大幅优于现有直推式方法。消融表明episodic whitening是主要增益来源，但它并非普遍有益的预处理。增益集中在简单支持原型指向错误类别或真实类与竞争类区分度低的查询上；直推式的额外增益在支持覆盖有限导致类别分离视图误导时最大。

Conclusion: 研究表明共享的少样本预测过程可以泛化到训练中未见过的表征空间，episodic whitening是关键机制，但需注意其适用条件。

Abstract: Frozen representations are widely reused for downstream classification, yet each new task typically requires fitting a new predictor. We ask whether the few-shot prediction procedure itself can instead be learned once and reused across datasets and representation spaces. To study this question, we introduce RepShiftBench, comprising 1,218 encoder--dataset tasks across text, image, and audio, with separate evaluation of generalization to unseen datasets, unseen encoders, jointly unseen datasets and encoders, and unseen modalities. The benchmark exposes a substantial gap: Logistic Regression fitted independently on each episode outperforms every evaluated in-context learner across all settings. We introduce RepICL, a meta-trained in-context learner that canonicalizes each episode through episodic whitening before prediction. Its inductive variant, RepICL-I, surpasses Logistic Regression in all 12 benchmark settings, while RepICL-T substantially outperforms existing transductive methods. Ablations identify episodic whitening as the primary source of these gains, while showing that it is not a universally beneficial preprocessing step. Across both variants, the gains concentrate on queries for which simple support prototypes favor the wrong class or provide little separation between the true class and competing classes. Transduction provides its largest additional gains when limited support coverage gives a misleading view of class separation. Together, these results demonstrate that a shared few-shot prediction procedure can generalize beyond the representation spaces observed during training.

</details>


### [476] [The Blind Spot Paradox: When Adaptive Classifiers Defeat Drift Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05853)
*Raphaël Minato,Fabrice Popineau,Arpad Rimmel,Bich-Liên Doan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 自适应分类器的内部更新会"抹除"漂移误差，导致CUSUM等累积型检测器在达到阈值前证据已被吸收，形成有限时域检测盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统概念漂移检测假设误差流中的证据会持续累积直至触发报警，但在自适应分类器中，模型自身的增量更新会同时消除这些误差，使检测器与更新回路产生操作冲突。论文试图揭示并量化这一冲突导致的检测失效。

Method: 对自适应随机森林（ARF）进行仪器化分析，追踪漂移后误差瞬态的归属：叶子增量更新、背景树替换等。推导累积证据无法跨越阈值的有限时域边界，并测量临界漂移幅度下限 Δe_c。在合成漂移、ARMA-GARCH（ProteuS）与表格基准（BAF、INSECTS）上验证。

Result: 幸存树通过增量叶子更新吸收了98.6%的漂移后误差瞬态；首次背景树替换仅贡献0.71%，却使外部检测率下降31个百分点。临界幅度下限 Δe_c = 0.120。合成扫描中标准阈值下盲区出现在 Δe ≈ 0.25，解释了经典基准 SEA（Δe ≤ 0.21）为何未能触及该盲区。失效表现为平稳流上的漏检与噪声基线上由内部树替换引发的误报泛滥。

Conclusion: 自适应模型的学习速度本身构成外部漂移检测的结构性障碍；当漂移幅度低于临界下限时，误报预算使检测不可行，经典低幅度基准因此掩盖了这一问题。

Abstract: Monitoring concept drift from an adaptive classifier's error stream creates an operational conflict with the model's own update loop. When internal adaptation outpaces evidence accumulation, accuracy recovers before cumulative detectors (CUSUM, Page-Hinkley) can reach threshold. Instrumenting an Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) shows that surviving trees absorb 98.6% of the post-drift error transient through incremental leaf updates alone. The first background tree swap accounts for just 0.71% of this erased error volume, but drops external detection rates by 31 percentage points. We derive the finite-horizon boundary where cumulative evidence fails to cross threshold and measure a critical magnitude floor ($Δe_c = 0.120$) below which false-alarm budgets preclude detection. This failure manifests as missed shifts on stationary streams and false-alarm flooding triggered by internal tree swaps on noisy baselines. We validate on synthetic shifts, ARMA-GARCH series (ProteuS), and tabular benchmarks (BAF, INSECTS); on the synthetic sweep at a standard threshold, the blind spot appears at $Δe \approx 0.25$, showing why classical benchmarks like SEA ($Δe \le 0.21$) failed to reach it.

</details>


### [477] [TurboPairFormer: Fast and Stable Protein Folding Model Training with an Optimized Triangle Attention Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05854)
*Yide Ran,Chelsea Lowman,Jan Domański,David Hartmann,Jenke Scheen,Jennifer Wei,Chuan Li,Jianwen Xie,Zhaozhuo Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TurboPairFormer 是一种面向 NVIDIA Hopper GPU 的三角注意力实现，通过关键瓦片并行反向算法与输出残差补偿，在无浮点原子操作、无完整分数梯度存储的情况下实现确定性归约，并提升 BF16 反向校正的数值精度。在 BF16 输入下，其 query、key、pair-bias 梯度 RMSE 最低，残差补偿使 RMSE 降低 28-47%，所有梯度在 600 个输入用例中重复调用均按位一致；集成到 OpenFold3 后，在 16 张 H100 上每优化步 GPU 计算时间最短，较 Triton 后端提速 1.73×，较 cuEquivariance 提速 1.13×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三角注意力是 AlphaFold3 风格生物分子模型的核心计算，但其代价随 token 数呈三次增长。其共享 pair bias 会在常规 query、key 归约之外引入对注意力切片的额外梯度归约。现有开源后端通过重复概率重算、浮点原子操作或完整存储分数梯度来处理这些归约，效率与确定性不佳；此外，从 BF16 舍入后的前向输出计算 softmax 反向校正会损失数值精度。论文动机即同时解决这两类问题。

Method: 提出 TurboPairFormer，针对 NVIDIA Hopper GPU 的三角注意力实现。其关键瓦片并行反向算法为 query、key、value 和 pair-bias 梯度各重算一次概率瓦片，并使用有序部分归约实现确定性累加，避免浮点原子操作与完整分数梯度存储。同时引入输出残差补偿，保留输出舍入残差的 BF16 近似，以在 FP32 中更准确地计算反向校正，且不改变 BF16 输出。

Result: 在 crop size 384、640、768 以及 head dimension 16、32 的 BF16 输入下，TurboPairFormer 相对 FP64 参考实现了所比较实现中最低的 query、key、pair-bias 梯度平均 RMSE。受控消融显示，残差补偿使这些 RMSE 降低 28-47%。在固定执行条件下，全部 600 个输入用例中四次梯度在五次重复调用中均按位一致。集成到 OpenFold3 并结合其三角乘法内核后，在 16 张 H100 上取得所评估后端配置中最低的每优化步 GPU 计算时间，crop size 768 时较 OpenFold3 的 Triton 后端提速 1.73×，较 cuEquivariance 提速 1.13×。

Conclusion: TurboPairFormer 通过关键瓦片并行反向与输出残差补偿，同时解决了三角注意力反向中的确定性归约与 BF16 反向校正精度问题，在精度、可复现性和计算效率上均优于对比后端，适合集成进 AlphaFold3 风格的生物分子模型训练流程。

Abstract: Triangular attention is a core computation in AlphaFold3-style biomolecular models, with cubic cost in token count. Its shared pair bias adds a gradient reduction across attention slices to the usual reductions over queries and keys. The open-source backends we examine handle these reductions through repeated probability recomputation, floating-point atomics, or full score-gradient storage. Separately, computing the softmax backward correction from BF16-rounded forward outputs loses numerical precision. We present TurboPairFormer, a triangular attention implementation for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs that addresses both issues. Our key-tile-parallel backward algorithm recomputes each probability tile once for the query, key, value, and pair-bias gradients, using ordered partial reductions for deterministic accumulation without floating-point atomics or full score-gradient storage. Output-residual compensation retains a BF16 approximation of the output-rounding residual to compute the backward correction more accurately in FP32, without changing the BF16 output. With BF16 inputs at crop sizes 384, 640, and 768 and head dimensions 16 and 32, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest mean query, key, and pair-bias gradient RMSE against an FP64 reference among the implementations compared in this paper. Residual compensation reduces these RMSE values by 28-47% in controlled ablations. All four gradients are bitwise identical across five repeated calls in all 600 input cases under fixed execution conditions. Integrated into OpenFold3 with our triangle multiplication kernels, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest GPU computation time per optimizer step among the evaluated backend configurations on 16 H100 GPUs, with speedups of $1.73\times$ over OpenFold3's Triton backend and $1.13\times$ over cuEquivariance at crop size 768.

</details>


### [478] [On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05902)
*Matteo Fregonara,Tom Viering,Jan van Gemert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究挑战"不得在测试集上调参"这一机器学习界戒律，发现测试集调参虽真实存在且显著，但影响常小于其他噪声源，模型排名基本保持不变，呼吁对此持更细致看法并公开报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习教材普遍将"在测试集上调超参数"视为严重违规，认为会产生误导性的乐观结果、破坏基准完整性，甚至可被解读为学术造假。然而实际中此类行为确实存在，因此有必要理解其真实后果，量化其危害程度。作者希望质疑这一教条并进行实证检验。

Method: 作者系统性地研究了在测试集上调超参数所导致的性能虚高（performance inflation）程度，实验涵盖 MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10 以及 GLUE 基准中的三项任务，通过对比验证集调参与测试集调参的结果来衡量效应大小。

Result: 实验表明，测试集调参带来的性能虚高虽然真实且显著，但相对于其他噪声来源往往较小；在许多情况下，测试集调参得到的模型与验证集调参完全相同；最重要的是，模型排名在测试集调参后基本保持不变。

Conclusion: 一致的测试集调参可能并不会使基准或模型选择失效。作者呼吁对测试集调超参数持更细致的观点，并鼓励研究者公开报告测试集调参情况。

Abstract: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.

</details>


### [479] [CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05863)
*Victor Li,Yuzhang Xie,Ziwei Dong,Qingyang Zhu,Wenjing Ma,Carl Yang,Jinbing Bai,Huiwen Xu,Jiaying Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CCQ数据集，整合美国12个州59,372条托育机构记录，构建LLM驱动的匿名化与标准化流程，产出文本与表格两种版本，并 benchmark 多种模型用于质量评级预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量托育对儿童成长至关重要，但相关研究受限于数据碎片化、不利于研究使用以及隐私限制。作者希望构建一个大规模、去标识化、便于数据科学研究的托育质量数据集，推动AI与儿童早期健康交叉领域研究。

Method: CCQ整合12个美国州共59,372条托育机构记录，覆盖多种机构类型和数据模式。采用基于LLM的自动化策展流程，对原始州级记录进行匿名化、清洗和标准化，产出两个版本：清洗后的文本版本和完全预处理的表格版本。并在质量评级预测与重要特征分析任务上benchmark传统机器学习模型、表格基础模型和语言模型。

Result: 在州内，基于预处理表格的表格分类器表现最佳。跨州零样本迁移接近随机水平；但少量目标州监督可恢复大部分州内性能，且在其他州预训练对微调语言模型有益。

Conclusion: 作者公开两个数据集及全部代码，以加速AI驱动的托育质量研究，最终改善儿童健康与发展。该工作凸显了跨州数据异质性挑战及迁移学习在托育质量预测中的潜力。

Abstract: High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.

</details>


### [480] [Beyond Transport Cost: Routing Differences between Flow Matching and Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05921)
*Eungyeol Han,Jong-Seok Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出，在生成模型的最优传输（OT）与流匹配（FM）中，仅用传输代价不足以指导噪声-数据耦合设计，还需考虑"路由"（每个噪声样本到达的目标），并验证了路由感知的耦合能带来一致的生成改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于OT的流匹配方法主要通过降低噪声-数据耦合代价来改进生成质量，但不同的噪声到输出分配可能产生几乎相同的代价。作者由此质疑：仅凭代价是否足以指导耦合设计？因此需要将传输代价与路由（routing）分开研究。

Method: 作者将传输代价与路由分离，数值展示了FM与OT在路由上可以不同却在代价上接近；并在学习式神经FM中分析其后果。以精确的FM路由作为oracle，构造了一种路由感知（routing-aware）的训练耦合，并与仅考虑代价的、代价匹配的对照方法进行比较。

Result: 数值实验显示FM与OT在路由上存在差异而代价相近。在学习式神经FM中，路由感知的训练耦合相比代价匹配但仅考虑代价的对照方法，在生成上取得了方向一致的改进。

Conclusion: 代价最小化会忽略路由这一关键信息。评估和设计基于OT的FM耦合时，应同时考虑代价与路由两个维度。代码将在论文被接收后发布。

Abstract: In generative models, Optimal Transport (OT) is used to improve Flow Matching (FM) by reducing noise-data coupling cost. However, different noise-to-output assignments can yield nearly equal costs, raising a key question. Is cost alone sufficient to guide coupling design? We address this question by separating transport cost from routing, i.e., the destination reached by each noise sample. We show numerically how FM and OT can differ in routing while remaining close in cost. We examine its consequences in learned neural FM. Using the exact FM routing as an oracle, we further construct a routing-aware training coupling and find that it yields a directionally consistent improvement in generation over a cost-matched, cost-only counterpart. Our findings highlight what cost minimization can overlook and motivate using both cost and routing to evaluate the design of OT-based FM couplings. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [481] [Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05872)
*Chen Henry Wu,Thomas Zhang,Aditi Raghunathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"grafting"（嫁接）方法，通过改变权重更新的学习位置与应用方式，证明在持续学习中离策略（off-policy）合并不但优于在策略自蒸馏（OPSD），还避免了昂贵的在策略采样，从而挑战了"在策略训练是持续学习必要条件"的传统认知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在已后训练的模型上，对新数据进行有监督微调（SFT）常导致泛化差和灾难性遗忘，因此学界普遍认为在策略（on-policy）训练是持续学习的必要条件。但现实中包含新知识或新能力的数据往往是在策略之外的（off-policy）。已有的在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）虽试图弥合这一差距，却被证明会导致推理崩溃。作者因此希望找到一种更有效且廉价的持续学习方案。

Method: 提出名为 grafting（嫁接）的简单配方，包含三个步骤：(1) 在更早的供体检查点（donor checkpoint，甚至早于预训练结束）上学习该更新，再将权重更新应用到后训练模型；(2) 对权重更新进行缩放，等价于一种模型合并形式；(3) 当新数据分布与后训练模型相距较远时，可选地对最敏感的更新方向进行掩码。

Result: 在多种持续学习场景下（从专家轨迹蒸馏、使用 STaR 和 Pedagogical RL 的自我改进、以及在预训练截止后注入知识），grafting 在新任务和旧任务性能上均帕累托支配（Pareto-dominates）SFT 和 OPSD，同时避免了昂贵的在策略采样。

Conclusion: 该工作表明 off-policy merging 优于 OPSD，挑战了"在策略训练是 RL 训练模型上持续学习的必要条件"这一观点，为持续学习提供了更高效且性能更优的替代方案。

Abstract: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.

</details>


### [482] [MEND: RL For Flow Models via Proximal Velocity Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05954)
*Shreshth Saini,Neil Birkbeck,Yilin Wang,Balu Adsumilli,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MEND是一种基于近端速度匹配的强化学习方法，通过对奖励封顶和带位移代价的梯度移动筛选，在极少更新次数下超越Flow-GRPO等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流模型奖励后训练方法存在不足：要么在KL惩罚或冻结参考模型下对自身样本重新加权，常需数千次更新；要么直接反向传播奖励并移动所有样本，而不检验移动是否与其幅度相称。

Method: MEND建立在近端速度匹配之上。对每个提示组内的奖励进行封顶，已得分良好的样本不再移动；在封顶以下，沿奖励梯度提出移动方案，仅当封顶奖励增益超过二次位移代价时才接受。随后模型回归到由此得到的速度目标，无需KL项、冻结参考模型或优势权重。

Result: 在100次更新内，MEND在六个评估器中的五个上于相同基础模型图像距离下超越Flow-GRPO（约4千次更新）。在等预算协议下，它在四个训练奖励上的每次评估更新均超过ReFL和DiffusionNFT，PickScore达24.03，对比23.92和23.43。一次300次更新的三奖励运行也超过五奖励DiffusionNFT模型在其训练的三个奖励上的表现。

Conclusion: MEND具有良好的通用性和易采用性，适用于任何具有可微奖励的流骨干网络。

Abstract: Reward post-training of flow models either reweights the model's own samples under a KL penalty or a frozen reference, often for thousands of updates, or backpropagates the reward and moves every sample without checking that the move is worth its size. We introduce MEND, a reinforcement learning method built on proximal velocity matching. MEND caps rewards within each prompt group, so samples that already score well receive no move. Below the cap, it proposes moves along the reward gradient and accepts one only when its capped reward gain exceeds a quadratic displacement price. The model then regresses onto the resulting velocity targets, with no KL term, frozen reference model, or advantage weights. In 100 updates, MEND outperforms Flow-GRPO (about 4k updates) on five of six evaluators at the same distance to base-model images. Under an equal-budget protocol, it surpasses ReFL and DiffusionNFT at every evaluated update across four training rewards, reaching PickScore 24.03 versus 23.92 and 23.43, respectively. A 300-update three-reward run also surpasses the five-reward DiffusionNFT model on all three rewards it trains on. MEND is general and easy to adopt: it applies to any flow backbone with a differentiable reward.

</details>


### [483] [Global Communication or Graph-Specific Memory?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05874)
*Hamed Shirzad,Danica J. Sutherland*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑在静态图的直推式学习中，可扩展图Transformer的共享记忆机制是否真正起到全局通信的作用，并给出初步证据表明其效果可由局部消息传递模型通过权重近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多可扩展图Transformer组件可被视为类似虚拟节点的常数大小共享记忆，用于压缩全图信息。但在单一固定图的直推式学习中，这种共享记忆在测试时是一个常数，因此其在静态设定下的实际作用值得怀疑，同时这类设定可能并不适合评估图神经网络中的全局通信。

Method: 作者分析了共享记忆机制与虚拟节点的等价性，并在静态直推式设定下，将直接优化共享记忆的方法与全局通信方法进行对比实验。

Result: 初步证据显示，直接优化共享记忆的表现与全局通信方法相似。

Conclusion: 常规的局部消息传递模型也能在权重中嵌入类似信息，因此静态图直推式设定可能不适合用于评估图神经网络中的全局通信。

Abstract: Scalable Graph Transformers are commonly trained and evaluated on static large graphs in a transductive setup. Many scalable Graph Transformer components can be formulated as a constant-size shared memory, similar to virtual nodes, providing compressed information about the whole graph. The counterpart of these models in language models and other domains is justified as the input changes, and this mechanism learns to compress some useful information about the input. In transductive learning on a single fixed graph, however, any shared memory can be seen as a constant at test time. This raises the question of what exactly this shared memory does in this static setup. We give preliminary evidence that optimizing a shared memory directly performs similarly to global communication methods, and so normal local message-passing models can embed similar information in their weights. Thus, these settings may be a poor fit for evaluating global communication in graph neural networks.

</details>


### [484] [Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06008)
*Noortje I. P. Schueler,Hans van Gorp,Ruud J. G. van Sloun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出检索诱导的潜在转移模型，将超声操作引导建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索，在颈动脉超声上实现86%闭环到达率，无需探头追踪硬件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声采集质量高度依赖操作者经验，而检查需求增长快于熟练技师供给，需要操作引导系统帮助经验较少的用户将探头移动到目标视野。

Method: 用V-JEPA 2.1将观测编码到潜在空间，使解剖相关视野彼此接近；从含编码潜在状态及对应探头位置/姿态的参考数据库中检索相似视野；不学习参数化转移函数，而直接用数据库中物理执行的转移构建非参数检索诱导转移模型，支持滚动时域规划；部署时仅用实时超声图像，无需探头追踪硬件。

Result: 颈动脉超声中，规划器在86%的回顾性闭环尝试中到达目标视野，优于两个基线的52%和43%，并在每个目标视野上均胜出，包括困难的颈内、颈外动脉纵向视野；在未见志愿者上的前瞻可行性研究，用蒸馏在CPU实时运行，达到83%到达率。

Conclusion: 由于规划由与可编码目标潜在的接近度驱动，同一世界模型可导航回任意先前采集的患者特定帧，支持可重复的纵向成像，如围术期或随访监测。

Abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

</details>


### [485] [OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05878)
*Haki Darwish,Xiangyu Yin,Changwen Li,Rongjie Yan,Francisco Gomes de Oliveira Neto,Chih-Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OGAM方法，将系统化测试与运行时保障相连：通过对象掩码投影梯度加权视觉注意力并按指令角色分组，动态时间规整对齐成功参考，结合保形校准设定早停阈值，在四种VLA策略上以3-5%误停率提前拦截87-100%失败回合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略的基准测试仅覆盖少量规范指令，而穷尽式部署测试不可行，因此需要将有限的系统化测试结果转化为可在部署中运行的实时保障机制。作者发现成功与失败执行之间存在注意力差异，希望利用这一信号在有限测试集之外的场景中提前阻止失败。

Method: 通过动作模板与对象的成对组合生成场景化指令，并单独测试保义改述，构建87个基准外用例；在每个动作查询处，将梯度加权视觉注意力投影到对象掩码，并按指令角色分组以跨任务、跨策略比较；用动态时间规整将注意力过程与成功参考对齐以消除速度差异；在成功回合上进行保形校准，设定持续性偏离的早停阈值（名义误停目标α=0.05），无需失败标注训练。

Result: 87个基准外用例在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA和π0.5上均暴露问题行为：无一完成24条可行指令中的任意一条，不可行或危险请求还会触发行为替换。OGAM在四种策略上以5-12秒中位时间、20秒预算内拦截87-100%的失败回合，实测误停率为3-5%。

Conclusion: 有限测试所揭示的注意力模式可支撑在线干预，在失败完全展开之前及时终止，从而把基准测试的诊断发现转化为部署阶段的运行时保障。

Abstract: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.

</details>


### [486] [The Optimization Landscape of Learning Compacted Context Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05885)
*Thomas Villeneuve,Alex Sandomirsky,Charles O'Neill,Max Kirkby,Michael Psenka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究通过KV缓存压缩实现持续学习，指出在冻结基座模型上优化KV压缩存在脆弱的平坦损失景观，并提出一种简化的Perceiver架构在压缩效果上超越完整Perceiver及基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作将持续学习视为无限上下文窗口问题，通过在上下文中放入更多观测（KV缓存）并进行压缩，等同于直接操作记忆而不改变基座模型权重。但把KV压缩当作优化问题、在冻结基座模型上优化小规模KV向量时，优化问题极为困难，损失景观脆弱且平坦，因此需要分析其难点并寻找更有效的架构。

Method: 论文刻画了KV压缩优化问题的困难来源，并提出一种高度简化的基于Perceiver的架构用于连续上下文压缩。

Result: 简化的Perceiver架构在连续上下文压缩上不仅匹配完整Perceiver transformer的性能，还在压缩效用上优于基线方法。结果在Finance、Legal、Gutenberg和Code的MCQ任务上进行了验证。

Conclusion: 在冻结基座模型下进行KV压缩优化困难，而简化架构即可达到甚至超越完整模型与基线的压缩效果，说明架构简化是提升上下文压缩的有效方向。

Abstract: Many works approach continual learning through the lens of infinite context windows. As an agent puts more observation into context (concretely the KV cache), compacting said context is akin to direct memory manipulation, without affecting the base model's weights. Many works pose KV compaction as an optimization problem: learn a smaller set of KV vectors that matches the behavior of the full KV cache. While this preserves base model behavior, optimizing through a frozen base model results in a highly nontrivial optimization problem with a brittle and flat loss landscape. In this paper, we characterize what makes these optimization problems difficult and demonstrate that a heavily simplified Perceiver-based architecture not only matches performance of a full Perceiver transformer in continuous context compaction, but outperforms baselines on compaction utility. Results are presented on MCQ tasks across Finance, Legal, Gutenberg, and Code.

</details>


### [487] [Collaborative Personalized Preference Alignment for LLMs under Data Deficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05898)
*Liyan Yang,Yige Yuan,Zhiqin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出近似帕累托最优（APO）方法，通过用户分组与梯度协调学习共享对齐器初始化，从而在少量样本下实现对异构用户偏好的个性化适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实用户对大模型回复的多目标偏好高度异构，而个性化训练受限于用户反馈稀少。共享初始化可支持少样本适配，但用户间及用户内部的偏好异质性与目标冲突会导致梯度冲突，阻碍有效初始化学习。核心问题是如何协同学习支持多元用户偏好少样本适配的对齐器初始化。

Method: 提出APO方法：首先将更新相互兼容的用户分组，以较少干扰地融合信息；在组内结合梯度下降与受控上升来协调竞争目标，向帕累托前沿上偏好特定的点移动，得到接近组内用户最优解的初始化；随后用少样本本地适配的更新迭代精炼该初始化。理论上建立单步本地协同更新的条件次优性界，并刻画初始化误差对后续随机适配的影响。

Result: 在Fed-ChatbotPA和UltraFeedback数据集上，仅使用20个本地样本，APO相较现有方法取得一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过分组兼容用户、协调竞争目标并精炼初始化，APO能有效协同学习支持异构偏好少样本个性化适配的对齐器初始化，理论与实验均验证其有效性。

Abstract: Real-world users often exhibit highly heterogeneous preferences over multiple objectives for LLM responses. A lightweight aligner can tailor these responses to individual preferences, but scarce user-specific feedback makes personalized training difficult. Learning shared initializations across users can support few-shot adaptation. However, heterogeneous preferences and competing objectives cause gradient conflicts across users and within each user, hindering effective initialization learning. This raises a central question: \textbf{how can we collaboratively learn aligner initializations that support few-shot adaptation to diverse user preferences?} To answer this question, we propose \textbf{A}pproximate \textbf{P}areto \textbf{O}ptimality (APO). We first group users whose updates are compatible, so that their information can be combined with less interference. Within each group, we combine gradient descent with controlled ascent to coordinate competing objectives and move towards preference-specific points on the Pareto front. This produces an initialization that is close to the optima of the users in the group. We then iteratively refine it using updates from few-shot local adaptation, making it more effective for personalization. Furthermore, we establish conditional suboptimality bounds for a one-local-step collaborative update and characterize how initialization error affects subsequent stochastic adaptation. Experiments on Fed-ChatbotPA and UltraFeedback show consistent improvements over existing methods using only 20 local examples.

</details>


### [488] [Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06195)
*Akshay Chandrasekhar,Pavlo Melnyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"被动探针"（固定、未训练、与属性无关的投影）来观察训练过程中神经表示结构的变化，并在回归任务与分类任务中揭示"可达性"与"可恢复性"的演化差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络学到的特征表示往往包含超出最终任务输出所直接使用的额外结构。已有探针（如学习的线性探针）会随训练自适应，难以区分表示本身的变化与探针的适应，因此需要一种不随训练变化、与被研究属性无关的观察手段。

Method: 从 S^2 上的预测任务出发，利用向量参数化与 Hermitian 参数化的等价性发现一个额外的、对损失不变的迹坐标；由此构造通用方法：用固定的随机投影作为"被动探针"（观测者）作用于训练中不断演化的表示。由于观测者与损失、属性无关，可达性的变化反映的是表示相对于固定观测者的变化，而非观测者自身的适应。进一步用被动探针的集成来反映目标对齐等任务相关信息。

Result: 被动探针的集成可直接反映目标对齐等任务相关信息；最终难度的可达性在不同任务中演化方式不同——在表面法向估计和图像修复等回归任务中随训练上升，而在图像分类中基本保持在初始水平。与学习型线性探针的对比表明，可恢复性与被动可达性在训练中可以有不同的演化轨迹。

Conclusion: 被动探针能够分别刻画表示几何的变化与最终任务难度的可达性，为理解神经网络表示中超越直接任务输出的结构提供了新的分析工具。

Abstract: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.

</details>


### [489] [LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06226)
*Benjamin Robson,Santeri Mentu,Wenshuai Zhao,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LeAVJEPA，首个在LeJEPA无塌缩目标下训练的音频-视觉编码器，架构简单却性能强劲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频-视觉自监督方法依赖EMA目标编码器、预测头、重建解码器、对比损失等复杂机制，作者希望简化架构并探索无塌缩目标下的音频-视觉对齐。

Method: 采用单一早期融合Vision Transformer处理音频、视频及联合音视频输入；将模态dropout视为同一事件的另一视图，使跨模态对齐隐含于目标中；对齐全局嵌入与模态特定的局部嵌入，并用SIGReg防止表示塌缩。

Result: 冻结评估下AudioSet-20K达36.0 mAP，ESC-50达91.3%准确率；微调后VGGSound达61.1%准确率；嵌入可支持零样本音视频检索。受控消融表明模态dropout是音视频对齐的关键机制。

Conclusion: LeAVJEPA以极简架构实现了有效的音频-视觉自监督学习，模态dropout是核心对齐机制，且嵌入具有良好的下游与零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

</details>


### [490] [CoHyFuse: Condition-wise Hypergraph Fusion with Global Connectome in Task-fMRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05913)
*Boseong Kim,Haejun Chung,Ikbeom Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件感知的ROI中心超图框架CoHyFuse，用任务态特异性关联矩阵刻画同一ROI在不同任务阶段形成的多ROI超边，融合全时段FC分支进行预测，在认知与年龄预测及ADHD分类任务上取得最佳表现，并提供状态分辨的可解释视图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统任务态fMRI连接组方法将不同条件聚合成静态成对图，边缘化了状态依赖的神经重配置信号，掩盖了条件特异的多ROI组织信息。

Method: 从条件级功能连接（FC）剖面嵌入构建任务态特异性关联矩阵，使同一ROI在不同任务阶段形成不同多ROI超边；用条件特异邻域规模K_q自适应各任务状态的超边尺度；将条件嵌入与互补的整个会话级FC分支融合用于预测。

Result: AABC队列（N=1,074）中FCC预测达7.83±0.10 MAE、0.439±0.026 R²，VISMOTOR年龄预测达7.52±0.37 MAE、0.592±0.022 R²，均为最佳；CMI-HBN ADHD分类（N=223）得72.0±2.1% macro-AUC、74.2±2.9%准确率。消融支持条件级关联构建与双视图融合的贡献；遮挡分析显示Distraction条件为主要驱动，指向SAN–FPN及SAN内超边定义的ROI集模体。

Conclusion: 状态分辨的ROI集合结构提供了超出全时段FC的互补预测信息，该框架为下游队列分析提供了可解释、状态分辨的连接组视角。

Abstract: Task-fMRI connectomes reveal state-dependent neural reconfigurations, yet conventional methods marginalize these signals by aggregating distinct conditions into static pairwise graphs, thereby obscuring condition-specific multi-ROI organization. We introduce CoHyFuse, a condition-aware ROI-centered hypergraph framework that constructs a task-state-specific incidence matrix from condition-wise functional connectivity (FC)-profile embeddings, allowing the same ROI to form different multi-ROI hyperedges across task phases. Condition-specific neighborhood sizes $K_q$ further adapt the hyperedge scale to each task state, and the resulting condition embeddings are fused with a complementary whole-session FC branch for prediction. In the AABC cohort (N=1,074), CoHyFuse achieved the best mean out-of-fold predictive performance among evaluated baselines on FACENAME Fluid Cognition Composite (FCC) prediction (7.83$\pm$0.10 MAE, 0.439$\pm$0.026 \(R^2\)) and VISMOTOR age prediction (7.52$\pm$0.37 MAE, 0.592$\pm$0.022 \(R^2\)). In an auxiliary CMI-HBN attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) classification benchmark (N=223), CoHyFuse obtained 72.0$\pm$2.1\% macro-AUC and 74.2$\pm$2.9\% accuracy. Ablation studies support the contributions of condition-wise incidence construction and dual-view fusion, suggesting that state-resolved ROI-set structure provides complementary predictive information beyond whole-session FC alone. Occlusion analysis identifies the Distraction condition as the primary driver of model prediction, pointing toward the Salience/Ventral Attention Network (SAN)--FrontoParietal Network (FPN) and within-SAN hyperedge-defined ROI-set motifs as candidate model-relevant patterns. This framework provides an interpretable, state-resolved view of the connectome for downstream cohort analysis.

</details>


### [491] [Improving Proactive AI Assistance with Hierarchical Procedural Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06505)
*Jin-Seop Lee,TaeYeon Won,SeongJun Jung,JungHoon Kim,Boyang Albert Li,Jin-Young Park,Jaehong Yoon,Jee-Hyong Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProactiveCoach套件，包含训练数据集ProactiveCoach-Instruct、评测基准ProactiveCoachBench以及带自适应引导系统的微调VLM，通过层次化引导（阶段、步骤、动作三级）提升主动AI助手在合适时机提供合适粒度引导的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动AI助手需持续观察用户活动并决定是否提供引导，要求引导内容恰当、时机合理、粒度适应用户专业水平与需求。但现有数据集要么只做基于检测的主动理解，要么只提供固定粒度的过程引导，缺乏细粒度进度与全局过程语境信息，难以判断任务完成度并自适应调整引导粒度。

Method: 构建ProactiveCoach套件：ProactiveCoach-Instruct用于训练，提供阶段、步骤、动作三个层级的层次化结构引导；ProactiveCoachBench用于评测，考察模型是否在不同引导层级、正确时机提供恰当引导及在请求层级变化时能否适应。在ProactiveCoach-Instruct上微调预训练VLM，并结合轻量级引导路由器构建自适应引导系统。

Result: 在多个骨干模型上，层次化监督相比固定粒度监督将整体性能最多提升9.6%p；结合微调模型与轻量级引导路由器构建的自适应系统，无需额外微调，在四种引导层级转换上比上下文适配基线高出57.1%p。

Conclusion: 层次化、多粒度的引导数据与评测能有效支撑主动AI助手的学习与评估，自适应引导系统可显著提升跨引导层级的适配能力。

Abstract: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent. They should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user's expertise and needs. Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs. However, existing datasets either focus on detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity. Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion and adapt guidance granularity. To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels for learning task progress and procedural context. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and adapt when the requested level changes. We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across backbones. Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision improves overall performance across backbones by up to 9.6%p. We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router. Without additional fine-tuning, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p across four guidance-level transitions. Our project page is available at https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/.

</details>


### [492] [Large Stepsizes Federated Learning on Logistic Regression with Linearly Separable Data: The Case of Heterogeneous Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05915)
*Hok Fong Wong,Hoi-To Wai,Chung-Yiu Yau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在可分数据下，FedAvg 对任意步长（包括任意大步长）和异构本地更新次数均稳定，目标值以 O(1/R) 收敛到零，且设备异构的负面影响随通信轮数增加而渐近消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FedAvg 在实际中常使用大步长和异构本地更新次数，但已有的分布式学习收敛性分析多局限于小步长或同构更新规则，缺乏对任意大步长与异构更新场景下稳定性和收敛性的理论保证，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 针对带有 FedAvg 的多项式逻辑回归分布式学习问题，考虑任意大步长以及设备每轮本地更新次数可不同的异构更新规则，在线性可分数据假设下对该算法进行理论分析。

Result: 在线性可分数据下，FedAvg 对任意步长均稳定，目标值以 O(1/R) 的速率收敛到零（R 为通信轮数）；设备异构的影响渐近消失；当 R 足够大时目标值单调下降，并被 O(1/(R T_avg)) 界约束，其中 T_avg 为各设备每轮本地更新的平均步数。数值实验验证了上述结论。

Conclusion: 研究从理论上刻画了 FedAvg 在可分数据、任意大步长和异构更新下的收敛行为，表明算法具有良好的稳定性与设备异构鲁棒性，收敛速率由通信轮数和平均本地更新步数共同决定。

Abstract: This paper revisits the distributed learning problem for training a multinomial logistic regression model with the Federated Averaging ($\texttt{FedAvg}$) algorithm. We concentrate on a scenario with arbitrarily large stepsizes and heterogeneous update rules where the devices may perform a different number of local updates in each round. We show that, with linearly separable data, $\texttt{FedAvg}$ is stable with any stepsizes and the objective values converge to zero at the rate of ${\cal O}(1/R)$, where $R$ is the number of communication rounds. Our result also demonstrates that the effects of device heterogeneity vanish asymptotically. For sufficiently large $R$, the objective values decrease monotonically and is bounded by ${\cal O}( 1 / (R T_{\rm avg}))$, where $T_{\rm avg}$ is the average number of local update steps per communication round across devices. Numerical experiments support our findings.

</details>


### [493] [Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06674)
*Srija Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个联合建模Black Marble M波段与日夜波段（DNB）信号的机器学习框架，构建可跨区域、季节、异常类别且覆盖陆地与海洋的泛化异常检测器集成，提升火情、火山喷发和天然气火炬等异常事件的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NASA Black Marble产品可捕获火灾、火山喷发、天然气火炬等异常事件的热与光辐射信号，但现有检测方法主要依赖热波段，对较弱信号的敏感性不足，因此需要一种更敏感的检测方法。

Method: 提出一个机器学习框架，联合建模Black Marble的M波段与日夜波段（DNB）信号，迭代地构建可跨区域、季节、异常类别扩展并覆盖陆地与海洋的检测器集成；根据相关波段与检测器一致性，得出不同置信度水平的检测集合。

Result: 该方法在提高真实检测率的同时减少了虚假检测，结果显示出较强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该框架可应用于自然灾害监测与能源开采等领域，具有较好的通用性与实用价值。

Abstract: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

</details>


### [494] [Non-invasive Seizure Detection Using Wearable Wrist-worn Accelerometry and Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05919)
*Nilushika Udayangani Hewa Dehigahawattage,Kishor Nandakishor,Marimuthu Palaniswami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出基于单腕加速度计的可穿戴癫痫检测系统，采用时序ResNet深度神经网络区分癫痫与非癫痫事件，实现95.65%敏感度与0.15次/24小时误报率，展示长期门诊监测潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有癫痫护理依赖昂贵的视频脑电图（VEEG）监测，需专业人员在医院环境下操作且具有侵入性；而癫痫日记因漏报导致不可靠，可能引发错误的治疗决策。因此需要一种可耐受、可行的长期门诊无创癫痫检测方案。

Method: 招募79名在VEEG监测下的患者佩戴单腕加速度计设备采集数据，由认证癫痫专家审阅同步VEEG记录生成癫痫发作起止与类型注释；基于时间序列ResNet架构构建深度神经网络，用以区分癫痫与非癫痫事件。

Result: 在5576小时总记录评估中，检测敏感度达95.65%，总体误报率为0.15次/24小时；在经历46次惊厥发作的20名患者平均评估中，AUC-ROC为0.98，AUC-PRC为0.67。

Conclusion: 结果表明该系统可有效用于长期门诊癫痫监测；未来需在更大数据集上验证发现，并评估其对其他癫痫类型的检测效用。

Abstract: Seizure monitoring and detection are crucial for reducing the morbidity and mortality associated with seizures. Current epilepsy care, often involving expensive video-electroencephalography (VEEG) monitoring, requires specialized expertise and is limited to in-hospital settings, and intrusive in nature. Seizure diaries, on the other hand, suffer from unreliability due to under-reporting, leading to incorrect therapeutic decisions. Wearable non-invasive seizure detection may offer a more tolerable and feasible solution for long-term ambulatory monitoring. This study explores a wearable remote monitoring system utilizing a single wrist-worn accelerometer device and capable of detecting multiple types of seizures, including shorter duration events. We enrolled 79 patients under video-electroencephalography monitoring to wear accelerometer devices and collect data. Concurrent VEEG recordings were reviewed by board-certified epileptologists to produce annotations, including seizure onset, offset, and seizure type. Using this data, we constructed a deep neural network based on the time-series ResNet architecture, which could discriminate among seizure and non-seizure events. Our proposed approach achieved a seizure detection sensitivity of 95.65% and an overall false alarm rate of 0.15/24 hours during the evaluation, which spanned 5576 hours of total recording. Additionally, it resulted in an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.98 and an area under the precision-re call curve (AUC-PRC) of 0.67 when averaged over 20 patients who experienced 46 convulsive seizures. These promising results suggest that the proposed seizure detection system can be effectively used for long-term ambulatory seizure monitoring. Future steps include validating our findings in larger datasets and assessing the utility of detection for additional seizure types.

</details>


### [495] [The Arbitrary-Placement Problem in Entropy-Minimizing Selection, and a Residual-Entropy Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05925)
*Alyssa H. Shin,Claire H. Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"残差熵"$D=H(p_A)-H(p_\beta)$，用于解决基于熵的选择目标只奖励"自信"而不关心候选是否具有信息量的问题，并给出其理论性质与多场景实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最小化Shannon熵$H(p_A)$存在根本性退化：它只奖励自信的选择，而不区分被选中的候选是否真正具有信息量。因此需要一个既能保证选择安全、又能判断选择是否具有信息量的准则。

Method: 提出残差熵$D=H(p_A)-H(p_\beta)$，其中$p_\beta$由候选信任权重诱导。证明恒等式$D=-\mathrm{KL}(p_A\|p_\beta)-\Delta$，其中$\Delta$度量分数诱导分布与信任分布是否偏好相同候选；分析均匀信任、one-hot极限等边界情形；在中间选择区间，证明当信任排序与信息量排序成对一致时$D\leq0$，并给出基于领先候选优势的紧致证书。方法不依赖具体候选打分函数，适用于静态与动态信息。

Result: 基于梯度的专家混合路由器实验表明排序条件在真实优化中可以成立，正确排序在候选不可互换且选择结果被直接使用（而非平均）时提升下游性能；边际重加权在类别不平衡任务中匹配或超越固定强度基线；在生产级视频预测系统中，信息性选择使MSE降低约20%，并可迁移到相近物种。

Conclusion: 残差熵为选择提供了一种安全性判据，同时可作为判断选择是否具有信息量的可用信号。

Abstract: Entropy-based selection objectives suffer from a fundamental degeneracy: minimizing Shannon entropy $H(p_A)$ rewards confident selection regardless of whether the selected candidate is informative. We address this limitation with the residual entropy $D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)$, where $p_β$ is induced by candidate trust weights. We prove the exact identity $D = -\mathrm{KL}(p_A\Vert p_β) - Δ$, where $Δ$ measures whether the score-induced distribution and trust profile favor the same candidates. Boundary cases establish basic safety: under uniform trust, $D\leq0$ automatically, so an equal-trust, non-starving state is never penalized, while at any one-hot limit, $D\to0$ regardless of the selected candidate. For the intermediate regime where selection occurs, we prove that $D\leq0$ when candidate ordering by trust agrees pairwise with ordering by informativeness, and derive a tighter certificate based on the leading candidate's margin over its competitors. These results are independent of the candidate-scoring function and apply to both stationary and dynamically changing information. Experiments with a gradient-based mixture-of-experts router confirm that the ordering conditions can hold during real optimization and show that correct ordering improves downstream performance when candidates are non-interchangeable and selections are used directly rather than averaged. Beyond routing, margin-based reweighting matches or outperforms fixed-strength baselines in a class-imbalance task, while informative selection in a production video-prediction system reduces MSE by approximately 20$\%$ and transfers to a related species. Residual entropy, therefore, provides a safety criterion for selection and a usable signal for deciding when that selection is informative.

</details>


### [496] [ThunderSyncRL: Lossless Acceleration of Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05935)
*Seil Kang,Hangoo Kang,Tarun Suresh,Youngeun Kim,Shreyas Pimpalgaonkar,Seong Jae Hwang,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ThunderSyncRL，通过梯度流式（gradient streaming）技术，在无策略陈旧性（zero policy staleness）的前提下，让 GRPO 和 OPD 训练的梯度计算与 rollout、验证、工具调用重叠，加速训练至多 1.9 倍并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练语言模型智能体需要长且异构的轨迹，同步训练系统会让学习引擎在 rollout 和验证完成前一直空闲，产生流水线气泡。异步训练虽能重叠计算，但会引入策略陈旧性（policy staleness）问题。因此需要一种既消除流水线气泡又不引入策略陈旧性的方案。

Method: 提出 ThunderSyncRL：一旦所有必需输入确定就立即开始梯度计算，且不产生策略陈旧性。对 GRPO，每条轨迹的分数梯度在其奖励到达时立即计算，无需等待整个组；对 OPD，在每个已完成智能体轮次的教师评分动作上计算梯度，同时工具调用在沙箱中并行运行。论文证明了梯度流式与批同步训练产生相同的 GRPO 和 OPD 更新。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal Bench 4.0 上，训练模型达到相同性能的速度比同步训练快至多 1.9 倍；在零策略陈旧性下，固定预算时性能比异步训练高出至多 2.47 个百分点。

Conclusion: ThunderSyncRL 通过梯度流式实现了无策略陈旧性的高效训练，兼顾同步训练的等价性与异步训练的效率，在性能与速度上均优于现有同步和异步方案。

Abstract: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSyncRL, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness. For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSyncRL computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. We prove that gradient streaming produces the same GRPO and OPD updates as batch-synchronous training, without changing either objective. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal Bench 4.0, we train models to the same performance up to $1.9 \times$ faster than synchronous training. With zero policy staleness, ThunderSyncRL also outperforms asynchronous training at a fixed budget by up to $2.47$ percentage points.

</details>


### [497] [Technical Report on the Turba Fertilizer Machine Learning Stack in Morocco](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05949)
*Abdelghani Belgaid,Zakaria Mahmoud,Fahd Chibani,Oumnia Ennaji,Younes Boudoul,Dounia Rachid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该技术报告提出了Turba肥料机器学习栈，一个面向摩洛哥可复现的站点特定施肥推荐的三层开源实现，包含客户端接口、数据集和模型包三个组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有站点特定施肥推荐系统虽能根据位置、土壤、作物和目标产量适配养分建议，但由于推荐功能主要依赖交互界面、输出缺乏版本管理、训练后的近似模型无法独立加载或基准测试，导致科学复用受限。

Method: 构建三层架构：turba-client提供对站点档案、作物目标产量空间及N、P2O5、K2O推荐流程的编程访问；turba-data分发分析就绪的快照；turba-models打包作物特定的机器学习代理模型。基于44,096个ESA WorldCereal位置构建首个数据集，在中等目标产量设定下扩展生成132,017条作物-位置推荐请求，形成涵盖10个地区、66个省、1,149个乡镇的22变量数据集，并在固定确定性80/20协议下评估九类回归模型。

Result: 生成22变量数据集，覆盖10个地区、66个省、1,149个乡镇；评估九类回归家族，当前版本打包了五种表现最佳的作物特定模型。

Conclusion: 该机器学习任务本质是推荐函数仿真而非观测作物响应预测。该栈为空间与时间验证、不确定性估计、田间试验对比及未来数据集成提供了可复现的基础。

Abstract: Site-specific fertilizer recommendation systems adapt nutrient advice to location, soil properties, crop type, and production targets, but scientific reuse is constrained when recommendation functions remain accessible mainly through interactive interfaces, outputs are not versioned, and trained approximations cannot be independently loaded or benchmarked. This technical report presents the Turba fertilizer machine learning stack, a three-layer open-source implementation for reproducible site-specific fertilizer recommendation in Morocco. \texttt{turba-client} provides programmatic access to publicly accessible site profiles, crop-specific target-yield spaces, and N, P$_2$O$_5$, and K$_2$O recommendation workflows; \texttt{turba-data} distributes analysis-ready snapshots; and \texttt{turba-models} packages crop-specific machine learning surrogates of recommendation outputs. The architecture links upstream retrieval, versioned analytical snapshots, reproducible cross-model benchmarking, and loadable offline surrogates while preserving the distinction between recommendation-system outputs, observed agricultural data, and model-generated predictions. The first dataset was constructed from 44,096 unique ESA WorldCereal locations. Scenario expansion across supported cereal workflows generated 132,017 crop-location recommendation requests under a medium target-yield setting. The resulting 22-variable dataset spans 10 regions, 66 provinces, and 1,149 communes. Nine regression families were evaluated under a fixed deterministic 80/20 protocol, and the current release packages five best-performing crop-specific models. The machine learning task is recommendation-function emulation rather than prediction of observed crop response. The stack provides a reproducible basis for spatial and temporal validation, uncertainty estimation, field-trial comparison, and future integration with additional data.

</details>


### [498] [Discovered, Not Designed: Population Evolution for Collaborative and Compute-Intensive Model Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05950)
*Bo Peng,Lizhu Zhang,Yuhang Zhou,Mingyi Wang,Yifan Wu,Serena Li,Xiangjun Fan,Zhuokai Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Population Evolution（PE）分层协同进化框架，通过共享实验证据连接局部搜索，并构建 RMD-Bench 验证其在推荐、RL 算法发现及 LLM/VLM 预训练等多任务上的迁移性与昂贵训练下的持续改进能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 驱动的进化能实现迭代式模型开发，但两个实际目标仍未被充分探索：找到可跨相关任务迁移的模型设计，以及在训练代价高昂时仍能持续改进。

Method: PE 为协作式分层框架：跨相关训练实例评估代码改动并共享结果，以指导后续提案与向更大训练规模的晋升；针对昂贵目标，先在小训练子集上搜索，并通过同伴评估与中间评估筛选候选，再进行全目标训练。同时提出 RMD-Bench 用于评测，覆盖排序、观看时长预测、RL 算法发现与 LLM/VLM 预训练。

Result: 在匹配源迭代次数下，PE 将排序任务平均最优局部增益从 7.01% 提升至 8.97%，观看时长从 2.84% 提升至 3.85%，并在三个联合发现族中均改善最优大规模结果；观看时长发现中五套 harness 有四套、四个 proposer 全部受益。共享目标侧校准下，新推荐数据集上所有 PE 设计均优于参考。匹配总 GPU 算力时，LLM 发现最优相对精度增益 2.48%、13 个成功候选，而直接进化仅 0.92%、无成功候选；VLM 损失下降 8.78% 对比 5.05%。

Conclusion: PE 通过共享实验证据与分层筛选，在跨任务迁移和昂贵训练场景下均优于独立进化，验证了协作式种群进化与相应基准的有效性。

Abstract: LLM-driven evolution enables iterative model development, but two practical goals remain underexplored: finding model designs that transfer across related tasks and sustaining improvement when training is expensive. We introduce Population Evolution (PE), a collaborative, hierarchical framework that connects ongoing local searches through shared experimental evidence. PE evaluates code changes across related training instances and shares the results to guide subsequent proposals and promotion to larger training scales. For expensive targets, PE searches small training subsets and screens candidates through peer and intermediate evaluations before full-target training. We introduce RMD-Bench to evaluate both settings across ranking, watch-time prediction, RL algorithm discovery, and LLM/VLM pretraining. Compared with standalone evolution at matched source iterations, PE raises mean best local gains from 7.01% to 8.97% in ranking and from 2.84% to 3.85% in watch-time, while improving the best larger-scale outcome in all three joint-discovery families. In watch-time discovery, PE improves best larger-scale gains with four of five harnesses and all four proposers. On new recommendation datasets under shared target-side calibration, every evaluated PE design improves over the reference in mean performance. Under matched total GPU compute, completed LLM discovery runs yield a best relative accuracy gain of 2.48% and 13 successful candidates for PE, versus 0.92% and none for direct evolution. VLM loss reduction reaches 8.78% versus 5.05% under matched total GPU compute.

</details>


### [499] [Physics-Informed but Not Physics-Consistent: Error Geometry and Subspace Projection for Neural AC Power Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05959)
*Changhun Kim,Timon Conrad,Redwanul Karim,Karan Pahlajani,Julian Oelhaf,David Riebesel,Tomás Arias-Vergara,Andreas Maier,Johann Jäger,Siming Bayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 神经潮流求解器电压预测准确但物理一致性不足；提出CSP方法压缩非子空间误差，显著降低功率平衡残差并提升电压精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经潮流求解器（含基础模型）电压预测精度高，但小电压误差会导致较大AC功率平衡残差，存在"精度—一致性"差距，需研究其误差几何特性。

Method: 在2224节点GBnetwork及GridSFM跨31系统评测PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit、LUMINA；用训练集AC解拟合SVD基，发现误差含大量非主子空间成分；提出校准解子空间投影（CSP），经训练集偏置校准后抑制非子空间分量。

Result: 相对校准后预测，CSP使四模型Mean PB分别降低67.0%、37.8%、40.5%、68.9%，且四模型电压幅值精度均提升。

Conclusion: 输出误差几何是物理一致神经AC潮流的关键因素，CSP有效缩小精度—一致性差距。

Abstract: Recent neural power-flow solvers, including emerging foundation models, achieve accurate voltage predictions, yet such accuracy does not necessarily imply physically consistent solutions. Even small complex voltage errors can yield large AC power-balance residuals. We study this accuracy-consistency gap across PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA on realistic 2224-bus Great Britain network (GBnetwork) scenarios, with cross-grid evaluation of GridSFM over 31 systems. Using a singular value decomposition (SVD) basis fitted to training AC power-flow solutions, we find that neural prediction errors contain substantial components outside the dominant solution subspace. To address this mismatch, calibrated solution-subspace projection (CSP) suppresses off-subspace prediction components after train-only bias calibration, reducing Mean PB by 67.0%, 37.8%, 40.5%, and 68.9% for PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA, respectively, relative to calibrated predictions, while improving voltage-magnitude accuracy in all four models. These results identify output-error geometry as an important factor in physics-consistent neural AC power flow. Code: https://github.com/Kimchangheon/neural-acpf-error-geometry

</details>


### [500] [Strategic Multi-Agent Learning for Interpretable Action Valuation of All Players in Football](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05961)
*Kenjiro Ide,Taiga Someya,Kohei Kawaguchi,Keisuke Fujii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种受马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE）启发的足球球员动作价值评估框架，将每次控球建模为有限期动态博弈，每位球员视为自主智能体，并用可扩展决策状态（EDMS）与线性奖励权重分解Q值以增强可解释性。基于95场J1联赛数据与独立强化学习基线对比，结果显示所提方法产生更具情境敏感性的动作排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 足球动作价值评估需考虑22名球员之间的策略互动，包括无球跑动与防守站位。现有基于强化学习的方法多在球队层面聚合决策或独立估计球员价值，导致球员间的策略相互依赖表征不足。

Method: 将每次控球建模为有限期动态博弈，每名球员为依赖当前状态的自主智能体；以MPE作为启发性求解概念而非精确均衡；采用可扩展决策状态（EDMS）并将Q值分解为后继特征基与线性奖励权重向量，价值基通过线性TD初始化后非线性精化。使用95场J1联赛的追踪与事件数据，与独立强化学习基线对比。

Result: 两种形式的TD误差目标空间不同，故TD MSE仅用于形式内一致性检验。固定EDMS时，独立基线在99.21%的被评估无球状态下给前向移动赋值最高，而所提框架下最高频方向仅占17.63%。球队层面平均Q值与赛季期望进球的关联：基线为负相关，所提框架为弱正相关。定性分析展示了无球跑动与防守站位的情境依赖估值。

Conclusion: 所提框架产生更具情境敏感性的动作排序，但该对比并未单独分离出MPE启发组分的贡献。

Abstract: Valuing player actions in football requires accounting for strategic interactions among 22 players, including off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Existing reinforcement-learning-based methods commonly aggregate decisions at the team level or estimate player values independently, leaving strategic interdependence among players insufficiently represented. This study proposes an action valuation framework inspired by Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) for all players. Each possession is modeled as a finite-horizon dynamic game, with each player represented as an autonomous agent whose policy depends on the current game state. MPE is used as a motivating solution concept rather than an exact equilibrium. To improve interpretability, we use Expandable Decision-Making States (EDMS) and decompose the Q-value into a successor-feature basis and a linear reward-weight vector. The value basis is estimated by linear TD initialization followed by nonlinear refinement. Using tracking and event data from 95 J1 League matches, we compare the proposed formulation with an independent reinforcement learning baseline. Because the two formulations define TD errors in different target spaces, TD MSE is used only for within-formulation consistency. With EDMS fixed, the independent baseline assigns the highest value to forward movement in 99.21% of evaluated off-ball states, whereas the most frequent direction under the proposed formulation accounts for 17.63%. Team-level average Q-values show a negative association with season-level expected goals for the baseline and a weakly positive association for the proposed formulation. Qualitative analyses illustrate context-dependent valuations of off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Overall, the proposed formulation produces more context-sensitive action rankings, although the comparison does not isolate the MPE-inspired component.

</details>


### [501] [Fast Last-Iterate Convergence in Zero-Sum Markov Games with Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05968)
*Yuheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究未知双人零和折扣马尔可夫博弈中的末次迭代收敛问题，在bandit反馈下提出自适应正则化TD学习算法（ARTD），实现了$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/4})$的对偶间隙界，显著优于此前最优的$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/(9+\nu)})$速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在bandit反馈下，玩家独立沿单条轨迹学习且无法观测对方动作，此前方法（如Cai等2023）的收敛速率较慢（$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/(9+\nu)})$），亟需更快且无需先验知识的算法。

Method: 提出自适应正则化TD学习（ARTD）：将快速时序差分平均与有界值更新分离以稳定策略学习；自适应地将log-barrier正则化与值估计进展同步，控制学习过程中的策略误差与值误差；算法无需知道命中时间界、时间范围和置信水平。

Result: 在均匀命中时间假设下，ARTD对当前策略实现了$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/4})$的对偶间隙界，且以高概率对所有轮次和起始状态同时成立，改进了Cai等（2023）在相同反馈模型与假设下任意固定$\nu>0$时的$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/(9+\nu)})$速率。

Conclusion: 通过分离快速TD平均与有界值更新、并使log-barrier正则化自适应于值估计进展，ARTD在玩家独立从bandit反馈学习的条件下仍能实现所玩策略的快速收敛。

Abstract: We study last-iterate convergence in unknown two-player zero-sum discounted Markov games with bandit feedback. The players learn independently along a single trajectory without observing each other's actions. We develop Adaptive Regularized TD Learning (ARTD), which achieves a $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/4})$ duality gap bound for the current policies under a uniform hitting time assumption, with high probability simultaneously over all rounds and starting states. This improves the $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/(9+ν)})$ rate of Cai et al. (2023), for any fixed $ν>0$, under the same feedback model and hitting time assumption. Our algorithm requires no knowledge of the hitting time bound, the time horizon, or the confidence level. To stabilize policy learning as value estimates change, we separate fast temporal difference averaging from bounded value updates. We adapt log-barrier regularization to the progress of value estimation, controlling both policy and value errors throughout learning. Together, these mechanisms enable fast convergence of the policies actually played, even when the players learn independently from bandit feedback.

</details>


### [502] [Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05969)
*Hikmet Simsir,Kutay Demiray,Ozgur S. Oguz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RADPO，一种无模型的安全感知扩散策略优化方法，将预测性首达安全估计与累积成本预算反馈结合，无需动力学模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续控制强化学习中，扩散策略能提供表达性强的动作分布，但安全感知的在线扩散策略优化仍研究不足，尤其是无需显式动力学模型、利用预测可达性信息的方法缺乏。

Method: RADPO学习折扣首达可达性价值，捕捉成本事件的折扣风险并对更早事件赋予更大权重，用于塑形奖励；用类似对偶的乘子根据实际回合成本相对预设预算调整塑形强度；扩散actor通过对reward critic评分的候选动作进行加权去噪回归来改进。方法无需学习动力学模型、无需通过critic的动作梯度、也无需对反向扩散采样器求导。

Result: 在十个连续控制安全任务上，RADPO取得有竞争力的奖励-成本权衡，在多个任务上相比基线显著减少约束违反。理论上证明了可达性价值的性质，并表明累积可达性惩罚是未来折扣累积成本的保守替代。

Conclusion: 理论与实证分析支持将可达性与累积预算反馈结合是构建安全感知扩散策略的可行途径。

Abstract: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

</details>


### [503] [Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation for RL-Improved Reasoning Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05974)
*Xiaoyu Chen,Bo Shao,Tiangang Zhu,Bintao Wu,Linjun Shou,Fengge Wu,Feng Sun,Wenbiao Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究探讨强化学习改进的教师在蒸馏到小模型时哪些收益能够迁移，提出TS-OPD方法，通过按学生与教师联合采样成功率筛选问题并路由到不同KL目标，取得最佳宏平均正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习能显著提升推理教师模型，但教师提升在监督更小的在线策略学生时哪些能保留尚不明确。核心问题是知识迁移是结构化而非标量的：仅靠教师更强并不足以让稠密蒸馏具备竞争力，而RL改进的教师带来的学生收益又依赖于具体指标，因此需要一个考虑迁移性的蒸馏框架。

Method: 在数学推理任务中比较GRPO前后的教师谱系、多种学生规模、直接GRPO以及多种在线策略蒸馏目标。据此提出Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD)：按学生和教师的联合采样成功率筛选训练问题，将"习得类"问题路由到带门控的前向KL，将"巩固类"问题路由到带门控的反向KL，并加入熵刹车以保护采样覆盖。

Result: 在主要对比中，配合GRPO改进的教师，TS-OPD在宏平均正确率上是最强的学生目标，但pass@K表现较为参差。消融实验表明收益来自路由与token门控，而非跳过问题本身。

Conclusion: 结果支持一种迁移感知的在线策略蒸馏视角：更强的教师只有在监督方向和token预算与学生已展现的能力相匹配时才有帮助，而非仅因教师端点更强。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can substantially improve a reasoning teacher, but it is unclear which of those improvements survive when the teacher supervises a smaller on-policy student. We study this question in mathematical reasoning by comparing teacher lineages before and after GRPO, multiple student scales, direct GRPO, and several on-policy distillation objectives. The central finding is that transfer is structured rather than scalar: teacher strength alone does not make dense distillation competitive, while an RL-improved teacher creates useful but metric-dependent student gains. This motivates Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD), which screens training problems by the joint sampled success of the student and teacher, routes acquisition problems to gated forward KL, routes consolidation problems to gated reverse KL, and adds an entropy brake to protect sampled coverage. Across the main comparison, TS-OPD is the strongest student objective for macro average correctness with the GRPO-improved teacher, while pass@K remains more mixed. Ablations show that the gains come from routing and token gating rather than skipping problems. These results support a transfer-aware view of OPD: stronger teachers help when the supervision direction and token budget match the student's observed ability, not merely because the teacher endpoint is stronger.

</details>


### [504] [StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05977)
*Zhe Wei,Mengqi Guo,Yuan Yuan,Jiunn Bin Lim,Boyi Pan,Michael Bi Mi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StagQ是一种多精度权重量化格式，通过2-bit分组仿射基流加可配置1-bit细化平面实现多精度前缀解码，并用稀疏侧记录补偿最差权重，在多个LLM上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模部署LLM时，需要在多台设备上支持多种权重精度工作点。若为每种精度分别存储模型副本，存储开销巨大。因此需要一个单一的权重流，其前缀即可作为更低精度的有效编码，从而用一种存储支持所有精度。

Method: 提出StagQ多精度权重格式：主流为2-bit分组仿射基，后接可配置数量的1-bit细化平面，采用二进步进计划。每个支持的精度都是可读前缀，通过所有精度共享的元数据导出仿射映射解码，无需逐权重查找表。另设稀疏侧记录，在网格拟合前后填充，保存网格表现最差的少数权重。编码器给出两种配置。

Result: 2-bit时较便宜配置在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4、OLMo-2-7B上领先最强多精度基线3.1至7.0个MMLU点，逻辑速率略低；3-bit时在Llama-3.1-8B领先，Phi-4在更高速率下领先，OLMo-2-7B持平；4-bit时三者持平但速率更高。在NVIDIA A100上batch-one矩阵向量乘积（合成权重计时）中，内核在多数形状-精度情形下快于两个基线内核。

Conclusion: StagQ以单一流前缀支持多精度解码，在低比特下精度优势明显，并具备实际GPU推理加速能力，是存储高效且性能优良的多精度权重方案。

Abstract: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.

</details>


### [505] [EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05996)
*Bowen Feng,Julian Ost,May Mei,Anirudha Majumdar,Felix Heide*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EpicWorldModel，用流匹配目标训练随机 JEPA 世界模型，在部分可观测场景下预测多种未来可能性，并利用流预测方差引导探索，提升潜空间规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 JEPA 的潜世界模型是确定性的，在完全可观测场景中有效，但当历史观测与动作对应多个合理未来（如遮挡）时会失效，因此需要在部分可观测且存在固有不确定性时建模随机性。

Method: 提出 EpicWorldModel 框架：联合训练预测器与潜表示空间，当条件历史缺少目标相关场景内容时，用流匹配目标直接预测多个潜在未来状态；将流预测方差（与预测熵上界相关）作为探索信号，融入基于 CEM 的规划。

Result: 在一系列潜空间规划实验中取得最佳或同等性能，相较 LeWorldModel 成功率最多提升 22%。

Conclusion: 随机 JEPA 结合流匹配与方差引导探索，可在部分可观测且不确定环境中有效平衡目标达成与探索，为潜世界模型规划提供可行方案。

Abstract: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

</details>


### [506] [Langevin Flow Maps: Efficient Molecular Dynamics and Transition Path Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05998)
*Sam McCallum,Niklas Rindtorff,Alexander Tong,James Foster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Langevin Flow Maps，将机器学习力场扩展为同时学习随机Langevin积分器，实现大时间步分子动力学模拟，速度比现有机器学习力场快一个数量级，并能恢复系统准确的动力学性质，同时展示了可迁移Langevin Flow Maps的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子动力学模拟需在众多飞秒级小时间步上积分Langevin方程，难以估计长时标的系综性质与转移动力学。

Method: 将机器学习力场扩展为额外学习随机Langevin积分器，即Langevin Flow Maps，并在多样化分子数据集上训练。

Result: Langevin Flow Maps支持大时间步分子动力学，能恢复系统准确的动力学性质，运行速度比现有机器学习力场快一个数量级；在多样化分子数据集上训练展示了可迁移性的路径。

Conclusion: Langevin Flow Maps通过将机器学习力场与随机Langevin积分器结合，实现了快速且动力学准确的大时间步分子动力学模拟，并具备可迁移潜力。

Abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations proceed by integrating the Langevin equations over many small femtosecond timesteps. This poses a challenge for estimating ensemble properties and transition dynamics that occur on much longer timescales. We introduce Langevin Flow Maps, which extend machine-learned force-fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator. We show that Langevin Flow Maps enable large-timestep molecular dynamics and recover accurate dynamical properties of the system, while running an order of magnitude faster than current machine-learned force fields. Further, by training on a diverse molecular dataset, we demonstrate a path towards transferable Langevin Flow Maps.

</details>


### [507] [Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06006)
*Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究上下文排队老虎机（Contextual Queueing Bandits, CQB）问题，提出 WISE 算法，在不需已知时间范围、不需协方差下界的条件下实现速率最优的队列长度遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有衰减型遗憾保证要么衰减速率次优，要么需要已知固定时间范围，并且假设逐上下文松弛（context-wise slack）和特征协方差严格正的最小特征值。作者希望放宽这些假设并达到速率最优的遗憾。

Method: 提出 WISE（Widest Interval Selection with Elimination）算法。分析上引入"工作量势"（workload potential），衡量等待作业在最优服务器上所需的期望服务次数；其漂移通过容量松弛保证负项，并结合次优服务选择的误差。再用椭圆势计数界定 WISE 选择宽置信区间的频率，从而限制服务误差大的轮数。假设上只要求容量松弛（capacity slack），不设协方差下界。

Result: WISE 在每个足够大的时刻 t 达到速率最优的 $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ 队列长度遗憾，且无需知道时间范围。作者还改进了现有下界对到达率的依赖，并显式给出其对特征维度和服务器数量的依赖；另证明了一个新的下界，量化了归一化容量松弛减小时遗憾的增加，这是 CQB 中首个此类下界。仿真显示即使逐上下文松弛失败，遗憾仍很小。

Conclusion: WISE 在更弱假设（仅容量松弛、无协方差下界、未知时间范围）下实现速率最优的队列长度遗憾，并首次给出了容量松弛对遗憾影响的下界，扩展了 CQB 的理论保证。

Abstract: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Widest Interval Selection with Elimination), achieving rate-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ queue length regret at every sufficiently large time without knowing the horizon. We assume capacity slack, meaning that expected incoming workload under best-server service is below service capacity, and impose no covariance lower bound. Our analysis uses a workload potential measuring the expected service attempts needed by waiting jobs on their best servers. Its drift on nonempty rounds combines a negative term ensured by capacity slack with errors from suboptimal service choices. Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.

</details>


### [508] [Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06012)
*Giulio Viganò,Simone Melzi,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从谱几何与算子理论视角研究Transformer注意力，提出Token Difference Operator，并基于内在概率几何区分sink效应与真实路由能力，进而提出一种注意力不确定性估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准欧氏谱受sink偏置影响，将质量集中与真实路由能力混为一谈，缺乏统一理论框架同时解释sink、路由坍塌与输出维度。

Method: 将每个注意力头视为token序列上函数Hilbert空间之间的泛函映射，推导Token Difference Operator；并利用注意力诱导的内在概率几何重构token空间。

Result: 内在概率几何下的token difference谱可解耦sink效应与路由能力，谱结构描述头输出维度；所提注意力不确定性估计器可与基于概率的分数互补，在长上下文输入上增益最大。

Conclusion: 该工作为分析注意力图提供统一算子论框架，连接谱几何与注意力启发式，并衍生实用的不确定性估计方法。

Abstract: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.

</details>


### [509] [Adaptive Expert Guidance for Efficient On-Policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06019)
*Daniele Affinita,Ming Xu,Rudolf Reiter,Davide Scaramuzza,Pascal Fua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种让学习者和次优专家在每个训练回合内交替控制的方法，将专家控制占比设为与策略联合优化的可学习参数，实现早期受益于专家、后期完全独立且超越专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从零开始的大规模并行策略强化学习（如PPO）样本效率低，且无法利用可能存在的次优专家（启发式、模型控制器、相关任务策略）。这类专家可用于指导早期训练，但其次优性限制最终性能，因此需要在专家指导与奖励学习之间取得平衡。

Method: 让学习者和专家在每个训练回合内交替控制，并将专家的控制占比作为单个可学习参数，与策略使用同一条on-policy目标联合优化（而非混合权重、调度、评估驱动课程或额外学习组件）。

Result: 在两个基准的34个任务上（含离散与连续动作空间、学习型与基于模型的专家），方法在样本效率上优于有指导和无指导基线，且超参数调整需求极小；专家控制占比随学习者进步衰减至零。

Conclusion: 通过用同一on-policy目标联合优化专家控制占比，学习者在早期获得专家指导、随能力提升而减少依赖，最终完全独立行动并超越次优专家。

Abstract: With massively parallel simulation, on-policy Reinforcement Learning methods such as PPO have become standard in many domains. However, learning from scratch is sample-inefficient and fails to exploit the potential existence of a suboptimal expert, such as a heuristic, a model-based controller, or a policy trained on a related task. Such an expert is often available and can guide early training, but its sub-optimality limits final performance. The challenge then becomes balancing expert guidance against learning from rewards. Existing methods set the expert's influence through a blending weight, a schedule, or an evaluation-driven curriculum. Alternatively, they adapt it with additional learned components such as critics over expert actions or auxiliary agents. However, none optimizes it using the same on-policy objective as the policy itself. We propose a method in which the learner and the expert alternate control within each training episode, and the expert's share of control is a single learnable parameter optimized jointly with the policy. The learner benefits from the expert early in training, but its share of control declines as the learner becomes more competent, until eventually vanishing completely. This leaves the learner acting alone and better than the suboptimal expert. We evaluate our method on 34 tasks across two benchmarks, spanning discrete and continuous action spaces, using both learned and model-based experts. Our method improves sample efficiency over guided and unguided baselines while requiring minimal hyperparameter variation. The expert's share decays to zero as the learner improves, vanishing when the expert is no longer useful.

</details>


### [510] [Joint Precision Neural Networks: Task-Aware Dependency and Predictive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06023)
*Andrea Cavallo,Samuel Rey,Antonio G. Marques,Elvin Isufi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出精度神经网络（PNN）与联合优化框架 PNN-Joint，通过交替优化联合估计稀疏精度矩阵与图神经网络权重，实现任务感知的图推断，在合成及真实数据上兼具可解释性、鲁棒性与竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从数据中挖掘有意义的潜在结构是信号处理与机器学习的基础难题。PCA 与协方差神经网络（VNN）依赖协方差矩阵，只能捕捉直接与间接相关性；精度矩阵（协方差逆）可显式编码条件独立性，但有限样本下估计极不稳定，且现有正则化估计器与具体任务无关。

Method: 核心贡献是任务感知的图推断：(1) 提出 Precision Neural Networks（PNNs），一类在精度估计器上运算的图卷积网络，并建立其与 PCA、VNN 的谱联系及对有限样本误差的稳定性；(2) 提出 PNN-Joint，通过交替优化联合估计稀疏且具统计依据的精度矩阵与 GNN 权重。

Result: 在合成数据以及真实神经影像与运动传感器数据集上的大量实验表明：PNN-Joint 能给出高度可解释的任务感知图，在低数据量情形下鲁棒性显著，并在真实任务中稳定取得最优或次优性能。
